meaning: n. （文章的）段，段落；段落符号；短评；v. 把（文章）分段

meaning: prep. 没有，缺乏；不使用，不借助；在没有（发生或做某事）的情况下；没有，不带（某种感情）；不和……在一起，无……相伴；在外面，在外部；adv. 没有，缺乏；在外面；conj. （方）不那样的话；除非，如果不；n. 外部，外面

meaning: n. 成年女子，妇女；（泛指）女性；带修饰语指来自……（或做……、喜欢……等）的女子；女工，女仆；妻子，女友，情人；（盛气凌人的称呼）女人；v. 使女性化；配备女性员工；使（某人）与女性交往

meaning: det. 双方，两者；pron. 两者；conj. …和…都；……和……都；adj. 两…，双…

meaning: n. 光，光线；光源（如电灯）；某种光亮；交通信号灯；车灯；打火机，点火器； 角度，（事物呈现的）状态；眼光，处世标准（lights）；（对问题的）了解，启迪；眼神；亮色，浅色；窗，天窗，采光口；直棂窗窗玻璃上的竖框；杰出的人，有声望的人；（字谜游戏中的）待填空格；adj. 浅色的，淡色的；采光好的，光线足的；天亮的，白天的；轻的，不重的；分量不足的；轻型的，轻便的；少量的，程度低的；不严厉的；（风）轻柔的；轻声的；（碰触）轻轻的；不累的，轻松的；不严肃的，愉快的；单薄的，不保暖的；（睡眠）不深的，易醒的；（饭食）简单的；酒精含量低的，低度酒的；（食物）清淡的，易消化的；（食物）松软的；（土地）轻质的；（字体）细体的；v. （使）照亮；（使）燃烧，点燃；用光指引；点烟；adv. （旅行）轻装地；轻地；【名】 （Light）莱特（人名）
definition: 1. n. (physics) electromagnetic radiation that can produce a visual sensation；2. v. make lighter or brighter
example: What do we make of these allusions to divine colleagues or subordinates in light of Kaufman's claims regarding biblical monotheism?
exampleZh: 参照考夫曼的一神论主张，我们如何理解这些暗示？,他们的地位等同于，还是次于上帝？

meaning: v. 阅读，读懂；朗读；（在书籍、报纸等中）读到，看到；解读，（按某种方式）理解；看透（想法或心思）；读起来（给人以某种印象）；有……的字样，写着；换用，改作（用于订正讹误）；读取（磁盘中的信息）；（通过无线电）收听到，听明白；（测量仪器）指示，显示；看（度量仪器显示的数字）；攻读；将（议案或其他法令）提交立法机构；n. 阅读，阅读时间；读物；解释，阐明；adj. 博学的，有学问的；【名】 （Read）（英）里德（人名）
definition: 1. n. something that is read；2. v. interpret something that is written or printed
example: If you're looking to have an opportunity for a personal reflective... I read this on a retreat last year.
exampleZh: 如果你想进行一下自我反省。。。,我去年在度假时读了这本书。

meaning: conj. （说明原因）因为，由于；（作出解释）因为
definition: 1. abstract: "Because" is a song by The Dave Clark Five, recorded in 1964. Originally the B-side to "Can't You See That She's Mine" in the United Kingdom, "Because" was released as a single in the United States and reached number three on the Billboard Hot 100 chart.
example: Because most of the people there didn't really need it because they have cars, or they just take taxis.
exampleZh: 因为那里的大多数人并不真正需要它，因为他们自己有车，或者会直接打车。

meaning: v. 增长，增强，增大；n. 增长；增长量；【名】 （Increase）（英、美、印、尼日尼亚）英克里斯（人名）
definition: 1. n. a quantity that is added；2. v. become bigger or greater in amount

exampleZh: 对于孤立系统,决定一个过程是否自发发生的判据为：,熵必须增加。

meaning: det. 许多；pron. 许多；优秀的事物；adv. 非常；用在否定句末表示相反的意思；优秀的事物；经常；很大程度上；长时间地；多达（强调数量大得惊人）；【名】 【名】（Much）人名；（德）穆赫；（英）马奇；（Much）人名
definition: 1. n. a great amount or extent；2. adj. (quantifier used with mass nouns) great in quantity or degree or extent

meaning: adv. （指过去）当时，（指将来）到那时；接下来，然后；因此，既然如此；另外，还有；总之；（表示交谈、陈述等的开始或结束）那么；这么说（用于表示对已知情况的判断或询问）；毕竟，话说回来；adj. 当时（任职等）的

meaning: prep. （空间上）在……中间；（时间上）在……之间；（数量、重量、距离等）介于……之间；分隔着；（表示两方或多方关系）在……之间；合用，共享；通过共同努力，一起；（两人）私下间；往返于；adv. （空间或时间上）介于……之间（in between）
definition: 1. adv. in the interval；2. adv. in between
example: The relation between the speech sounds it's like the relation, as I'm saying, between the boy and the birches.
exampleZh: 语言韵律和,就像这种关系，像我说的，像孩子和桦树的关系一样。

meaning: n. 脑；智力，智慧；聪明的人，智者；电脑；（供食用的）动物脑髓；v. 猛击……的头部；【名】 （Brain）（英）布雷恩（人名）
definition: 1. n. that part of the central nervous system that includes all the higher nervous centers; enclosed within the skull; continuous with the spinal cord；2. v. hit on the head
example: So imagine that over the weekend, the mad scientist copied my memories, beliefs,desires,fears,ambitions,goals, intentions and imprinted that on somebody else's brain.
exampleZh: 想象一下一个周末，某个疯狂科学家复制了我的记忆，信仰，欲望，恐惧，野心，目标，以及意向，并植入另一个人的大脑。

meaning: n. （非正式的）谈话，交谈；社交，交际
definition: 1. n. the use of speech for informal exchange of views or ideas or information etc.
example: So if you answer the phone, you'll be saving me from a long conversation that will last ten hours.
exampleZh: 如果你去接电话的话，我就可以免于一段又臭又长的谈话的痛苦了。

meaning: n. 地点，场所；城镇（或建筑物等）；有某用途的建筑（或土地）；表面的某处；家，住所；（书本或讲话中的）点；座位，位置；地位，资格；机会，名额；适当的地方；境况；排名；第二名；（数学的）位；广场，短街；乡间住宅；一套餐具；v. 放置；使处于某种境地；以某种态度对待（或看待）；认出，想起；下指示，请求；安置；排名，归类；（赛跑）获前三/四名；定位球得分；证明……在场；【名】 （Place）（罗）普拉切，（法）普拉斯，（英）普莱斯（人名）
definition: 1. n. a point located with respect to surface features of some region；2. v. put into a certain place or abstract location
example: The metropolis, well, it's a place of ambivalence, a place of promise and of threat, of exultation and also of dread.
exampleZh: 都市是一个自相矛盾的地方，既有希望，又有威胁，喜悦与恐惧相伴而存在。

meaning: n. 银行；储蓄罐；库存，库；河岸；斜坡；云团，雾团；一排，一组；庄家的赌本；（泥）滩，沙洲；v. 把（钱）存入银行，把……储存入库；与银行有业务往来；（飞机）倾斜飞行；使反弹；（把某物）堆积起来，聚集起来；（用煤等）封炉火；【名】 （Bank）（英、德、俄）班克，（法、匈）邦克（人名）

example: But I was not worried because I still have more than half of the cash in my bank account.
exampleZh: 但我并不担心,因为公司的银行账户上还有60多万美元。

meaning: n. 工作，职业；零工，任务；职责，责任；罪行，（尤指）盗窃； 东西，物件；费力的事；幸运的事；刺，捅；东西，物件；v. 刺，捅；（尤指经纪人小规模操作）买卖股票；欺骗，出卖；假公济私，营私舞弊；【名】 （Job）（英）乔布，（法、葡）若布，(?-1605)约伯俄罗斯正教会莫斯科牧首，（德、塞、捷、荷、意）约布（人名)
definition: 1. n. the principal activity in your life that you do to earn money；2. v. profit privately from public office and official business

meaning: adv. 向下，倒下；翻过，翻转；越过；超过，以上；完全覆盖；在上方；剩下，余下；再，又；改变，掉换；结束，完；去，到（某处）；很，太；仔细地；度过一段时间；prep. 盖在……上面；悬在……上面；从一边到另一边；翻越；在……的对面；从……落下；遍及；超过，多于；控制，支配；在……期间；渡过（难关等）；由于，关于；利用，通过；声音大于；胜过，优于；尽管；漏掉，略过；除以；n. （板球）一轮投球；adj. 结束的；剩下的；v. 越过；【名】 （Over）（美、英、德）奥韦尔（人名）

meaning: v. 有，拥有； 承认；为（某事）承担全责，承认为（某事）负全责； 彻底击败，彻底羞辱；adj. 自己的，属于自己的；自己做的，为自己的；具有自己特点的，特有的；pronoun. 自己的，属于自己的；自己做的，自己生产的；具有自己特点的，特有的；【名】 （Own）（阿拉伯）奥恩（人名）
definition: 1. v. have ownership or possession of；2. adj. belonging to or on behalf of a specified person (especially yourself); preceded by a possessive

meaning: n. 城市，都市；市民，全市居民；市政府；充满……的地方；伦敦金融、商业区；（国王或女王授权的）特许市；（由州政府划定市界并授予特权的）特权市
definition: 1. n. a large and densely populated urban area; may include several independent administrative districts；2. n. an incorporated administrative district established by state charter

exampleZh: 这是一座现代化的城市，并不是破碎或绝望的场景，而是一座在上升的渴望之城。

meaning: n. 社区，社会；（由同国籍、同宗教等构成的）群体，界；（多个国家的）共同体；归属感；（动植物的）群落
definition: 1. n. a group of people living in a particular local area；2. n. a group of people having ethnic or cultural or religious characteristics in common

meaning: n. 声明，报告；说明，说法，表态；结算单，报表；（某观点的） 表达；（嫌犯或证人向警方提供的） 陈述，证词；（文字）陈述，表述；评估报告（英国地方教育主管部门针对儿童的特殊需要而提出意见）；（乐）（作品主题或旋律的）呈现；（计算机程序中的）语句；vt. 对儿童进行特殊教育评估认定
definition: 1. n. a message that is stated or declared; a communication (oral or written) setting forth particulars or facts etc；2. n. a fact or assertion offered as evidence that something is true

meaning: v. 变得，变成，成为；适合，使显得漂亮

example: The martyrs in the Easter Rebellion of 1916 become ancient Irish warriors, and we'll talk about that next time.
exampleZh: 916年复活节起义中的烈士6,化身为古代爱尔兰骑士，这个我们下次课再谈。

meaning: n. 庄稼；（谷物或水果的）收成，产量；（同时涌现的）一批，一帮；平头，短发；（尤指头发）大量，丰富；短马鞭；（鸟的）嗉囊；（农场一年的）牲口总数；鞣制的整张兽皮；v. 剪短；剪裁（照片）；（牲畜）啃吃（草）；种植（庄稼）；收获

meaning: v. 感受到，体会到；觉得，相信；使人感觉……；察觉到，意识到；触摸；受到；摸索；有知觉，能感知……；n. 感觉，气氛；触觉，手感；触摸；感知，理解；熟练使用；特性，特质

exampleZh: 我们觉得我们认识的事物,都是事物真实的本质。

meaning: n. 月亮，月球；月光；卫星；月份；渴望之物；月状物；v. 懒散度日，浪荡；出神，呆视；（向某人）亮屁股；虚度（时间）；【名】 （Moon）（英）穆恩，（瑞典）莫恩，（柬）蒙，（缅）孟（人名）

meaning: aux. （表示必要或很重要）必须；（用于表示肯定推测）一定，谅必；（提出建议）应该；（用于表示意图）一定要，坚持要；（用于表示同情）必定；（用于问句中表示生气）非要 ；（用于感叹句，表示惊讶或震惊）一定是；n. 必不可少的事物；（发酵前或发酵中的）葡萄汁；潮气，霉菌；（尤指发情期的公象、雄骆驼等的）狂暴状态（=musth）；【名】 （Must）（美）穆斯特（人名）
definition: 1. n. a necessary or essential thing；2. adj. highly recommended

meaning: n. 东西，物；（无生命的）物体，物件；个人物品，衣物（things）；器具，用品（things）；情形，事件；行为，活动；想法，观点；情况，形势（things）；……之类的东西，特定的事物；需要的东西，适当的东西；事实本身；（生活的）方面；目标，目的；生物，有生命的东西；家伙，东西（指人或动物，常带感情色彩）；（用于强调）任何东西；（某人喜欢或擅长的）事情；（对某事物或某人的）喜欢，憎恶；烂东西，破烂玩意儿
definition: 1. n. a special situation；2. n. an action

meaning: conj. 是否（表选择或可能性）；不管，无论；pron. 两个中的哪一个

meaning: n. 作者，著者；作家；发起者，创始人；作品；v. 撰写，写作；发起，创造

meaning: n. 最后部分，末尾；结束，结局；端点；目的；剩余物，残余；过世；部分，方面；半边球场；城区；边锋；v. 结束，终止；【名】 （End）（英、德）恩德（人名）

meaning: n. 钱，钞票，货币；财产，财富；款项，金额；工资，薪金；【名】 （Money）（英）莫尼，（西、法）莫内（人名）

definition: 1. n. harmony of people's opinions or actions or characters；2. v. go together
example: He did not quit as France's prime minister of his own accord.
exampleZh: 他不是自愿地辞去法国总理一职的。

meaning: det. （同类的）另一，又一；（不同类的）另外一个，其他一个；类似的（人或事物）；pron. 又一个，再一个；另一个，另一种；不确切的事物，某些事物（用于与 one 或 some 构成的短语）；adj. 再加一个的；另一的，不同的；另一类似的
definition: 1. adj. any of various alternatives; some other
example: So maybe what we have here is another polemic,another adaptation of familiar stories and motifs to express something new.
exampleZh: 所以，也许这又是另一场辩论,又是对我们所熟悉故事的颠覆。

meaning: n. 气候；气候区；氛围，局势
definition: 1. n. the weather in some location averaged over some long period of time；2. n. the prevailing psychological state
example: We have modern patterns of climate, vegetation and fauna, so the climate conditions were somewhat similar to today.
exampleZh: 那时有现在的气候模式,植被和动物群,因此气候条件在某种程度上和现在差不多

meaning: n. 一天；白昼，白天；工作日，一天的活动时间；时期，时代；如今，现在；（过去或将来的）一天；重大日子；太阳日；恒星日；（天体）白昼；日光；adj. 白昼的，日间的；（人）日间工作的，上白班的；【名】 （Day）（英、法、西）戴，（越）岱，（阿拉伯、土）达伊（人名）
definition: 1. n. time for Earth to make a complete rotation on its axis；2. n. some point or period in time
example: They are very aggressive to be type-A people who just simply made two extra hours out of their 24-hour day.
exampleZh: 他们渴望成为上等人,甚至希望每天,能多过两个小时。

meaning: n. 能力，力气；精力，活力；能源；能，能量
definition: 1. n. (physics) the capacity of a physical system to do work; the units of energy are joules or ergs；2. n. forceful exertion
example: I want to go back to our energy level diagrams and see if I can rationalize energy level diagrams.
exampleZh: 让我们往回看，回到我们的能级图表,来看看我是否能使能级图表合理化些。

meaning: n. （协同工作的）系统；（计算机、警报器等的）系统；体制，制度，方式，方法；现行体制，既成制度（the system）；身体，（器官）系统；人体的活动方式（尤指消化和排泄方式）；（度量，分类中的）方法（或规则）；条理，秩序；（交通、通信）网，网络；（地质）（年代地层学用语）系；（天文）系；下赌注法；（乐）用弧线连为一体的谱表；晶系（crystal system 的简称）
definition: 1. n. a group of independent but interrelated elements comprising a unified whole；2. n. instrumentality that combines interrelated interacting artifacts designed to work as a coherent entity
example: Thermodynamics is asking you, what work does this thing do on the surroundings or the surroundings do on the system?
exampleZh: 热力学在问你们，到底是系统对环境做功,还是环境对系统做功？

meaning: v. 倾向于，往往会；照顾，护理；走向，趋向；招待，照料（商店、酒吧等的顾客）
definition: 1. v. have a tendency or disposition to do or be something; be inclined；2. v. have care of or look after
example: I think the main difference is Australians tend to mumble a little bit and to draw out their vowels,
exampleZh: 我想，主要的区别是澳大利亚人习惯说话有点含糊，而且突出元音发音，

meaning: v. 理解，懂得；了解，明白（某事物）；谅解，体谅；得知，听说；默认，默许；领会，推断出；解释
definition: 1. v. know and comprehend the nature or meaning of；2. v. perceive (an idea or situation) mentally
example: OK, important -- if you are part of this group here think about it and make sure you understand that.
exampleZh: 好的，这很重要，如果刚才你选了可逆过程,请好好想想并且保证已经理解了这个问题。

meaning: n. 记录，记载；（某人或某物过去的）记录，经历；（尤指体育运动中的）最佳纪录，最好成绩；唱片；前科，犯罪记录；唱片乐曲；（计算机）记录（指作为一个单位处理的一批相关信息）；v. 记录，记载；录制；（仪器）显示，标示；（尤指体育上）获得（好成绩）；发表正式（或法律方面的）声明，申明；演奏音乐供录制；adj. 创纪录的；【名】 （Record）（美）勒科尔（人名）
definition: 1. n. anything (such as a document or a phonograph record or a photograph) providing permanent evidence of or information about past events；2. v. make a record of; set down in permanent form
example: and ended up owning record companies and radio stations and airline companies and those kind of thing.
exampleZh: 最后拥有了自己的唱片公司、广播电台和航空公司，诸如此类的东西。

meaning: adj. 同一的；一模一样的；没有变化的；独一无二的人（或物）；上述的（this/that same）；pron. 同样的人，同样的事物；（数目、颜色、大小、质量等）相同；（与前述之事）同样的事（the same）；未改变的人（或事物），和从前一样的人（或事物）；adv. 同样；【名】 （Same）（意）萨梅（人名）
definition: 1. n. a member of an indigenous nomadic people living in northern Scandinavia and herding reindeer；2. adj. same in identity
example: So Roth imagines lived life as fictional in the same register as a novel, in the same register as an autobiography.
exampleZh: 所以罗斯想像过的生活就像小说中记录的那样，一如自传所述。

meaning: adj. 小型的；（数量）少的；小规模的；无关紧要的，不重要的；幼小的，年幼的；（字母）小写的；（嗓音）微弱的，轻柔的；一般的，非极端的；出丑的，羞愧的；n. 小件衣服（尤指内衣）（smalls）；后腰（the small of the/sb.'s back）；小费，小额礼金（smalls）；小件物品；矮小的人；adv. 成小块地；小小地；【名】 （Small）（英）斯莫尔（人名）
definition: 1. n. the slender part of the back；2. adj. limited or below average in number or quantity or magnitude or extent
example: I basically gave them free ray at the beginning, so they work in small groups, and travel from site to site.
exampleZh: 在最初，我给了他们充分的自由，孩子们组成学习小组，在各地游览。

meaning: pron. 某事，某物；……或诸如此类的东西，……什么的；大致，大约，左右；什么什么（用于表示不记得人名、数字的余下部分或歌词等）；还算幸运的事；重要的人（或事）；（想法或建议）有道理，值得考虑；有点儿，有几分；adv. 稍微，有点；很，非常
definition: 1. n. a thing of some kind
example: How do you influence the way people connect the way they think about something and the way they act about something.
exampleZh: 您是怎样影响人们,让人们将其所想与,所为联系起来的呢？

meaning: v. 谈话，交谈；说，讲述；（会）讲（某种语言）；发言，演讲；（不用言语）表明，显示；代表……讲话，充当……的代言人；（发言或写作中）提到，谈及；以……方式说；表达（思想、观点）；（乐器或其他物体）发出特有的响声；（猎狗）吠
definition: 1. v. express in speech；2. v. exchange thoughts; talk with
example: or it's a moment where you're both feeling opened and available to speak about what the other person looks like.
exampleZh: 或者是在你们彼此都感觉轻松坦率，因而可以评价对方的样子的时候。

meaning: v. 度过，花（时间）；花（钱），花费；消耗，用尽（精力等）；n. 花费，开销；n. 预算
definition: 1. v. pass (time) in a specific way；2. v. pay out
example: We aren't very wealthy, so we don't have enough money to spend on that even if I wanted to.
exampleZh: 我们不是很富有，所以即使是我想买，我也没有足够的钱去买。

meaning: adv. 还，依旧；仍然，还是（会或可能）；尽管那样，尽管如此；更加，还要（用于表示强调）；还有（更多）；静止地，不动地；adj. 静止的，不动的；宁静的，寂静的；无风的；不含碳酸气的，不起泡的；（照片）静态的，（画面）定格的；n. （电影或录像的）定格画面，剧照；（制酒的）蒸馏器；静止，安静，平静；v. （使）静止，平静，安静；使（感情）减轻，使（感情）平息；蒸馏；【名】 （Still）（英、芬、瑞典）斯蒂尔，（德）施蒂尔（人名）
definition: 1. n. a static photograph (especially one taken from a movie and used for advertising purposes)；2. v. make calm or still
example: Host: Flashback 29 years ago, and put yourself in the seat here and pretend you were still in school.
exampleZh: 主持人：回首29年前，假装你还坐在这儿,还在商学院念书。

meaning: v. 情态动词 can 的否定式：不能，无法，不可能；不可以，不允许；用于 cannot help doing、cannot help but、cannot but 等结构，表示“不得不，禁不住，忍不住”
example: Every city has their own unique qualities and things to do, so I cannot really say a specific city.
exampleZh: 每一座城市都有自己的特质和可以做的事情，所以我说不出具体哪个城市最好。

meaning: v. 创造，创建；设计，创作；造成，引起；授予，册封；大惊小怪，抱怨
definition: 1. v. make or cause to be or to become；2. v. bring into existence
example: but what works for me the best is to really step out of this sort of need to create
exampleZh: 但是对我来说最有用的方法，就是要走出一种必需创造的意念

meaning: n. 事实，真相；现实
definition: 1. n. a piece of information about circumstances that exist or events that have occurred；2. n. a statement or assertion of verified information about something that is the case or has happened
example: What may be most important here is the mere fact that Milton is expressing these political convictions at all.
exampleZh: 这里最重要的不过是,弥尔顿只是在表达他的政治信念。

meaning: adj. （尺寸、范围、容量）大的；广泛的，重要的；身材高大的；（公司或组织）大规模的；n. 大号，同类中最大者；v. （尤指跳舞和饮酒）作乐，狂欢；adv. 夸大地；大大地；【名】 （Large）（英）拉奇，（法）拉尔热（人名）
definition: 1. n. a garment size for a large person；2. adj. above average in size or number or quantity or magnitude or extent
example: We're moving into the large on-term across next term where we'll teach 600 students in six sections, of about 100 each.
exampleZh: 我们准备下学期,搬去更大的地方,就能一次教六个班的学生，每个班100人左右。

meaning: n. 注意；注意力；照料；兴趣；立正；殷勤，关心
definition: 1. n. the process whereby a person concentrates on some features of the environment to the (relative) exclusion of others；2. n. the work of providing treatment for or attending to someone or something
example: and they put a very simple idea forward, it captures my attention and I continue thinking about it.
exampleZh: 他们提出一个很简单的想法，吸引了我的注意力，让我一直思考着它。

meaning: adj. 数字的，数码的；数字显示的；指头的，手指的；n. 数字电视，数位电视
definition: 1. adj. of a circuit or device that represents magnitudes in digits；2. adj. displaying numbers rather than scale positions
example: Like, it's really good to have a digital camera because you can see like directly what the image is like.
exampleZh: 数码相机很好，因为你可以立刻看到照片怎么样。

meaning: adv. 然而，可是，不过；无论如何；（用于表示惊讶）究竟怎样；……左右，……上下；conj. 不管怎样，无论如何；然而，可是
definition: 1. adv. despite anything to the contrary (usually following a concession)；2. adv. by contrast; on the other hand
example: However, your friend might think that what you're talking about is more important than the project that you're discussing.
exampleZh: 然而，你的朋友可能觉得你们谈论的内容比项目更为重要。

meaning: n. 想法，主意；观点，看法；原则，信念；理解，了解；猜想；目标，意图；（柏拉图哲学）理念
definition: 1. n. the content of cognition; the main thing you are thinking about；2. n. a personal view
example: It is a transnational idea, in other words, which nevertheless has, obviously, certain specific applications depending on where it is.
exampleZh: 这是一个跨国的概念，但是很明显，它也有其明确的地区性。

meaning: adv. 代替，顶替，反而
definition: 1. adv. in place of, or as an alternative to；2. adv. on the contrary
example: Let's imagine maybe instead we just immediately dropped the pressure let the system expand against the lower pressure.
exampleZh: 现在假设,我们很快地降低压力,让系统在低的外压力下膨胀。

meaning: v. 共享，合用；分享；分配；分担（责任），分摊（费用）；共同拥有（看法、特质或经历）；倾诉，吐露；n. 股份，股票；（共有财产的）部分所有权；责任，贡献；份额；（某物的）一个合理（或正常）的量；【名】 （Share）（美）沙雷（人名）
definition: 1. n. any of the equal portions into which the capital stock of a corporation is divided and ownership of which is evidenced by a stock certificate；2. v. have in common
example: We should be going to 55 minutes after the hour, so I have something to share with you.
exampleZh: 我们上了一个小时55分钟了，我有些事要和你们分享。

meaning: n. 路上行驶的车辆，交通；（沿固定路线的）航行，行驶，飞行；运输量；非法交易；信息流量，通信（量）；v. （非法）进行……交易，做……买卖；在……通行
definition: 1. n. the aggregation of things (pedestrians or vehicles) coming and going in a particular locality during a specified period of time；2. v. deal illegally
example: And you know we have a very dominant traffic share over there, so it's really a very good spot to be in.
exampleZh: 在中国，百度占据着,绝大部分的流量份额，这是一个很吸引人的地方。

meaning: n. 能力，能够；才能，技能，本领
definition: 1. n. the quality of being able to perform; a quality that permits or facilitates achievement or accomplishment；2. n. possession of the qualities (especially mental qualities) required to do something or get something done
example: and I really liked, you know, the material and I felt like I had the natural ability for it,
exampleZh: 我很喜欢课堂上接触到的那些会计知识，而且我感觉我在这方面有天赋。

meaning: v. 开始，着手；开始说；开始发生，开始进行；以……为起点，起始于；首字母为
definition: 1. n. Israeli statesman (born in Russia) who (as prime minister of Israel) negotiated a peace treaty with Anwar Sadat (then the president of Egypt) (1913-1992)；2. v. take the first step or steps in carrying out an action
example: It's one that is maybe initially counterintuitive but actually, I think, is rather important once you begin to think about it.
exampleZh: 乍一听你会觉得不可思议，但是仔细一想就会悟出其中道理。

meaning: n. 原因；事业；理由；v. 引起
definition: 1. n. events that provide the generative force that is the origin of something；2. v. give rise to; cause to happen or occur, not always intentionally
example: So inadvertent sins can be purged, the sanctuary defilement that they cause can be purged by bringing a purification sacrifice.
exampleZh: 无意的罪孽可以被净化，给圣所所带来的玷污,可以通过进行净化祭来净化。

meaning: v. （使）成长，发育，发展；逐渐形成，逐渐养成；开发，研制；出现，产生；修建，开发土地；提高，加强；患病；阐释，展开；冲洗，使底片显影；（修改旋律、和声或节奏以）展开（音乐主题）；（棋）出子
definition: 1. v. make something new, such as a product or a mental or artistic creation；2. v. work out
example: especially as I am trying to develop my own thoughts and my own research questions for my future career.
exampleZh: 尤其是就我未来职业方面，我正在尝试形成自己的观点，提出我的研究问题。

meaning: adj. 全球的，全世界的；全面的，整体的；（计算机）全局的；球形的
definition: 1. adj. involving the entire earth; not limited or provincial in scope；2. adj. having the shape of a sphere or ball
example: On a global scale, 77% of energy is created from fossil fuels.
exampleZh: 全球77%的能量产生自化石燃料。

meaning: n. 社会（以群体形式生活在一起的人的总称）；社群（某国家、地区、时期等的群体组织）；社团，协会；上层社会；交往，相伴；阶层，界；植物的群落，动物的群体
definition: 1. n. an extended social group having a distinctive cultural and economic organization；2. n. a formal association of people with similar interests
example: These materials were transmitted and developed by different circles within Israelite society over centuries, and they crystallized at different times.
exampleZh: 这些资料被传播发展,几世纪来，由以色列社会中的不同圈子，它们曾在不同的时期都非常明确。

meaning: num. 十个，十；adj. 十的；det. 十个；十个（东西）；n. （Ten）（美、俄、加、德、荷、西、英）登（人名）
definition: 1. n. the cardinal number that is the sum of nine and one; the base of the decimal system；2. adj. being one more than nine
example: So if you answer the phone, you'll be saving me from a long conversation that will last ten hours.
exampleZh: 如果你去接电话的话，我就可以免于一段又臭又长的谈话的痛苦了。

meaning: n. 非洲
definition: n. the second largest continent; located south of Europe and bordered to the west by the South Atlantic and to the east by the Indian Ocean
example: So I definitely want to go to places in Asia, Africa, uh, Europe. So, definitely travel a little bit.
exampleZh: 所以，我非常想去亚洲、非洲，还有欧洲。就是想多旅行一下。

meaning: n. 家，家庭；家属，亲属；家族；子女，孩子；（动植物的）科；语族；祖先； 一窝（动物）； 有组织的犯罪团伙；（具有明显共同特征的）一类东西；（在某些方面）像家人一样的一群人；（数）族；派别；氏族；adj. 家庭的；一家所有的；老少咸宜的；全家用的
definition: 1. n. a social unit living together；2. n. primary social group; parents and children
example: He's a black man, and he passes for his whole life as Jewish, and in doing so rejects his family.
exampleZh: 他是黑人，并以犹太人的身份度过一生，这样做受到了家人的反对。

meaning: n. 结果，发现；判决，裁决；（制作服装、鞋子或首饰用的）一应小物件（或小工具）；v. 找到，感到（find 的现在分词形式）
definition: 1. n. the act of determining the properties of something；2. n. the decision of a court on issues of fact or law
example: She moves from interpretation to actually finding the history, and the intertextuality, and the variations of these editions of the play.
exampleZh: 她在从去看阐释的历史，到去探索真相，对文本互涉和，各种版本戏剧得心应手。

meaning: v. 引领，带路；通向，通往；（与……）相连，相通；领导，指挥；导致，造成；促使，使得；过（某种生活）；领先，居于首位；开牌；对（证人）进行诱询；用水砣测深；n. 领先地位；超前量，领先的距离；范例，榜样；线索；主角，扮演主角的演员；铅；铅笔芯；狗绳，牵狗带；（报纸或电台的）要闻，头条；子弹；电线，导线；导语；（投球前跑垒员的）离垒；螺距，牙距；水渠，水道；行间距；【名】 （Lead）（英）利德（人名）
definition: 1. n. a soft heavy toxic malleable metallic element; bluish white when freshly cut but tarnishes readily to dull grey；2. v. take somebody somewhere
example: I think if we force people to vote, it would not lead to a good result.
exampleZh: 如果我们采取强制投票，结果也不会多好。

meaning: n. 数字；编号，序数；电话号码；总量，数量；大量（numbers）；一群人；（杂志的）期，号；（演出中的）一首歌，一段舞蹈；有吸引力的人（或事物）；数，单复数；历史数据（numbers）；数字彩票（numbers）；钱数（numbers）；具有……特征的人；常说的事；v. 标号，编号；总计；包括，列入（某类）；计算，数
definition: 1. n. the property possessed by a sum or total or indefinite quantity of units or individuals；2. v. add up in number or quantity
example: That means that p1 and -- where I am, the point number 1 and point number 2 were completely arbitrary.
exampleZh: 因为1和，两个点是2,陆军上面。

meaning: n. 教师，老师，教员；给人教益的事物
definition: 1. n. a person whose occupation is teaching；2. n. a personified abstraction that teaches
example: You are now a history teacher. But did you ever go to New York museums when you were a student?
exampleZh: 你现在是一个历史老师。但是你做学生的时候，去过纽约博物馆吗？

meaning: v. 长大，成长；成活，生长；发展，增加；逐渐变得；产生，形成；栽种，种植；留长，蓄；变长；【名】 （Grow）（英）格罗（人名）

meaning: v. （使）保持，（使）留在；继续，重复；耽搁，延误；保有，留下；存放，储存；经营，管理；保鲜；保守（秘密）；遵守；记录，记载；饲养；供养；保护；（按规定）纪念，庆祝；守门；尊重（法律或习俗）；n. 生活必需品，生活费用；城堡主楼；【名】 （Keep）（英）基普（人名）

meaning: adj. 可能的，可能做到的；可能发生的，可能存在的；合乎事实的，合理的；尽可能……的；（用于形容词后表示强调）最好的（或最差的等）；可能的（但可能性很小）；（数字或分数）最高的；如果可能的话；n. 可能适合的人（事物）；可能性，能完成的事（the possible）；（尤指射击比赛的）最高分

meaning: n. 项目，计划；（学校的）课题，研究项目；廉租房区，公共房屋区；v. 预计，推算；计划，规划；伸出，突出；投掷，喷射；投射，投影；展现，表现；使（声音，尤指嗓音）扩及远处；传播；想像（自己、场景等）在另一地点或时间；（尤指无意地把情感、愿望）投射转移（给别人）；使（某人）迅速成功，让（某人）获得更好的工作；作（曲线）的射影图；把（地球，天空等）投影在平面上

meaning: n. 句子，句；判决，判刑；命题；v. 判决，宣判，判刑

meaning: v. 提议，建议；推荐，举荐；显示，表明；暗示，暗指；使人想到，使人联想到

meaning: adv. 实际上，事实上；（用于开始新话题）其实；竟然，居然

meaning: pron. 我的；int. 哎呀（表示惊奇等）；喔唷；n. （My）人名；（越）美；（老、柬）米

meaning: n. 技巧， 技艺；（特定的）技术，技能；v. 培训（工人）；【名】 （Skill）（瑞典）希尔（人名）

meaning: v. 旋转，转动；转身，扭转（身体部位）；翻转；旋动，拧动；翻动（书页）；转向，拐（弯）；（路或河流）转弯；对准；（潮）涨落；（使）松开，释放；表演，做；（使）扭转局势；（使）变成，成为；转移（思考、处理、观察等的对象）；求助于，求教于；达到（一定年龄或时间）；（使）反胃，（使）恶心；车削；获得（利益）；扭伤（脚踝）；造（句），组（词）；（印刷）倒排，倒空；包抄（敌军）；n. 转动，旋转；转向；（道路的）转弯处；轮到的机会；（情况的）变化，转变；交替时刻；短小节目；短小节目表演者；散步，转一圈；（疾病的）一阵发作，不适；（影响他人的）举止，行为；吓唬，惊吓；（股票等的）买卖差价；（板球）（球）弹地转向；（一卷绳子等的）一圈；涨潮或落潮；（乐）回音；【名】 （Turn）（德、匈）图恩（人名）

meaning: n. 动物；兽类；衣冠禽兽，畜牲；某一类人或物；adj. 动物的；肉体的，肉欲的；取自动物的；（胚胎）动物极的

meaning: adj. 空白的，空的；茫然的，毫无表情的；单调的，无活动的；断然的，彻底的；n. 空白处，空格；（头脑或记忆）一片空白；空弹；（金属或木头的）坯件，坯料；v. 成为空白，不记得；冷落，不理睬；阻止（对方）得分；切割（金属坯件）；封锁；【名】 （Blank）（英、德、西、俄、罗、捷、瑞典、芬）布兰克，（法）布朗克（人名）

meaning: n. 理解力，领悟力；（听力或阅读）理解测试；包括，包含

meaning: pron. 它自己；它本身（表强调）；与抽象品质名词连用，表示“非常……，是……的化身”；adv. in itself：就其本身而言，本质上；by itself：单独地；自动地；of itself：自行，自发地；v. speak for itself：不言而喻，有目共睹

meaning: n. 语言，语言文字；言语，说话；（某一领域的）全部词汇，术语；计算机语言；语言风格，措辞；粗话，脏话；（使用手势、动作或声音的）表达方式

meaning: v. 开始，着手；（使）发生；发动，启动；创办，开办；出发，启程；以……起步（或起家）；（由……）起，起始；突然一惊，吓一跳；开始抱怨，开始争论；（比赛中）首发上场；（眼睛）突起，鼓出；使松动，使脱落；使（猎物）离巢；n. 开始，开端；启程，启动；（事业的）最初机遇，起步机会；起点（the start）；比赛，上场；突然一惊；领先的时间（距离）；新工作，新企业，新手；先发上场

meaning: n. （尤指困难的或必须定期做的）工作，任务；（尤指语言教学中旨在帮助达到某一学习目的的）活动；v. 派给……任务；对（手段，能力）要求极高，考验

meaning: n. 观点，看法；（理解或思维的）方法，方式；景象，视野；风景，景色；风景画，风景照；图像，视图；（一次）观看，一睹，一览；（文本或图表在计算机屏幕上的）显示方式；v. 看待，考虑；观看；查看，观察；（在计算机屏幕上）阅读，看；看见（狐狸）离开隐藏处

meaning: v. 想要，希望；需要；（用于提出建议）应该；缺少；搜捕，追捕；想见（某人），想与（某人）谈话；（用于疑问句中表示提议或邀请）想要，需要；照料，爱护（小孩）；想要进去，想要出去；应受；n. 缺乏，缺少；贫穷，贫困；渴望的东西，需要的东西

meaning: adj. 单独的，个别的；个人的；独特的，与众不同的；n. 个人，个体；与众不同的人，有个性的人；某种类型的人

meaning: v. 遗失，丢失；失去（某一特性、特点、态度或信念）；被剥夺，被损坏；失去（亲人或朋友等）；输掉（比赛、战斗、争论等）；降低，减少；摆脱，甩掉（追赶者）；使不明白，使迷惑；去掉，拿掉；亏（本），赔（钱）；浪费，错过；（钟、表）走慢；【名】 （Lose）（英）洛斯，（德）洛泽（人名）

meaning: adj. 过去的，昔日的；刚过去的，刚结束的；完成的，结束的；（语法）过去时的；n. 过去，昔日（the past）；往事，经历；（语法）过去时，（动词的）过去式（the past）；prep. 晚于，在…...之后；在…...的更远处；经过，越过；超出，超过；adv. 从一侧到另一侧，经过；（时间）过去，逝去

meaning: n. 美丽，漂亮；美好的事物，上品；美人，美女；魅力，吸引人之处；优点，妙处；美容品，化妆品；adj. （产品、工作或活动）美容的

meaning: n. 作用，影响；（刻意制造的）效果，印象；所有物，财产；生效，实行；v. 实现，引起

meaning: n. 成长，生长；增长，发展；肿瘤，赘生物；生长物，产物；种植，栽培；adj. 发展的，增长的

meaning: n. 自然资源；资源（指钱、物、人等）；有助于实现目标的东西，资料；（对付困境所需的）个人素质（resources）；（逆境中的）出路，应付办法； 谋略，智谋；v. 向……提供资金（或设备）

meaning: n. 杂志，期刊，报纸；日记，日志；（会计）日记账
definition: 1. n. a daily written record of (usually personal) experiences and observations；2. n. a periodical dedicated to a particular subject
example: In the long run, we want The Wall Street Journal and so I guess that-- we just have to accept that.
exampleZh: 但从长远来说,我们需要《华尔街日报》,所以我想,我们必须得接受

meaning: v. （涉及推断）似乎，看来；（用于表示谨慎、礼貌或委婉）好像，可能；【名】 （Seem）（英）西姆（人名）
definition: 1. v. give a certain impression or have a certain outward aspect；2. v. seem to be true, probable, or apparent
example: There are so many entities in this passage that seem to be mysteriously conjoined in some kind of hermaphroditic unity.
exampleZh: 这段里有很多看起来很多实体神秘地,结合在两性的一个结合体重。

meaning: n. 感觉官能（即视、听、嗅、味、触五觉）；（对某物的）感觉；道理，合理性；见识，良好的判断；理智，理性；理解力，判断力；意义，含义；（数，物理）指向，方向；v. 感觉到，觉察到；（机器）检测出；adj. （遗传）有意义的；【名】 (Sense) （美）森斯（人名）
definition: 1. n. a general conscious awareness；2. v. perceive by a physical sensation, e.g., coming from the skin or muscles
example: It is autonomous in the sense that it is a pure, uncluttered and uninfluenced declaration of fact or falsehood.
exampleZh: 科学是自主的，因为,科学就是单纯的,不受外界影响的，关于真伪的论断。

meaning: v. 影响（或决定）……的结果；断定，判定；使下决心；决定，选定；裁决，判决
definition: 1. v. reach, make, or come to a decision about something；2. v. bring to an end; settle conclusively
example: and you sort of just decide if you want to go into litigation, which is the trial and court practice
exampleZh: 你只要决定你想不想参与诉讼，就是审判和法庭程序，

meaning: n. 努力，艰难的尝试；力气，精力；有组织的活动；努力的结果，成就
definition: 1. n. earnest and conscientious activity intended to do or accomplish something；2. n. use of physical or mental energy; hard work
example: so I, you know, I enjoy that sort of intense effort, the sort of adrenaline that goes with the crunch
exampleZh: 我就喜欢那种高强度的努力，那种肾上腺素增长的感觉。

meaning: v. 包含；把……列为一部分，把……算入
definition: 1. v. have as a part, be made up out of；2. v. consider as part of something
example: Moreover, this earthling that seems to include both male and female, is then said to be in the image of God.
exampleZh: 而且，这地球生物中似乎既有男也有女，他们依照上帝的形象。

meaning: v. 听，倾听；听从，听信；努力听，留神地听（listen for/listen out for）；听着；n. 听，倾听
definition: 1. v. hear with intention；2. v. listen and pay attention
example: because I said, "Listen, I got a great idea, let's go for it." And she did exactly what I said.
exampleZh: 因为我说：“听着，我有个好主意，我们研究吧。”我怎么说她就怎么做。

meaning: n. (常sing.) 一群，一批；小块土地；电影摄制场；（汽车经销处的）停车场；拍卖品；全体成员；（尤指不太好的）命运, 处境；签，阄；一群，一批；v. （拍卖前）将（商品）分成批组；pron. 大量，许多；所有，全部；adv. 很多地，非常（a lot）
definition: 1. n. (often followed by `of') a large number or amount or extent；2. v. divide into lots, as of land, for example
example: I listened to a lot of people handing out a lot of advice.
exampleZh: 我听了许多人给予的很多忠告。

meaning: n. 会议，集会；偶遇，会面；与会者（the meeting）；运动会，赛马会；宗教聚会；交锋，比赛；交汇处；v. 会面；会合（meet 的现在分词形式）
definition: 1. n. a formally arranged gathering；2. n. the social act of assembling for some common purpose
example: There's only enough of them to fill a decent sized dining room, but they call themselves the "town meeting."
exampleZh: 人数刚够坐满一间小饭馆而已，但他们却称之为“镇民大会“

meaning: n. 模型；模式；（机器等的）型号；模范，典型；模特儿；样本，范例；（小说中人物或地点的）原型；（著名设计师设计的）款式；v. （为艺术家）当模特儿；模特儿展示（服装）；（用黏土、木头等）做……的模型，塑造；（用计算机）做出（情景、事件）的模型；使仿效，使模仿；adj. 模范的，榜样的；模型的；【名】 （Model）（英、德、俄）莫德尔 (人名)
definition: 1. n. a hypothetical description of a complex entity or process；2. v. plan or create according to a model or models
example: You've got the model solutions, and there will be a test in recitation on Tuesday the 14th based upon that homework.
exampleZh: 你们也有参考答案，在周二的背诵课上会有个测试,就是14号，基于你们的家庭作业。

meaning: n. 观点，论点；要点，核心问题；目的，意图；具体细节；特点，特征；地点；时刻，阶段；得分；小数点，点；罗盘（方位）点；点（标度）；（电影的）利润百分比；尖端，尖头；岬角；光点，色点；插座；（字号的）磅值；轨尖，道岔（points）；（芭蕾）脚尖（points）；（分电器中的）接点；称赞，认可（points）；（板球）防守；尖兵队；排头位置；（动物的）外部位；（猎）直窜（位置）；束衣带；束帆绳；狗指方向；（乐曲的）重要乐句或主题；v. 指，指向；对准，瞄准；朝向，对着；指路；引导，指引；暗示，表明；强调（话语或行动）；（用水泥）勾缝；绷直（脚趾）；削尖；使（光标）指着；插入点号；（狗）示意有（猎物）；【名】 （Point）（法）普安（人名）
definition: 1. n. a geometric element that has position but no extension；2. v. indicate a place, direction, person, or thing; either spatially or figuratively
example: That means that p1 and -- where I am, the point number 1 and point number 2 were completely arbitrary.
exampleZh: 因为1和，两个点是2,陆军上面。

meaning: n. 政策，方针；(处事) 原则，策略；保险单
definition: 1. n. a line of argument rationalizing the course of action of a government；2. n. a plan of action adopted by an individual or social group
example: And all these political considerations or policy considerations, in some ways, are coming together in President Obama's council.
exampleZh: 所有这些政治方面考虑,或政策考虑，在某种程度上，都交给了总统奥巴马的委员会解决。

meaning: adj. 最近的，最新的；（地质）全新世的 （Recent）
definition: 1. n. approximately the last 10,000 years；2. adj. being new in a time not long past
example: I'd like to close with a short story of recent interaction that I had with a video over the internet.
exampleZh: 我想用一个小故事来结束,是最近我关于网络视频的互动作用。

meaning: adj. 强壮的，健壮的；坚固的，结实的；坚强的，有主见的；坚定的，强烈的；有影响的，深刻的；（关系）稳固的，持久的；强有力的，有说服力的；实力强的，厉害的；有望成功的，可能性大的；精通的，擅长的；健康的；味重的；浓的；强效的；明显的，显著的；（货币）坚挺的，（行业）景气的；强劲的，高速移动的；大量的，众多的；多达……的，计有……的；强硬的，冒犯的；（语法）（动词）强变化的，强变格的；（语音学）强读式的，重读的；（物理）强，强相互作用的；adv. 强劲地，猛烈地；n. 强势群体（the strong）；【名】 （Strong）（英）斯特朗（人名）
definition: 1. adj. having strength or power greater than average or expected；2. adj. not faint or feeble
example: These are unquestionably strong words, and I think it's impossible for us to overestimate the weight of these words.
exampleZh: 毫无疑问，这些言辞非常激烈，我觉得,怎么高估它们的分量都不过分。

meaning: n. 缺席，缺勤，不在；缺乏，没有；缺席期间，休假期间；不注意
definition: 1. n. the state of being absent；2. n. failure to be present
example: Purity, which is the absence of impurity, is a prerequisite for access to the holy or for holy status.
exampleZh: 纯洁，不纯的反义词，是接近神圣或达到神圣状态的先决条件。

meaning: n. 年龄，年纪；寿命，（物的）年代；法定年龄；时代，时期；年龄段；很长时间；成长，年老，陈年；（地质）代；v. 变老，老化；（使）显老，（使）苍老；（使）变陈，（使）成熟；推算年龄；【名】 （Age）（西、荷）阿赫，（瑞典）阿格，（日）扬（人名）
definition: 1. n. how long something has existed；2. v. begin to seem older; get older
example: From the point of view of the school age of youngsters' population, there are really, I think, two implicit purposes.
exampleZh: 从青少年的,学龄角度考虑，我想存在两个深层目标。

meaning: adv. 总是，每次都是；一直，长久以来；永远；老是，一再；总还有（表示有另一种可能）
definition: 1. adv. at all times; all the time and on every occasion；2. adv. seemingly without interruption; often and repeatedly
example: It's a persistent problem partly because it always raises these issues of fictionality versus truthfulness, of honesty versus embellishment.
exampleZh: 这是个持久的问题,原因是它一直在质疑虚构性和真实性的关系，还有诚实与修饰的关系。

meaning: prep. 在……当中，周围是；与……在一起；……之一；在……群体中；为……所共有；彼此间；以及
example: Dickens was pre-eminent among English writers of his day.
exampleZh: 狄更斯在其同时期英国作家中最为出色。

meaning: n. 后面，后部；背部；（文件等的）背面；（书等的）末尾；椅背，靠背；后卫；（the Backs）（背向剑河的）剑桥大学后园；adj. 后面的，位于后部的；偏远的，偏僻的；到期未付的，拖欠的；早期出版的，过期的；向后的，相反的；（18穴高尔夫球场的）后9穴的；（音）后位的，舌后的；adv. 回原处，恢复原状；回报，回复；向后；束起 ，收拢；与（某物）有距离，在远处；（将钟表）拨回；在曾去过（或提到过）的地方；回到过去，追溯至；控制住，忍住；归还，取回；再次，又一次；v. （使）后退，倒退；支持，资助；下赌注于；伴奏，伴唱；给……加背衬；在……后面；【名】 （Back）（美）巴克（人名）
definition: 1. n. the posterior part of a human (or animal) body from the neck to the end of the spine；2. v. be behind; approve of
example: So, that's present in all of these moments, but--equally present-- I want to get back to this sense of blankness.
exampleZh: 所以它在这些时候都被呈现了出来，而且是同等地呈现了出来-,让我们回头看看,这种空无一物的感觉。

meaning: v. （使）继续，（使）延续；继续说，接着说；移动，延伸；留任，维持原状
definition: 1. v. continue a certain state, condition, or activity；2. v. continue talking
example: This is a myth that has and will continue to haunt Milton all the way up through Paradise Lost.
exampleZh: 这个神话曾一度而且会一直萦绕着弥尔顿,并贯穿了《失乐园》全诗。

meaning: n. 集体，团体；组，群；集团；乐团，乐队；空军大队（通常由两个或两个以上的基地组成）；（元素周期表中的）族；（系统语法中的）词组；原子团；v. （使）成组，聚集；将……分类
definition: 1. n. any number of entities (members) considered as a unit；2. v. arrange into a group or groups
example: OK, important -- if you are part of this group here think about it and make sure you understand that.
exampleZh: 好的，这很重要，如果刚才你选了可逆过程,请好好想想并且保证已经理解了这个问题。

meaning: n. 习惯；（吸毒、喝酒、抽烟的）瘾；道袍，道服；体质，体型；v. 给……穿衣
definition: 1. n. an established custom；2. v. put a habit on
example: if I could type, in order to just to get into that, in order to get into the habit.
exampleZh: 如果我可以输入，为了不在这里陷入，为了养成这个习惯。

meaning: v. 发生；使遭遇；碰巧；adv. 或许，大概
definition: 1. v. come to pass；2. v. happen, occur, or be the case in the course of events or by chance
example: Just as you are making decisions about your life, where you need to go and what needs to happen next.
exampleZh: 当你正在为自己的人生做决定的时候——你要去哪儿？接下来又会发生什么？

meaning: n. 兴趣，关注；吸引力，趣味；爱好；利息；利益，好处；权益，股权；利害关系，重要影响；利益集团，利益相关者；v. 使感兴趣，引起……的关注；劝说（某人）做（或参与）
definition: 1. n. a sense of concern with and curiosity about someone or something；2. v. excite the curiosity of; engage the interest of
example: They are trained and have an interest in modern poetry, and this is a happy collaboration for me with them.
exampleZh: 他们非常有经验，并且对现代诗歌也有所涉猎，对我而言，能和他们一起工作是很令人开心的。

meaning: n. 成年男子，男人；人类；（不论性别的）人；（来自某地、从事某种工作的）人；（喜欢某事的）人 ； （支持某组织或为其工作的）人；士兵，（男性）工人 ；上门服务的人；伙计，哥儿们；（表示不耐烦或生气）你这家伙；丈夫，男友；男子汉，大丈夫；棋子；头头，老板，警察（the Man）；v. 负责，操控（某物）；int. （表示惊奇、气愤等）嘿，天哪；【名】 （Man）（俄）马恩，（英、葡、意、罗、捷、尼、老、缅、柬）曼，（日）万（人名）
definition: 1. n. an adult person who is male (as opposed to a woman)；2. v. take charge of a certain job; occupy a certain work place
example: De Man does not believe this. De Man thinks, on the contrary, that there is such a thing as literariness.
exampleZh: 德曼不相信这个，反之，他认为，有书面性这种东西存在。

meaning: v. 玩，玩耍；捉弄，戏弄；摆弄，玩弄；耍弄，愚弄；不认真地干，闹（play at）；参加（游戏、比赛等）；与……比赛；击，踢（球）；出（牌），走（棋子）；派（某人）上场；（在球队中）打（某位置）；扮演，演出；佯装，假装；假扮……玩；（戏剧或电影）上演，上映；演奏，弹奏；（使）播放；闪烁，浮现；（以某方式）行事，做事；（使）发射（或喷射、照射）；赌，投机；被接受，被认可；（喻）合作，买某人的账；寄于；让（上钩的鱼）挣扎得筋疲力尽；（板球场状况对比赛）产生影响；n. 剧本，戏剧；游戏，玩乐；比赛；比赛中的动作；（运动或游戏中的）打法，走法；活动空间，间隙；影响，作用；闪烁，变幻；玩笑；（音频或图像的）播放次数，播放时长；播放（功能）；（报纸或电视的）关注；（对文字的）巧用，妙用；【名】 （Play）（法、瑞典）普莱（人名）
definition: 1. n. a dramatic work intended for performance by actors on a stage；2. v. participate in games or sport
example: These are primal forms of play, if you like, ; that suggest forms of poetic activity; also, spiritual activity.
exampleZh: 这是玩最原始的形式，如果你愿意，这种形式显示出了诗歌活动的形式;,还有精神活动。

meaning: n. 空间，空地；（尤指有特定用途的）空位，处所；（公共汽车等的）空座；开阔地，空旷处；开阔，空旷；太空，外层空间；宇宙空间；一段时间；属于自己的空间；空格，空行；版面，篇幅；广告专页，广告插播时间；（乐）（谱表的）线间空白；（电信）空号；v. 把（某物）隔开；在（词语等）之间加空格；变得昏昏沉沉，瞪着眼发呆
definition: 1. n. the unlimited expanse in which everything is located；2. v. place at intervals
example: He separates the waters above and the waters below and creates this space that will become the inhabited world.
exampleZh: 他将天上的水和地上的水分离开来,开创了这个将被居住的世界。

meaning: n. 美术，艺术；艺术品；技术，技巧；人文学科；艺术活动（the arts）；adj. 艺术性的；v. be 的第二人称单数现在式
definition: 1. n. the products of human creativity; works of art collectively；2. n. the creation of beautiful or significant things
example: I like having different art pieces that can interact with the room in a way that are not too intrusive.
exampleZh: 我喜欢拥有不同的艺术作品，它们可以以某种方式和房间交流融合，而不会显得很格格不入。

meaning: adj. 共同的，共享的；常见的，普遍的，一般的；普通的，平凡的；出于礼貌的，起码的；粗俗的，庸俗的；n. 公共用地，公地；校园公共食堂；常识；（基督教教会适用于各种场合的）普通礼拜；平民
definition: 1. n. a piece of open land for recreational use in an urban area；2. adj. belonging to or participated in by a community as a whole; public
example: Their observance protects the holy object from profanation, from being profaned, reverting from holy status back to common status.
exampleZh: 它们按照惯例保护着神圣的东西不受亵渎，不受玷污，不让它们重新回归世俗。

meaning: n. 设计，布局，安排；设计艺术，构思；设计图，图纸；图案，花纹；计划，意图；v. 设计，制图，构思；筹划，制订；预定，指定；【名】 （Design）（俄、巴、印）迪赛（人名）
definition: 1. n. the act of working out the form of something (as by making a sketch or outline or plan)；2. v. make or work out a plan for; devise
example: And then I, I self-publish, so I had to do the design and layout of the book myself as well.
exampleZh: 因为这书是我自己出版的，所以书的设计、排版之类的事情都是我自己亲自做的。

meaning: n. 家，住宅；（可买卖的）房子，寓所；家庭；养育院，收容所；适于存放……的地方；发源地，发祥地；栖息地，生息地；家乡，祖国；（组织、公司等的）本部，基地；（比赛的）主场；adj. 家庭的，家用的；在家里做（或进行）的；本国的，国内的；在主场进行的；总部的；adv. 回家，在家；到正确的位置；朝着球门，进入到球门里；v. 归巢；对准（目标）；把（思想、注意力）集中于；把（动物）养作宠物；【名】 （Home）（德、芬）霍梅，（英、尼）霍姆（人名）

meaning: n. 控制力，操控力；政权，统治；权力，职权；强国，大国；有影响力的人（或组织）；能力，本领；支配力，实力；（某事物或社会集团的）影响力，势力；力量，体能；能量，电力；动力，功率；幂，乘方，指数；放大率；神灵，神力；（基督教）掌权天使（powers）；（旨在提升某群体地位的）权力运动；v. 驱动，推动（机器或车辆）；（使）迅猛移动，快速前进；猛力踢（或推、顶）（尤指球）；adj. 电力的，电动的；强大的；有重要人士参与的；（服装）礼服的，显示权势的

meaning: n. 实践，实际操作；通常的做法，惯例；练习；练习课，固定的训练时间；（医生、律师或其他专业人士的）业务，事务所；诉讼手续，诉讼程序；v. 练习；经常做，养成……的习惯；信奉（宗教）；（医生、律师等）执业，从业

meaning: v. 放，置；使开始；把故事情节安排在；设置；摆放餐具；镶嵌；安排；树立；布置；凝固；使现出坚定的表情；固定发型；把（断骨）复位；排版；为……谱曲；落（下）；布置（戏剧、电影或电视节目的布景）；（断骨）愈合；n. 一组（类似的东西）；一组（配套使用的东西）；一伙（或一帮、一群）人；电视机；布景 ；舞台；（网球、排球比赛等的）盘；集；一组歌曲（或乐曲）；（在某学科上能力相当的）一批学生 ；（尤指坚定的）姿势；头发的定型；凝固；兽穴；（供移植的）秧苗；adj. 位于（或处于）……的；安排好的；固定的；套（餐）；有可能的；不自然的；【名】 （Set）（瑞、以）塞特（人名）

meaning: adv. （用于强调形容词或副词）很，非常；极其，完全地；显著的，典型的；显然，确实，真正地；adj. 同一的，恰好的，正是的；（加强名词的语气）仅仅的，唯独的，甚至于；（强调极限的地点或时间）最……的，极端的，十足的；最远端的，末端的；真正的，真实的；最佳的，最合适的；【名】 （Very）（法、爱）维里（人名）

meaning: adv. 从一边到另一边；在……对面；朝，向；宽；横向字谜答案；prep. 从一边到另一边；横过，穿过；在……对面；遍及；在……上；跨越（政治、宗教、社会隔阂等）

meaning: adj. 独自的；单独的；孤独的，无依无靠的；唯一的；adv. 独自，单独；独力，单干（地）；单，只；仅仅……就

meaning: v. 放，放置；猛推，用力插入；将……送往，安置；使与……连接，安装；写下；使处于（某状态或情况）；使受到……的影响，把……施加给；给予（重视、信任、价值等）；把……视为（或列为）；表述，提出；使工作，使用；投掷（铁饼），推（铅球）；（船）（沿某个方向）行驶；谱曲；n. （铅球或铁饼的）投掷，推；（股票）put option 的简称；adj. 固定不动的；【名】 （Put）（泰、缅）布（人名）

meaning: n. （人、团体、国家等相互间的）关系；（人或事物之间的）关联，关系；恋人关系，性爱关系；血缘关系，姻亲关系

meaning: v. 影响；（疾病）侵袭，感染；（在感情上）深深打动，震撼； 假装，佯装；n. （尤指影响行为或行动的）情感，感情

exampleZh: 那是特区里少有的几个收费博物馆之一，因为它不是国家博物馆。

meaning: n. 音乐，乐曲；乐谱；悦耳的声音；音乐（学），音乐创作（或演奏）技能
definition: 1. n. an artistic form of auditory communication incorporating instrumental or vocal tones in a structured and continuous manner；2. n. any agreeable (pleasing and harmonious) sounds
example: Our brain is really good at kind of absorbing music and lyrics and so if you're trying to focus on that,
exampleZh: 我们的大脑真的很擅长于理解音乐和歌词，所以如果你试着把注意力集中到那个上面，

meaning: adj. （人）……岁的，（事物）存在……久的；年老的，年纪大的；衰老的；古老的，历史悠久的；陈旧的；过去的，从前的；原来（属于自己的）的；结识久的；（表示亲昵）老……；（语言形式）古的，早期的；老派的，守旧的；老一套的，经历多次的；n. 老年人；某个年龄段的人；古时；【名】 （Old）（英）奥尔德（人名）
definition: 1. n. past times (especially in the phrase `in days of old')；2. adj. (used especially of persons) having lived for a relatively long time or attained a specific age
example: The Old Testament prophet had said, "All flesh is grass," an important verse for the new dispensation of Christianity.
exampleZh: 旧约里说，“凡有血气的，尽都如草“,这是基督教教义新体系中的重要一条。

meaning: pron. 用作反身代词，作动词或介词宾语，指包括说话者在内的一组人自身，也可泛指人们；作强调用法时表示“我们亲自”，正式英语中有时代替 us 作宾语；固定搭配 by ourselves 意为“独自地；靠我们自己”，between ourselves 意为“只限于咱们之间；秘密地”。
definition: 1. abstract: Ourselves is a 1988 album by punk band 7 Seconds.
example: We recognize in ourselves a virtue which is considered to be the cornerstone of many systems of moral understanding.
exampleZh: 我们承认我们拥有那种美德，可以作为,许多道德认知体系的基石。

meaning: n. （行为）准则，（道德）原则；道义，正直；基本原则，基本法则；（机器等或自然界的）原理，定律；（宗教或政治的）主义，信条；起源，本原；本质，实质；（化）成分，要素
definition: 1. n. a basic generalization that is accepted as true and that can be used as a basis for reasoning or conduct；2. n. a rule or standard especially of good behavior
example: Cummings actually boldly experimented with this principle and he attracted the attention of the linguists, particularly a linguist named Dell Hymes.
exampleZh: 对此，卡明斯做了一个大胆的试验,吸引了语言学家的注意，特别是德尔海默斯。

meaning: adv. 颇，相当；宁愿，最好（would rather）；而不是；更确切地说；（用以使表达的语气婉转）有几分，有点儿；恰恰相反，而是；int. 当然，的确（表同意）；【名】 （Rather）（英）拉瑟（人名）
definition: 1. adv. on the contrary；2. adv. to some (great or small) extent
example: It's usually best to respond in a complete sentence rather than saying yes or no which can be ambiguous.
exampleZh: 一般来说，回答最好是完整的句子，而不是简单的模棱两可的“是”或“不是”。

meaning: prep. 自……以后，自……以来；（表示气愤）何曾，什么时候；conj. 在……以后，自……以来；因为，由于，既然；adv. 自……以后，自……以来；此后，后来；n. （Since）（法、美）新斯（人名）
definition: 1. abstract: Since may refer to the following places:
example: And so to see somebody so prolific and who's been that way since he was a teenager, I mean,
exampleZh: 所以，（我们）看到这样一个从青年时期就多产的作家，我的意思是，

meaning: adv. 在一起，共同；以使接触（或相结合），到一起；（位置）在一起，紧挨地；关系密切，有婚姻关系；同时，一齐；（团结）在一起，合作地；合计地，总和地；不间断地，接连地；靠着，贴着；adj. 自信而有条理的，沉稳的；（两人）结婚的，有性关系（或恋爱关系）的
definition: 1. adj. mentally and emotionally stable；2. adv. in conjunction with; combined
example: There're also clubs like tennis club that you just get together with people to play a little bit, yeah.
exampleZh: 学校里也有像网球俱乐部这样的俱乐部，你只是跟别人一起打球就行了。

meaning: n. 写作，著书；作品，著作；写，书写；字迹；（书写或印刷的）文字；（某作家或专题的）著作，作品（writings）；v. 写字；写作；写信（write 的现在分词）
definition: 1. n. the act of creating written works；2. n. the work of a writer; anything expressed in letters of the alphabet (especially when considered from the point of view of style and effect)
example: This is a poet who, with his wife, practiced automatic writing, who believed that the dead spoke through the living.
exampleZh: 他是这样的诗人，和他妻子一起，尝试着，自动写作，他们相信死人通过活人说话。

meaning: pron. 你自己
definition: 1. used to refer to the person being spoken to as the object or for emphasis
definitionSource: 人工校订（依据词典义项）
example: You will find this pattern very useful anytime you're not feeling happy about something and you want to express yourself.
exampleZh: 你会发现，当你因为什么事感到低落，你想表达自己的感觉时，这个句型特别有用。
exampleSource: I get so upset 课堂

meaning: adv. 已经，早已；马上，够了（用于表达不耐烦或气恼）
definition: 1. adv. prior to a specified or implied time
example: We have already encountered on some level the importance of the figure of eating to John Milton. Think of Comus.
exampleZh: 我们已经在某种程度上见识到了,对于弥尔顿来说吃的形象的重要性，想想司酒宴之神。

meaning: n. 艺术家，美术家；表演艺术家；大师，行家
definition: 1. n. a person whose creative work shows sensitivity and imagination
example: Even if they are writer or an artist or whatever you are doing, I think it's a very inspiring place.
exampleZh: 即使他们是作家或艺术家，无论你从事什么行业，我想这都是一个非常启发人心的地方。

meaning: v. 声称，断言；索取，索要（钱）；要求（拥有），认领；使丧生，致命；赢得，获得；值得，需要（花时间或精力）；n. 声称，断言；索要，索赔；权利，所有权；要求得到的土地使用权；专利新特征申明
definition: 1. n. an assertion of a right (as to money or property)；2. v. assert or affirm strongly; state to be true or existing
example: Milton elaborates on this claim that we should read and prove anything we want, for we are sufficient to judge aright.
exampleZh: 弥尔顿详尽阐明了这个论点，我们应该多读书,去求证自己想知道的所有事，因此我们才能够做正确的判断。

meaning: n. 担心，忧虑；使人担忧的事物；关心，关爱；重要的事物，关心的事；（某人）负责的事，涉及的事；公司，企业；复杂的物体；v. 有关，关于；涉及，影响；使忧虑，使担心
definition: 1. n. something that interests you because it is important or affects you；2. v. have to do with or be relevant to
example: Another theme in the Book of Deuteronomy is the theme of providential concern, and that appears in Deuteronomy 8.
exampleZh: 申命记》的另一个主题是,对幸运的忧虑，这出现在《申命记》第8章中。

meaning: v. 考虑，斟酌；认为，视为；体贴，顾及；细看，端详；探讨，讨论
definition: 1. v. deem to be；2. v. give careful consideration to
example: With any innovation, it's important not only to launch it properly but also to consider how to sustain it over time.
exampleZh: 对于任何发明，重要的不仅仅是,正确的使用它，还要考虑,怎样维护它。

meaning: v. 包含，容纳；遏制，防止……蔓延；抑制（感情）
definition: 1. v. include or contain; have as a component；2. v. contain or hold; have within
example: This is Barth's effort to enclose the silence into something readable, to contain that impossibility in the structure of the story.
exampleZh: 这是巴斯想把沉默嵌套到某些可阅读的的，在故事的结构中包含一些不可能的努力。

meaning: n. 经济；节省，简练；经济舱；adj. 经济实惠的；【名】 （Economy）（英）伊科诺米（人名）
definition: 1. n. the system of production and distribution and consumption；2. n. the efficient use of resources
example: We need to innovate. We need to have more value-added things in the Chinese economy or in the GDP composition.
exampleZh: 中国需要创新,需要更多高附加值的产品。

meaning: n. 专家，能手，权威；adj. 专业的，熟练的；v. 当专家；【名】 （Expert）（法、印、俄、罗、巴、荷）埃克斯佩（人名）
definition: 1. n. a person with special knowledge or ability who performs skillfully；2. adj. having or showing knowledge and skill and aptitude
example: As an expert in teaching, could you give us some advice on how best to study a language?
exampleZh: 作为一名教育专家，关于怎样才是学习语言的最佳方式，你能给我们一些建议吗？

meaning: v. 降落，落下；跌倒，倒塌；（水平、数量、价格等）下跌，减少；属于；下垂，低垂；照射（到），（阴影）落在；降临，发生；倒台，失势；被打败，沦陷；阵亡，被击毙；打中，击中；（嗓音或声音）变轻，变小；进入（某状态），开始变成（某事物）；n. 落下，跌倒；（数量、水平、价格等的）下降，降低；秋天，秋季；失败，垮台 ；瀑布；（摔跤或柔道项目中的）摔倒，压倒；（雨、雪等的）降落；堕落；【名】 （Fall）（西）法勒（人名）
definition: 1. n. the season when the leaves fall from the trees；2. v. descend in free fall under the influence of gravity
example: And in fact, under type checking, different languages sometimes fall on a spectrum from weak to strong typing.
exampleZh: 实际上，在类型检查的下面，不同的语言会对应着,从弱到强的一个定型范围。

meaning: n. 朋友，友人；（社交网站上的）好友；（与……是） 朋友，朋友关系（friends）；（组织或政治运动等的）支持者，（尤指）赞助者；自己人，同盟者；熟悉（或有帮助）的事物；相识的人，（偶然遇见的）陌生人（常作礼貌称呼语或讽刺用语）；友好国家；（议员间或律师间的一种称呼）朋友，阁下，同人；（基督教）公谊会教友，贵格会成员，教友派信徒（Friend）；v. （在社交网站上） 把（某人）加为好友；与……为友，帮助；【名】 （Friend）（英）弗兰德（人名）
definition: 1. n. a person you know well and regard with affection and trust；2. n. an associate who provides assistance
example: Look now, and this is on the handout, at the letter that Milton had written to his friend, Charles Diodati.
exampleZh: 现在看讲义上,弥尔顿写给朋友查尔斯·迪奥达蒂的信。

meaning: n. 一半，二分之一；半场，半局；（足球、橄榄球等的）中场队员；半品脱；儿童半票；半学年，一学期；（高尔夫）一穴击球得分与对手相等；pron. 一半；（时间）……点半（=half past）；大量，许多；det. 一半；adj. 一半的；不完整的，部分的；adv. 一半地，接近一半地；部分地，不完全地；极其，非常（强调情况很糟）；一半……血统地；【名】 （Half）（英）哈夫，（德）哈尔夫，（阿拉伯）哈勒夫（人名）
definition: 1. n. one of two equal parts of a divisible whole；2. adj. consisting of one of two equivalent parts in value or quantity
example: Okay so exchange numbers; okay good half of that problem is gone now we have just these two left.
exampleZh: 好，交换数字,好，问题解决一半了,只剩你们两个了。

meaning: n. 重要，重要性；傲慢；名望
definition: 1. n. the quality of being important and worthy of note；2. n. a prominent status
example: We have already encountered on some level the importance of the figure of eating to John Milton. Think of Comus.
exampleZh: 我们已经在某种程度上见识到了,对于弥尔顿来说吃的形象的重要性，想想司酒宴之神。

meaning: n. 钥匙；（电脑、打字机或乐器的）键；关键，要诀；答案；音调，声调；图例，符号说明；低岛，礁；扳手；销子，楔；（文章、形势等）主调，基调；（梣树、枫树或无花果树的）翼果；板条间首层灰泥；（有助于石膏等黏附的）粗糙表面；罚球区；v. 键入；成为（获胜）的关键；用钥匙划坏（汽车）；用别针（或楔子、栓）固定；将……的表面处理好；给（广告）加识别编码；adj. 关键的，主要的；【名】 （Key）（美）基（人名）
definition: 1. n. metal device shaped in such a way that when it is inserted into the appropriate lock the lock's mechanism can be rotated；2. v. identify as in botany or biology, for example
example: But what we're trying to do now is identify the key influencers in those merchant areas and make them distribution points.
exampleZh: 但我们现在努力要做的是,在商界确定,最重要的影响因素,让他们变为非配点。

meaning: n. 牲畜，家畜
definition: 1. animals and birds that are kept on a farm, such as cows, sheep, or chickens；2. animals such as cows, sheep, etc. that are kept or traded as a source of income
example: The robots are not limited to herding and monitoring livestock.
exampleZh: 这些机器人并非仅能用于放牧和监控牲畜。

meaning: adj. 活着的，活的；在使用的，在实施的；居住的，起居的；（水）流淌不息的；活跃的；逼真的；n. 生计，收入；生活方式；活着的人（the living）；教区牧师的圣职（圣俸）；v. 居住；生活；生长；继续存在（live 的现在分词形式）；【名】 （Living）（英）利文（人名）
definition: 1. n. the experience of being alive; the course of human events and activities；2. adj. pertaining to living persons
example: He's going to try to give us a living prose, but this is the end against which it finds itself pressed.
exampleZh: 试图给我们一部活生生的作品，但是这中留白成了,他最终努力的结果。

meaning: n. 肉类，（某种）食用肉；重要的部分，有趣的部分；棒球球棒等物体最粗的部分；食物；果肉，坚果仁，（蛋的）可食用部分
definition: 1. n. the flesh of animals (including fishes and birds and snails) used as food；2. n. the inner and usually edible part of a seed or grain or nut or fruit stone
example: It's like when you have too much meat in the city, you decide to not eat any of it, so.
exampleZh: 就像是在城市吃了太多的肉类，于是你决定再也不吃了。

meaning: adj. （产品、服务或信息）在线的，网上的；（计算机）联机的；adv. 在网上，利用网际网路（购买、获得等）；联机地，在电脑操控下；开始运行，存在着
definition: 1. abstract: The term "online" can refer to a state of connectivity.
example: And part of this is happening because of the development of all these wireless networks, miniaturization, things moving online.
exampleZh: 部分原因是,无线网络的发展，微型化的发展。

meaning: n. 产品，制品；（自然、化学或工业过程的）生成物；（特定行动、影响或事件的）结局；（受某种环境或经历影响而形成的）产物；积，乘积；总称（商业性）音乐制品
definition: 1. n. commodities offered for sale；2. n. an artifact that has been created by someone or some process
example: and then use the proceeds, use the profits that you make from selling the product to make the product better.
exampleZh: 然后用得到的钱，用销售产品的收入和利润来改进产品。

meaning: n. 录音，录像；录制；（正式的）记录，记载；v. 记录，记载；录制；（仪器）显示，标示；（尤指体育上）获得（好成绩）（record 的现在分词）
definition: 1. n. signal encoding something (e.g., picture or sound) that has been recorded；2. n. the act of making a record (especially an audio record)
example: That's on tape, that's you know, you get on the early VHS and recording tapes as well, cassette players.
exampleZh: 会卖磁带，你得用早期的家用录像系统、录音磁带或录音机播放。

meaning: v. 减少，降低；（烹调中）使变浓稠，收汁；节食减肥；使沦为，使陷入（不好的境地）；迫使，使不得不（做）；（通过破裂、燃烧等）使变成，使化为；归纳，简化；将分数约到（最小项）；（使）进行还原反应；减薄（底片或图片）；（语音）弱化；使（脱臼，断骨）复位；攻克，征服（尤指围攻并占领城镇或要塞）
definition: 1. v. cut down on; make a reduction in；2. v. make less complex
example: So, The Norton Anthology, this book, this heavy book, I order it as a way to, well, reduce your expenses.
exampleZh: 叫《一首诗的心路历程》，就在这本诺顿诗集里，我自己订购了一本，这样可以减少你们的花费。

meaning: v. 反射（光、热或声音）；反映，照出（影像）；显示，表明；深思，反省；深思后认为，深思后说；引起（某种）看法，带来影响
definition: 1. v. manifest or bring back；2. v. to throw or bend back or reflect (from a surface)
example: Does such an attitudinal change reflect real experiences in daily life?
exampleZh: 人生观的这种转变是否反映了日常生活中的真实经历？

meaning: n. 信号，暗号；标志，预示；（尤指铁路和公路上的）指示灯，信号灯；（无线电、电视等的）讯号，信号；起因，导火线；（桥牌）信号；（传递的）信息；v. 发信号，示意；标志，预示；告知，表示；（车辆转方向时）打灯示意；adj. 重大的，显要的；作为信号的；【名】 （Signal）（瑞典）西格纳尔（人名）
definition: 1. n. any communication that encodes a message；2. v. communicate silently and non-verbally by signals or signs
example: This is a signal - this passing of phosphorous - is a signal that's used very frequently in intracellular communication.
exampleZh: 这是一种信号,一种通过磷酸来传递的信号,这种信号在细胞内通讯时经常被用到

meaning: adv. 仅仅，只，不过；简直，的确； 简单地，简明地；朴素地，简朴地
definition: 1. adv. and nothing more；2. adv. absolutely; altogether; really
example: They are very aggressive to be type-A people who just simply made two extra hours out of their 24-hour day.
exampleZh: 他们渴望成为上等人,甚至希望每天,能多过两个小时。

meaning: n. 情况，形势；重要问题，突发情况；（建筑物或城镇的）地理位置，环境特点；工作，职位
definition: 1. n. the general state of things; the combination of circumstances at a given time；2. n. a condition or position in which you find yourself
example: One is a little bit higher and one is a little bit lower than they are in the atomic situation.
exampleZh: 一个有点高,一个有点低,相比他们是原子状态的情景而言。

meaning: conj. 虽然，尽管；可是，不过；adv. 不过，可是，然而
definition: 1. adv. (postpositive) however
example: That's how this advertisement represents critics, even though it also invokes critics to describe what's powerful about the novel.
exampleZh: 这就是广告对批评的描述，尽管如此,它还引述批评家的话来衬托小说的出色之处。

meaning: adj. 错误的，不合乎事实的；（状况）有问题的，（身体）有毛病的；（决定、选择、行动等）错误的；（言论或想法）错的；不道德的，不能被社会所接受的；不合适的，不适宜的；（机器设备）出毛病的；上下（或前后、里外）颠倒的；adv. 错误地，不符合事实地；（方式或方向）不适当地，不适宜地；出问题；不正当地；n. 坏事，不道德行为， 错误的行为（或情况）；冤枉，不公平的行为；v. 不公正地对待，冤枉；【名】 （Wrong）（美、俄、荷）朗（人名）
definition: 1. n. that which is contrary to the principles of justice or law；2. v. treat unjustly; do wrong to

meaning: n. 照料，护理；小心，谨慎；忧虑，烦恼；收养，监护；v. 照顾，照料；在意，担忧；喜欢，想要；【名】 （Care）（英）凯尔，（塞）察蕾（人名）
definition: 1. n. the work of providing treatment for or attending to someone or something；2. v. feel concern or interest
example: but it's just like a time when they really took the care to look at how to construct things.
exampleZh: 但它代表了一个时期，那时他们真正关注搞建筑的方法。

meaning: adj. 认识的，认知的
definition: 1. connected with thinking or conscious mental processes；2. relating to or involving the processes of thinking and reasoning
example: And our students are probably more cognitive than many young people in our society at this point and they think deeply.
exampleZh: 在这个时代，我们的学生大概,比社会上的许多其他年轻人,更具备认知能力，他们思想深刻。

meaning: n. 排放物，散发物；（尤指光、热、气等的）散发，排放；射精，遗精；发行；【名】 （Emission)（英）埃米申（人名）
definition: 1. n. the act of emitting; causing to flow forth；2. n. a substance that is emitted or released
example: The emission of gases such as carbon dioxide should be stabilized at their present level.
exampleZh: 二氧化碳之类气体的排放应该被控制在目前的水平上。

meaning: adv. 曾经，从来，在任何时候；一直，始终；越来越，愈发；究竟，到底；非常，确实；【名】 （Ever）（英）埃弗，（俄）叶韦尔，（西、法）埃韦尔（人名）
definition: 1. adv. at any time；2. adv. at all times; all the time and on every occasion
example: No English poet before Milton ever suggested that he had been chosen by God at birth to be a poet.
exampleZh: 在弥尔顿之前没有英国诗人敢说,自己是被上帝选中去做诗人的。

meaning: n. 因素，要素；等级，系数；因数，因子；遗传因子，基因；（血液中的）凝血因子；代理公司，代理商；地产管理人，管家；测量水平；v. 把……作为因素计入，把……包括在内（factor in）；把……作为因素排除，不把……包括在内（factor out）；将……分解为因子；代理经营，（代管）产业；做代理商；【名】 （Factor）（英）法克特（人名）
definition: 1. n. anything that contributes causally to a result；2. v. resolve into factors
example: A log algorithm typically is one where you cut the size of the problem down by some multiplicative factor.
exampleZh: 对数级复杂度的算法就是指,通过一系列常量级步数的操作,可以将问题的规模。

meaning: v. 获得，赢得；受益；增加，增长；（经过努力）到达；（钟表）走快；持球前进，推进（一段距离）；n. 增加；好处，改进；收益；将球推进的距离；（常用对数表示的功率或电压的）增益；【名】 （Gain）（英、匈、法）盖恩（人名）
definition: 1. n. a quantity that is added；2. v. obtain
example: Electron affinity is actually the ability of an atom, or we could also talk about an ion to gain electrons.
exampleZh: 电子亲和能其实就是一个原子，或者我们也可以讨论离子获取电子的能力。

meaning: adj. 绿色的；青春的；n. 绿色；青春；vt. 使……变绿色；vi. 变绿色；n. （Green）人名；（英、意）格林；（瑞典、芬）格伦
definition: 1. n. green color or pigment; resembling the color of growing grass；2. v. turn or become green
example: Yeah, I actually, we have a concert here on Main Green once a year called "Spring Weekend"
exampleZh: 是的，我们每年都会在梅因格林举办一场音乐会，叫做“春日周末”，

meaning: n. 温室，暖房；adj. 温室效应的
definition: 1. n. a building with glass walls and roof; for the cultivation and exhibition of plants under controlled conditions；2. adj. of or relating to or caused by the greenhouse effect
example: You can make your flights carbon neutral by planting trees to make up for the greenhouse gas emissions.
exampleZh: 你可以通过种树抵消温室气体排放，这样你的飞行就可以做到碳中和。

meaning: n. 议题，争论点；（报纸、杂志等的）期，号；发放，分配；（新股票或邮票等的）发行；子女，后嗣；流出，发出；结果，后果；v. 发表，颁布；分发，分配；正式发行；流出，发出；由……产生，由……得出
definition: 1. n. an important question that is in dispute and must be settled；2. v. prepare and issue for public distribution or sale
example: So it's a complex issue, and I should leave it having said this much, at least for the moment.
exampleZh: 因此它是一个很复杂的问题，而我就讲到这里，至少暂时这样。

meaning: v. 离开（某人或某处）；离开居住地点（或群体、工作单位等）；与……脱离关系， 离开（某人）；不立刻做，不马上处理；使保留，让……处于（某种状态、某地等）；给……留下（不愉快的东西）；留下（信息或答复）；遗留，遗忘；剩下（食物或饮料）；遗下（家人）；（去世时）遗赠，遗留；把……留交，交托；递送，递交；留（空隙或空白）；留给（指有限的机会）；不再谈论；（数学）剩余，余下；n. 假期，休假；准许，许可；（斯努克、槌球等）收盘球势，（球被击后）停留的位置
definition: 1. n. the period of time during which you are absent from work or duty；2. v. go away from a place
example: and that's spreading. This prosperity preaching is going on in Africa. And my question is, where does that leave suffering?
exampleZh: 这种劲头越来越大，这种追求繁荣的论调,甚至在非洲都出现了，我想问的是，在这样的大背景下，受苦还能存在么？

meaning: v. 保持，维持；维修，保养；断言，主张；赡养，抚养；支持，维护
definition: 1. v. keep in a certain state, position, or activity; e.g.,；2. v. keep in safety and protect from harm, decay, loss, or destruction
example: a lot of people want to maintain the language that their family, either themselves or their parents spoke.
exampleZh: 其中很多人，不管是学生自己还是他们的家长，都想要保留自己种族的语言。

meaning: n. 记忆力，记性；记忆，回忆；（计算机存储器的）存储量；（计算机的）存储器；对死者的记忆；记忆所及的时间（或范围）；【名】 （Memory）（英）梅默里（人名）
definition: 1. n. something that is remembered；2. n. the cognitive processes whereby past experience is remembered
example: Some scholars assume there's a historical memory behind the elaborate and dramatic story of a miraculous redemption by God.
exampleZh: 一些学者假设潜藏着历史记忆,在上帝神奇兑现许诺的详细的戏剧化故事中。

meaning: adv. 决不，永不；不会，不可能（表示惊讶或震惊）
definition: 1. adv. not ever; at no time in the past or future；2. adv. not at all; certainly not; not in any circumstances
example: Now never mind that our own experience with virgins has failed to afford us such a spectacle of bodily transformation.
exampleZh: 没有关系，如果我们关于贞操的知识,之前未能告诉我们如此壮观的身体转换。

meaning: v. 提供，给予；提议，表示愿意（做某事）；出（价），开（价）；提出，作出；表示（爱、友谊等）；（向上帝或神）奉献（祈祷、赞美），祭献（牺牲）； 试图（使用暴力，进行抵抗）；发动，挑起（战争）；把……摆好（或放到位）（以便检测或评估其外观或状况）；（机会）出现；求婚；n. 主动提议，提供； 出价，报价； （商品的）特价，特惠；求婚
definition: 1. n. the verbal act of offering；2. v. make available or accessible, provide or furnish
example: But at the same time, you receive an offer to work at another company that is also very intriguing.
exampleZh: 但与此同时，你也被另外一家公司录用了，这非常吸引人。

meaning: int. 好吗，请（用于客气地请求）；请千万，请务必（用于加强请求的语气）；行，谢谢（用于接受别人的好意）；请别，请不要；得了吧；让我说；v. （使）开心，（使）满意；想，选择，喜欢；请便，随你的便
definition: 1. v. give pleasure to or be pleasing to；2. adv. used in polite request
example: And, by all means, if you are scheduled to attend class at 11:00, please take the test at 11:00.
exampleZh: 当然，如果你安排到11：00参加考试的话，请在11：00参加考试。

meaning: adj. （人）在场的，出席的；（事物）存在的；现在的，目前的；考虑中的，正在讨论的；（语法）现在时（态）的；历历在目的；n. 现在，目前；礼物，赠品；（语法）现在时；（举枪的）瞄准（姿势）；v. 颁发，赠送；出示（护照等供检查）；正式提交（支票，账单）； 正式引见，介绍；正式出席，到场；引起，造成；表达（歉意等）；提出，陈述；上映，播出；展示，表现； 主持（广播或电视节目）；把……对准；（病人）呈现症状
definition: 1. n. the period of time that is happening now; any continuous stretch of time including the moment of speech；2. v. show or demonstrate something to an interested audience
example: So, that's present in all of these moments, but--equally present-- I want to get back to this sense of blankness.
exampleZh: 所以它在这些时候都被呈现了出来，而且是同等地呈现了出来-,让我们回头看看,这种空无一物的感觉。

meaning: adj. 实际存在的，非想象的；名副其实的；真正的，真实的；真的，非人工的；真诚的；强烈的；确实重大的；十足的，绝对的（用来加强语气）；（数量、数字）真实的，实际的；（光学）（图像）实的；（书或电影中的场景）逼真的，似真的；（哲学）实在的；adv. 很，非常地；n. 雷阿尔（巴西1994年以来的基本货币单位，等于100分）；雷阿尔（多个西班牙语国家以前的硬币和货币单位）；【名】 （Real）（德、西、葡、法）雷亚尔，（英）里尔（人名）
definition: 1. n. any rational or irrational number；2. adj. being or occurring in fact or actuality; having verified existence; not illusory
example: I mean it is still like a real big cultural mecca for African American people in New York City.
exampleZh: 对于身在纽约的美国黑人来说，这里仍然是个真正的文化麦加圣地。

meaning: adv. 真正地，事实上；确实的，的确（用于加强语气）；很，十分；（用于带有隐含的否定回答的疑问句和感叹句）真的，是吗；用于缓和否定语气；int. 真的（用来表示兴趣、惊奇或疑惑）；真是的！（用于表示生气或不赞成）；是啊！（用于表示同意某人的意见）
definition: 1. adv. in accordance with truth or fact or reality；2. adv. in actual fact
example: But I had like, really, really big dreams, so I wanted to pursue in New York, which led me here.
exampleZh: 但我有很伟大的梦想，我想在纽约实现这个梦想，这也是我来这里的原因。

meaning: v. （数字、 数量、价值）增加；升高，上升；起身，站起；（权力或地位）提高；耸立，隆起；（声音）变响，变大；（太阳、月亮）升起；（感情或情绪） 变得强烈；（面包、蛋糕等）发酵；起床；复活，再生；休会，休庭；（风力）加强，增强；（河流）发源；起义，反抗；脸红，涨红；（毛发）竖起；（胃）感到恶心；接近（某个年龄）；n. （数量或水平的）增加，改善；加薪；（地位的）升高，增强；上升，升起；小山丘，斜坡；（声音或声调的）提高；源头，起源；兴起，高涨
definition: 1. n. a growth in strength or number or importance；2. v. move upward
example: That would that would give rise to a perpetual motion machine, breaking of the second law. It can't happen.
exampleZh: 否则就会使,得永动机出现，打破第二定律那是不可能的。

meaning: pron. 有人，某人；重要人物
definition: 1. n. a human being
example: It is the most amazing image because amidst of all this chaos, is this image of someone sitting there, breathing.
exampleZh: 那是最神奇的场景,在众多喧哗中，有人静坐呼吸。

meaning: v. 系上，贴上，连接；附上（附件）；赋予，认为……具有； 和……在一起，缠着； 附带（条件)；附属，依附；与……有关联；委派；扣押（债务人或其财产)；使依恋
definition: 1. v. cause to be attached；2. v. be attached; be in contact with
example: And he had to attach something to dogs so that their saliva would pour out so he could study saliva.
exampleZh: 他给狗套上了一些装置,来收集狗的唾液用以研究。

meaning: adj. （Chinese）中国的；中国人的；汉语的；n. （Chinese）中国人，华人；汉语；中餐，中餐馆；n. （Chinese）（美、印、澳、巴）奇内斯（人名）
definition: adj. of or pertaining to China or its peoples or cultures
example: On the Walk of Fame, you're going to find Drew Barrymore's star in front of the Chinese theatre.
exampleZh: 在星光大道上，你会发现德鲁·巴里摩尔的星星在中国剧院前。

meaning: n. 大学，专科学校；学院，分院；公学；学会，社团；学院的全体师生
definition: 1. n. the body of faculty and students of a college；2. n. an institution of higher education created to educate and grant degrees; often a part of a university
example: There are tons of studios, and most of those are college kids. That's where "Yoga to the People" is.
exampleZh: 有数不清的工作室，其中的大多数是针对大学生的。“大众瑜伽”工作室就是在那儿。

meaning: n. 关系，联系；连接，接通；连接物，接头；联运，转车，转机；交通线；人际关系，人脉；亲戚，旁系亲属；毒品贩子
definition: n. a relation between things or events (as in the case of one causing the other or sharing features with it)；n. the state of being connected
example: All you need is an Internet connection and a headset!
exampleZh: 你需要的仅仅只是网络连接和一副耳机！

meaning: n. 价钱，费用；成本，开支；代价，损失；诉讼费用；v. 价钱为，需花费；估算成本，估价；使丧失，使损失；使付出努力，使做不愉快的事；使花许多钱；【名】 （Cost）（英、美、罗、巴、法、荷）科斯特（人名）
definition: 1. n. the total spent for goods or services including money and time and labor；2. v. be priced at
example: So the cost of the product will be higher for them, for you know, for any product that uses advertising
exampleZh: 所以他们的产品价格就会更高，你知道，任何打广告的产品。

meaning: n. 发育，成长，发达；发展，进步；动态，进展；开发，研制；研制成果；（土地）开发；新建住宅区，新开发区；开始，出现；显影；出子布局
definition: 1. n. act of improving by expanding or enlarging or refining；2. n. a process in which something passes by degrees to a different stage (especially a more advanced or mature stage)
example: And part of this is happening because of the development of all these wireless networks, miniaturization, things moving online.
exampleZh: 部分原因是,无线网络的发展，微型化的发展。

meaning: adj. 到期的，预期的；应有的，应得的；应付的，应给的；适当的；adv. 正对着；n. 应得，所得；会费；【名】 （Due）迪尤（人名）
definition: 1. n. that which is deserved or owed；2. adj. owed and payable immediately or on demand
example: Now, gravity, well force, is equal to mass times acceleration, g and the acceleration due to gravity is g.
exampleZh: 是重力，等于质量乘以加速度，由重力导致的加速度是。

meaning: adj. 早期的，初期的；提早的，提前的；早开花的，早熟的；adv. 在早期，在初期；提早，提前；【名】 （Early）（英）厄尔利（人名）
definition: 1. adj. at or near the beginning of a period of time or course of events or before the usual or expected time；2. adv. during an early stage
example: That's on tape, that's you know, you get on the early VHS and recording tapes as well, cassette players.
exampleZh: 会卖磁带，你得用早期的家用录像系统、录音磁带或录音机播放。

meaning: adv. 尤其，特别；专门，特地；在很大程度上，非常
definition: 1. adv. to a distinctly greater extent or degree than is common；2. adv. in a special manner
example: especially as I am trying to develop my own thoughts and my own research questions for my future career.
exampleZh: 尤其是就我未来职业方面，我正在尝试形成自己的观点，提出我的研究问题。

meaning: n. 事件，大事；社交场合，既定活动；赛事，比赛项目；结果
definition: 1. n. something that happens at a given place and time；2. n. a special set of circumstances
example: But let me use the term "event" anyway, employing it with caution and as if in quotation marks.
exampleZh: 但是无论如何我还是使用，“事件“，这个词，小心谨慎地使用它，带引号地使用。

meaning: n. 农夫，农民，农场主；（Farmer，人名）法默（英），法尔梅（法），法梅尔（西）
definition: 1. n. a person who operates a farm；2. n. United States civil rights leader who in 1942 founded the Congress of Racial Equality (born in 1920)
example: At first glance, organic farming looks much more expensive for the farmer.
exampleZh: 乍一看，有机耕作对农民来说似乎昂贵得多。

meaning: adj. 女性的，妇女的；女性特有的；由女性组成的；内孔的；雌性的，母的；雌蕊的；n. 雌性动物，雌性植物；女子
definition: 1. n. an animal that produces gametes (ova) that can be fertilized by male gametes (spermatozoa)；2. adj. being the sex (of plant or animal) that produces fertilizable gametes (ova) from which offspring develop
example: She writes, Woman's being created last will not be a very great argument to debase the dignity of the female sex.
exampleZh: 她写道，女性被后造出来并不能,为压制女性尊严做论证。

meaning: n. 小时；一小时的路程；（工作，办公等的）固定时间；某个时间；长时间；整点，正点；（西派教会中）固定时分短礼拜；（天文）黄经（或赤经）15°；【名】 （Hour）（法）乌尔，（柬）胡（人名）
definition: 1. n. a period of time equal to 1/24th of a day；2. n. clock time
example: It's about maybe half an hour, one hour from Barbados and maybe another hour and half from Puerto Rico.
exampleZh: 从巴巴多斯岛到那儿大概要半小时或一小时；从波多黎各到那儿则需要再花上一个半小时。

meaning: adv. 越来越多地，不断增加地
definition: 1. adv. advancing in amount or intensity
example: All of this is Darwinian thinking and, I think, increasingly will be central in importance in the twenty-first century.
exampleZh: 这就是达尔文所思考的，我认为，这在二十一世纪会越来越重要。

meaning: n. 影响，作用；势力，影响力；有影响的人（或事物）；v. 影响，对……起作用
definition: 1. n. a power to affect persons or events especially power based on prestige etc；2. v. have and exert influence or effect
example: How do you influence the way people connect the way they think about something and the way they act about something.
exampleZh: 您是怎样影响人们,让人们将其所想与,所为联系起来的呢？

meaning: n. 项目，条款；一件商品（或物品）；一则，一条（新闻）；（关系亲密的）一对；adv. （用于介绍清单上逐个项目之前）又，此外还有；v. 逐条列出，记下
definition: 1. n. a distinct part that can be specified separately in a group of things that could be enumerated on a list；2. adv. (used when listing or enumerating items) also
example: There's the vector, and again you'll see this in your handout, says I only took the first item.

meaning: prep. 反对；（行为）违背……；（法律或法规）禁止；与……竞争；对……造成伤害（威胁，不利）；碰；倚着；逆向；以……为背景；与……相比；防备，抵御；讨厌某人，不赞同某人；作为（某物的）应付款项；（赌博用语）预计……的失败

meaning: v. 询问，打听；要求，请求；邀请，约请 ；指望，期待；【名】 （Ask）（芬、瑞典）阿斯克（人名）

meaning: v. 打破，折断；（使）破裂，撕开；弄破，使流血；（使）骨折；破纪录；打断，中断；终止；断绝（联系）；损坏；违反，违背；使……放弃习惯；休息；稍停，暂留；突破，挣脱；（被）摧毁，削弱；使心碎；透露，传开；告诉（坏消息）；驯化，驯服；得分（低于或高于规定总分）；超过；（云）散开；开始，（风暴）发作；拍岸，迸溅；（男孩嗓音）变粗；（因激动）变调；破解，破译；兑开（纸币）；减缓；（网球中）破发球；（球）转向，曲线飞行；（股价）暴跌；猛冲，开始快跑；发生，发展；（热度）降低，退烧；n. 间歇，小憩；课间休息；停顿，暂停；（电台或电视节目）插播广告的间隙；短假；机会，机遇；结束，断绝；逃跑（尤指越狱）；裂缝，缺口；骨折；（因情感作用）嗓音突变；黎明，破晓；天气突变；接发球得分；接连击中；（球的）弧线飞行；（尤指球员或球队）进攻；有帮助的事物；芽，蓓蕾；双轮驱马大车（breaking cart 的原称）；敞篷四轮马车（同 brake）
definition: 1. n. some abrupt occurrence that interrupts an ongoing activity；2. v. terminate
example: If we take hydrogen peroxide in the liquid state, it can break down to form water and oxygen.
exampleZh: 如果我们有一些液态的过氧化氢，它会分解成水和氧气。

meaning: n. 竞争；比赛，竞赛；竞争者，对手
definition: 1. n. a business relation in which two parties compete to gain customers；2. n. an occasion on which a winner is selected from among two or more contestants
example: So the nature of the world, post-cold war world is increasingly one about competition for markets, govern of one nation's markets.
exampleZh: 因此冷战之后，市场的竞争,成为世界的主题，一国市场的管理，如果事实如此。

meaning: n. 结果，后果；重要性，价值
definition: 1. n. a phenomenon that follows and is caused by some previous phenomenon；2. n. the outcome of an event especially as relative to an individual
example: Humans suffered as a consequence from nutritional deficiencies in almost all parts of the world because there weren't complete diets.
exampleZh: 几乎全世界的人们都饱受营养不良的困扰,因为他们没有平衡的食谱

meaning: v. 抄写，誊写；模仿，效法；作弊，抄袭；听见（或明白）无线电收发报机中讲话人的话；复制，拷贝；n. 一本，一册，一份；复印件，副本；原稿，素材；广告文字
definition: 1. n. a reproduction of a written record (e.g. of a legal or school record)；2. v. copy down as is
example: So this is a classic error. I've not made a copy of the list. I've got an alias of the list.
exampleZh: 这是个相当经典的错误,在这里我并没有得到数组的。

meaning: n. 乡村，农村；乡村居民
definition: 1. n. rural regions
example: I want to have a look at some of the countryside down in Surrey and in Sussex.
exampleZh: 我想看看萨里和苏塞克斯的一些小乡村。

meaning: adj. 创造（性）的，创作的；有创造力的，有想象力的；n. 创作者；创意，创作素材
definition: 1. adj. having the ability or power to create；2. adj. promoting construction or creation
example: We need to find more creative ways to discipline our students and to maintain control in the classroom.
exampleZh: 我们需要用更有创意的方法约束学生，维持课堂纪律。

meaning: n. 危机，紧要关头；决定性时刻，关键时刻；（病情的）转折点，危象；adj. 用于处理危机的
definition: 1. n. an unstable situation of extreme danger or difficulty；2. n. a crucial stage or turning point in the course of something
example: But once the financial crisis hit, things changed a little bit, and so there is more competition.
exampleZh: 但一旦金融危机爆发了，情况稍微有所改变，因此竞争就会更激烈了。

meaning: adj. 文化的，与文化有关的；艺术的，文艺的
definition: 1. adj. of or relating to the arts and manners that a group favors；2. adj. denoting or deriving from or distinctive of the ways of living built up by a group of people
example: We then promised to move to an emphasis on psychological matters, and finally social and cultural determinants of literature.
exampleZh: 然后我们把重点转移到了心理学，最后还讨论了社会和文化对文学的决定因素。

meaning: v. 决定，控制；查明，确定；下定决心；判决，裁定；求出，解出；限定；终止
definition: 1. v. establish after a calculation, investigation, experiment, survey, or study；2. v. shape or influence; give direction to
example: My critical powers are just sufficient to determine this, and I am gratified to be able to say it.
exampleZh: 我的评论能力可以确认这一点，而且我很高兴我能这么说。

meaning: v. 鼓励，激励；鼓动，怂恿；刺激，促进
definition: 1. v. contribute to the progress or growth of；2. v. inspire with confidence; give hope or courage to
example: That's why many of them are thinking really very hard of how to foster entrepreneurship, how to encourage innovation.
exampleZh: 这就是为什么大家都在思索,如何才能培养企业家精神，如何鼓励创新。

meaning: n. 自然环境，生态环境；周围状况，条件；工作平台，软件包
definition: 1. n. the totality of surrounding conditions；2. n. the area in which something exists or lives
example: Behind this environment are the great social processes of migration and modernization that produced that new urban form, the metropolis.
exampleZh: 在这种环境背后是移民和现代化的重大社会进程,所带来的新的城市形式，即大都市。

meaning: pron. 每个人，人人，大家
definition: 1. abstract: Everyone is a morality play that was collaboratively written by members of six theatre companies in Vancouver, British Columbia, Canada: The Electric Company, Neworld Theatre, November Theatre, Pound of Flesh Theatre, Theatre Melee, and Theatre Replacement. These companies wrote one scene each for the play.
example: but everyone knows, like, which one's, ah... which societies exist and who is in them, just things like that.
exampleZh: 但是每个人都知道这种社团的存在，也知道社团的成员是谁，这些事情都不是秘密。

meaning: v. 期待；预计；要求，指望；认为；怀孕

example: Milton's Lady doesn't proceed as we expect her to, to marshal further arguments for the moderate fulfillment of one's conjugal obligations.
exampleZh: 弥尔顿笔下的女士没有按我们期望的那样进行，整理有关人们适当满足婚姻权利义务,的进一步论点。

meaning: v. （使）出现；（使）（关系、习惯或想法）形成；构成，是……的组成部分；陶冶，培养；组织，建立；n. 表，表格；类别，种类；形状，外形；体形；（存在的）形态，形式；（尤指艺术作品或文章的）结构；体能，良好的健康状态；良好表现；词形；惯常做法，习俗；（英国的）班级，年级；不礼貌的行为；【名】 （Form）（英）福姆，（法、德）福尔姆（人名）
definition: 1. n. the phonological or orthographic sound or appearance of a word that can be used to describe or identify something；2. v. to compose or represent:
example: Behind this environment are the great social processes of migration and modernization that produced that new urban form, the metropolis.
exampleZh: 在这种环境背后是移民和现代化的重大社会进程,所带来的新的城市形式，即大都市。

meaning: n. 身份，本体；个性，特性；同一性，一致；恒等运算，恒等式

meaning: v. 介绍，引见；使初次了解，使尝试；为（电视或广播节目）做开场白，主持；实施，推行；首次引入（某物），使传入；使开始，创始；将（法案）提交讨论；将……放进，添入

meaning: adj. 小的，比较小的；用于强调对某人或某物的意见；年幼的；短暂的，近的；微不足道的；可爱的，可怜的；det. 一点儿，少得几乎没有；少量的，一些；adv. 极少，轻微；几乎不；短时间地，一会儿地；pron. 少许；【名】 （Little）（英）利特尔（人名）

example: One is a little bit higher and one is a little bit lower than they are in the atomic situation.

meaning: num. 一百万，一百万个；n. 百万，百万个（人或物）；许多，无数；百万英镑（或美元）；adj. 许多的，无数的；【名】 （Million）（美、法）米利翁（人名）

meaning: adj. 下一个的，接下来的；（时间）紧接着来到的，下次的；紧邻的；其他的；adv. 紧接着，随后；仅次于；下次，再次；（用于询问，表示吃惊或困惑）；n. 下一个人或事件；det. 下一（年、月、星期等）；pron. 下一个

meaning: n. 参加者，参与者；adj. 参与的

meaning: n. 表演，演出；工作情况，表现；（投资的）业绩；执行，履行；麻烦，苦差事（a performance）；艺术上的表现，演技；（汽车的）性能；（语言学）语言表现，言语行为；adj. 性能卓越的，高性能的

meaning: n. 价格；代价；开价，价码；投注赔率； 价值；v. 为……定价；给（商店中的产品）标价；比较……的价格；问……的价格；【名】 （Price）（英）普赖斯，（法）普里斯，（葡、瑞典）普里塞（人名）

meaning: v. 选择，挑选；（在计算机屏幕上）选定；（进化）决定（特征，生物）是否继续存在；adj. 精选的，优等的；高级的，奢华的；【名】 （Select）（美、印）塞阿克特（人名）

example: Select the text you want to format by holding down the left button on your mouse.
exampleZh: 按住鼠标左键选取你想要格式化的文本。

meaning: n. 自律，自我约束

example: It's up to your own self-discipline—how much efforts you put into study.
exampleZh: 这取决于你自己的自律程度——你在学习上投入了多少努力。

meaning: v. 为……工作，服役；端上，给……提供（餐饮）；够……吃； 接待，服务；对……有用，满足；（向某地或某群体）供应，提供；服刑，服劳役； 送达（传票、令状等）；（网球、排球等）发球；开（某人）（玩笑）；产生……的效果；（军）操作（枪炮）；（航海）卷缠（绳索）；（雄性种畜）与（雌性）交配；（基督教）在弥撒中担任助祭；n. （网球、排球等的）发球； 申斥；【名】 （Serve）（法）塞尔夫（人名）；（Serve）（法）塞尔夫（人名）

meaning: adj. 相像的，类似的；（几何图形）相似的；n. 相似之人（或物）；顺势药物（指疗效与某些疾病症状相似的药物，为顺势疗法的基础）

meaning: n. （品质的）标准，水平，规范；正常的水平，应达到的标准；行为标准，道德水准（standards）；（小学）（考试达到的）级别；法定度量衡标准；旗杆；流行曲调（或歌曲）；茎干挺直的树（或灌木）；（植）（蝶形花的）旗瓣；（植）（鸢尾属植物的）直立花瓣；直立水管（或煤气管）；adj. 普通的，标准的；（大小、尺寸、式样等）常规的，一般性的；权威的，广泛认可的；（语言）合乎规范的，符合标准的；茎干挺直的树（或灌木）；（整成树形并嫁接于挺直茎干上的）灌木

meaning: v. （因疾病、痛苦、悲伤等）受苦，受折磨；经受，遭受（坏事）；变差，变糟；容许，允许；受处决
definition: 1. v. undergo or be subjected to；2. v. undergo (as of injuries and illnesses)

meaning: n. 想法，看法，主意；考虑，深思；关心，顾虑；意图，希望，念头；思想，思潮；思考，思维；心思，思想（thoughts）；v. 认为，觉得；思考，考虑；想做，打算做（think 的过去式和过去分词形式）

meaning: v. 担心，发愁；使担忧，使发愁，使焦虑；烦扰，使不安宁；（狗）追赶，撕咬（其他动物）；n. 令人担忧的事，令人发愁的问题；担心，忧虑

example: and not worry about, you know, if your husband likes it, or if your mom likes it, or whatever.

meaning: n. 入口，通道；获得的机会，使用权；（对计算机存储器的）访问，存取；（情感）爆发，发作；探视权；v. 接近，进入；获取，访问（计算机信息）；adj. （电视节目或时间等）对外公开的

meaning: v. 同意，赞成；答应，接受；达成一致意见；商定，约定；相符，吻合；赞同；（语法）呼应；批准，认可（计划、要求等）；适合（某人）
definition: 1. v. be in accord; be in agreement；2. v. consent or assent to a condition, or agree to do something

meaning: v. 出现，呈现；首次使用，起源；出庭；演出，出场；出版，发表；记载，提及；看来，似乎；表现得……；到达
definition: 1. v. give a certain impression or have a certain outward aspect；2. v. come into sight or view

exampleZh: 那么神圣与自然的界限,以及与人类世界的界线就很清楚了。

meaning: n. 板，木板；黑板，告示牌；董事会，理事会；膳食，伙食，膳食费用；局；舞台；（冰球场周围的）界墙；（美国大学的）入学考试；v. 登上（火车、轮船或飞机）；让乘客登机（或上船等）；寄宿；（在学校）住校；将（宠物）暂时寄养在他处；用木板覆盖；【名】 （Board）（英、西）博德（人名）
definition: 1. n. a committee having supervisory powers；2. v. get on board of (trains, buses, ships, aircraft, etc.)

exampleZh: 我们将整本《利未记》分成一个个单元来讲,单元表就在那边的板上。

meaning: v. （使）关闭；合上，合拢；（使）暂时性关闭；（永久）停业，停止活动；（使）结束，（使）停止；关闭（计算机程序）；（股票等）收盘；拉近（距离），缩小（差距）；抱住，抓住，握住；（使）（伤口）愈合；封锁（公路、公园等）；完成，做成（交易等）；接通（电路）；adj. 接近的；酷似的，几乎相等的；快要……的；（坏事）险些发生的；近亲的；亲近的，亲密的；（关联）密切的；仔细的，全面的；势均力敌的；闷热的，不通风的；密集的，空间很小的；（头发或胡子）齐根的；守口如瓶的，掩饰感情的；吝啬的，小气的；严加保护（守卫）的；闭塞音的；adv. （空间或时间上）接近地；n. 结束，结尾；（大教堂的）围地；死胡同；英国某些传统公学的操场；通路，入口；（股市一日的）收盘（the close）；（板球一日比赛的）终赛（the close）；（乐）短句结尾，收束；关闭（尤指关门）；【名】 （Close）（英、法）克洛斯（人名）
definition: 1. n. the temporal end; the concluding time；2. v. cease to operate or cause to cease operating
example: practice our, you know, talking skills. We get really close because there's not that many people in the class.
exampleZh: 练习我们的表达能力。因为上这个课的人不多，所以我们之间变得很亲近。

meaning: n. 痴呆，精神错乱
definition: n. mental deterioration of organic or functional origin
example: Most older adults do not develop Alzheimer's disease or other forms of dementia.
exampleZh: 大多数老年人不会患上阿尔茨海默氏病或其他形式的痴呆症。

meaning: n. 森林，林区；（森林似的）一丛，一片；御猎场；v. 被森林覆盖，植林于；【名】 【名】（Forest）福雷斯特（人名）
definition: 1. n. the trees and other plants in a large densely wooded area；2. v. establish a forest on previously unforested land
example: Because her brothers have naturally done what any brother would do accompanying a sister in a dangerous forest at night.
exampleZh: 因为她的弟弟,做了任何一个弟弟深夜跟随着姐姐,在一个危险森林会做的事。

meaning: n. 缝隙，缺口；（时间上的）间隔；空白，缺漏；隔阂，差距
definition: 1. n. a conspicuous disparity or difference as between two figures；2. v. make an opening or gap in
example: The gap between the best and poorest childcare provision has widened.
exampleZh: 儿童保育供给的最佳和最低水准之间加大了差距。

meaning: n. 罗马数字二（即 2）；第二（用于人名、幕次、战争等编号后，通常大写为 II）；adj. 两个的（= two）；abbr. 微光（Image Intensification）
definition: n. the cardinal number that is the sum of one and one or a numeral representing this number；adj. being one more than one
example: Hundreds of years later, in 1969, American astronaut Neil Armstrong stepped down from Apollo II and walked on the moon.
exampleZh: 几百年后的1969年，美国宇航员尼尔·阿姆斯特朗走下阿波罗二号，在月球上迈出了人类的一大步。

meaning: num. 罗马数字 3（小写形式；大写为 III）；n. 第三；三世（用于人名、称号、阶段或协议等名称后，常写作 III）
definition: n. the cardinal number that is the sum of one and one and one；adj. being one more than two
example: The ion-supported hypervalent iodine(iii) reagent is a kind of "task-specific ionic liquids".
exampleZh: 离子负载的高价碘（iii）试剂是一种“功能化离子液体”。

meaning: n. 干预，介入；调停，斡旋；（为改善情况尤指病痛采取的）措施，做法
definition: 1. intentional action to change a situation, with the aim of improving it or preventing it from getting worse；2. the action by God or a god of getting involved in a human situation in order to change it
example: Many people felt he would be hostile to the idea of foreign intervention.
exampleZh: 许多人觉得他会反对外来干预。

meaning: num. 罗马数字 4；第四（小写 iv 常用于页码、章节编号；大写 IV 也置于君主、教皇等名后表示“…四世”）；adj. 静脉内的；静脉注射的（intravenous 的缩写，常作定语）；n. 静脉输液，静脉滴注；（Iv）人名，如（柬）尤、（俄）伊夫；abbr. 自变量（independent variable 的缩写）；输入阀（input valve 的缩写）；交互式视频，亦作交互式视讯（interactive video 的缩写）
definition: n. the cardinal number that is the sum of three and one；n. administration of nutrients through a vein
example: I then re-initialize the cipher with the new iv object.
exampleZh: 然后我用新的iv对象重新初始化这个密码。

meaning: v. 管理，处理；操纵，控制；设法做到，勉力完成；腾出时间参加；凑合着活下去，支撑；调教（人或动物）；竟搞得，竟做出
definition: 1. v. be successful; achieve a goal；2. v. be in charge of, act on, or dispose of
example: They are quite distinct from each other, and you should be able to manage with that final exam without undue difficulty.
exampleZh: 它们都各有特点,你需要在期末考之前解决所有困难。

meaning: n. 月，月份；一个月的时间；数月，很长时间（months）
definition: 1. n. one of the twelve divisions of the calendar year；2. n. a time unit of approximately 30 days
example: Please don't, if you are up here, become complacent because a month from now we will have another test.
exampleZh: 如果你考得不错的话，请不要自满,因为在一个月后我们将还有一次测试。

meaning: n. 国家，民族；国民；（美洲土著居民的）部落，部族；【名】 （Nation）（英）内申（人名）
definition: 1. n. a politically organized body of people under a single government；2. n. the people who live in a nation or country
example: And most people in London and UK follow a football team. It's quite a sporting nation.
exampleZh: 大部分在英国伦敦的人，都追足球队。这是个足球大国。

meaning: v. 保护，防护；（制订法律）保护；投保，为……买保险；对……实行贸易保护；（计算机）保护（数据或储存库）；防守
definition: 1. v. shield from danger, injury, destruction, or damage；2. v. use tariffs to favor domestic industry
example: How would you recommend that investors protect their wealth during this period to ? take advantage of upcoming investment opportunities?
exampleZh: 那你对投资者在这段时间内,如何保护他们的财产并且,进一步利用这即将到来的投资机会有什么建议呢？

meaning: v. 推，移动；按；挤，推搡；推动，促使；推销，推广；说服，强迫；鼓励，督促；努力争取；坚持地做；（军队）挺进；赶走；贩卖（毒品）；接近（某年龄或数字）；使（栈）准备接收顶层数据；对（底片）作增感处理；n. 推 ；按；努力；鼓励，敦促；挺进，进攻 ；毅力，进取心；棘手的事
definition: 1. n. the act of applying force in order to move something away；2. v. move with force,

exampleZh: 并且让自己总比头一天跑得远些，并且努力保持身材。

meaning: n. 报告，汇报；新闻报道；官方文件，调查报告；传闻，传说；（学生）成绩报告单；案情报告；下属；爆炸声，枪声；谣言，流传；名誉，名声；v. 报道；据说，传闻；述说，报告；公告，公布；举报（罪案）， 报告（事故）；报到；描述（感情、病情等）；（议会委员会主席）正式宣布委员会已讨论（法案）；（议会委员会）将法案交还给议会表决；对（上级或监督者）负责，由......领导；告发，检举；【名】 （Report）（匈）雷波特（人名）
definition: 1. n. a written document describing the findings of some individual or group；2. v. to give an account or representation of in words

exampleZh: 然后我们根据实验结果来撰写实验报告，

meaning: n. 科学家
definition: 1. n. a person with advanced knowledge of one or more sciences

exampleZh: 它们在这，当它们被起名的时候，是由科学家们建议的,那些提取它们的科学家。

meaning: adj. 简单的，简明的；简朴的，朴素的；纯粹的，完全的；结构单一的，简易的；普通的，平凡的；愚笨的，迟钝的；（动词时态）简单的；（数）简单的；（叶、茎）没有分杈的；（镜头、显微镜等）单镜头的；（利息）单利的；（句子）无从句的；n. 草药，药草；出身低微者；笨蛋；【名】 （Simple）（法）桑普勒（人名）
definition: 1. n. any herbaceous plant having medicinal properties；2. adj. having few parts; not complex or complicated or involved
example: So it's a really powerful and simple formalism, once we set up what is needed the go through it, right?
exampleZh: 因此这是一种很强大而简单的形式,一旦我们定下需要什么,就可以推导出它，对吧？

meaning: n. （动植物的）种，物种；种类；（具有相同特征的）一类人；（化学，物理）核素；（圣餐中用的）面包和圣酒；adj. 原种的
definition: 1. n. (biology) taxonomic group whose members can interbreed；2. n. a specific kind of something
