meaning: v. 接受，收受；同意，赞成；相信，认为……正确；忍受，容忍；吸纳，招收；接纳；承担（责任等），承认；承兑，认付（单据等）；不排斥；适配
definition: 1. v. consider or hold as true；2. v. receive willingly something given or offered
example: Great. Yup, it's going to be an electron acceptor, it wants to accept electrons, it wants to accept electron density.
exampleZh: 很好，没错，它将是一个电子的受主，它想要接收电子，接收电子密度。

meaning: n. 成绩，成就；完成，实现；（纹章）纹章牌
definition: 1. n. the action of accomplishing something
example: The people who were primed, subconsciously with words related to achievement, did better on tests than control group.
exampleZh: 受到影射的人，用与“成就“有关的词进行潜意识影射的人，测试结果比对照组好。

meaning: n. 大气，空气；空中，天空；乘坐飞机，航空；神态，氛围；曲调，旋律；装腔作势，做作；空气媒质；气，风；v. 使公开，宣扬；（使）通风；（使）晾干，（使）烘干；播送，播放；出去透气；炫耀，夸示
definition: 1. n. a mixture of gases (especially oxygen) required for breathing; the stuff that the wind consists of；2. v. expose to fresh air
example: Then he flung outward, feet first, with a swish, Kicking his way down through the air to the ground.
exampleZh: 然后，纵身一跳，他两脚先伸出去，在空中乱踢乱舞，于是飕的一声，降落到地面。

meaning: n. 可供选择的事物，替代物；adj. 可替代的，备选的；非传统的，另类的；（两者）互不相容的，非此即彼的
definition: 1. n. one of a number of things from which only one can be chosen；2. adj. allowing a choice
example: What's the alternative? The alternative,it seems,for the soul theorist, Shelly Kagan is to say,neither of them is Shelly Kagan.
exampleZh: 还有什么选择，灵魂理论者还有的选择，就是说他们都不是。

meaning: abbr. （计算机）应用程序，应用软件；开胃菜；【名】 （App）（美、德、巴）阿普（人名）；（App）（美、德、巴）阿普（人名）
definition: 1. abstract: App is short for application software but is frequently used to mean mobile app (more specific) or computer program (more general).
example: I think we have an app that's like, "Next Muni" here in the city.
exampleZh: 我们有一个“下一趟有轨电车”的应用程序。

meaning: v. 手持，携带；（车，船）运输，运送；写有，刻有；以（姓名，头衔）相称；见证，作证；承担，担负（责任）；经得起；承受，容忍；生育（孩子）；（树，植物）结（果实），长出（花）；拐弯；n. 熊；粗暴无礼的人，没教养的人；体格笨重的男人，行动迟缓的男人；（股票）卖空者，做空头者；麻烦事，棘手之事；“北极熊”（俄国的外号）；【名】 （Bear）（美）贝尔（人名）
definition: 1. n. massive plantigrade carnivorous or omnivorous mammals with long shaggy coats and strong claws；2. v. have
example: And when you have an optimal substructure and the local solutions overlap, that's when you can bring dynamic programming to bear.
exampleZh: 当你得到一个最优子结构,但局部解决方案有重跌时，你就可以引入动态编程,来解决这个问题了。

meaning: n. 行为，举止，态度；活动方式，特点，特性；习惯
definition: n. the action or reaction of something (as a machine or substance) under specified circumstances；n. (behavioral attributes) the way a person behaves toward other people
example: He is always perfectly proper in his behaviour.
exampleZh: 他的行为举止向来是无可挑剔的。

meaning: prep. 在（或向）……的后面；落后于；是……背后的原因；支持；（……的外表）之下；成为（某人的）过去；低于；在……死后；adv. 在后面；留在原地；落后（于）；拖欠，不按时；n. 屁股；（澳橄）射门得分
definition: 1. n. the fleshy part of the human body that you sit on；2. adj. having the lower score or lagging position in a contest
example: Some scholars assume there's a historical memory behind the elaborate and dramatic story of a miraculous redemption by God.
exampleZh: 一些学者假设潜藏着历史记忆,在上帝神奇兑现许诺的详细的戏剧化故事中。

meaning: n. 细胞；小牢房；电解槽，电池；电芯；（政治组织的）小组，基层组织；（修道院中的）单人小室；（巢穴中单个的）巢室；（计算机屏幕上的）单元格；【名】 （Cell）（英）塞尔（人名）
definition: 1. n. any small compartment；2. n. (biology) the basic structural and functional unit of all organisms; they may exist as independent units of life (as in monads) or may form colonies or tissues as in higher plants and animals
example: If we think about the size of a typical cell - excuse me, now I'm getting confused about nuclei.
exampleZh: 它大约是10的,负十四次方米，如果我们考虑。

meaning: n. 厨师，炊事员；v. 煮，烧；烹饪，烹调；发生，计划中；干得起劲，干得好；篡改，伪造；【名】 （Cook）（美）库克（人名）
definition: 1. n. someone who cooks food；2. v. prepare a hot meal
example: The olive itself, you use it to cook with as oil; some people just put oil on their salad.
exampleZh: 你可以用它来烹饪,有些人还往沙拉中加入橄榄油

meaning: n. 法院，法庭；球场；王宫，宫廷；朝臣；全体审判人员；庭院，院子；董事（会），理事（会）；（用于大型宅第和公寓街区的名称中）宅第，公寓大楼；v. 奉承，讨好；设法取得，追求；招致，引起（不愉快的事）；谈恋爱，求爱；【名】 （Court）（英）考特，（法）库尔（人名）
definition: 1. n. an assembly (including one or more judges) to conduct judicial business；2. v. make amorous advances towards
example: Embarrassment tells us we're in the presence of the excess, and that's why Beat writers court it.
exampleZh: 难堪告诉我们自己是处在过度的状态，所以垮掉一代的作者追求难堪。

meaning: n. 大量；交易；坏运气，不公平的对待；发牌；冷衫木；优惠的价格，划算的价格；牌戏的一局；一手牌；v. 应对（难缠的人，困难局面）（deal with）；（以某种方式）对付，对待（deal with）；论及，讨论（deal with）；买卖，交易；给予；贩卖（毒品、艺术品等）；与……有关；发牌；【名】 （Deal）（美）迪尔（人名）
definition: 1. n. a particular instance of buying or selling；2. v. deal with verbally or in some form of artistic expression
example: So I think a really good way to deal with stress is to find a hobby that you enjoy, personally,
exampleZh: 所以我觉得应对压力的一个非常好的办法就是给自己找个让自己乐在其中的爱好，

meaning: v. 描述，形容；做……运动，形成……形状
definition: 1. v. give a description of；2. v. to give an account or representation of in words
example: So, these on-changing properties that describe the state of the equilibrium state of the system are called state variables.
exampleZh: 这些描述,系统平衡态的,变化的属性,就叫做状态变量。

meaning: v. 赚得，挣钱；盈（利），生（利）；赢得，博得；【名】 （Earn）（泰）炎（人名）
definition: 1. v. earn on some commercial or business transaction; earn as salary or wages；2. v. acquire or deserve by one's efforts or actions
example: And so I decided to have a progressive scale that increases according to what you earn like the tax scale.
exampleZh: 所以，我决定制定一个累进的捐款标准表,捐款的数量随着收入的增加而增加,就像税率表一样，这个标准表从收入的1%起步。

meaning: n. 情感，情绪；激情，强烈的情感
definition: 1. n. any strong feeling
example: I think even soul's emotion... People are a little too off for good church, for good church people. -Right.
exampleZh: 这也和“灵魂情感“有关。。。,人们对按时拜谒教会这件事，太冷淡，-是的。

meaning: v. 增强，提高，改善
definition: 1. v. increase；2. v. make better or more attractive
example: Large paintings can enhance the feeling of space in small rooms.
exampleZh: 大幅画作能增加小房间的宽敞感。

meaning: adj. 快的，迅速的；系牢的，紧缚的；寻欢作乐的；不褪色的；忠实的，可靠的；adv. 快速地；坚定地，牢固地；v. 斋戒，禁食；n. 斋戒，斋戒期；【名】 （Fast）（英、德、俄、芬、捷、瑞典）法斯特（人名）
definition: 1. n. abstaining from food；2. v. abstain from certain foods, as for religious or medical reasons
example: It gives you a lot of expressive convenience, you can write the programs much more cleanly, but most importantly, it's fast.
exampleZh: 你可以把一些程序写的更清楚，最重要的是，它的效率非常高。

meaning: n. 安全地，避难所；港口，港湾；v. 为……提供避难所；【名】 （Haven）（美）黑文（人名）
definition: 1. a safe or peaceful place；2. an area of water next to the coast where ships and boats can shelter, or a small port
example: Some Democrats support granting the Haitians temporary safe haven in the U.S.
exampleZh: 一些民主党人支持为海地人提供在美国的临时避难所。

meaning: n. 心，心脏；内心，感情；胸前；重点，核心；中心，中央；信心，勇气；（表示爱的）心形物；红桃牌，红心牌；菜心；同情，怜悯；爱情，情爱；（土地的）肥力；v. 喜爱，深爱；【名】 （Heart）（英）哈特（人名）
definition: 1. n. the locus of feelings and intuitions；2. n. the hollow muscular organ located behind the sternum and between the lungs; its rhythmic contractions move the blood through the body
example: I mean, you can go anywhere and everywhere, and USF is located in the heart of San Francisco, so.
exampleZh: 我是说，你去哪儿都行，旧金山大学坐落在旧金山的中心位置。

meaning: n. 震惊，恐惧；惧怕，憎恶；恐怖性；极其不愉快的（或可怕的）经历；恐怖故事（或电影等）；调皮捣蛋的孩子
definition: 1. n. intense and profound fear；2. n. something that inspires dislike; something horrible
example: I said that Yeats looks on the modern with a sense of both horror and a fascination, a compulsion almost.
exampleZh: 我说过叶芝看待现代是,以一种害怕和好奇的感觉，一种难以压抑的冲动。

meaning: n. 收入，收益
definition: 1. n. the financial gain (earned or unearned) accruing over a given period of time
example: such as taking women out of Thailand who are in prostitution and providing them with sustainable income.
exampleZh: 比如把在泰国卖淫的女性解救出来，向她们提供可持续的收入。

meaning: adj. 自治的，独立的；自立的，自力更生的；公正的，不受他人影响的；分离的，单独的；私营的；无党派的；有主见的，有独立见解的；n. 独立自主者，独立团体；无党派政治家；公理会教友
definition: 1. n. a neutral or uncommitted person (especially in politics)；2. adj. free from external control and constraint
example: So I feel like people are more independent over there, which is sort of a good thing,
exampleZh: 所以，我觉得那里的人更独立，这也是件好事情，

meaning: v. 表明，标示；象征，暗示；间接提及，示意；指示，指出；（用灯光或手臂）打行车转向信号；有必要，被建议
definition: 1. v. be a signal for or a symptom of；2. v. indicate a place, direction, person, or thing; either spatially or figuratively
example: The extent of the rise might indicate that it had been overdone.
exampleZh: 上涨的程度可能显示事情做得过头了。

meaning: n. 判断，看法；判断力，识别力；判决，裁决；报应，天谴
definition: n. an opinion formed by judging something；n. the act of judging or assessing a person or situation or event
example: I respect his judgment and I'll follow any advice he gives me.
exampleZh: 我敬重他的判断力，并将听从他给我的任何建议。

meaning: n. 法律（体系）；法令，法规；规律，法则，定律；法学，法律学；司法界，律师业；（道德或宗教上的）准则，守则；警方，警察；v. 起诉，控告；【名】 （Law）（英、缅、柬）劳（人名）
definition: 1. n. legal document setting forth rules governing a particular kind of activity；2. n. the collection of rules imposed by authority
example: Now the first law is going to hold in all of these steps, and we're going around in a cycle.
exampleZh: 现在热力学第一定律,就蕴含在这所有的步骤里了，我们沿着这个循环走。

meaning: pron. 我（宾格）；n. 自我；极端自私的人；自我的一部分
definition: 1. n. a state in New England
example: They say you don't call me, that you don't show up at my house, you don't write me emails anymore.
exampleZh: 要你别再给他们打电话，不再上门拜访，甚至连电邮也不再写了。

meaning: n. 名字，名称；名声，名誉；名人，有名的事物；（侮辱人的）绰号，别称；（英国）属劳埃德保险社辛迪加的承保人；v. 命名，给……取名；说出……的名称，叫出……的名字；说定，确定；任命，委任；（下议院议长）点名开除（立法委员会成员）的议员身份；adj. 有名的，出名的；姓名的，据以取名的；【名】 （Name）内姆（日）滑（姓）（人名）
definition: 1. n. a language unit by which a person or thing is known；2. v. assign a specified (usually proper) proper name to
example: The heroine of the mask, as you know, doesn't seem to have a Christian name. She's not Britney or Lindsay.
exampleZh: 你们也知道《面具》里的女主角，似乎没有教名，她不是布兰妮或林赛。

meaning: n. 消息，新情况；新闻（报道）；新闻人物，新闻事件；电视新闻节目（the news）；（用于报纸名）新闻
definition: 1. n. new information about specific and timely events；2. n. new information of any kind
example: Let's say that you're watching the news and you see a story about a house that blows up,
exampleZh: 假设你正在看新闻，你看到一条关于一幢房子爆炸的消息。

meaning: pron. 没有什么，没有一件东西；无关紧要的事，无足轻重的人；不值钱，不花钱；没有什么；（表示强调）没有别的东西；（计算机数量上的）零；adv. 并不，毫不； 用于强烈地表示相反看法根本不是（这样）；n. 无关紧要的事，无足轻重的人；空地，虚空；零；无；adj. 没前途的，没价值
definition: 1. n. a quantity of no importance；2. adv. in no way; to no degree
example: This is The Life You Can Save, which essentially gives the lie to the idea that there is nothing I can do.
exampleZh: 你可以拯救的生命》,这本书彻底地推翻了那种,“我什么都帮不上“的想法。

meaning: n. 军官；（政府或大机构的）官员，高级职员；警察，警官；船长；某一荣誉等级中的一分子（如英帝国勋位中四等勋爵士以下的级别）；v. 配备军官；指挥；【名】 （Officer）（英）奥菲瑟（人名）
definition: 1. n. any person in the armed services who holds a position of authority or command；2. v. direct or command as an officer
example: I was strucked by what I found in the New York Times December 8th, a piece writen by an army officer.
exampleZh: 我感到非常震惊,12月8号，我在纽约时报，看到了一篇军官写的文章。

meaning: adj. 总的，全面的；所有的，包括一切的；adv. 全部，总共； 总的说来，大体上；n. （工作时穿的）罩衣；（上下连身的）工作服，防护服（overalls）；背带工装裤（overalls）；骑马裤，紧身制服裤（overalls）
definition: 1. n. (usually plural) work clothing consisting of denim trousers (usually with a bib and shoulder straps)；2. adj. involving only main features
example: There were also issues about nutritional adequacy and meat turned out to be a better overall food than most plants.
exampleZh: 还有关于营养充分的问题,这样看,肉类较植物来说是更好的食物

meaning: adj. 受大众喜爱的，受欢迎的；（想法、情绪或态度）普遍的；通俗的，大众化的；民众的，百姓的
definition: 1. adj. regarded with great favor, approval, or affection especially by the general public；2. adj. carried on by or for the people (or citizens) at large
example: So a very popular thing to do on Boxing Day is go shopping and take advantage of the sales.
exampleZh: 所以在节礼日人们通常会趁着促销之际出去购物，这很流行。

meaning: v. 更喜爱，宁可；举报，提出（控告）；提拔（某人），提升
definition: 1. v. like better; value more highly；2. v. select as an alternative; choose instead; prefer as an alternative
example: Some people prefer only taking the courses that they want to take. What do you think of that?
exampleZh: 一些人只愿意学习他们喜欢的课程。你对此怎么看？

meaning: n. 利润，盈利； 利益，好处；v. 获益，得益（于）；赢利，获利；【名】 （Profit）（法）普罗菲（人名）
definition: 1. n. the excess of revenues over outlays in a given period of time (including depreciation and other non-cash expenses)；2. v. derive a benefit from
example: Now incidentally, in a for-profit corporation-- this is how to understand this, this is a concept that is enshrined in law.
exampleZh: 顺便提一下,在一家盈利性公司中,我们需要这样理解,这是个在法律中明文昭示的概念

meaning: v. 追求，致力于，执行；继续探讨（或追究、从事）；追逐，跟踪，追赶；沿着……前行；追求（某人）；力劝（某人）接受聘用
definition: 1. v. carry out or participate in an activity; be involved in；2. v. follow in or as if in pursuit
example: The best of them are winnowed out to pursue further study and eventually assume positions of public leadership and responsibility.
exampleZh: 学习能力最佳的人,会被精选出来深造,最后承继,公共领袖的职位与责任。

meaning: adv. 罕有，很少；异乎寻常地，极度
definition: 1. adv. not often
example: Rarely does the narrator comment on or explain a character's actions or thoughts or motives. There's only the barest minimum of dialogue.
exampleZh: 作者极少评价或解释一个人物的行为,或思想或动机，文章中只有不能再直白的对话。

meaning: v. 联系，使有联系；涉及，关于；叙述，讲述；认同，理解；相处，交往（描述人们如何交谈、相处和对待他人）
definition: 1. v. make a logical or causal connection；2. v. have to do with or be relevant to
example: I don't think he understood the dynamics of how the police and the city administration relate.
exampleZh: 我认为他不理解警方与市政部门如何发生联系的动态原理。

meaning: adj. 安全的，平安的；不损害（或危害）健康的；谨慎的；（地点或局势）安全的；不会丢失，不会被拿走； 不错的；不致引起争议的，有把握的；（棒球）成功上垒的；（选举中席位）十拿九稳的；无风险的，稳妥的；n. 保险箱； 阴茎套，安全套；纱橱；int. 嗨，喂（年轻人打招呼时说）；adv. 安全地，平安地；【名】 （Safe）（几）萨菲（人名）
definition: 1. n. strongbox where valuables can be safely kept；2. adj. free from danger or the risk of harm
example: So things can be dangerous. But generally, if you're smart, I think it's a very safe place to live.
exampleZh: 因此，危险还是存在的。但大多数情况下，只要你精明点，我认为那儿还是一个非常安全的居住地。

meaning: n. （某事发生的）环境，场合；（戏剧、小说或电影的）场景，背景；舞台布景；（设备的）档位；（宝石的）镶嵌底座；（为诗、祷文等谱写的）乐曲；（供一人用的）一副餐具；v. （小心地）放置；嵌入（表面）；（电影、戏剧、故事等）以……为背景（set 的现在分词形式）
definition: 1. n. the context and environment in which something is set；2. n. the state of the environment in which a situation exists
example: But still is very professional and you can use it in any setting, business or casual.
exampleZh: 但它也同样可以是很专业的表达，可以用在商务或是生活的各种语境。

meaning: v. （使）移动，（使）转移；（使）转换到（另一个人或另一事物）；（使）改变意见（或信仰等）；赶快；换（挡）；（计算机）移位；按（计算机键盘上的）Shift 键；摆脱，消除；（尤指大量）销售，出售；狼吞虎咽地吃；含糊其辞，拐弯抹角；n. 改变，转变；轮班工作时间；轮班工作的人；（计算机键盘上的）Shift 键；（计算机）移位；（机动车的）换挡装置；宽松直筒连衣裙（=shift dress）；长而宽松的内衣；（建筑）错位；（美橄）（开赛前）球员位置的变换；（天文）（光谱线的）偏移；语音演变（sound shift 的简称）；计谋，诡计
definition: 1. n. an event in which something is displaced without rotation；2. v. make a shift in or exchange of
example: So the reasons for this really enormous shift in plans, and the enormous shift in subject matter, are worth exploring.
exampleZh: 弥尔顿的计划变化为何如此之大，他对主题的选择为何有这么大的改变，是值得探究的。

meaning: n. （问题、困难等的）解决办法；（练习或竞赛的）解答，答案；溶液；溶解过程，溶解状态；（满足特定需要的）产品（或服务）（solutions）
definition: 1. n. a homogeneous mixture of two or more substances; frequently (but not necessarily) a liquid solution；2. n. a statement that solves a problem or explains how to solve the problem
example: The notion here is that you can get a globally optimal solution from locally optimal solutions to sub-problems.
exampleZh: 这里的概念是你可以通过,子问题的局部最优方案,得到全局优化解决方案。

meaning: v. 展开，打开；张开，伸开（手臂、手指、腿）；扩散，蔓延；传播，传染；散布，（使）流传；（人，动物，植物）分布，分散开来；撒，散播；传递；（脸上）露出，渐渐表现出；涂，敷；分摊，分配；延伸，伸展，扩张；分散（于某一时段内），分期还清（债务）；分散（风险）；n. 扩散，蔓延；范围，幅度，种类；延展度，宽度，覆盖面；涂抹食品的酱类；盛宴，酒席；（尤指横贯两版的）文章，广告；床罩；大农场，大牧场；翼展；一大片；（两种价格或比率的）差额，差幅；（两支对抗的运动队之间比分的）差距；（物理，生理）点源能量传播；adj. 伸展的
definition: 1. n. process or result of distributing or extending over a wide expanse of space；2. v. distribute or disperse widely
example: So I've sort of just spread out what we have as the second row here, graphed against the ionization energy.
exampleZh: 所以我将第二行的情况,在这里展了，纵坐标是电离能。

meaning: v. 粘，贴；刺，戳，插；（随便）摆放，放置；伸出，突出；卡住，钉住；容忍，忍受；被接受，被众人采用；（牌戏中）不再要牌；停顿下来，没有进展；（生气地）放弃（和打发）；使支付，导致损失；n. 枯枝，枝条；条状物，棍状物；（用于某特定用途的）棍，条，签；球棍，球棒；变速杆，操纵杆；批评，惩罚；边远地区（the sticks）；（家具的）件；非常瘦的人（或四肢）；画着短细直线的；球门柱（the sticks）；（股票）大宗死股；【名】 （Stick）（芬）斯蒂克（人名）
definition: 1. n. an implement consisting of a length of wood；2. v. fix, force, or implant
example: Or take this value out of memory, run it through some other simple operation, stick it back in memory.
exampleZh: 或者从记忆存储器中取出一个结果，在类似的操作中运行，再插回到存储器中。

meaning: v. 成功，达成；（学业、事业或其他活动）表现出色，有作为；取得预期效果，表现良好；继任，接任；接替，随后出现；结果却是……；若一次不成功，要再接再厉
definition: 1. v. attain success or reach a desired goal；2. v. be the successor (of)
example: And as far as right now, just study hard, learn the material that will help you succeed.
exampleZh: 就现阶段来讲，最重要的是勤奋学习，有一些知识是走向成功必不可少的，你要好好学习这些知识。

meaning: adj. 极好的，极优秀的；超级的；adv. 极其，非常；n. （英国的）警官，（美国的）警长；（大楼的）管理人；主管，上司；过磷酸盐，过磷酸钙；特级品，特优产品；跑龙套的角色，临时演员；【名】 （Super）休珀（人名）
definition: 1. n. a caretaker for an apartment house; represents the owner as janitor and rent collector；2. adj. of the highest quality
example: I'm going to Greece in the summer so I've got to be super slim.
exampleZh: 我这个夏天要去希腊，所以我得变得超级苗条才行。

meaning: prep. 遍及，到处；自始至终，贯穿整个时期；adv. 遍及，到处；自始至终，贯穿整个时期
definition: 1. adv. from first to last；2. adv. used to refer to cited works
example: He influenced a great many people whose work is still current throughout the United States and elsewhere.
exampleZh: 他影响了很多人,这些人在美国和其他国家至今仍有影响力。

meaning: prep. 向，朝，往；趋向，趋于；对于；接近（时间）；靠近；用于，为了（同 towards）；adj. 即将来到的；进行中的
definition: abstract: Toward Lighthouse and Foghorn Building
example: Now this may suggest a certain condescension both toward theory and toward literary text, which is not at all intended.
exampleZh: 选择这篇文章也许意味着,要对理论和文本进行一定的浓缩，这一点不是我想要的。

meaning: prep. 向，朝着；接近达到（目的）；接近，将近（某一时间）；接近，靠近（某地）；对，关于；（钱）用于
example: She spread her arms and the child ran towards her.
exampleZh: 她张开双臂，孩子向她跑来。

meaning: n. （人的个性的）特征，特点；遗传特征；一点，少许；【名】 （Trait）（美、法）特雷（人名）
definition: 1. a particular characteristic that can produce a particular type of behaviour；2. a characteristic, esp. of a personality
example: What do you think is your strongest trait that helped you get into this university?
exampleZh: 你觉得你的什么特质帮你进入了这所大学？

meaning: n. 运输，运送；交通运输系统；运输工具，交通方式；（犯人的）流放，放逐
definition: 1. n. a facility consisting of the means and equipment necessary for the movement of passengers or goods；2. n. the act of moving something from one location to another
example: You have to have a good public transportation system when you have as many people here as we do.
exampleZh: 如果你那儿和我们这儿的人一样多，你们得有一个良好的公共交通系统。

meaning: vt. 构成……的基础，为……的起因；位于……的下面
definition: 1. to be a hidden cause of or strong influence on something；2. to be a cause of or strong influence on something
example: Scant attention has been paid to many of the dubious social and economic assumptions that underlie the plan.
exampleZh: 人们对该计划背后的许多可疑的社会和经济假设缺乏关注。

meaning: prep. 不像，和……不同；不是……的个性（或特点）；（用于对比）与……不同；adj. 不同的，不相似的；v. 取消点赞；以厌恶或敌意看待，不喜欢（be unliked）；conj. 不同于
definition: adj. marked by dissimilarity；adj. not equal in amount
example: Should a tree write its autobiography, it would not be unlike the history of a race.
exampleZh: 如果一棵树写出自传，它会像一个民族的历史。

meaning: v. 敦促，催促，力劝；竭力主张，强烈要求；驱赶，鞭策；鼓励，激励（~ sb. on）；n. 强烈的欲望，冲动；推动力
definition: 1. n. an instinctive motive；2. v. force or impel in an indicated direction
example: He says, "Sin couches at the door; Its urge is toward you Yet you can be its master," Genesis 4:7.
exampleZh: 上帝说，罪恶在门外召唤;,它能控制你,你却不能成为他的主人，《创世纪》第4章第7节。

meaning: adv. 通常地，经常地
definition: 1. adv. under normal conditions
example: We usually use this pattern when the question that you're asking about relates directly to the person you're speaking with.
exampleZh: 当你在询问与谈话对方直接有关的话题时，你可以使用这个句型。

meaning: v. 欣赏，鉴赏；理解，明白；感谢，感激；升值，增值
definition: 1. v. recognize with gratitude; be grateful for；2. v. be fully aware of; realize fully
example: What I want to do is get you to appreciate the unique perspective that you will get from studying solid-state chemistry.
exampleZh: 我要做的是，让你们,欣赏领会到它独特的远景,在学习固体化学的过程中。

meaning: n. 基础，要素；基准，方式；理由，根据；主要成分（或部分）
definition: 1. n. a relation that provides the foundation for something；2. n. the fundamental assumptions from which something is begun or developed or calculated or explained
example: Here, the stopping of the train is like the interruption by memory of normal consciousness that's the basis of the poem.
exampleZh: 这里，火车的停止就像是,被正常知觉的记忆所打断，那是这首诗的基础。

meaning: n. 战役，战争；争论，斗争；竞赛，较量；拼搏，奋斗；v. 与……作战，和……斗争；搏斗，奋斗；争吵，争论；阻止，打败；【名】 （Battle）（英）巴特尔，（法）巴特勒，（西）巴特莱（人名）
definition: 1. n. a hostile meeting of opposing military forces in the course of a war；2. v. battle or contend against in or as if in a battle
example: Well,you're in some battle,or rather, your troop is in some battle, and people are being killed left and right.
exampleZh: 比如你在战场上，或者说你的军队在战场上，周围的人被杀死。

meaning: n. 身体，躯体；躯干；尸体；（与灵魂或精神相对的）肉体；（尤指某种类型或性格的）人；（建筑物、文件等的）主体，主要部分；车身，机身；衣身；器身，（球拍的）拍身；团体，机构，群体；大量；物体，天体；水域；（酒的）醇度，醇厚；（头发的）稠密度，浓密；（妇女或婴儿的）紧身衣裤；（制陶用语）坯体；v. 赋予（抽象事物）以形体，使具体化；制造（汽车）的车身；【名】 （Body）（英、法、罗）博迪（人名）
definition: 1. n. the entire structure of an organism (especially an animal or human being)；2. v. invest with or as with a body; give body to
example: Yeats counterposes Isaiah's prophetic coal to the blazing body of Section IV, where fire is spontaneous, imminent, something that arises from the body.
exampleZh: 叶芝将比赛亚的预言性的煤,和第五节里燃烧的身体相对照，这里火是自燃的，迫在眉睫的，是从人身体里升出的。

meaning: n. 书，书籍；本子，簿册；（长篇作品的）篇，卷，部；装订成册之物；赌局，打赌；账册，账簿；v. 预订，预约；（警方）将……记录在案；（裁判）记名警告；【名】 （Book）（英）布克，（瑞典）博克，（朝）北（人名）
definition: 1. n. a written work or composition that has been published (printed on pages bound together)；2. v. record a charge in a police register
example: In "The Horror and the Glory," the second half of the book as originally written, that voice becomes the parenthetical.
exampleZh: 恐惧与荣耀“,在书的第二部分，插叙引出了。

meaning: n. 机会，时机；可能性；危险，冒险；运气，偶然；v. 偶然，碰巧；冒险做；adj. 偶然的，碰巧的；【名】 （Chance）（英）钱斯（人名）
definition: 1. n. a possibility due to a favorable combination of circumstances；2. v. be the case by chance
example: And I had done well, so I knew that I had a good chance of getting into graduate school,
exampleZh: 我的表现也不错，所以，我知道我有很大的机会被研究生院录取，

meaning: n. 厨师，主厨；v. 当厨师；【名】 （Chef）（法）谢夫（人名）
definition: 1. n. a professional cook
example: I think he's perhaps a bit more sort of respected here as a chef than Jamie Oliver.
exampleZh: 我想，作为厨师，他在这里比杰米•奥利弗更受尊重。

meaning: adj. 复杂的，难懂的；组合的，合成的；（句子）复合的；复数的，复的；配合的，络合的；n. 综合大楼，建筑群；复合体，综合体；情结；强烈（或过度）的关心（或忧虑）；配合物，络合物
definition: 1. n. a conceptual whole made up of complicated and related parts；2. adj. complicated in structure; consisting of interconnected parts
example: So it's a complex issue, and I should leave it having said this much, at least for the moment.
exampleZh: 因此它是一个很复杂的问题，而我就讲到这里，至少暂时这样。

meaning: n. 结论，推论；结局，结尾；缔结，商定；（根据所给前提得出的）命题
definition: 1. n. a position or opinion or judgment reached after consideration；2. n. an intuitive assumption
example: It is 1.7475. Conclusion: if I start to react sodium with chlorine, the result is a crystal, a three-dimensional array.
exampleZh: 这是1。7475，结论就是：,如果我使钠和氯反应，结果将会是一个晶体，一个三维排列。

meaning: v. 实施，进行；指挥；带领，引导；举止，表现；传导；n. 行为，举止；经营方式，管理方法
definition: 1. n. manner of acting or controlling yourself；2. v. direct the course of; manage or control
example: Beyond this, his youth must be innocent of crime and chaste, his conduct irreproachable and his hands stainless.
exampleZh: 通过这些，他的青春,将是贞洁的而不会充满犯罪，他的行为将是无可非难的，他的手将不会有任何污点。

meaning: n. 消费者，顾客，用户；食用者，使用者，消耗者
definition: 1. n. a person who uses goods or services
example: But I was a really good programmer and I wanted to understand the consumer side of the Internet.
exampleZh: 但我是个很好的程序设计师,我想了解互联网关于消费者的一面。

meaning: n. 难题，困难
definition: 1. n. an effort that is inconvenient；2. n. a factor causing trouble in achieving a positive result or tending to produce a negative result
example: Its difficulty lies in Milton's tendency in this poem to seek out what Dr. Johnson wonderfully calls remote allusions.
exampleZh: 诗的难点在于弥尔顿想要在诗中极力追求,被约翰逊绝妙地称为不切实际的幻想的倾向。

meaning: n. 司机，驾驶员；驱动程序；推动力；驱赶某种动物的人；传动装置，主动轮；（电子）激励器；高尔夫球棒；【名】 （Driver）（英）德赖弗，（德）德里弗（人名）
definition: 1. n. the operator of a motor vehicle；2. n. someone who drives animals that pull a vehicle
example: The driver's expression and his hand stayed exactly the way they were, as if he didn't hear very well.
exampleZh: 就像是没怎么听见似的,那个司机的表情和手几乎一动不动，“

meaning: adj. 自然环境的，生态环境的；环保的，生态环境保护的；与周围环境有关的，由生存环境引起的
definition: 1. adj. concerned with the ecological effects of altering the environment；2. adj. of or relating to the external conditions or surroundings
example: So my favorite class right now is, I'm taking a clinical law class and environmental law
exampleZh: 我现在最喜欢的一门课是法律实务和环境法，

meaning: v. 进化，演化；逐步发展，逐渐演变
definition: 1. v. work out；2. v. undergo development or evolution
example: That is the modification of what would and does evolve in and of itself within an understanding of literary historiography.
exampleZh: 这种修正会在文学历史的领域里,进化自己。

meaning: v. 表达，表露；表现，体现；（用数学方法）表示；压榨，挤压出（空气或液体）；特快发运；n. 快车；快递；初速大的猎枪；专使；捷运公司；adj. 快递的，特快的；明确的；特意的；adv. 用快递寄送
definition: 1. n. rapid transport of goods；2. v. give expression to
example: So maybe what we have here is another polemic,another adaptation of familiar stories and motifs to express something new.
exampleZh: 所以，也许这又是另一场辩论,又是对我们所熟悉故事的颠覆。

meaning: v. （使）淹没；泛滥；大量涌来，大量涌去；（感觉或回忆）涌上心头；（光线）倾泻，照亮；（使）溢流；（产后等）子宫出血过多，月经过多；n. 洪水，水灾；大批，大量（的人或事物）；（海洋、江河等）大水体；【名】 （Flood）（美、英、加）弗勒德（人名）
definition: 1. n. the rising of a body of water and its overflowing onto normally dry land；2. v. fill quickly beyond capacity; as with a liquid
example: When we read the flood story in Genesis 6 through 9, we're often struck by the very odd literary style.
exampleZh: 当我们在《创世纪》中读到关于大洪水故事时，会觉得文风非常奇怪。

meaning: adv. 充分地，完全地，彻底地；（强调数量）整整，至少；【名】 （Fully）（法）菲利（人名）
definition: adv. to the greatest degree or extent; completely or entirely; (`full' in this sense is used as a combining form)；adv. sufficiently; more than adequately
example: stem cell researchers have found a way to get perfectly usable stem cells from fully grown human beings.
exampleZh: 干细胞研究者已经找到了一种方法，可以从成年人身上获取可用的干细胞。

meaning: n. 功能，职责；宴会，典礼；函数，应变量；由其他事情造成的结果；子例行程序，子例程；官能团，功能团；v. 工作，运转；行使职责，发挥功能
definition: 1. n. a mathematical relation such that each element of one set is associated with at least one element of another set；2. v. perform as expected when applied
example: What lambda that does, it creates on the fly a function, as the program runs. That I can then pass around.
exampleZh: 这里的入是在函数运行的时候，由一个函数创建的，然后我会传递这个值。

meaning: adj. 总体的，普遍的；一般的，常规的；大致的，大概的；综合的，广泛的；首席的，总管的；n. 上将，将军；半军事化管理的宗教组织（如耶稣会修士、多明我会修士或救世军）的领袖；大众，公众；【名】 （General）（英）杰纳勒尔（人名）
definition: 1. n. a general officer of the highest rank；2. v. command as a general
example: It began to infiltrate other disciplines and was in general a high-spirited horse for that certain period of time.
exampleZh: 它逐渐渗入到其它学科,总之是那个时代的一匹黑马。

meaning: n. 网格，方格；栅栏；输电网，电力网；赛车起跑线；美式橄榄球球场，橄榄球赛；（控制）栅极；计算机联网；v. 使……构成网格状，布置成网格结构
definition: 1. a pattern or structure made from horizontal and vertical lines crossing each other to form squares；2. a system of wires through which electricity is connected to different power stations across a region, or the system of connected pipes for water and gas
example: The television screens of the next century will be linked up to an emerging world telecommunications grid.
exampleZh: 下个世纪的电视屏幕将与一种新兴的世界电信网格相连。

meaning: n. 公顷（土地丈量单位，等于1万平方米或约2.5英亩）
definition: 1. n. (abbreviated `ha') a unit of surface area equal to 100 ares (or 10,000 square meters)
example: His family had a 40-hectare farm on which they grew wheat, maize and hay and raised pigs and cattle.
exampleZh: 他家有一个40公顷的农场，种植小麦、玉米和干草，还养猪和牛。

meaning: adv. 在这里，此处；到这里，朝这里（常与 come、go 等连用）；此时，此刻；在这一点上，在这方面；给，这就是（用于句首或给予时引出）；int. 嘿，喂！（用于引起注意或应答）；n. 这里，此处
definition: 1. n. the present location; this place；2. adj. being here now
example: So let's take a look down here at what I'm doing and notice here that this is perhaps more compelling; right?
exampleZh: 让我们往下看一下我在做什么,请注意这里这个可能是更引人入胜的，对不？

meaning: n. 形象，印象；影像，映像，图像；比喻，意象；画像，塑像，雕像；酷似另一个人的人；（人或事物）外形，外表；像点；硬盘备份；（圣经）偶像；v. 作……的像，描绘……的形象；（以探测器或电磁束）扫描出……的直观图；幻想，想像；【名】 （Image）（法）伊马热（人名）
definition: 1. n. an iconic mental representation；2. v. imagine; conceive of; see in one's mind
example: Milton pushes this image even further into indistinctness with an instance of his famous deployment of the conjunction or.
exampleZh: 弥尔顿甚至把这幅图像发展为朦胧的意象,添加了一丝他引以著称的对关联的展开。

meaning: adj. 必然发生的，不可避免的；总会发生的，惯常的；n. 必然发生的事，不可避免的事
definition: 1. n. an unavoidable event；2. adj. incapable of being avoided or prevented
example: There were tales, inevitable tales of-- and with French food, as you know, presentation accounts for something very much.
exampleZh: 还有一些不可避免的传说,关于法国菜的传说,菜的品相是很重要的

meaning: v. 相互交流，互动；相互作用，相互影响
definition: 1. v. act together or towards others or with others
example: And we will show you exactly how you can write programs that actually interact with the user in that way.
exampleZh: 我们将给大家示范如何,书写代码以及跟用户交互。

meaning: n. 互动，交流；相互影响，相互作用
definition: 1. n. a mutual or reciprocal action; interacting；2. n. (physics) the transfer of energy between elementary particles or between an elementary particle and a field or between fields; mediated by gauge bosons
example: it's happening. And I think it's happening, I think it's being sped up by humans, by our interaction.
exampleZh: 这是一个正在发生的事实，由于人类的活动，这个进程在加速。

meaning: n. 投资；值得买的东西；（时间、精力的）投入；包围，封锁
definition: 1. n. the act of investing; laying out money or capital in an enterprise with the expectation of profit；2. n. money that is invested with an expectation of profit
example: But then who would understand better than John Milton, Sr. the importance or the value of a long-term investment strategy?
exampleZh: 但在那时谁又比弥尔顿先生更懂得,长远投资的重要性呢？

meaning: adj. 中间的，中等的；折中的，中庸之道的；（语言）中古的，介于现代与古代之间的；语法中动态的，中间反身态的；（英语及物动词）无被动态的；n. 中间，中部，中等；腰部；语法中动态，中间反身态；v. （板球、网球等中）用球棒（或拍）中部击（球）
definition: 1. n. an area that is approximately central within some larger region；2. v. put in the middle
example: Now,what about those Episcopalians? As one of my friends says, "Those whiskey-palians." They decided to be in the middle.
exampleZh: 那些圣公会呢？就像我一个朋友所说的，那些威士忌佩利安，他们决定保持中立。

meaning: n. 肌肉；体力，力气；权力，影响力；身强力壮的男子（们）；v. 用力搬动；挤； 以经济（或政治）压力迫使；加强
definition: 1. n. one of the contractile organs of the body；2. v. make one's way by force
example: Now, in the heart action potential is moving from one heart muscle cell to another over the surface of the heart.
exampleZh: 心脏中的动作电位,沿相邻心肌细胞在心脏表面传递

meaning: v. 反抗，阻碍；与……竞争，与……角逐
definition: 1. v. be against; express opposition to；2. v. fight against or resist strongly
example: This party would bitterly oppose the re-introduction of the death penalty.
exampleZh: 本党会强烈反对恢复死刑。

meaning: n. 外表，外部（the outside）；（建筑物、车辆等的）周围，外围（the outside）；（人行道的）外侧；（弯曲路面或轨道的）外道，边缘；一令纸的上下两张（outsides）；局外（人士），外界（人士）；prep. 在……的外面，在户外；超出……的范围（或界限）；（团体或组织）以外的；除了，除……之外（outside of）；adv. 在外面；在户外，在四周；在外侧，表面上；adj. 外边的，表面的；（曲棍球、足球等）边锋的；（建筑物）外围的，四周的；不属于本团体（或机构、国家等）的，不相关的；（可能性）极微小的，不大可能的；（车道）靠近路中间的，快车道的
definition: 1. n. the region that is outside of something；2. adj. relating to or being on or near the outer side or limit
example: Yeah, I think if you live outside of London and you need to commute, you got to get the train.
exampleZh: 如果你住在伦敦市区外面，你需要坐火车上下班往返。

meaning: n. 纸；报纸；（工作、学习或个人的）资料，文件（papers）；证明，证件（如护照、身份证等）（papers）；政府报告，官方政策文件；考试，答卷；（研究）论文，（学术）讲话；（学校课程的）学期论文；墙纸，壁纸；有价证券；手纸，卫生纸；（剧院等娱乐场所的）免费入场券；v. 用墙纸裱糊（墙壁）；用墙纸覆盖（洞，污点）（paper sth. over）；掩盖（尴尬问题）（paper sth. over）；发免费入场券使（剧院）满座；adj. 纸做的，纸质的；书面的，印刷的；纸上的，有名无实的；【名】 （Paper）（俄）帕佩尔（人名）
definition: 1. n. a material made of cellulose pulp derived mainly from wood or rags or certain grasses；2. v. cover with paper
example: It was interesting that I sent home because we will be doing this paper and we will be doing family tree.
exampleZh: 我让他们在家完成的作业很有意思,因为我们要完成这张纸上的内容,并画一个族谱。

meaning: n. （跳舞、玩游戏等的）搭档，同伴；（合伙企业的）合伙人；（生意、组织或国家的）伙伴；配偶，（同居的）伴侣，情人；v. 成为搭档，合伙；【名】 （Partner）（英、德）帕特纳（人名）
definition: 1. n. a person's partner in marriage；2. v. provide with a partner
example: For example, maybe you are a partner at your firm and you're working with an associate on a project.
exampleZh: 例如，你是公司的合伙人，你和一位同事正在共同跟进一个项目。

meaning: v. 经过，穿过；传递，传送；传（球）；（所有权）转移，转让；（状态）转变；（数量上）超过，突破；（时间）流逝；度过，消磨；通过（考试、课程等）；批准（法律或议案）；发生，说过；略过（问题）；排泄；使（货币等）流通；结束，停止；拒绝邀请（提议）；宣布，声明；（纸牌等游戏中）不叫，过；n. 出入证，通行证；及格，合格；传球；山道，山口；阶段，步骤；（计算机）一次浏览，一次扫描；越过；变戏法；（击剑中的）戳刺；（不好的）境遇，处境；（桥牌）不叫；【名】 （Pass）（德、英）帕斯（人名）
definition: 1. n. (baseball) an advance to first base by a batter who receives four balls；2. v. go across or through
example: According to the Second Brother, it's virtually impossible for a single, helpless maiden to pass uninjured in this wild, surrounding waste.
exampleZh: 弟弟认为，一个孤独无助的女孩想要，毫发无伤的穿过这野外的荒原是根本不可能的。

meaning: adj. 政治（上）的，政府的；政党的，党派的；对政治感兴趣的，参与政治的；反政府的；（组织内部人际间）牵涉权力关系的，争权夺利的
definition: 1. adj. involving or characteristic of politics or parties or politicians；2. adj. of or relating to your views about social relationships involving authority or power
example: What may be most important here is the mere fact that Milton is expressing these political convictions at all.
exampleZh: 这里最重要的不过是,弥尔顿只是在表达他的政治信念。

meaning: n. 优先事项，最重要的事；优先，优先权，重点；优先通行权；adj. 优先的
definition: 1. n. status established in order of importance or urgency；2. n. preceding in time
example: Two quotations, the first the president Bush " "Passing a new growth package is our most pressing economic priority."
exampleZh: 下面是两个引述，第一个来自布什总统,“一个新的一揽子增长计划迫在眉睫“

meaning: n. （以销售为目的的）生产，制造；（对自然物的）加工，采集，生产；产量；（自然的）产生；（交通工具的）大量生产；（戏剧、电影、电视节目、唱片等的）制作；（戏剧、电影等的）上映，上演；（尤指从制作与公演等特点来看）影片，戏剧；音响效果，制作方式；出示，提供；非常费力的事，非常复杂的事
definition: 1. n. (economics) manufacturing or mining or growing something (usually in large quantities) for sale；2. n. a presentation for the stage or screen or radio or television
example: My other roommate is named Cooper Lewis, who is actually going to play Hamlet in that production.
exampleZh: 我的另一个室友叫库伯·路易斯，他会在那场戏剧演出中扮演哈姆雷特。

meaning: adv. 快速地；很快，马上；短暂地，匆匆地
definition: adv. with rapid movements；adv. with little or no delay
example: Twenty years have passed so quickly, in the blink of an eye.
exampleZh: 二十年快滴很，弹指一挥间。

meaning: v. 停止，戒掉；离开（工作岗位、学校等），离任；搬离（租住的房子），离开（某地）；关闭，退出（计算机程序等）；使解除，使摆脱；adj. 摆脱了……的，已经了结的（quit of）；n. 辞职，离任；【名】 （Quit）（英）奎特（人名）
definition: 1. v. put an end to a state or an activity；2. v. give up or retire from a position
example: I once counted the number of times he used the word the letter--O--in that poem, and I quit counting.
exampleZh: 我曾经数过他到底在诗里用了多少个"啊",最后我放弃了

meaning: adv. 快速地，迅速地
definition: adv. with rapid movements
example: If somebody just steps back and truly listens and watches the customers rapidly iterates, good things tend to happen.
exampleZh: 如果有人能够退后一步,认真倾听用户的需求，好事就会发生。

meaning: v. 了解，意识到；（所担心的事）发生，产生（be realized）；实现（目标、梦想等）；（充分）发挥出自己的潜力； 把（概念等）具体表现出来；用（语言特征）表达；对（记谱不全的乐曲）做完整兑谱改编；获得（金钱，利润）；变现，变卖（资产）
definition: v. be fully aware or cognizant of；v. perceive (an idea or situation) mentally
example: She was mortified to realize he had heard every word she said.
exampleZh: 她意识到自己的每句话都被他听到了，直羞得无地自容。

meaning: v. 提到，谈及（refer to）；描述，涉及（refer to）；查阅，参考（refer to）；将……送交给（以求获得帮助等）；让（某人）注意；把……归因于；（考试中）淘汰（应试者）
definition: 1. v. make reference to；2. v. have to do with or be relevant to
example: They come from Tuam, a place they refer to on the title track of their album, "All the Way From Tuam."
exampleZh: 他们来自蒂厄姆，一个他们在专辑的标题曲《从蒂厄姆远路而来》中提到的地方。

meaning: adj. 可靠的，可信赖的；真实可信的，确凿的；（汽车、设备、系统等）耐用的，性能稳定的；n. 可靠的人（或物）
definition: 1. adj. worthy of reliance or trust；2. adj. conforming to fact and therefore worthy of belief
example: With some degree of confidence, I'm working with a reliable spring and then I will get the mass of the elephant.
exampleZh: 这时我就对弹簧有信心了,我用的是一个可靠的弹簧,我能测出大象的质量

meaning: v. 回想起，记得；记起，忆起（某事物）；记牢，不忘记；纪念，缅怀；（祈祷时）为......祝福；送钱，送礼（给某人）；代（某人）问候（某人）；（失态后）检点，补救
definition: 1. v. recall knowledge from memory; have a recollection；2. v. keep in mind for attention or consideration
example: Now you also may remember that we have already run into Spenser's Mammon before this point, before Paradise Lost.
exampleZh: 现在你们可能也记得我们已经,在遇到《失乐园》之前就与斯潘塞的贪欲之神相遇了。

meaning: v. 阻挡，抵制；抵抗，回击；耐得住，抵挡；使不受……的伤害，抗（伤害）；n. 保护涂层（防染色、着釉等），防染材料
definition: 1. v. elude, especially in a baffling way；2. v. stand up or offer resistance to somebody or something
example: You apply a force and the material will resist it until you have a force great enough to break the bonds.
exampleZh: 如何你对它施加一个外力，材料能够承受,除非这个外力足够强大去打破键。

meaning: n. 反应，响应；（口头或书面的）回复，答复；（考试题的）答案；（教堂中人们对牧师所说的话作出的）唱和，应答
definition: 1. n. a result；2. n. a bodily process occurring due to the effect of some foregoing stimulus or agent
example: But in this case it's a response produced in the negative register similar to the responses produced in the saloon.
exampleZh: 在这次让人讨厌的举动中,理查表现得与在酒吧里一样。

meaning: n. 责任，负责；（对不良事件所负的）责任；（道义上或法律规定的）责任（responsibility to/towards）；职责，任务；重任，职权
definition: 1. n. the social force that binds you to the courses of action demanded by that force；2. n. the proper sphere or extent of your activities
example: They throw a lot of work at us, we have a lot of responsibility, it's all new.
exampleZh: 他们丢给我们一大堆工作，我们责任很大，还都是新的。

meaning: v. 回来，回去；归还，退还；回报，回应；（感觉或情况）重新出现，恢复；重新开始，继续（某项活动）；带来，产生（利润或损失）；回击，击回； 宣告（裁决）；选举，选出；（建筑）（尤指成直角）转延（墙壁）；（高尔夫）打后九穴；（美橄）截获（对方传、踢或漏球）反攻；（桥牌）（尤指同伴所攻出的同花色牌赢墩后）跟着打出，回出；把（空瓶或空罐头盒）送到回收站；n. 回来，返回；归还，退回；重新开始，恢复；回报，收益； 往返票，来回票；返回键，回车键；（选举）结果；（网球等）回击球；（纳税）申报表，申报单；（建筑）转延，转延侧面；回路导线；被退回（或送回）的东西，退票；（可以回收的）空罐头盒，空瓶子（returns）；adj. （票）双程的，往返的；（旅途）返回的，返程的；（比赛）回访的；再度的，再次的
definition: 1. n. document giving the tax collector information about the taxpayer's tax liability；2. v. come back to place where one has been before, or return to a previous activity
example: They're plainly interrelated in a variety of ways, but it's more to the question of determinism I want to return today.
exampleZh: 在很多方面他们都相互联系，但是今天我要多谈点有关决定论的问题。

meaning: v. 揭示，透露；表明，证明；展示，显示；（通过神或超自然手段）启示；n. （电视节目最后的）揭示；门侧，窗侧
definition: 1. v. make visible；2. v. make known to the public information that was previously known only to a few people or that was meant to be kept a secret
example: The good scholars of Milton reveal their typical resistance to anything even remotely interesting or alive in the text.
exampleZh: 研究弥尔顿的优秀学者们透露他们反对,研究文本中那些不太有趣和生动的东西。

meaning: n. 路，公路，马路，街； 途径，方法，路子；（矿）地下巷道；贸易路线；铁路；（列车可通行的）无障碍铁路路轨，特殊情况铁路路轨；近岸锚地，港外锚地；【名】 （Road）（英）罗德（人名）
definition: 1. n. an open way (generally public) for travel or transportation；2. adj. taking place over public roads
example: When he gets back to New York, finally, at the end of this first road trip, he has missed Dean.
exampleZh: 当他终于回到纽约时，在这首次旅途的末期，他弄丢了迪恩。

meaning: n. 房间，室；客房；（租用的）住所，寓所（rooms）；空间，地方；机会， 余地；房间里所有的人；v. 租房，合住； 让……同住；【名】 （Room）（英）鲁姆，（俄）罗姆（人名）
definition: 1. n. an area within a building enclosed by walls and floor and ceiling；2. v. live and take one's meals at or in
example: Each guest has her own single room, or shares, on request, a double room.
exampleZh: 每位客人都有自己的单人房间，经要求也可共用双人间。

meaning: v. 搜查，搜寻；搜查（地方，车辆），搜……的身；思索，细想（问题答案等）；细察，细查；（用计算机）搜索，检索；n. 搜寻，搜查；探索，寻求；（计算机的）搜索，检索；调查地产负担；【名】 （Search）（印、美）瑟奇（人名）
definition: 1. n. the activity of looking thoroughly in order to find something or someone；2. v. try to locate or discover, or try to establish the existence of
example: You'll remember that in his search for immortality Utnapishtim Gilgamesh sought out Utnapishtim, the one human who had been granted immortality.
exampleZh: 他对永生的追求,吉尔伽美什找到，唯一可以长生不老的人类。

meaning: num. 第二（的），第二个（的）；（重要性、规模、质量等）居第二位的；另外的，外加的；n. 秒（时间单位）；片刻，瞬间；秒（角度单位）；次品，二等货；第二次上菜，添菜（seconds）；（车辆的）第二挡；（英国大学本科的）二等成绩学位；（学校或大学的）二年级；（棒球的）二垒；正式支持，附议；（体育俱乐部的）预备队（the seconds）；粗面粉，粗粉面包；（尤指拳击比赛或旧时决斗中的）助手；（乐）二度音程；v. 支持，附议；临时调派，短期调任；adv. 以第二位；第二，其次；【名】 (Second) （美）塞孔（人名）
definition: 1. n. 1/60 of a minute; the basic unit of time adopted under the Systeme International d'Unites；2. v. give support or one's approval to
example: What did we lose in our understanding of it as a literary object when the second half was not published?
exampleZh: 将它置于文学作品之列来理解时,我们失去了什么？,书的后半部分没出版时？

meaning: n. 指示牌，标志；迹象，征兆；示意动作，手势；手语动作；符号，记号；踪迹，踪影；（医）征，体征；神迹（主要用于《圣经》和文学作品中）；（野生动物的）足迹，臭迹；（占星）（黄道12宫中的）宫，星座；（数）正负号；暗号，信号；（表示某人状况或经历的）动作，反应；v. 签名，署名；（与机构、公司等）签约；示意，打手势；打手语；用标志杆（或其他记号）表示
definition: 1. n. a perceptible indication of something not immediately apparent (as a visible clue that something has happened)；2. v. mark with one's signature; write one's name (on)
example: I'm looking at the small print; I don't want to sign anything that I shouldn't sign.
exampleZh: 我在读小体印刷的细则，我不想在不该签的文件上签字。

meaning: adj. 特殊的，特别的；格外看重的，特别要好的；专门的，特设的；特有的，独具特色的；格外的，分外的；（主题）研究深入的；（数）特殊（矩阵）的；n. 特色菜；特别节目；特价商品，折扣商品；特派员，临时警察，特约记者；专车；【名】 （Special）（印、美、俄）史派西娅乐（人名）
definition: 1. n. a special offering (usually temporary and at a reduced price) that is featured in advertising；2. adj. unique or specific to a person or thing or category
example: I felt like, in my hometown of Huston, it was cool, special, and different that I was an actor.
exampleZh: 在我的老家休斯顿，作为一名演员，我觉得很酷、很特别、很与众不同。

meaning: adj. 明确的，具体的；特定的；特有的，独特的；有特殊功能的，有特效的；（生物）种的；（关税，税）按数量（根据固定税率）征取而非按货价征取的；（物理）（与参照物同一性质成）比率的；n. 细节，详情；特效药
definition: 1. n. a fact about some part (as opposed to general)；2. adj. (sometimes followed by `to') applying to or characterized by or distinguishing something particular or special or unique
example: This is very simple but it's a great way to ask about a specific category among many different categories.
exampleZh: 这是个非常简单的句型，但它在询问不同种类中某一特定类型的事物时是非常理想的句型。

meaning: n. 街道，街；马路，车行道；街头，户外（公共场合）；（用于街道名称或地址）…街，…大街
definition: 1. n. a thoroughfare (usually including sidewalks) that is lined with buildings；2. n. the part of a thoroughfare between the sidewalks; the part of the thoroughfare on which vehicles travel
example: And you've asked several people on the street . "I just can't get there! I don't know where I'm going!" and
exampleZh: 你在街边向几个行人问路。“我没法找到目的地了，我不知道该怎么走！”

meaning: n. 精神压力，紧张；压力，应力；强调，重要性；（单词）重音，重读，（音乐）加强音；压强；环境恶劣引起的疾病；v. 强调，着重；重读；焦虑，紧张；使受压力，使受重压；【名】 （Stress）（意）斯特雷斯 （人名）
definition: 1. n. the relative prominence of a syllable or musical note (especially with regard to stress or pitch)；2. v. to stress, single out as important
example: What I want to stress now is that Yeats sees passion at work in the same way in history.
exampleZh: 我现在要强调的是,叶芝在工作中感到了激情,就如他在历史中感受到的一样。

meaning: adj. （计划、方法、体制）可持续的，持续性的；（自然资源）可持续的，不破坏环境的 ；站得住脚的
definition: 1. adj. capable of being sustained
example: such as taking women out of Thailand who are in prostitution and providing them with sustainable income.
exampleZh: 比如把在泰国卖淫的女性解救出来，向她们提供可持续的收入。

meaning: adv. 因此；这样，以此种方式；到如此程度
definition: 1. n. an aromatic gum resin obtained from various Arabian or East African trees; formerly valued for worship and for embalming and fumigation；2. adv. (used to introduce a logical conclusion) from that fact or reason or as a result
example: So in Exodus 4:22, Yahweh tells Moses to say to Pharaoh "Thus says the Lord, 'Israel is my firstborn son.
exampleZh: 所以在《出埃及记》第四章第22节中，耶和华让摩西告诉法老,“犹太人是我的长子“

meaning: adj. 真实的；正确的；adv. 真实地；准确地；n. 真实；准确；vt. 装准；n. （True）(英)特鲁（人名）
definition: 1. n. proper alignment; the property possessed by something that is in correct or proper alignment；2. v. make level, square, balanced, or concentric
example: Why? Because that block identifies a set of things that I'm going to do if the test is true.
exampleZh: 为什么呢？这是因为这一块指令,指定了一系列的要进行的操作,如果测试为真的话。

meaning: adj. 值钱的，贵重的；有益的，宝贵的；重要的，珍贵的；可估价的；n. 贵重品
definition: 1. n. something of value；2. adj. having great material or monetary value especially for use or exchange
example: It's as if the commodity of the bride is deemed truly valuable only if it can be guaranteed pure and untouched.
exampleZh: 这就好像新娘这件商品,只有在完全的纯净没有动过才是有真正价值的。

meaning: n. 星期，周；一个星期的时间，一周；一周工作时间，工作周；（除去星期六和星期日的）星期，周；活动周（举行某项活动的一周）；（从某天算起的）一周；（某天之前的）一周；一周又一周，接连好几个星期
definition: 1. n. any period of seven consecutive days；2. n. a period of seven consecutive days starting on Sunday
example: Bryant Park used to have fashion week there and that was like, a great meeting place for people there.
exampleZh: 布莱恩公园过去有时尚周，那里真的是个很适合与人见面的地方。

meaning: n. 意志力，毅力
definition: 1. n. the trait of resolutely controlling your own behavior
example: It appears that people, at some level, think that they can exert willpower over it and control it.
exampleZh: 这说明在某种程度上,人们认为他们可以通过意志力控制结果

meaning: n. 雅典（希腊首都）
definition: n. the capital and largest city of Greece; named after Athena (its patron goddess)；n. a town in southeast Ohio
example: I asked the captain to wangle us three tickets to Athens.
exampleZh: 我求船长帮我们弄3张去雅典的票。

meaning: n. 增加物，新增人员；增加；加法；（建筑物的）扩建部分
definition: 1. n. a component that is added to something to improve it；2. n. the act of adding one thing to another
example: In addition to headaches, you may develop stomach ulcers as well.
exampleZh: 除了头痛，你还可能患上胃溃疡。

meaning: adj. 审美的，美学的；美的，艺术的；n. 美感，审美观；美学（aesthetics）；美术理论
definition: 1. relating to the enjoyment or study of beauty；2. An aesthetic object or a work of art is one that shows great beauty
example: He responded very strongly to the aesthetic of this particular work.
exampleZh: 他对这部作品的审美特质反应十分强烈。

meaning: adv. 再一次；复原；请再说一遍；不过，然而（then again）；增加，多；【名】 （Again）（英、保）阿盖恩（人名）
definition: 1. adv. anew
example: That's something that we see again and again and it's remarkable how little common sense is often applied.
exampleZh: 这些技能是我们司空见惯的,当时很奇怪人们一般却没有注意到它们。

meaning: n. 焦虑，忧虑；令人焦虑的事；渴望；焦虑症
definition: 1. n. a relatively permanent state of anxiety occurring in a variety of mental disorders；2. n. a vague unpleasant emotion that is experienced in anticipation of some (usually ill-defined) misfortune
example: Milton's Lycidas doesn't end up all soaked in this unhealthy brew of -neurotic brew of anxiety and shame and naked ambition.
exampleZh: 终局时并未完全沉浸在这种非正常的,神经质的对焦虑羞愧和赤裸裸的野心的酝酿里。

meaning: n. 文章，论文；物品；条款，条文；冠词；见习契约，见习期；v. 见习，签约做实习生；进行控告；使……受协议条款的约束
definition: 1. n. nonfictional prose forming an independent part of a publication；2. v. bind by a contract; especially for a training period
example: Yeah! I mean, one of the ones that comes up again and again is the use of the article.
exampleZh: 是的，其中一再出现的错误就是对冠词的使用。

meaning: adj. 可用的，可获得的；有空的，有闲暇的；未婚的，单身的
definition: 1. adj. obtainable or accessible and ready for use or service；2. adj. not busy; not otherwise committed
example: or it's a moment where you're both feeling opened and available to speak about what the other person looks like.
exampleZh: 或者是在你们彼此都感觉轻松坦率，因而可以评价对方的样子的时候。

meaning: n. 出身背景，学历，经历；（事件或情况的）背景；背景声音；（画等的）后景；底色；adj. 背景的，事先的；v. 作……的背景
definition: 1. n. a person's social heritage: previous experience or training；2. v. understate the importance or quality of
example: If you want to find out about their background or about how they feel about a certain thing,
exampleZh: 如果你想了解他们的背景，或者他们对做某一件事有什么样的态度，

meaning: adj. 行为的，与行为有关的
definition: adj. of or relating to behavior
example: The same with cognition and we will talk a lot about it when we talk about CBT-- Cognitive Behavioral Therapy.
exampleZh: 认知也是如此，我们会深入讨论认知,当谈到认知行为治疗时。

meaning: n. 血，血液；出身，血统；成员，人员；杀戮，流血；气质，脾气；纨绔子弟，花花公子；血样，血检；v. 使取得初次经验；用猎物的血涂（新手的）脸；让（猎狗）第一次尝血；【名】 （Blood）（英、西）布拉德（人名）
definition: 1. n. the fluid (red in vertebrates) that is pumped by the heart；2. v. smear with blood, as in a hunting initiation rite, where the face of a person is smeared with the blood of the kill
example: Your heart starts to beat a little faster, your blood starts flowing quicker, and your breath gets shorter.
exampleZh: 你的心跳加速，血脉贲张，呼吸也急促起来。

meaning: adj. 化学的，与化学有关的；n. 化学品，化学制品；成瘾的药物
definition: 1. n. produced by or used in a reaction involving changes in atoms or molecules；2. adj. relating to or used in chemistry
example: I figured Chemical Engineering would be the best way to get into it because it's a really broad major.
exampleZh: 我发现化学工程应该是接触新能源的最好方式，因为这个专业覆盖面也很广。

meaning: n. 表达，交流，交际；信息，书信，电话；通讯，交通联系；传播学
definition: 1. n. the activity of communicating; the activity of conveying information；2. n. something that is communicated by or to or between people or groups
example: But the interesting thing I realized along the way is that payment is another form of communication.
exampleZh: 我渐渐意识到一个很有趣的事实：,付款是另一种交流方式。

meaning: adv. 现时，当前
definition: 1. adv. at this time or period; now
example: And, this is how I'm doing now in relationship to what we're currently discussing or evaluating or experiencing.
exampleZh: 这也可以表达我手头正在做的事情与我们正在讨论、评价或者经历的事情之间的联系。

meaning: n. 危险，风险；威胁，危险因素；（不愉快之事发生的）可能性，风险；【名】 （Danger）（法）当热（人名）
definition: 1. n. the condition of being susceptible to harm or injury；2. n. a venture undertaken without regard to possible loss or injury
example: And as they were past they see that a small child has fallen into the pond and is in danger drowning.
exampleZh: 这时，你看到,一个小孩掉进了池塘,就要溺水，情况危急。

meaning: adj. 依赖的，依靠的；取决于；有瘾的；n. 受供养者
definition: 1. n. a person who relies on another person for support (especially financial support)；2. adj. not independent
example: But when you solve the Schrodingerequation, you don't get just a set of solutions that are dependent upon one number.
exampleZh: 但当你解薛定谔的方程式时，你没得到有一个统一答案的,一系列解决方法。

meaning: n. 碟，盘；一盘食物；全部餐具（the dishes）；菜肴；碟状物，盘状物；性感的人；轮盘；抛物面天线；凹形容器；v. 说……的闲话；把（食物）装盘；使（希望等）破灭；闲谈；成盘形
definition: 1. n. a piece of dishware normally used as a container for holding or serving food；2. v. provide (usually but not necessarily food)
example: To fill this culture dish with inner ear cells you would need the equivalent of 40 experimental animals.
exampleZh: 用内耳细胞填满这个培养皿,你得需要四十只试验动物。

meaning: v. 使有别于；看清，认出；区别，分清
definition: 1. v. mark as different；2. v. detect with the senses
example: Milton devotes a lot of time in Areopagitica to making a number of attempts to distinguish licensing from censorship.
exampleZh: 弥尔顿在《论出版自由》中花了很大功夫,试图区分出版许可管理和出版控制。

meaning: v. （使）分开，分散；分配，分担；使分离；分隔，隔开；使产生分歧；除，除以；分岔；n. 差异，分歧；（两事物间的）界限；分水岭，分水线
definition: 1. n. a serious disagreement between two groups of people (typically producing tension or hostility)；2. v. separate into parts or portions
example: If you divide the two of them through you will get 6.02 times 10 to the plus 23 per mole.
exampleZh: 如果你除以他们两个,你会得到6。02*10^摩尔。

meaning: adj. 编辑的，主编的；社论的；n. 社论，社评；（报刊的）由编辑撰写的部分，非广告部分
definition: 1. n. an article giving opinions or perspectives；2. adj. of or relating to an article stating opinions or giving perspectives
example: Murdoch claims he will not alter the editorial content of The Wall Street Journal.
exampleZh: 默多克声称不会阉割,《华尔街日报》的评论

meaning: conj. 或者，要么；两者都（不），既（不）；pron. （两者之中）任意一个；两者都（不）；adv. 也（不），亦（不）；而且，还；det. （两者中的）每个，各方；adj. （两者中的）每个的，各方的
definition: 1. adv. after a negative statement used as an intensive meaning something like `likewise' or `also'
example: So either a potassium cyanide or sodium cyanide, these are used in synthesis in terms of making carbon-carbon bonds.
exampleZh: 因此无论是氰化钾还是氰化钠，都被用来在合成过程中,制造碳碳键。

meaning: n. 公平，公正；资产净值；普通股；衡平法
definition: 1. the value of a company, divided into many equal parts owned by the shareholders, or one of the equal parts into which the value of a company is divided；2. the value of a property after you have paid any mortgage or other charges relating to it
example: He has a new name for it -I think it's called Home Equity Protection Corporation -but almost the same idea.
exampleZh: 他已经想出了一个新名字,我想应该是叫做住房资产保护公司,但是这几乎跟房主贷款公司是一样的

meaning: v. 估计；判断，评价；n. 估计，估价；估价单；看法，判断
definition: 1. n. an approximate calculation of quantity or degree or worth；2. v. judge tentatively or form an estimate of (quantities or time)
example: So, if you want to estimate how many grammatical sentences under twenty words in English, the answer is, "A lot."
exampleZh: 如果你想估计一下,用二十个英文单词,可以组成多少个符合语法的句子,答案会是,"很多"

meaning: v. 暴露，使显露；使面临，使遭受（危险或不快）；揭露，揭发；接触，体验；露出，显露（感情）；使（胶卷）曝光；弃（婴孩）于户外让其死去；n. 揭露，曝光
definition: 1. n. the exposure of an impostor or a fraud；2. v. expose or make accessible to some action or influence
example: Altman strips away the pretense and mythology to expose the film industry as a business like any other.
exampleZh: 奥尔特曼揭穿伪装和神话，把电影业暴露成像其他任何行业一样。

meaning: adj. 极大的，极度的；极端的，严重的；过分的，偏激的；尽头的，末端的；极限的，从事极限运动的；n. （观点或行为方式的）极端；（事物的）极度；端顶，端词
definition: 1. n. the furthest or highest degree of something；2. adj. of the greatest possible degree or extent or intensity
example: Or maybe you could be wanting to try some extreme sports like skydiving, jumping out of an airplane.
exampleZh: 又或者你想尝试一些极限运动，比如跳伞，直接从飞机上跳下来。

meaning: v. 闪光，闪亮；（快速）出示，显示；飞驰，掠过；闪现；迅速播出，传送（信息）；突然显露（强烈情感）；当众暴露（性器官）；（为引人注目而）展示，炫耀；（尤指用无线电或光波）通信，联络；n. 闪光；闪光灯；闪现；（军装上的）肩章；网站动画程序；花哨，噱头；突然理解，顿悟；（感情的）突发；炫耀财富，夸富；（产品包装上用来吸引顾客眼光的）色带，突显区域；（模塑过程中的）溢料，溢边；（尤指为帮助行船而从堰闸里放出的）水流；飞快的一瞥；（模塑过程中的）溢料，溢边；adj. 阔气的，爱显摆的；突然而短暂的；非常有才能的，杰出的；【名】 （Flash）（美）弗拉什（人名）
definition: 1. n. a sudden intense burst of radiant energy；2. v. gleam or glow intermittently
example: In the course of backing itself up, there are sort of random events flash to consciousness and get put together in a coherent story.
exampleZh: 在备份过程中，有些事件会随机地浮现到意识层面,被拼凑成一个连贯的故事。

meaning: n. 手；（钟表的）指针；一局牌，一手牌；帮助，援手；工人；船员，水手；支配，掌管；作用，影响；鼓掌，拍手喝彩；字迹；一手之宽（用来测量马匹的高度）；（女方的）允婚；表演艺人，制作工匠；comb. 用……手的；手工；v. 交，递；支持，搀扶；卷（帆）；【名】 （Hand）（英、瑞典）汉德（人名）
definition: 1. n. the (prehensile) extremity of the superior limb；2. v. place into the hands or custody of
example: I saw them making their way, hand in hand, down the path.
exampleZh: 我看到他们手拉手沿着小路朝前走。

meaning: adj. 重的，沉的；大量的，严重的；大而结实的，不精致的；厚实的；充满（某物）（heavy with）；重型的，大型的；繁忙的；辛苦的，费力的；用力的，重重的；难消化的；难懂的，艰涩的；危险的，汹涌的；闷热的，沉闷的；浓郁的；（土壤）黏重的；苛刻的，严厉的；认真的，严肃的；（声音）粗重的；（身体部位）沉重的；（心情）忧伤的；n. 保镖，打手；（电影或戏剧中的）反派；重要人物； 严肃报纸（heavies）；烈性啤酒；adv. 浓浓地，沉重地；使不安，使担忧
definition: 1. n. an actor who plays villainous roles；2. adj. of comparatively great physical weight or density
example: I used to listen to a lot of hip-hop music and heavy metal when I was younger.
exampleZh: 我年轻的时候，我常常听一些嘻哈和重金属音乐。

meaning: n. 措施，倡议；主动性，积极性；主动权；（美国某些州的）公民立法提案程序
definition: 1. n. readiness to embark on bold new ventures；2. adj. serving to set in motion
example: But they don't I don't know, it's just -there isn't enough initiative in the world, not many people do it.
exampleZh: 但是他们没有这样做,我不知道,也许只是,主动性不够,没什么人这样做

meaning: n. 生活方式；adj. 生活方式类的，时尚生活的（常用于名词前，修饰杂志、电视节目、产品等）；保健的（指旨在提高生活质量而非治疗特定疾病的药物）
definition: n. a manner of living that reflects the person's values and attitudes
example: They enjoyed an income and lifestyle that many people would envy.
exampleZh: 他们享有很多人会羡慕的收入和生活方式。

meaning: n. 关注，留心，警觉；（心理学／佛教）正念
definition: n. the trait of staying aware of (paying close attention to) your responsibilities
example: The gift of mindfulness is a practice of listening with compassion to others describe their experiences.
exampleZh: 正念的馈赠是一种以同理心倾听他人描述其经历的练习。

meaning: n. 片刻，瞬间；某一时刻；现在，目前；时机，机会；（事物发展的）关头，转折点；重大，重要；力矩；矩，动差；【名】 （Moment）（英）莫门特（人名）
definition: 1. n. a particular point in time；2. n. an indefinitely short time
example: These two oscillate back and forth so the moment of deprivation is often then balanced by a moment of imagination.
exampleZh: 来回交替丧失的时刻,经常和想像的时刻,互相平衡。

meaning: adj. 必要的，必需的；必然的，不可避免的；迫不得已的，非自愿的；n. （生活）必需品；必要的事（the necessary）；足够的钱（the necessary）；【名】 （Necessary）（英）内塞瑟里（人名）
definition: 1. n. anything indispensable；2. adj. absolutely essential
example: And he's going to have to rectify the circumstances that made his destruction of the earth necessary in the first place.
exampleZh: 他不得不修正,他认为有必要毁灭人类的情形。

meaning: v. （尤指意外地）发生；存在，出现；（想法）产生

meaning: adj. 能忍耐的，有耐心的；n. 病人，患者；（语言学）受动者，承受者；【名】 （Patient）帕迪恩特（人名）

meaning: adv. 可能；（用以缓和语气或表示礼貌）也许，可能；（委婉地表示不赞同或不接受）也许，大概；（用于提出建议或请求）也许；n. 假定，猜想

meaning: n. 位置，方位；姿势，安置方式；处境，状况；观点，立场；地位，身份；职务，职位；名次；（队员的）职责，角色；恰当位置；阵地；持有状态；（逻辑）命题，主张；v. 安置，使处于；为（产品）定位

meaning: adj. （人，组织，国家）强大的，有影响力的；大功率的，高效能的；（文章、演讲或艺术品）极具感染力的，有震撼力的；（感情）强烈的，（效果）巨大的；强壮的，强健的；猛烈的，有力的；（毒品或化学品）强效的；刺耳的，刺眼的，刺鼻的；adv. 非常，很

meaning: n. 压力，挤压；（气体或液体形成的）压力，压强；心理压力，紧张；催促，要求；气压；v. 对……施加压力，强迫；使……增压

meaning: adj. 职业的，专业的；非常内行的，极为称职的；（人）职业性的，非业余的；由职业人员参加的；（人）坚持某种活动特征（或特点）的；n. 专业人员，专业人士；内行，专家；职业选手；（受雇于高尔夫或网球协会的）职业教练

meaning: n. 教授；（大学的）讲师，教员；信仰表示者，宣称信仰者

exampleZh: 同时做母亲和教授是不是很困难呢？两者之间取得平衡不容易吧？

meaning: adj. 心理的，精神的；心理学的，关于心理学的；由焦虑（或悲伤）引起的，存在于心理上的

exampleZh: 然后我们把重点转移到了心理学，最后还讨论了社会和文化对文学的决定因素。

meaning: n. 购买，采购；购买的东西；（非继承性的）财产置得；紧握，牢牢抓住；（移动重物的）滑轮（或类似装置）；v. 购买，采购；（努力或艰难地）获得，得到；（航海）（用滑轮或杠杆）升起，举起（绳，索，锚）

meaning: n. 彩虹；众多花色品种，五颜六色的组合，五花八门的聚合；五彩缤纷的展示；多种颜色，五彩缤纷；adj. 不同种族（或文化等）人群的；【名】 （Rainbow）（英）雷恩博（人名）

meaning: vt. （英国英语拼写；亦作 recognize）认出，辨认出；识别，辨别；承认，认可；认识到，意识到

meaning: n. 地区，区域；行政区；（首都以外的）地方（the regions）；身体部位；领域，界

meaning: n. 尊敬，敬重；重视，尊重；方面，着眼点；问候，敬意（respects）；v. 尊敬，敬佩；慎重对待，尊重；遵守；避免破坏（或干扰）；int. 真了不起（因敬重或赞同而发出的感叹）
definition: 1. n. (usually preceded by `in') a detail or point；2. v. regard highly; think much of

meaning: adj. 年龄大些的；（用在家庭内姓名相同的人名后表示）老，年长的；老年人的；（地位、水平或级别）较高的，高级的；（比赛）成人的，高水平的；大于一定年龄（通常为11岁）的学童的；（高中或大学）毕业年级的；n. 较年长的人；老年人，长者；地位（或级别）较高者，上司；（中学或大学的）毕业班学生；资深成人运动员，高水平运动员；【名】 （Senior）（英）西尼尔（人名）

meaning: adj. 严重的，危急的；认真的，严肃的；重要的，须重视的；（音乐、文学等艺术）严肃的；（人）庄重的，严肃的；大量的，极多的；（恋爱中）态度认真的；极感兴趣的，热衷的；很好的，质优价高的

meaning: n. 形状，外形；形态，特征；状况，身体状况；健壮；（朦胧的）影像；（事物平常或本来的）样子；有序的排列，条理清楚；伪装，假装；特定形状的东西，模型；身材；vt. 形成，影响；使成形，塑造；计划，思考出；产生（声音，词）；使适合，使符合；（运动员）摆姿势，做动作；【名】 （Shape）（瑞典）沙佩（人名）

meaning: n. 商店，店铺；作坊，工场；手工课，工艺课；手工课教室；购物，采购；有关工作（或公事）的谈话；工作室，办公室；v. 购物；举报，告发；试图说服（公司出版或生产）；（用软件 Photoshop）修（图）

meaning: adj. 聪明的，明智的；（人）衣着得体的；整洁而漂亮的，光鲜的；耍小聪明的，不恭的；时髦的，高档的；迅速有力的，迅猛的；智能的；v. （身体部位）感到刺痛；（因批评、失败等）难过，烦恼；n. 剧痛，刺痛；痛苦，苦恼；聪明，敏锐（smarts）；adv. 机敏地，整洁地，潇洒地；【名】 （Smart）（法）斯马尔，（英、德）斯马特（人名）

meaning: n. 智能手机（运行移动操作系统，可安装并运行应用程序，具备较强计算和联网能力的移动电话）

meaning: n. 声音，声响；听力范围，听距；乐音；（音乐演出、电影等的）音响录制和播出，音响制作；无线电广播；声音，音响；（个人或乐队的）音乐特色，音乐风格；流行音乐（sounds）；海峡，海湾；厄勒海峡（the Sound）；印象，感觉；（检查体腔的）医用探子；v. （使）发声，（使）作响；发出（警告等），（以……语调）发表；测量（水体）的深度；试探，探询；听起来像；（从嗓音中）听起来；（用于谈论印象或观点）听起来，似乎；发音；听诊（肺或其他体腔）；（医）用探子检查（人的膀胱或其他内腔）；（尤指鲸鱼）向深海潜入；adj. 无损伤的，健康的，坚实的；合理的，明智的，可靠的；全面的，透彻的；酣睡的，沉睡的；（惩罚）严厉的；不错的，实实在在的；资金充实的；adv. 酣畅地

meaning: n. 来源，出处；（问题的）原因，根源；消息人士，信息来源；河流源头，发源地；源（代）码；（电子）源极，电源；（技）源；v. （从某地）获得；找出……的来源；【名】 （Source）（法）苏尔斯（人名）

meaning: n. 方式，作风；款式，样式；（尤指服装上的）风尚，流行式样；风格，体；轻松优雅的方式；生活方式；发型；气派，优雅格调；文风，文体；称号，称谓；（植）（花的）花柱；（无脊椎动物的）尾片，尾须；v. 设计，给……造型；称呼，命名；使合潮流；用刻刀作装饰画；【名】 （Style）（英）斯泰尔（人名）

meaning: adj. 成功的，如愿以偿的；事业有成的，飞黄腾达的；（公司、影片、产品等）利润丰厚的，非常赚钱的

meaning: n. 太阳（the sun）；日光，阳光；恒星；成功，荣耀；一天，一年；被视为荣誉（或灵感、理解）源泉的人（或物）；v. 晒太阳，（尤指）日光浴；【名】 （Sun）（中）孙（普通话·威妥玛），（柬）孙，（缅）素，（土）松（人名）

meaning: v. 推断，料想，猜想；假设，假定，设想；预期，需要，以……为条件；相信，认为（某事物是可能的）；（婉转表达）我看，要我说，要不；（因处于某种境地或因约定）必须做（be supposed to do sth.）；我看（用于生气地表示预料某事属实）

meaning: n. 开关，电闸；骤变，突变；交换机；（计算机）切换； （铁路的）转辙器，道岔；（细软的）枝条，鞭子；假发；（在英国使用借记卡付账的一种）转换系统（Switch）；v. （用开关）打开，关闭；（使）改变，转变；交换，调换；转移（注意力）；（与某人）交换工作，调班； 用枝条击打，轻拂

meaning: adj. 总的，全部的；完全的，绝对的；v. 总数达，总计；把……加起来；彻底毁坏（汽车）；杀死，严重伤害（某人）；n. 总数，合计；【名】 （Total）（法、德）托塔尔（人名）

meaning: adj. 传统的；根据传统而制造（或使用）的；因袭的，守旧的；（活动）惯例的，经常从事的；典型的；（爵士乐）具20世纪早期风格的

meaning: n. 趋势，动态；时尚，风尚；热门话题；v. 趋向，倾向；（尤指地理特征的）走向；成为热门话题
