example: And also in a row three, yeah, we're generally increasing, there's some glitches here, but the general trend holds true.
exampleZh: 另外对于第三行，也对，我们大体上是在升高的，只是这里有些小偏差，但是总体规律是正确的。

meaning: adv. 最终，最后；根本上，最重要地
definition: 1. adv. as the end result of a succession or process
example: Milton ultimately is a pious man and wants us to frown on Satan's critique of the Judeo-Christian conception of divinity.
exampleZh: 弥尔顿终究还是个虔诚的教徒，想要我们厌恶撒旦,对犹太教与基督教共有的神权概念的批判。

meaning: prep. 在……上；用在一些动词后，与 on 同义；一……即……，一……就……；（用于两个相同的名词之间，强调数量之多）（一个）接（一个），……又……；将要发生，马上来临；adv. 在上面地；此后
definition: 1. on; a more formal word for on in many phrases
definitionSource: 人工校订（依据词典义项）
example: C So, that's the breakdown. And, the grade is C level, 50% and it's based upon a performance of 50% absolute.
exampleZh: 这些就是分类，分数是，那就是基于成绩的。

meaning: adj. 城市的，城镇的；黑人音乐的；住在都市的；【名】 （Urban）（英）厄本，（法）于尔邦（人名）
definition: 1. adj. relating to or concerned with a city or densely populated area；2. adj. located in or characteristic of a city or city life
example: the Ministry of, or the Department of Housing and Urban Development working on... various issues that way.
exampleZh: 住房和城市发展部，研究……各种不同的问题。

meaning: n. （学校的）假期，（法院的）休庭期；休假，假期；腾出，辞去；v. 度假
definition: 1. n. leisure time away from work devoted to rest or pleasure；2. v. spend or take a vacation
example: Let's say that your uncle is going to go on a vacation with you and the rest of your family.
exampleZh: 假设你的叔叔要和你们全家人去度假。

meaning: v. （使）不同，（使）呈现差异；（根据情况而）变化，改变；改变，使……变化；变奏；【名】 （Vary）（英、法、罗、柬）瓦里（人名）
definition: 1. v. make or become different in some particular way, without permanently losing one's or its former characteristics or essence；2. v. be at variance with; be out of line with
example: This means you can vary the neutron number without changing chemical identity, because chemical identity is fixed by the proton.
exampleZh: 这表示你可以改变中子数,而不会改变它的化学特性，因为化学特性是由质子决定的。

meaning: v. 参观，游览；拜访，作客；浏览（网页）；视察，巡视；找（医生或律师）咨询；闲谈；（多作圣经用语）（上帝）救助（某人），降临（某地）；使某人遭受（有害或不快之事）；n. 参观，游览；拜访，作客；（政治领导人或公务员的）访问，视察；（到网站的）访问；（在宾馆或汽车旅馆等的）住宿，逗留；就诊，咨询（律师等）；会面，闲聊；【名】 （Visit）（泰）威实（人名）
definition: 1. n. the act of going to see some person or place or thing for a short time；2. v. visit a place, as for entertainment
example: And part of my journalism class was actually to go visit them and kind of see how they're doing.
exampleZh: 我所在的新闻学课上的同学有人去参观过，看他们是怎样运作的。

meaning: n. （蜘蛛）网；网状物，错综复杂的事物；网络；（鸟兽的）蹼；连接板，金属薄条（片）；（连续印刷用）一卷纸；（制造卷筒纸的造纸机上的）无端金属丝网；织物；v. 用网（或网状物）覆盖；使中圈套；形成网
definition: 1. n. an intricate network suggesting something that was formed by weaving or interweaving；2. v. construct or form a web, as if by weaving
example: Derrida, as I said, believes in a kind of seamless web of discourse or discursivity. We are awash in discourse.
exampleZh: 德里达，我说过，他相信有一种无缝的网,存在于论述或推论中，我们在论述中是处于同一水平线的。

meaning: adj. 全部的，整个的；完整的，完好无损的；(强调大小或重要性）整个的，全部的；要点，主旨；健全的，健康的；n. 整体，全部；adv. 完全地；整个
definition: 1. n. all of something including all its component elements or parts；2. adj. including all components without exception; being one unit or constituting the full amount or extent or duration; complete
example: He's a black man, and he passes for his whole life as Jewish, and in doing so rejects his family.
exampleZh: 他是黑人，并以犹太人的身份度过一生，这样做受到了家人的反对。

meaning: n. （尤指犯罪或事故的）目击者；（法庭等的）证人；（签署正式文件的）见证人，连署人；宗教信仰声明，见证；见证人（声明自己笃信基督教的人）；证据，证言；证明标志；v. 目击，目睹；见证，经历（事件、变化等）；在（正式文件）上签名，连署；作见证（公开声明自己对基督教的信仰）；证明，表明；为…...作证；作证，作证人；【名】 （Witness）（津）威特尼斯（人名）
definition: 1. n. someone who sees an event and reports what happened；2. v. be a witness to
example: The police need a witness to make a positive ID.
exampleZh: 警方需要有目击者加以确认。

meaning: n. 狼；色狼，色鬼；（喻）残忍凶狠的人；同性恋者；狼音，不谐和音，粗厉音；v. 狼吞虎咽地吃；【名】 （Wolf）（以、捷、芬、瑞典、德、匈、法、罗、荷、英）沃尔夫（人名）
definition: 1. n. any of various predatory carnivorous canine mammals of North America and Eurasia that usually hunt in packs；2. v. eat hastily
example: He thought he had better track this wolf and see where it lived.
exampleZh: 他认为他最好跟踪这只狼，并看看它在哪儿生活。

meaning: n. 口音，腔调，土音；着重点，强调；重音；（字母上的）读音符号；点缀，特色；v. 强调，突出；重读；以重音演奏
definition: 1. n. distinctive manner of oral expression；2. v. to stress, single out as important
example: But, obviously, it's the matter of adjusting to the accent. So that'll be my advice, I think.
exampleZh: 但是，显然地，这就是适应重口音的问题。所以，我想那就是我的建议。

meaning: adj. （与）非洲（有关）的；非洲人的；非洲裔的；n. 非洲人（尤指黑人）；非洲黑人后裔
definition: n. a native or inhabitant of Africa；adj. of or relating to the nations of Africa or their peoples
example: His previous fusions of jazz, pop and African melodies have proved highly successful.
exampleZh: 他先前对爵士乐、流行乐和非洲音乐旋律的融合已经证明是非常成功的。

meaning: adv. 以前，从前；adj. 以前的；【名】 （Ago）（美）阿戈（人名）
definition: 1. adj. gone by; or in the past；2. adv. in the past
example: So Muslims believe that Koran has maintained its original form since it was revealed to the Prophet Mohammad, 14 centuries ago.
exampleZh: 穆斯林认为自从《可兰经》,在14世纪展示给先知穆罕默德起,就保持了最原始的形式。

meaning: n. 祖先，祖宗；（动植物）原种；原型，雏形
definition: 1. n. someone from whom you are descended (but usually more remote than a grandparent)
example: We can say today that this university is a direct ancestor of the platonic republic of Plato's Academy.
exampleZh: 我们可以说现今这间大学的直系原型,即是，“柏拉图学院“的,柏拉图式理想国。

meaning: pron. 任何事物 （用于含有否定意义的陈述句中）；某事物（用于疑问句和条件分句中）；任一事物（强调）；任何……的事物（接后置修饰语）；任何（接近、像……的）事物；（某范围的）任何事物；重要东西，重要事物；某一限定范围之内的任何一个数量
definition: 1. n. a thing of any kind
example: Milton shows unusually little interest in the miraculousness of the conception or anything like the domestic details of the manger scene.
exampleZh: 不同寻常的是，弥尔顿没有太对,怀孕这一奇迹或其他的事情感兴趣,像马槽这个内在的细节。

meaning: v. 联想，联系；支持，同意；交往，（尤指）混在一起；n. 同事，伙伴；副学士，准学士；副职，副手；准会员；联想；adj. 副的，准的，非正式的；联合的，有关连的
definition: 1. n. a person who joins with others in some activity；2. v. make a logical or causal connection
example: He will remain affiliated with the firm as a special associate director.
exampleZh: 他会作为特别副主管，继续与这家公司保持联系。

meaning: v. 假定，假设，认为；装出，做出；承担，就职；呈现，具有；夺取，篡夺
definition: 1. v. take to be the case or to be true; accept without verification or proof；2. v. take on titles, offices, duties, responsibilities
example: Everyone, according to the logic ofAreopagitica everyone has the potential to assume the inner authority of conscience and self-discipline.
exampleZh: 按照《论出版自由》的逻辑，每个人都有,用内在良心的统治和自律的潜力。

meaning: v. 随同，陪同；经常去，定期去(学校、教堂等)；伴随……而至，（作为结果）伴随；出席，参加；注意，专心；处理，照料；致力于
definition: 1. v. be present at (meetings, church services, university), etc.；2. v. take charge of or deal with
example: And, by all means, if you are scheduled to attend class at 11:00, please take the test at 11:00.
exampleZh: 当然，如果你安排到11：00参加考试的话，请在11：00参加考试。

meaning: v. 使自动化
definition: 1. v. make automatic or control or operate automatically
example: Research in human-vehicle interaction has shown even systems designed to automate driving are far from being error-proof.
exampleZh: 人车交互领域的研究表明，即便是专为自动驾驶而设计的系统，也远未达到万无一失的程度。

meaning: adj. 知道的，明白的；察觉到的，意识到的；有……意识的，有……知识的；【名】 （Aware）（阿拉伯、索）阿瓦雷（人名）
definition: 1. adj. (sometimes followed by `of') having or showing knowledge or understanding or realization or perception；2. adj. bearing in mind; attentive to
example: Now as soon as we start talking about things like the dominant, we are also aware of the evanescence of dominance.
exampleZh: 说到支配性，我们就必须认识到支配并不是不变的。

meaning: n. 小片，小块；小部分，片段；（一组东西中的）一个；喜剧小品，小笑话；比特；辅币，12.5美分；马嚼子；钻头；（与某活动、过程有关的）所有事情；女孩，姑娘；（人的）生殖器；adj. 很小的；v. 制约，限制；给（马）上嚼子；v. 咬，咬伤；叮，蜇（bite 的过去式和过去分词形式）
definition: 1. n. a small quantity；2. n. a small fragment of something broken off from the whole
example: So now I've got this gamma placed in there, -1 gamma minus 1, so I've ben feeling a little bit better.
exampleZh: 这样我把这里的指数，换成γ,这样看起来舒服一些。

meaning: n. （大学或学院的）校园；大学生活；大学（学校、医院等机构的）场地；【名】 （Campus）（英）坎帕斯，（意、罗）坎普斯，（法）康皮斯（人名）
definition: 1. n. a field on which the buildings of a university are situated
example: He was accepted into the most popular clique on campus.
exampleZh: 他被吸收到了校园里最受欢迎的小团体里。

meaning: n. 碳；复写纸；炭精棒；碳纤维；adj. 碳的，碳处理的；【名】 （Carbon）（英）卡本，（西）卡尔翁，（法）卡尔邦（人名）
definition: 1. n. an abundant nonmetallic tetravalent element occurring in three allotropic forms: amorphous carbon and graphite and diamond; occurs in all organic compounds；2. n. a thin paper coated on one side with a dark waxy substance (often containing carbon); used to transfer characters from the original to an under sheet of paper
example: So either a potassium cyanide or sodium cyanide, these are used in synthesis in terms of making carbon-carbon bonds.
exampleZh: 因此无论是氰化钾还是氰化钠，都被用来在合成过程中,制造碳碳键。

meaning: v. 庆祝，庆贺；赞扬，赞美；主持（宗教仪式）
definition: 1. v. celebrate, as of holidays or rites；2. v. have a celebration
example: Celebrate your gifts, enjoy them, but don' t take pride in them, take pride in your decision and hardwork.
exampleZh: 为你的天赋欢呼，享受它们带来的乐趣，但为自己作出的决定和勤奋工作，而感到自豪。

meaning: n. （地理位置）中间，中心点；（机构，组织）活动中心；关注点，焦点；中间派，中间立场；中锋；v. 把……放在中央；（使）以……为中心，（使）注意力集中于；（使）主要发生在，（使）集中于；n. （Center）森特（人名）
definition: n. an area that is approximately central within some larger region；n. the piece of ground in the outfield directly ahead of the catcher
example: But... I really like the student center because there's a lot of places you can eat in there,
exampleZh: 但是……我真的很喜欢学生中心，因为那里有很多可以吃东西的地方，

meaning: adj. 经典的，传统的；和古希腊与古罗马文化相关的；（音乐）古典的；文科的，人文科学的；典型的，有代表性的；相对论和量子力学理论前的概念、理论的，古典力学的
definition: 1. n. traditional genre of music conforming to an established form and appealing to critical interest and developed musical taste；2. adj. of or characteristic of a form or system felt to be of first significance before modern times
example: You can see on the handout those poems by those classical authors that Milton's Lycidas is most indebted to.
exampleZh: 讲义上有这些经典作者的经典诗作,弥尔顿的《利西达斯》是受这些诗作的启发写成的。

meaning: adv. 清楚地，清晰地；毫无疑问，显然；明智地，清醒地
definition: 1. adv. without doubt or question；2. adv. in an intelligible manner
example: You could contrast the roguish and fanciful, clearly done by hand, title of the magazine, with that machine-type Blast.
exampleZh: 你们可以把这些明显手写的，无赖而稀奇的标题，和机械化的“暴风“相对比。

meaning: n. 硬币，金属货币；塔罗牌中的一种花色（coins）；v. 创造新词，首次使用；铸币，造币；迅速而轻松地发财；【名】 （Coin）（西、意）科因，（法）库安（人名）
definition: 1. n. a metal piece (usually a disc) used as money；2. v. make up
example: We wanted this to be a twenty shilling coin but now in the market it's trading at twenty-one.
exampleZh: 我们希望它是一个值二十先令的硬币,但现在它在市场上以二十一个先令的价值来交换。

meaning: n. 颜色，色彩；肤色；有色人种（常用于 people of color 等短语）；颜料；脸色，气色；生动，趣味，地方色彩；vt. 给……着色，涂颜色；影响，左右；歪曲，粉饰；vi. 变色，呈现颜色；adj. 彩色的，能产生彩色的（用于名词前）
definition: n. a visual attribute of things that results from the light they emit or transmit or reflect；n. interest and variety and intensity
example: I mean, it will wake us up in the morning. It will be the color of a beautiful bird.
exampleZh: 我是觉得，那样的颜色会让我们在早上惊醒。它会是一只漂亮的鸟的颜色。

meaning: v. （使）结合，组合；（使）化合；合并，协力；兼有，兼备；兼做，兼办；n. 联盟，联合体；联合收割机
definition: 1. n. harvester that heads and threshes and cleans grain while moving across the field；2. v. put or add together
example: The combine had cut a swathe around the edge of the field.
exampleZh: 联合收割机把庄稼绕田边割了一长条。

meaning: v. 传递信息，通讯；传达，传递（想法或感情）；传染（疾病）；（房间或建筑）相通，相连；传输（热，力），传递（运动）；领受圣餐
definition: 1. v. transmit information；2. v. transmit thoughts or feelings
example: The other way it shares an ambition of modernism is precisely in that effort to communicate experience, consciousness.
exampleZh: 它与现代主义追求的另一个共同点,正体现在经验和意识的交流上。

meaning: adj. 完全的，彻底的；全部的，完整的；完成的，结束的；技能全面的，技术娴熟的；向前传球成功的；v. 使完整，使完美；填写（表格）；完成，结束
definition: 1. v. come or bring to a finish or an end；2. adj. having every necessary or normal part or component or step
example: It's usually best to respond in a complete sentence rather than saying yes or no which can be ambiguous.
exampleZh: 一般来说，回答最好是完整的句子，而不是简单的模棱两可的“是”或“不是”。

meaning: v. （使）连接；（使）相通；使接通（电源、水源等）；与……有关系；把……联系起来；衔接，联运；（使）换乘（飞机或火车）；给……接通电话；产生共鸣，契合；建立良好关系；击中
definition: 1. v. connect, fasten, or put together two or more pieces；2. v. make a logical or causal connection
example: The canal was built to connect Sheffield with the Humber estuary.
exampleZh: 修建这条运河是为了将设菲尔德和亨伯河河口连接起来。

meaning: adj. 满足的，满意的，甘愿的；n. 目录；所含物，容纳的东西；（书、文章、演讲、电影等的）内容；含量；满足，满意；投赞成票的贵族院议员；网上信息，电子信息；v. 使满意，使满足；【名】 （Content）（法）孔唐（人名）
definition: 1. n. everything that is included in a collection；2. v. satisfy in a limited way
example: And so I help with their media content and create videos that promote their campaigns.
exampleZh: 我帮助制作媒体内容和做视频，用来支持他们的宣传。

meaning: n. 背景，环境；上下文，语境
definition: 1. n. discourse that surrounds a language unit and helps to determine its interpretation；2. n. the set of facts or circumstances that surround a situation or event
example: There's a way in which the context of the war, too, shadows the poem and remains present in it.
exampleZh: 在战争的背景下，也投影于诗中同时也保持了它的现实性。

meaning: n. 洲，大陆；adj. 有排便节制力的；节制性欲的
definition: 1. n. one of the large landmasses of the earth；2. adj. having control over urination and defecation
example: That is to say, discover an entirely new continent, a new world, so to speak, the new world of Machiavelli.
exampleZh: 也就是说发现了全新的大陆，全新的世界，属于马奇亚维利的全新世界。

meaning: n. 合作，协作；协助，配合
definition: 1. n. joint operation or action；2. n. the practice of cooperating
example: In any private cooperation, there is a final line between what is good for management and what is good for shareholders.
exampleZh: 在任何一个私人企业里，总是有一条底线划分,怎样对管理有利,怎样对股东有利。

meaning: adj. 至关重要的，决定性的；极好的
definition: 1. adj. of extreme importance; vital to the resolution of a crisis；2. adj. having crucial relevance
example: So although holiness derives from god, humans have a crucial role to play in sanctification, in sanctifying the world.
exampleZh: 尽管神圣源于神灵，人类在将世界神圣化的过程中，扮演者重要的角色。

meaning: v. 不同于；意见有分歧；【名】 （Differ）（法）迪费（人名）
definition: 1. v. be different；2. v. be of different opinions
example: These two dialogues, it should be evident, I mean, differ not only in content but in their dramatic context.
exampleZh: 这两本语录，很明显地，不只是内容不同,其戏剧性的脉络更是不同。

meaning: n. 狗，犬；公狗，公狐，公狼；质量极差的东西；卑鄙小人，无赖；朋友；v. 困扰，纠缠；跟踪，尾随
definition: 1. n. a member of the genus Canis (probably descended from the common wolf) that has been domesticated by man since prehistoric times; occurs in many breeds；2. v. go after with the intent to catch
example: so you can either leave or you can leave the dog here. You give it up. You surrender the dog."
exampleZh: 所以你可以离开，也可以把狗留下。你只是把狗放弃了。”

meaning: adj. 教育的；有教育意义的
definition: 1. adj. relating to the process of education；2. adj. providing knowledge
example: The work that goes on at the Center for Educational Computing Innovations really falls into three Different intersecting areas.
exampleZh: 教育主动性计算机研究中心,的研究工作主要可以归为,三个不同的领域。

meaning: v. 剔除，根除；对……不予考虑，把……排除在外；（比赛中）淘汰；铲除，杀害；（生理）排除，排泄；消去
definition: 1. v. terminate or take out；2. v. do away with
example: We called up three economists to ask how to eliminate the deficit and they obliged with very straightforward answers.
exampleZh: 我们致电3位经济学家咨询消除赤字的方法，他们满足了我们的要求，给出了非常直接的答复。

meaning: adv. 精确地，确切地；（用于强调）恰好，完全；（要求得到更多信息）究竟，到底；正是如此，一点不错
definition: adv. indicating exactness or preciseness；adv. just as it should be
example: Well, in some sense this is exactly what modernity might be seen to be doing to traditional English culture.
exampleZh: 某种程度上这正是现代性,被认为的对传统英国文化所产生的影响。

meaning: adj. 过度的，过多的
definition: 1. adj. beyond normal limits；2. adj. unrestrained, especially with regard to feelings
example: Now formally I could have had this pointing off to another object containing 4, but that just seemed excessive, right?
exampleZh: 当然我可以正式的把它指向,另外一个含有4的对象，但这有点多余对不对？

meaning: n. 借口，托词；正当理由；宽恕，赦免；拙劣样品，蹩脚货；（医生或父母为学生写的）病假条，请假条；v. 原谅，宽恕；辩解，开脱；准许……离开；同意免除
definition: 1. n. a defense of some offensive behavior or some failure to keep a promise etc.；2. v. accept an excuse for
example: You know, so it's nice to kind of have an excuse to go, do all sorts of things.
exampleZh: 所以找个借口就去了，干了很多事儿。

meaning: v. 运用，施加（影响）；努力，尽力（exert oneself）
definition: 1. v. put to use；2. v. have and exercise
example: In order to be successful he would have to exert himself.
exampleZh: 他必须努力才能成功。

meaning: n. 小伙子，家伙；同伴，同事，同学；研究员；男朋友；（研究期间领取津贴的）研究生；（大学的）董事；（学术或专业团体）会员；对等者，对手；adj. 同类的，同伴的；【名】 （Fellow）（美、英、印）费洛（人名）
definition: 1. n. a boy or man；2. n. a person who is frequently in the company of another
example: And so, Rutherford had a fellow working in his lab by the name of Geiger. And, Geiger invented a detector.
exampleZh: 卢瑟福的一个实验同事,叫做盖革，他发明了一种探测器。

meaning: n. 财政，金融；资金，财源；财务事务，经济情况；v. 提供资金；贷款购买，赊购；【名】 （Finance）（法）菲南斯（人名）
definition: 1. n. the commercial activity of providing funds and capital；2. v. obtain or provide money for
example: But for, at least for finance, a lot of the banks and companies actually have sessions here on campus
exampleZh: 但是对于金融专业来说，很多银行和公司都在校内召开宣讲会，

meaning: adv. 经常地，频繁地
definition: adv. many times at short intervals
example: This is a signal - this passing of phosphorous - is a signal that's used very frequently in intracellular communication.
exampleZh: 这是一种信号,一种通过磷酸来传递的信号,这种信号在细胞内通讯时经常被用到

meaning: n. 燃料，燃烧剂；刺激因素，刺激性言行；（为身体提供能量的）食物，饮料，药剂；v. （给……）提供燃料，加油；刺激，加剧；【名】 （Fuel）（美）傅爱乐（人名）
definition: 1. n. a substance that can be consumed to produce energy；2. v. provide with a combustible substance that provides energy
example: You take fuel, rather you take something that's warm, and you put it in contact with the atmosphere, it cools down.
exampleZh: 改变约束,继续加热,气体膨胀。

meaning: n. 女孩；姑娘，年轻女子，未婚女子；（常与物主限定词连用）女儿；（非正式）（男人的）女朋友；（旧或用于复合词）女职员，女演员
definition: 1. n. a young woman；2. n. a youthful female person
example: Not with this girl, this girl is perfect. But in the past, I've had lots of problems with roommates.
exampleZh: 和这个女孩没吵过，她太完美了。但在过去，我和室友之间存在很多问题。

meaning: n. 房子，住宅；一家人，同住一幢房子的人们；（有特定用途的）大楼，大厦；公司，商业机构；观众席，观众；演出场次；餐馆，餐厅；豪斯音乐；王室，皇族（House）；（某些英国学校学生为进行比赛而分的）组；动物的笼舍；议院，议会；（占星）黄道十二宫之一，黄道宫；v. 让……居住，给……提供住房；给……提供场地，收藏存放；包裹，覆盖；住；adj. 家养的，常在室内的；公司的，机构的；（乐队，组合）（在俱乐部或别的场所）常驻的，定期表演的；【名】 （House）（英）豪斯（人名）
definition: 1. n. a dwelling that serves as living quarters for one or more families；2. v. contain or cover
example: And speaking in turn to the arden secularists to say religion should have no part in the White House.
exampleZh: 再说到艺术世俗主义者,他们说白宫不应该涉及宗教。

meaning: n. 一百；许多，数量大；一百美元（英镑）的纸币；百位数；（表示24小时制的整点）一点、两点、三点等整；（板球）击球手获得的一百（或以上）的得分；adj. 一百的；许多的
definition: 1. n. ten 10s；2. adj. being ten more than ninety
example: But these days you pay for it which is why you get SSDs, you're paying several hundred dollars more.
exampleZh: 但是现在你购买固态硬盘，需要多花费几百美元。

meaning: n. 猎人，捕猎者；搜寻者，寻找者；猎狐马；猎犬；有护盖的手表
definition: 1. n. someone who hunts game；2. n. a person who searches for something
example: Well, the Native Americans, as hunter-gatherers, didn't actually enclose land.
exampleZh: 印第安人，作为采猎者，事实上是没有圈地。

meaning: v. 佯装未见，不理睬；忽视，对……不予理会；（因证据不足）驳回（诉讼）
definition: 1. v. refuse to acknowledge；2. v. bar from attention or consideration
example: At this point in the story, perhaps the view is that all know of God even if they ignore him.
exampleZh: 从这点来看,即使每个人都忽略上帝，但都知道上帝的存在。

meaning: v. 执行，贯彻；为……提供工具；n. 工具，器具；履行；手段
definition: 1. n. instrumentation (a piece of equipment or tool) used to effect an end；2. v. apply in a manner consistent with its purpose or design
example: But you'll see that once you get to final projects frankly, you're not gonna want to implement everything from scratch.
exampleZh: 但是一旦你得出了最终方案，你就不会愿意利用框架去,实现任何功能了。

meaning: adj. 法律允许的，合法的；与法律有关的，法律的；（与衡平法相对）普通法或成文法确认的；神学律法的，与神学律法有关的；（纸张）标准大小的；【名】 （Legal）（法）勒加尔（人名）
definition: 1. adj. established by or founded upon law or official or accepted rules；2. adj. of or relating to jurisprudence
example: I give them legal advice and legal representation, and go to court with them and all sorts of things.
exampleZh: 我会给他们一些法律方面的建议，做他们的法定代理人，陪同他们去法院诉讼等等。

meaning: v. 平躺，平卧；位于，坐落在；存在，在于；处于，保持（某种状态）；（尤用于墓碑上的文字中）长眠；（比赛时）名列，排名；撒谎，编造谎言；（物体）平放在……上，平放着；朝……方向；造成假象，不可靠；（尤指不快或困难之事）将发生，在等待；（光、云、雾等）存在，展现；（诉讼，控告，索赔）可受理，可立案；n. 方向，位置；谎言，谎话；（动物的）穴，（鸟的）巢；【名】 （Lie）（罗、挪、瑞典）利，（中）李（普通话·威妥玛）（人名）
definition: 1. n. a statement that deviates from or perverts the truth；2. v. be located or situated somewhere; occupy a certain position
example: This is The Life You Can Save, which essentially gives the lie to the idea that there is nothing I can do.
exampleZh: 你可以拯救的生命》,这本书彻底地推翻了那种,“我什么都帮不上“的想法。

meaning: n. 地点，位置；（电影的）外景拍摄地；定位；（计算机内存里的）地址
definition: 1. n. a point or extent in space；2. n. the act of putting something in a certain place
example: Well, it turns out on most computers an address of the location and memory, aka a pointer, is itself 32 bits.
exampleZh: 好的，它是一个计算机内存地址,或者说一个指针，占32位。

meaning: n. 经营，管理，安排；管理人员，管理层；（成功的）处理手段，（有效的）处理能力；治疗，监控；欺骗，欺诈
definition: 1. n. the act of managing something；2. n. those in charge of running a business
example: In 1989, about a year after we went public, we had a horrible problem related to inventory management.
exampleZh: 989年，也就是我们上市的第二年，我们在库存管理方面,遇见了极大的困难。

meaning: n. 态度，举止；礼貌；方式；（文学或艺术的）风格；习俗；种类；（语法）方式状语，方式副词；【名】 （Manner）曼纳（人名）
definition: 1. n. how something is done or how it happens；2. n. a way of acting or behaving
example: The first is, that while God's promise is sure, the manner and the timing of its fulfillment is quite unpredictable.
exampleZh: 首先是，上帝的承诺是确定无疑的，但实现的方法和时机却都是不可知的。

meaning: n. 成员，一分子；会员；议员；用于表示荣誉的头衔（尤指最低级）勋章获得者；（建筑或桥的）构件；（句子）成分；（方程式）端边；（一组数字）项；（数学集合）元；身体的一部分（如胳膊或腿）；阴茎
definition: 1. n. one of the persons who compose a social group (especially individuals who have joined and participates in a group organization)；2. n. an organization that is a member of another organization (especially a state that belongs to a group of nations)
example: Well, Mario Molina, who was a faculty member here at MIT, won a Nobel prize for describing this process.
exampleZh: 马里奥，莫丽娜，一个麻州理工学院的教员，凭借描述这一过程获得了诺贝尔物理学奖。

meaning: n. 口信，消息；（书籍、演讲等的）要旨，主题思想；（从大脑发给身体某部位或身体某部位向大脑发送的）信息；购物；电视广告；差使；启示，教训；（先知的）预言；v. （尤指以电子形式）传送（信息）；通报
definition: 1. n. a communication (usually brief) that is written or spoken or signaled；2. v. send a message to
example: And it raises a specifically interpretive question: what is the message of the work that the man does?
exampleZh: 它也引发了理解上的问题：,这个劳动者正在做的事儿要传达什么信息呢？

meaning: adj. 单语的，仅用一种语言的，仅懂一种语言的；n. 只用一种语言的人，单语者
definition: n. a person who knows only one language；adj. using or knowing only one language
example: It has been estimated that there are fewer monolingual speakers in the world than bilinguals and multilinguals.
exampleZh: 据估计，世界上讲单语的人要少于讲双语和多语的人。

meaning: adv. 多半，主要地；几乎全部，几乎所有
definition: 1. adv. in large part; mainly or chiefly；2. adv. usually; as a rule
example: 0% of the websites that may change, two years now, into mostly mandarin or some other language. We don't know.
exampleZh: 也许，两年后80%的网站，会变成其他语言,可能是普通话，或者其他语言，我们无法预测。

meaning: n. 母亲；大娘；女修道院院长；vt. 生下；养育；像母亲般关怀或照管；adj. 母亲的；出生地的
definition: 1. n. a woman who has given birth to a child (also used as a term of address to your mother)；2. v. care for like a mother
example: Isn't it difficult being a mother and a professor at the same time and keeping a balance between the two?
exampleZh: 同时做母亲和教授是不是很困难呢？两者之间取得平衡不容易吧？

meaning: adj. 核子的，原子核的；核武器的；原子能的，核能的；核心的，中心的；细胞核的，构成细胞核的
definition: 1. adj. (weapons) deriving destructive energy from the release of atomic energy；2. adj. of or relating to or constituting the nucleus of an atom
example: It's Huxley that said woe to the slaying of a beautiful theory by an ugly fact, nuclear collapse.
exampleZh: 赫胥黎说过,一个美丽的理论,被丑陋的事实所抹杀，核坍塌，真是科学的悲剧。

ipa: ˈɒbdʒɪkt; ˈɒbdʒekt; əbˈdʒekt / ˈɑːbdʒekt; ˈɑːbdʒekt; əbˈdʒekt
meaning: n. 物体，实物；目的，目标；宾语；（引发某种情感或行为的）对象；客体；（计算机）对象；v. 反对；反对说，反对的理由是
definition: 1. n. a tangible and visible entity; an entity that can cast a shadow；2. v. express or raise an objection or protest or criticism or express dissent
example: Their observance protects the holy object from profanation, from being profaned, reverting from holy status back to common status.
exampleZh: 它们按照惯例保护着神圣的东西不受亵渎，不受玷污，不让它们重新回归世俗。

meaning: adv. 非常，尤其；特别是；清楚地，明确地
definition: 1. adv. to a distinctly greater extent or degree than is common；2. adv. specifically or especially distinguished from others
example: Well, it's on one hand a very large idea to take in, particularly I think if one's working in a university.
exampleZh: 这是一个很大的话题，不容易理解，对于在大学中工作学习的人尤为如此。

meaning: n. 小径，小道；（开出的）通道；（事物或人移动的）路线，轨迹；（有助于实现某事的）道路，途径；通勤火车时刻表；（计算机）路径
definition: 1. n. a course of conduct；2. n. a way especially designed for a particular use
example: And the path that I'm describing then, let's assume that we're raising the temperature up is this path right here.
exampleZh: 经过一个，等压过程,路径就是这样。

meaning: v. 继续存在，持续；坚持，执意；坚持说，反复说
definition: 1. v. continue to exist；2. v. be persistent, refuse to stop
example: He urged the United States to persist with its efforts to bring about peace.
exampleZh: 他敦促美国坚持努力实现和平。

meaning: n. 富裕，充裕；pron. 大量，众多；adv. 大量，很多；非常，十分；足够有余；det. 很多，大量；【名】 （Plenty）普伦蒂（人名）
definition: 1. n. a full supply；2. adv. as much as necessary
example: Please accept my present, which has been brought to you, for God has favored me, and I have plenty.
exampleZh: 求你收下我带来给你的礼物，因为神恩待我，使我充足。

meaning: n. 偏爱，偏好；更喜欢的人（或物）；优待，优先（权）；（尤指债务偿付）优先偿还权
definition: 1. n. a strong liking；2. n. a predisposition in favor of something
example: Let's make a list of possible speakers, in order of preference.
exampleZh: 咱们按优先顺序列出一份可能请到的发言者名单。

meaning: v. 承诺，保证；使很可能，预示；指望，期待（promise oneself）；把（某人，尤指女人）许配给；有指望，有前途；n. 承诺，诺言；前途，指望；迹象，预示
definition: 1. n. a verbal commitment by one person to another agreeing to do (or not to do) something in the future；2. v. make a promise or commitment
example: She represents a power that might enable Milton perhaps someday actually to fulfill, to consummate his much-anticipated poetic promise.
exampleZh: 她象征着一种力量,也许有一天那力量可以，使弥尔顿圆满完成他那备受期待的理想诺言。

meaning: v. 代表；为……代言（辩护）；代表（选区、政党、群体）任国会议员（或其他立法机构议员）；代表（国家、学校、城镇等参加比赛）；作为某人的代表（尤指在正式场合或仪式中）；等于，相当于；（符号或象征）代表，表示；象征，体现；展示，描绘；（尤指不真实地）描述，描写；扮演；明确讲述，清楚说明；声称；正式提出（意见、抗议等）
definition: 1. v. take the place of or be parallel or equivalent to；2. v. express indirectly by an image, form, or model; be a symbol
example: Shakespeare in the theater seemed to represent a temptation greater even than promiscuous sex or perhaps akin to sex.
exampleZh: 在戏剧中,莎士比亚似乎更代表着一种诱惑,而不是乱性或类似的性关系。

meaning: n. 要求，必要条件；需要（要求）的事物
definition: 1. n. required activity；2. n. anything indispensable
example: Evidence of basic proficiency in English is part of the admissions requirement.
exampleZh: 基本英语水平的证明是录取条件的一部分。

meaning: n. 规模，范围；等级，级别；刻度，标度；秤；比例，比例尺；音阶；鳞，鳞片；水垢；牙垢；天平盘；天秤（星）座（the Scales）；（加热后金属上形成的）氧化皮；（数）进位制；（摄）影调范围；v. 攀登，翻越；刮鳞；剔除（牙垢）；（按比例）缩小（或放大）；（尤指皮肤）生成鳞屑；（成片状）脱落，剥落；称得重量为；（数量，财产） 按一定比例调节；估算（树木的）产木材量；adj. （模型或复制品）按比例缩小的；【名】 (Scale)（意）斯卡莱（人名）
definition: 1. n. an ordered reference standard；2. v. measure by or as if by a scale
example: Because I think our education system, pre-college is generally not great in sort of the world scale.
exampleZh: 因为我觉得我们的教育系统，大学之前的教育在世界范围内并不是最好的。

meaning: n. 计划（表），进度表；（公共汽车、火车等的）时间表；（价目、费用等的）清单，一览表；（电视或电台的）节目表；（学校的）课程表； 附件（尤指表格、单据等）；（英国所得税制的）报税单；v. 安排，预定；列入，收进（正式目录、清单等中）； 把（建筑物）列为文物保护单位
definition: 1. n. a temporally organized plan for matters to be attended to；2. v. plan for an activity or event
example: it's very hard for the professors to schedule a lot of individual time for the people who can't make it.
exampleZh: 教授很难为那些没法按时考试的考生另外安排时间。

meaning: v. 坐下，就座；能容纳，可坐（……人）；为……做模特；（比赛）不用（某选手）；（狗等动物）蹲坐；处在，坐落在； 担任职务，当委员；开会，开庭；参加（考试）；照看小孩；n. 坐的一段时间；（衣服的）合身；【名】 （Sit）（美、加）西特（人名）
definition: 1. v. be seated；2. v. sit around, often unused
example: it's like really, forest sit on that side, so it's really nice to sit down and read a book or something.
exampleZh: 那一边简直就像是一片森林，在那里坐下来看看书或干点别的什么将会是件很美妙的事情。

meaning: n. 种类，品种；某一种（或某一类）人；（计算机对信息的）分类，排序；程度，方式；v. 整理，把……分类，拣选；妥善处理，安排妥当；交往；协调
definition: 1. n. a category of things distinguished by some common characteristic or quality；2. v. examine in order to test suitability
example: God creates the world and then sort of, as Milton says himself, "uncircumscrib'd withdraws," right? God is not there.
exampleZh: 上帝创造了这个世界，然后，就像弥尔顿说的，“退出了“，是吗，上帝不在结构之中。

definition: adv. in an effective manner；adv. in actuality or reality or fact
example: You must delegate effectively and empower people to carry out their roles with your full support.
exampleZh: 你们必须有效地下放权力，使人们能够在你们的全力支持下履行他们的职责。

meaning: n. 电，电流，电力；强烈感情
definition: 1. n. a physical phenomenon associated with stationary or moving electrons and protons；2. n. energy made available by the flow of electric charge through a conductor
example: It's like electricity, you know, like the feeling of seeing that many people in the stadium
exampleZh: 就像电流一样，那种在体育场看到超多人的感觉，

meaning: n. 基本部分，要素；元素；有点，少量；一群人；恶劣天气（the elements）；基本原理；适宜的环境；电热元件，电热丝；（基督教圣餐中的）面包和酒；【名】 （Element）（英）埃利门特，（德）埃勒门特（人名）
definition: 1. n. an abstract part of something；2. n. any of the more than 100 known substances (of which 92 occur naturally) that cannot be separated into simpler substances and that singly or in combination constitute all matter
example: But what's really shocking is when you compare this with this, it's based upon sonnet 57 because lanthanum is element 57.
exampleZh: 但是真正令人震惊的是,当你比较这个和这个的时候，基于诗57来看7,而正好镧是57号元素。

meaning: adj. 全部的，整个的；完全的，绝对的；（公马）未经阉割的；（叶子）全缘的，边缘光滑的；n. 未经阉割的公马，种马；【名】 （Entire）（英）恩泰尔（人名）
definition: 1. n. uncastrated adult male horse；2. adj. constituting the full quantity or extent; complete
example: Now in these two books we've seen Milton dig up and discard just about the entire tradition of epic poetry.
exampleZh: 现在在我们看到的两册书中弥尔顿,挖出并丢弃了所有史诗的传统。

meaning: v. 建立，设立；证实，确定；发现，找出；使被接受，使得到承认；使（故事的角色）真实；（桥牌）（通过出大牌）使（某）花色所剩的牌都能赢
definition: 1. v. set up or found；2. v. set up or lay the groundwork for
example: We're trying to establish linkages between these groups and financial institutions.
exampleZh: 我们正试图建立这些团体和金融机构间的联系。

meaning: pron. 每件事物，（有关的）一切，万事；形势，情况；最重要的东西；n. （Everything）（印、美、澳）艾维辛（人名）
definition: 1. abstract: "Everything" is the second single from the album Elegantly Wasted by INXS. It was released only in Mexico, Europe and Australia.
example: He tells us that everything that we've read up to this point that has been spoken by a third-person narrator.
exampleZh: 他把目前为止我们读到的,所有以第三人称叙述的事情都告诉我们。

meaning: n. 眼睛；目光，所看之处；眼力，鉴赏力；眼光，视角；观点，态度；（钩）环，扣眼；（马铃薯上的）芽眼，芽；（飓风等风暴的）风眼；拍摄对象，取景器；（电）眼，（红外）眼，眼状探测装置；针眼，针鼻儿；v. 注视，仔细打量；【名】 （Eye）（英）艾，（德）艾厄（人名）
definition: 1. n. the organ of sight；2. v. look at
example: The Magi here are, again, an image, a kind of visionary symbol, an image available "in the mind's eye" at all times.
exampleZh: 这儿，三圣贤又是个意象，一个幻想出的标志，时时存在于大脑中的一个意象。

meaning: adj. 熟悉的；常见的，普通的；非正式的，随和的；过分亲密的，随便的；n. （与女巫共居的）妖精；知交，密友；（在教皇或主教家服务的）仆人；【名】 （Familiar）（西）法米利亚尔（人名）
definition: 1. n. a person attached to the household of a high official (as a pope or bishop) who renders service in return for support；2. adj. well known or easily recognized
example: So it really, you know, becoming familiar with the different methods is best done through experience, not through books.
exampleZh: 所以，真的，你知道，熟练掌握不同的方法最好是通过经验，而不是通过书。

meaning: v. 饲养，喂养，为……提供食物；以……为食物，吃食；提供（意见或信息等），灌输；施肥；添加燃料；把……放进机器，将……塞进机器；加深，强化；使（缓慢平稳地）移动，使穿过（有限的空间）；维持，满足（习惯）；传球；流入，进入；n. 哺乳，喂养；动物的饲料，植物的肥料；（机器的）进料装置；（机器、设备的）原料供给；（卫星或网络）转播，（信号）传输；（计算机）订阅源；（给舞台演员的）提词，提白；丰盛的一餐
definition: 1. n. food for domestic livestock；2. v. provide as food
example: You need to take a pragmatic approach, because in the beginning, we saw the portal companies, well, feed us.
exampleZh: 采取切实有效的方法，因为一开始，可以找到门户网站。

meaning: n. 过滤器；滤光器，滤声器，滤波器；过滤程序，过滤软件；（指示车辆转弯的）分流指示灯；v. 过滤；渗入，透过；（消息、信息等）慢慢传开，走漏；缓慢进入，陆续步入；（车辆）看到分流指示灯的信号后转弯；（用程序）筛选；【名】 （Filter）（德）菲尔特（人名）
definition: 1. n. device that removes something from whatever passes through it；2. v. remove by passing through a filter
example: Put the coffee in the filter and let the water run through.
exampleZh: 把咖啡放入过滤器里让水流过。

meaning: adj. 最终的，结束的；(出现次序)最后的，末尾的；决定性的，不可变更的；无比的，极度的；n. 决赛；期末考试，课程终结考试；主调音；当日报纸的末版；（飞机进入着陆跑道的）最终边，第五边
definition: 1. n. the final match between the winners of all previous matches in an elimination tournament；2. adj. occurring at or forming an end or termination
example: I'll text you the final score.
exampleZh: 我会发短信告诉你最终的比分。

meaning: num. 五，五个；n. 五，五个；（口语）五点钟；五美元钞票；（篮球）五人球队；（人名）Five（挪威姓氏菲弗）；adj. 五的，五个的
definition: 1. n. the cardinal number that is the sum of four and one；2. adj. being one more than four
example: +4 Because this could be three plus four, 3 times five, or it could be three, plus four times five.
exampleZh: 因为这可能是，然后乘以5，也可能是，加上4乘以5。

meaning: adj. 宽松式喇叭形的（多指裙装，走路时下摆会来回摆动）
example: Robot-chef Flippy does not fear laborious work, nor does it make any complaints.
exampleZh: 机器人厨师 Flippy 不怕繁重的工作，也不会抱怨。

meaning: n. 自由权，自主权；（状态）自由，自主；行动自由（指不在狱中）；摆脱，免受；自由使用权；荣誉市民称号；（讲话，行为）过分亲密，放肆；直率，坦率；【名】 （Freedom）（英）弗里德姆（人名）
definition: 1. n. the condition of being free; the power to act or speak or think without externally imposed restraints；2. n. immunity from an obligation or duty
example: I basically wanted to do... and to be a taxi driver because of the freedom that it gives me.
exampleZh: 基本上是我想做这份工作……而且当出租车司机可以带给我很多自由空间。

meaning: v. 突出，强调；用亮色突出；挑染；n. 最好（或最精彩、最激动人心）的部分；挑染的头发；强光部分
definition: 1. n. the most interesting or memorable part；2. v. move into the foreground to make more visible or prominent
example: And I want to just highlight it for you because we're going to come back and look at it.
exampleZh: 我想强调下这一点因为我们即将,回过头去再去看看这些东西。

meaning: adv. 极其，非常；高度地，高水平地；钦佩地，赞赏地；在高处，地位高
definition: 1. adv. to a high degree or extent; favorably or with much respect；2. adv. at a high rate or wage
example: They different greatly in style. Genesis 1 is formalized, it's highly structured, it has the seven days and everything's paired up.
exampleZh: 风格迥异，《创世纪》1，很书面化,结构严谨，什么东西都是成双成对的。

meaning: v. 打，击；撞击，碰撞；击中，命中；击（球）；产生不良影响，危害；攻击，袭击；达到（一个特定的水平，阶段，数字）；碰到，遇到（困难、问题等）；使（某人）突然意识到；使（突然）闻到，使看到；按，摁；给（人）一剂毒品（或烈酒）；（产品）面市并产生影响；给（21点纸牌游戏玩家）发另一张纸牌；n. 打击；命中，击中；很受欢迎的人（或事物），成功；（对网站的）访问，点击；毒品的一剂；暴力犯罪，凶杀；很受欢迎的人（或事物）
definition: 1. n. (baseball) a successful stroke in an athletic contest (especially in baseball)；2. v. cause to move by striking
example: and I work with them and you know, they hit their goal. That's when I feel the best about it.
exampleZh: 我跟他们一起练，他们达成目标。那时候我感觉最好。

meaning: adj. 立刻的，即时的；目前的，紧迫的；附近的，紧接的；（关系或级别）最接近的，直系的；（两者间）直接的；（感知，反应）直觉的
definition: 1. adj. very close or connected in space or time；2. adj. having no intervening medium
example: Actually, I don't really think that... No? -I don't think that... The cultural wars were an immediate war.
exampleZh: 实际上，我并不这么认为。,不，我不这么认为。,文化论战是十分紧迫的论战。

meaning: adj. 不可能的，办不到的；（境况）极其艰难的；（人）难以对付的；n. 不可能的事（the impossible）
definition: 1. n. something that cannot be done；2. adj. not capable of occurring or being accomplished or dealt with
example: These are unquestionably strong words, and I think it's impossible for us to overestimate the weight of these words.
exampleZh: 毫无疑问，这些言辞非常激烈，我觉得,怎么高估它们的分量都不过分。

meaning: n. 昆虫；类似昆虫的小动物（如蜘蛛）；卑鄙的人
definition: 1. n. small air-breathing arthropod；2. n. a person who has a nasty or unethical character undeserving of respect
example: The roof timbers were affected by rot and insect attack.
exampleZh: 屋顶的木料已经腐朽并遭虫害。

meaning: n. 机构，团体；社会收容机构；制度，习俗；建立，制定；知名的人（或事物）
definition: 1. n. an organization founded and united for a specific purpose；2. n. an establishment consisting of a building or complex of buildings where an organization for the promotion of some cause is situated
example: and went down to California to go to my undergraduate institution, which was Cal Poly, San Luis Obispo.
exampleZh: 之后我去了加利福尼亚州，在位于圣路易斯-奥比斯波县的加州理工大学读本科。

meaning: n. 智力，才智；智能；情报，谍报；情报机构
definition: 1. n. the ability to comprehend; to understand and profit from experience；2. n. a unit responsible for gathering and interpreting information about an enemy
example: So, we devoted a lecture early on--of a couple of weeks ago, to individual differences across people in intelligence and personality.
exampleZh: 几周之前我们用了一整节课，来讲人与人之间的智力与个性差异。

meaning: n. 学习者，初学者；（驾驶）学车者；（Learner）人名（勒纳）
definition: 1. n. someone (especially a child) who learns (as from a teacher) or takes up knowledge or beliefs；2. n. works for an expert to learn a trade
example: For the adult learner, the technology has the capability of freeing us in terms of time and space.
exampleZh: 对成年学习者而言，技术能够让我们免受,时间和空间的限制。

meaning: n. 动力，诱因；积极性，干劲；（支持请求或倡议的）事实与理由
definition: 1. n. the psychological feature that arouses an organism to action toward a desired goal; the reason for the action; that which gives purpose and direction to behavior；2. n. the condition of being motivated
example: He admitted a lack of motivation and a feeling of sloth.
exampleZh: 他承认自己缺乏动力，感觉懒散。

meaning: n. 发动机，马达；汽车，轿车；原动力；adj. 机动的；汽车的，车辆的；肌肉运动的，运动神经的；原动的，引起运动的；v. 乘车旅行，驾车旅行；使用发动机驾驶帆船；快速移动，迅速增加；用汽车运送
definition: 1. n. machine that converts other forms of energy into mechanical energy and so imparts motion；2. v. travel or be transported in a vehicle
example: The motor neurons are deactivated and then, because the way you breathe is through motor neurons, you then die.
exampleZh: 运动神经元被抑制了,也因为你的呼吸是由运动神经元支配的,那接下来你就会死去

meaning: adj. 多个的，多种的；多人共有的；影响身体许多部位的；n. 倍数；连锁商店；（电信）复联，复接
definition: 1. n. the product of a quantity by an integer；2. adj. having or involving or consisting of more than one part or entity or individual
example: The square brackets here, meanwhile, say this is a special type of variable that's got multiple values inside of it.
exampleZh: 这里的这个方括号，同时，说明这个是特殊的变量类型,里面有很多复合的值。

meaning: adv. 几乎，差不多；密切地，亲密地；即将，就要
definition: 1. adv. (of actions or states) slightly short of or not quite accomplished；2. adv. in a close manner
example: It wasn't nearly as big as Rome, which would consist of a million inhabitants fairly quickly around this time.
exampleZh: 而且也没有罗马那么大，罗马当时能快速聚集百万居民。

meaning: n. 夜间，夜晚；晚上，傍晚；黄昏；（特殊活动之）夜；黑夜，夜色；挫败时期；adj. 夜晚的；夜晚使用的；夜间进行的；夜晚活动的；int. 晚安（goodnight 的简称）
definition: 1. n. the time after sunset and before sunrise while it is dark outside；2. n. the time between sunset and midnight
example: III Yonder a maid and her wight Come whispering by: War's annals will fade into night Ere their story die.
exampleZh: 那边一个女仆和她的同伴,走进来低语：,在故事结束前战争会没入夜色中。

meaning: pron. 全无；adv. 毫无，绝不（none the）；（与 too 加形容词或副词连用）绝不；n. 申初经（天主教七段祈祷时间中的一部分，通常在一天中的第九个小时 下午3点）；【名】 （None）（葡、罗）诺内（人名）
definition: 1. n. a canonical hour that is the ninth hour of the day counting from sunrise；2. adj. not any
example: What is the meaning of an untrodden way, or of "there are none to praise" her but "very few to love"?
exampleZh: 没有人走过的路是什么意思呢？,还有“没有人赞扬她“但是“几乎没有人爱她“又是什么意思呢？

meaning: adj. 正常的，标准的；（身心）健康的，（人）普通的；（线或线性特征）正交的，垂直的；（盐溶液）与血液的盐浓度相同的；正（断层）的；平常的，通常的；n. 常态，通常标准；正常人，循规蹈矩者；法线，正交；【名】 （Normal）（德）诺马尔（人名）
definition: 1. n. something regarded as a normative example；2. adj. conforming with or constituting a norm or standard or level or type or social norm; not abnormal
example: So mostly it's just work and practice and a lot of fun with my friends, but it's pretty normal.
exampleZh: 所以，我的本科生活就是学习，训练，和朋友们一块放松，很普通的学生生活。

meaning: n. 北，北方；北部（地区）；北方发达国家（the North）；（桥牌）北家（North）；adj. 北方的，朝北的；（风）北方吹来的；adv. 向北，朝北；大于
definition: 1. n. the region of the United States lying north of the Mason-Dixon line；2. adj. situated in or facing or moving toward or coming from the north
example: You can take something that's magnetic with a north-south 1 magnetization and just say arbitrarily, this will represent one.
exampleZh: 你只需要一个北南极的磁性物体,任意指定，比方说代表。

meaning: adv. 如今，现在
definition: 1. n. the period of time that is happening now; any continuous stretch of time including the moment of speech；2. adv. in these times
example: Locke says that legitimate government is government founded on consent and who, nowadays, would disagree with him?
exampleZh: 洛克说合法政府是建立在同意的基础上,而现如今又有谁会不同意他的观点呢？

meaning: n. 意见，看法；（群体的）观点，信仰；专家意见，专业意见；（对某人的）评价，印象；（法官或法院说明判决理由的）判决意见书
definition: 1. n. a personal belief or judgment that is not founded on proof or certainty；2. n. a belief or sentiment shared by most people; the voice of the people
example: It's this basic antagonism, this difference of opinion, that Eikhenbaum wants to focus on and, indeed, does focus on.
exampleZh: 这就是艾肯鲍姆的反对者的，基本意见，针对这点，艾肯鲍姆将反对付诸行动了。

meaning: adj. 普通的，平常的；平淡无奇的，平庸的；（尤指法官、主教）常任的，本身有权的；n. 常见的人（或事物）（the ordinary）；常任法官；管区长，教区长（the Ordinary）；（罗马天主教）常规弥撒（Ordinary）；礼拜式规程书典（Ordinary）；（纹章）普通图记；普通股（ordinary share 的简称）；（前轮大后轮小的）老式自行车
definition: 1. n. a judge of a probate court；2. adj. not exceptional in any way especially in quality or ability or size or degree
example: When you don't have to worry about criteria like that ordinary, mechanical energy rules supreme, and that's dictating where equilibrium lies.
exampleZh: 如果你不担心像这样的要求,通常的机械能就占据主要地位，并且决定平衡位于何处。

meaning: n. 组织，团体，机构（英国英语拼法，等于 organization）；组织，筹备，安排；条理，系统性
definition: n. an organized structure for arranging or classifying；n. the persons (or committees or departments etc.) who make up a body for the purpose of administering something
example: When an organisation is shrinking, the best and most mobile workers are prone to leave voluntarily.
exampleZh: 当一个组织在萎缩时，最优秀、流动性最强的员工往往会自愿离职。

meaning: adj. 特定的，某一的；格外的，特别的；讲究的，挑剔的；特殊的，独特的；详细的，详尽的；n. 一点，一个细节； 详细资料，详情（particulars）；（哲学）（与普遍性相对的）特殊性
definition: 1. n. a fact about some part (as opposed to general)；2. adj. unique or specific to a person or thing or category
example: What are some of the particular opportunities and challenges of being a Muslim chaplain in America on a secular university campus?
exampleZh: 美国大学中的穆斯林教士,一般都会遇到一些,什么样的机会和挑战呢？

meaning: n. （艺术家的）赞助人，资助者；代言人，名义赞助人；（酒吧、旅馆等的）主顾，顾客；（古罗马）有权势的保护人，庇护人；（古罗马）已获得自由的奴隶的原主人和保护人；有圣职授予权的人（或机构）；【名】 （Patron）（英）佩特伦，（法、意、罗）帕特龙（人名）
definition: 1. a person or group that supports an activity or organization, especially by giving money；2. a person who uses a particular shop, restaurant, hotel, etc., especially regularly
example: Catherine the Great was a patron of the arts and sciences.
exampleZh: 凯瑟琳大帝是艺术和科学的赞助人。

meaning: n. 平台；讲台，舞台；讲台上的人（the platform）；（火车站的）月台；（公共汽车上供乘客上下车的）踏脚台；发言机会，论坛；契机；（政党的）纲领；厚底鞋；计算机平台；（海上）钻井平台；（供人上下小船的）水上平台；（火箭或导弹的）卫星发射平台
definition: 1. n. a raised horizontal surface；2. n. a document stating the aims and principles of a political party
example: And it's just like a platform for that; for artists both well-known and not so well-known.
exampleZh: 它就像是个给有名的或者还不那么有名的艺术家提供的舞台。

meaning: n. 流行，普及，受欢迎
definition: 1. n. the quality of being widely admired or accepted or sought after
example: But for all that, despite the popularity of that view, I'm inclined to think it must be wrong.
exampleZh: 虽然观点受到追捧，我倾向认为它一定是错的。

meaning: adv. 大概，或许
definition: 1. adv. with considerable certainty; without much doubt；2. adv. easy to believe on the basis of available evidence
example: The same nations and the short life expectancy of birth probably the lowest quality of life in other areas.
