meaning: n. 读者， 爱读书的人；（初级）读本，简易读物；（英国大学中仅次于教授的）高级讲师（Reader）；（美国大学的）助教；电子阅读器，电子识读机；缩微软片阅读机；（出版社的）审稿人，审阅人；校对人；抄表员；（基督教堂中）领读经文的信徒；【名】 （Reader）（英）里德（人名）
definition: 1. n. a person who enjoys reading；2. n. someone who contracts to receive and pay for a service or a certain number of issues of a publication
example: He began and ended his career as a decadent, I suppose a reader of Walter Pater and Oscar Wilde.
exampleZh: 他以颓废者的形象开始和结束其事业，我想作为佩特和王尔德的读者。

meaning: adj. 有道理的，合情理的；（人）通情达理的，讲道理的；适度的，合适的；（价格）公道的；还算好的，尚可的；相当大的，（数量）不少的
definition: 1. adj. showing reason or sound judgment；2. adj. not excessive or extreme
example: So what we see is, again perfectly reasonable statistical techniques, but not looking at things in the right way.
exampleZh: 所以我们这里可以看到，还是很完美很有逻辑的统计学工具，但是他们没有用正确的方式去看待数据。

meaning: n. 康复，痊愈；戒除；恢复，复苏；（供刚做完手术的病人使用的）监护室；（被拿走或失去的东西的）复得，找回；收回的物品（资金）；（破损车辆或坠毁飞机）回收修理；（高尔夫）挽回败局之击，复原之击（击回球道或球穴区）；（美橄）重新获球；（划船，自行车赛，游泳）还原至预备姿势（如回桨等）；回收利用（能源、化工品等）
definition: 1. n. return to an original state；2. n. gradual healing (through rest) after sickness or injury
example: That's shown functionally here but recovery means that this sodium channel becomes closed again.
exampleZh: 在此展示了这项功能,恢复代表着钠离子通道再次关闭

meaning: n. 减小，降低；减价，折扣；（照片、地图、图片等的）缩图，缩版；归纳，简化；（数学）归约，约化；染色体减半；简编曲（管弦乐改编的钢琴曲或小乐队演奏曲）；浓汤，浓汁；脱臼（或断骨）复位；（化学）还原，被还原；（语音）弱化
definition: 1. n. the act of decreasing or reducing something；2. n. any process in which electrons are added to an atom or ion (as by removing oxygen or adding hydrogen); always occurs accompanied by oxidation of the reducing agent
example: In other words, the reduction of excitation is obviously something that the pleasure principle is all about.
exampleZh: 换句话说快乐原则关注的不就是,减少兴奋吗？

meaning: adj. 定期的，规律的；经常的，频繁的；惯常的，通常的；持久的，固定的；标准尺寸的，中号的；普通的，平凡的；常备军的，正规军的；（动词）规则的；（人）正常通便的，月经正常的；完全的，彻底的；均匀的，端正的；正规的，正当的；（冲浪等）左腿在前的；n. 常客，老主顾；主演，主力队员；正规军人，职业军人；普通产品，普通装；（区别于世俗教士的）修道者，教士；【名】 （Regular）（以）雷古拉尔（人名）
definition: 1. n. a regular patron；2. adj. in accordance with fixed order or procedure or principle
example: but people came and they, you know, started making a fuss about it. So it's back to the regular time.
exampleZh: 但纽约市民不满意这个决定，纷纷跑来闹事。所以，公园的开放时间又恢复到从前了。

meaning: adv. 定期地，有规律地；频繁地，经常地；均匀地，匀称地；（语法）变化规律地
definition: adv. in a regular manner；adv. having a regular form
example: So for this reason, the sanctuary has to be regularly purged of the accumulated defilements accruing to it as a result of such sins.
exampleZh: 出于这个原因，圣所需要定期净化,清除这些累计的罪孽。

meaning: v. 提醒，使想起；（因相像）使联想起（remind sb. of）
definition: 1. v. put in the mind of someone；2. v. assist (somebody acting or reciting) by suggesting the next words of something forgotten or imperfectly learned
example: Can you remind me to buy a bottle of wine?
exampleZh: 你能提醒我买一瓶葡萄酒吗？

meaning: vt. 移开，拿开；除去，废除；把……免职，开除；脱下，摘下； 依法迫迁；远离；不同于，迥异于； 搬家；n. 距离，间距；（一些英国学校中的）年级
definition: 1. n. degree of figurative distance or separation；2. v. remove something concrete, as by lifting, pushing, or taking off, or remove something abstract
example: And so what happens when we remove these stops is that the piston slams up against the next pair of stops.
exampleZh: 把挡板移开后活塞会,向上移动直道第二个挡板处。

meaning: v. 重复，重说；复述，跟读（尤指为学习）；转述，转告；（强调说过的话）再说一遍；重新做，使再次发生；重播；重读，重修；（选举中违法）重复投票；再次成功，两连冠；（吃下的食物因打嗝或消化不良）在口中留下余味；（钟表按要求）连打；n. （事件的）重演，重现；重播节目；（同类货物的）再次运送；重复装饰图案；（乐谱的）反复符号，重复段
definition: 1. n. an event that repeats；2. v. to say, state, or perform again
example: So I will ask you questions. The only annoying thing I will have to do is to repeat your answers.
exampleZh: 所以我要向你们提问,唯一很讨厌的就是我要你们重复你们的回答。

meaning: v. 取代；（用……）替换，（以……）接替；更换， 赔还；把......放回原处
definition: 1. v. substitute a person or thing for (another that is broken or inefficient or lost or no longer working or yielding what is expected)；2. v. take the place or move into the position of
example: He wants to replace that with a new kind of, I want to call it rational citizenship, philosophical citizenship.
exampleZh: 他想要以一种,新型态取而代之，我称之为理性的公民社会，达观的公民社会。

meaning: v. 恢复（某种情况或感受）；使复原，使复位；修复，整修；重新采用，恢复使用；归还
definition: 1. v. return to its original or usable and functioning condition；2. v. return to life; get or give new life or energy
example: We will restore her to health but it may take time.
exampleZh: 我们会让她恢复健康，但这或许需要时间。

meaning: n. 满意，称心；（对需求或欲望的）满足；（抗议、投诉等的）妥善处理；乐事，快事；（债务等的）清偿，（义务等的）履行；赔偿，补偿；通过决斗维护荣誉的机会；（基督教神学）基督替世人赎罪
definition: 1. n. the contentment you feel when you have done something right；2. n. state of being gratified; great satisfaction
example: In other words, the judgment of beauty does not depend on the existence of the object for its satisfaction.
exampleZh: 换句话说，审美不会依赖于,事物自己的存在形式。

meaning: n. 自己，自我；（指一个人）自己，本人；私心，私利；本人（用于商业函件、支票等）；（自己的）通常的行为方式，本来面目；adj. （装饰品，封面）与其他部分同质同色的；v. （主植）使自花授粉，使自体受精；（遗传）（动物、植物）同系繁衍，同系受精；自花受精；pron. 自己（用于自谑的赞美语中）；本人（用于票根、支票等，指称持有人或签署人）；【名】 （Self）（英）塞尔夫（人名）
definition: 1. n. your consciousness of your own identity；2. adj. (used as a combining form) relating to--of or by or to or from or for--the self
example: Everyone, according to the logic ofAreopagitica everyone has the potential to assume the inner authority of conscience and self-discipline.
exampleZh: 按照《论出版自由》的逻辑，每个人都有,用内在良心的统治和自律的潜力。

meaning: n. 大小，尺寸；庞大，巨大；数量，规模；（尤指衣服、鞋子等的）尺寸，尺码；特定尺寸；相应尺码的人（或衣物）；（使纸张、布料坚挺且光亮的）浆料，（贴壁纸用的）涂料；v. 依大小分类（或排列）；按一定大小制作；改变......的大小； 给（衣服、纸张等）上浆，给......涂胶； 大致评价，估量；估算（或测量某物）大小；可比拟；adj. 一定大小（或尺码）的
definition: 1. n. the physical magnitude of something (how big it is)；2. v. cover or stiffen or glaze a porous material with size or sizing (a glutinous substance)
example: An entry is made in the memo whenever an item, memo and an available size pair is considered.
exampleZh: 每当选择一件物品和考虑，一种可行的方案时，都会访问。

meaning: n. 天，天空；天堂，天国之力；v. 把（球）击向空中；（尤指在展览中）把（画）高挂在墙上；踢或击高空球；把桨叶翘得过高；飞涨；【名】 （Sky）（英）斯凯（人名）
definition: 1. n. the atmosphere and outer space as viewed from the earth；2. v. throw or toss with a light motion
example: Actually, I suppose to get ideally married under the open sky, under a Chuppah, gather people under the open sky.
exampleZh: 实际上，我理想中的婚礼就是,在户外的天空和犹太传统的彩棚下进行，人们聚集在蓝天下。

meaning: n. 泥土，土壤；（可供某物发展的）土壤，温床；国土，领土；耕作，务农（the soil）；粪便；v. 弄脏，玷污
definition: 1. n. the state of being covered with unclean things；2. v. make soiled, filthy, or dirty
example: So, you must imagine these are successive kings who are being buried in this, what must have been, sacred soil.
exampleZh: 因此,你必须设想他们是被埋葬在,这块圣土中的历任国王

meaning: n. 演说，发言，谈话；说话的能力；说话方式；口语，言语；（戏剧中的）台词；（该词常用于使某人感到自己所说的话很愚蠢）长篇大论
definition: 1. n. the act of delivering a formal spoken communication to an audience；2. n. (language) communication by word of mouth
example: Because you're able to use this questions to soften your speech in asking a variety of different questions.
exampleZh: 因为你可以用这样的问句来使你提出的问题更为温和。

meaning: n. 配偶；v. 和……结婚；【名】 （Spouse）斯波斯（人名）
definition: 1. n. a person's partner in marriage
example: It is often helpful to have your spouse in the room when major news is expected.
exampleZh: 在等待重大消息时，让你的配偶在场往往是很有好处的。

meaning: adv. 坚定地，强烈地，坚决地；强有力地，猛烈地；（气味）浓重地
definition: adv. with strength or in a strong manner；adv. in a powerful manner
example: As a child, she felt strongly about something else, too: People should be treated equally.
exampleZh: 在她还是个孩子的时候，她对其他事情也有强烈的感觉：人应该被平等对待。

meaning: adv. 成功地，顺利地，圆满地
definition: adv. in a successful manner
example: She has successfully combined a career and bringing up a family.
exampleZh: 她成功地兼顾了事业和抚养子女。

meaning: n. 学说，理论；（某一学科基于的）理论，原理；观点，见解
definition: 1. n. a well-substantiated explanation of some aspect of the natural world; an organized system of accepted knowledge that applies in a variety of circumstances to explain a specific set of phenomena；2. n. a tentative theory about the natural world; a concept that is not yet verified but that if true would explain certain facts or phenomena
example: Now this may suggest a certain condescension both toward theory and toward literary text, which is not at all intended.
exampleZh: 选择这篇文章也许意味着,要对理论和文本进行一定的浓缩，这一点不是我想要的。

meaning: num. （数字）一千；许许多多，数以千计；千位数；pron. 成千上万
definition: 1. n. the cardinal number that is the product of 10 and 100；2. adj. denoting a quantity consisting of 1,000 items or units
example: But it was there for over a thousand years, and we now know things to be a little different.
exampleZh: 但是，它存在了超过1000年，我们现在知道的事情有点不一样。

meaning: adj. 极小的，微小的；n. 幼童；【名】 （Tiny）（葡、印）蒂尼（人名）
definition: 1. adj. very small
example: So, indeed, we are talking about a lot of void and a tiny little bit of extremely dense being.
exampleZh: 事实上，更多的是许多真空,只有极小部分的高密度的物质。

meaning: n. 传统，惯例；传统故事，传说，传统信仰；和著名历史人物有共同品质的人；（神学）圣传
definition: 1. n. an inherited pattern of thought or action；2. n. a specific practice of long standing
example: In other words, language, according to Derrida, in the Saussurian tradition seems to privilege sound over script, over what is graphic.
exampleZh: 换句话说，德里达认为，在索绪尔的理论中，音响比文字，更具优势。

meaning: n. （彻底或重大的）改观，变化，转变；（用于南非）民主改革；舞台场景的突变；（动物生命周期中的）变态；（物理）嬗变，核的转换；（数，逻）变换；（语言学）转换；（生）遗传转化；（生）细胞转化
definition: 1. n. a qualitative change；2. n. (mathematics) a function that changes the position or direction of the axes of a coordinate system
example: The way in which we work has undergone a complete transformation in the past decade.
exampleZh: 在过去的十年里，我们的工作方式经历了彻底的变革。

meaning: n. （捕捉动物的）陷阱，网，夹子；圈套，诡计；伏击；牢笼，困境；嘴；（尤指旧时使用的）双轮轻便马车；（应该避免的）错误，问题；（赛狗开始时的）放狗隔栏；（高尔夫球场的）沙坑，凹地；容器，存贮装置；（水管）存水弯，U形管；抛靶器（将泥鸽等抛于空中以打靶）；（射球戏用的）抛球器；v. 设陷阱（或夹子、捕捉器）捕捉；使陷入圈套，使中计；诱捕，抓捕；使无力改变，使受限制；把……困在，使陷于（尤指危险之地）；（尤指身体某部位等）被卡住；聚集（空气、气体或能量等）；（英足）停（球）；（棒球）抓住（从地上弹起的球）；n. 暗色岩；【名】 （Trap）（美、丹、法、荷）特拉普（人名）
definition: 1. n. a device in which something (usually an animal) can be caught and penned；2. v. place in a confining or embarrassing position
example: But... Or say that the car is hurtling towards a switch that will drop the trap.
exampleZh: 但是。。。或者是列车飞驰而来时,正好可以触发活门开关。

meaning: v. 低估，对……估计不足；轻视，小看（某人）；n. 低估，对……估计不足
definition: 1. n. an estimation that is too low; an estimate that is less than the true or actual value；2. v. assign too low a value to
example: And I'll just say a word quickly, that don't underestimate the influence here of an ideology beneath this.
exampleZh: 我要简单阐述一个单词,不要小看了这种现象下的,意识形态对此的影响

meaning: adj. 无关的，不相干的；无亲属关系的，无血缘关系的
definition: adj. lacking a logical or causal relation；adj. not connected by kinship
example: Its prevalence appears unrelated to any rational assessment of risk.
exampleZh: 这种普遍的恐惧似乎与任何合理的风险评估无关。

meaning: adj. 不安全的，危险的；（指人）不安稳的，无安全感的
definition: adj. lacking in security or safety；adj. involving or causing danger or risk; liable to hurt or harm
example: But it's so much better now and I really never felt unsafe.
exampleZh: 现在这里好多了，我真的从来不会觉得不安全。

meaning: adj. 易变的，多变的；时好时坏的；可变的，可调节的；（数）（数字）变量的；（植，动）变异的，变型的；（齿轮）变速的；n. 可变性，可变因素；（数学中的）变量，变元；（计算机）变量（元）；（天文）变星的简称；（东北信风带以北或南半球的东南信风带与西风带之间的）变风区
definition: 1. n. something that is likely to vary; something that is subject to variation；2. adj. liable to or capable of change
example: The temperature remained constant while pressure was a variable in the experiment.
exampleZh: 做这实验时温度保持不变，但压力可变。

meaning: n. 乡村，村庄；在乡村的，乡村的；村民；（城市中带有村庄特点的）生活小区，居民区；（有有限自治权的）小自治市；高级城郊购物中心；（动物的）群落
definition: 1. n. a community of people smaller than a town；2. n. a settlement smaller than a town
example: It's a long avenue that runs from Greenwich Village all the way up into Harlem, almost into Harlem.
exampleZh: 它是条很长的大道，从格林威治村一直延伸到哈莱姆，几乎到哈莱姆里面了。

meaning: n. 财富；富有；大量
definition: 1. n. the state of being rich and affluent; having a plentiful supply of material goods and money；2. n. the quality of profuse abundance
example: How would you recommend that investors protect their wealth during this period to ? take advantage of upcoming investment opportunities?
exampleZh: 那你对投资者在这段时间内,如何保护他们的财产并且,进一步利用这即将到来的投资机会有什么建议呢？

meaning: n. 网站（全球资讯网的主机站）
definition: 1. n. a computer connected to the internet that maintains a series of web pages on the World Wide Web
example: So, this is what happens. You go to the website, there's all these bars down the side, so there's lecture videos.
exampleZh: 事情就是这样，你们访问这个网站，在下边有这些栏，还有上课的视频。

meaning: adj. 西方的，西部的；（Western）西方国家的（指与北美、西欧、北欧、南欧各国相关的）；美国西部的；n. （关于19世纪美国西部生活，尤指牛仔生活的）西部电影、西部小说；西方人；【名】 （Western）（英）韦斯顿（人名）
definition: 1. n. a film about life in the western United States during the period of exploration and development；2. adj. relating to or characteristic of regions of western parts of the world
example: So, his letters come out of this western land, New Mexico, and a land of criminality, the reform school.
exampleZh: 他的信从新墨西哥这片西部的土地而来，还是寄宿学校这种犯罪滋生地。

meaning: pron. 谁的（疑问代词）；其，……的（关系代词）；det. 谁的（限定词）；其，……的（关系限定词）
definition: 1. belonging to which person or thing; of whom or of which
definitionSource: 人工校订（依据词典义项）
example: Orpheus had provided Milton with a paradigm of the poet, the poet whose discipline and whose abstinence nourished and strengthened his poetry.
exampleZh: 俄耳甫斯在弥尔顿看来是诗人的模范,他严于律己，节制禁欲，让诗作更加出色。

meaning: n. 野生动植物；adj. 野生动植物的
definition: 1. n. all living things (except people) that are undomesticated
example: And also you have a chance to see fish and other wildlife in the water.
exampleZh: 你也有机会见到海里的鱼儿和其他野生动物。

meaning: n. 智慧，才智；明智；学问，知识；普遍看法；【名】 （Wisdom）（英）威兹德姆（人名）
definition: 1. n. accumulated knowledge or erudition or enlightenment；2. n. the trait of utilizing knowledge and experience with common sense and insight
example: Well, Yeats begins in scorn of an audience that's unable to recognize true wisdom and great art.
exampleZh: 叶芝以嘲讽一个不能识别真正的,的智慧和伟大的艺术的观众开始。

meaning: v. 破坏，断送（计划、关系等）；（严重）破坏，毁坏（车辆或建筑物）；造成（船舶）失事，使遇难；毁船打劫；（为获取有用的零件、碎料而）拆，拆除（破汽车、旧建筑物等）；营救失事船只；失事；n. 沉船，遇难船；遭到严重破坏的东西（尤指建筑物、车辆）；健康（或精神）严重受损的人；（船舶的）失事，遇难，交通事故；杂乱的地方；（船舶失事后被冲上岸的）残货，沉船漂浮物

meaning: n. 交通事故，车祸；（不幸的）意外遭遇，不测事件；意外，偶然的事；运气，机遇；大便（或小便）失禁；（亚里士多德思想中的）非本质属性

meaning: n. 住宿，膳宿；住处，办公处，停留处；（楼房或交通工具内的）空间，座位；和解，调和；（通过改变眼球晶状体形状）自动调焦

meaning: adj. 便宜的，付得起的

meaning: adj. 农业的，与农业有关的；务农的，农用的；笨拙的

meaning: adv. 在前面，朝前面；领先，占优势；提前，预先；在将来，今后；（数量或价值上）更多，更高；取得进步，获得成功；超出预期地，超前地；adj. 在前的，提前的

meaning: v. 预期，预料；预见（并做准备）；期望，盼望；先于……做，早于……行动；提前使用；在期限内履行（义务），偿还（债务）

meaning: n. 存档材料，档案；档案室；v. 把……存档，把……归档

meaning: n. 手臂，上肢；武器，军备；扶手；袖子；职能部门；臂（状部件）；盾徽，纹章；狭长港湾；臂力；v. 武装，备战；提供，配备；使（炸弹等）随时爆炸，准备发射

meaning: v. 到达，抵达；送达，寄到；发生，出现，诞生；开始，到来；成功，出名；作出（决定）；【名】 （Arrive）（法）阿里夫（人名）

meaning: adv. 在旁边，到（或向）一边；积攒，留出；除……以外；n. （戏剧或电影中的）旁白；低语，悄悄话；离题话，题外话

meaning: n. 协会，社团，联盟；交往，联合；联系，因果关系；联想
