exampleZh: 他认为一神论和多神论是截然不同的,不可能是一个由另一个进化而来。

meaning: 扭曲；歪曲
definition: 1. to change the shape of something so that it looks strange or unnatural；2. to change something so that it is false or wrong, or no longer means what it was intended to mean
example: How can you portray something exactly as it is and at the same time distort it with emotions?
exampleZh: 你怎么可能一边完全客观的作画，一边又带有感情的去使之变形呢？

meaning: n. 地区，区域；行政区，辖区；（郡或区以下的）选区；v. 把……划分成区
definition: 1. n. a region marked off for administrative or other purposes；2. v. regulate housing in; of certain areas of towns
example: Oh, I've only been a few times but, I mean, I love the Theater District.
exampleZh: 哦，我只去过几次，我是说，我喜欢剧院区。

meaning: n. 医生，大夫；诊所（the doctor）；博士；牙医，兽医 (Dr)；博学的人；（钓鱼用）人造蝇；凉爽海风；船上的厨师；v. 篡改，伪造；将有害物掺入（食物或饮料）中；阉割（动物）；为……治病，给……疗伤；授以博士学位；修理（机器等），修复；当医生，行医
definition: 1. n. a licensed medical practitioner；2. v. alter and make impure, as with the intention to deceive
example: So my dad's a doctor, my uncle's a doctor, So it's kind like you're going to be a doctor.
exampleZh: 我的父亲和叔叔都是医生，所以你本来也该成为医生的。

meaning: n. 教义，主义，信条；（政府政策的）正式声明
definition: 1. a belief or set of beliefs, especially political or religious ones, that are taught and accepted by a particular group；2. a belief, theory, or set of beliefs, esp. political or religious, taught and accepted by a particular group
example: The African National Congress today dropped its doctrine of nationalizing industry in favour of a mixed economy.
exampleZh: 非洲国民大会今天放弃了工业国有化的信条转而赞同公私并存的混合型经济。

meaning: n. 领域，范围；领土，势力范围；（因特网上的）域；（函数的）定义域；地产；【名】 （Domain）（英、法）多曼（人名）
definition: 1. an area of interest or an area over which a person has control；2. a set of websites on the internet that end with the same letters, for example .com
example: Users need to find out if a domain name is already registered or is still available.
exampleZh: 用户需要查明某个域名是已经被注册过还是仍然可用。

meaning: adj. 占支配地位的，占优势的；（基因）显性的；n. 显性（性状），显性基因
definition: 1. n. (music) the fifth note of the diatonic scale；2. adj. exercising influence or control
example: Economically, the centre of Spain has lost its dominant role.
exampleZh: 西班牙中部在经济上已失去了其主导地位。

meaning: v. （使）排出，滤干；喝光，喝干；使劳累，使疲惫；（使）逐渐消失；使降低，消耗；（通常指因惊吓或疾病而脸色）变苍白；漂亮地完成（投篮、射门等）；将（球）轻击入穴；n. 下水道，排水管；流失，消耗；（将体内液体排走的）导管，引流管；（场效应晶体管的）漏极；使人疲倦的事物，负担；【名】 （Drain）（英、美、法、加）德兰（人名）
definition: 1. n. emptying something accomplished by allowing liquid to run out of it；2. v. flow off gradually
example: She tipped the dirty water down the drain.
exampleZh: 她把脏水倒入了下水道。

meaning: n. 嗡嗡叫，嗡嗡响；雄蜂，公蜂；（遥控的）无人驾驶飞机（或导弹）；单调乏味的讲话；（不劳动，依赖他人为生的）寄生虫；伴音（如风笛等发出的持续音），伴音管（或弦等）；干单调工作的人；v. 嗡嗡叫，嗡嗡响；（人）絮絮叨叨地说，喋喋不休地说；混日子；【名】 （Drone）（法）德罗纳（人名）
definition: n. stingless male bee in a colony of social bees (especially honeybees) whose sole function is to mate with the queen；n. an unchanging intonation
example: The drone drops off the package and then returns to its home.
exampleZh: 无人机卸下包裹，随后返航。

meaning: v. 投，丢；躺倒；剔除，除名；停止，放弃；中途卸客，中途卸货；寄，送，写（信）；（道路、地面等）急剧向下倾斜；突然终止与（某人）的（恋爱）关系；（使）掉落；减少，降低；n. 滴，少量；下降；落差；递送，交付；邮政信箱，邮筒；（赃物、非法物、秘密物品的）藏匿处；垂幕，升降幕；（绞刑架的）下落板
definition: 1. n. a small indefinite quantity (especially of a liquid)；2. v. let fall to the ground
example: My parents thought I'd lost my mind to drop out of Stanford Business School to go join some company that made software.
exampleZh: 我父母认为我从斯坦福商学院,辍学去一家软件公司工作根本是疯了。

meaning: adj. 上了年纪的；老掉牙的；n. 老人（the elderly）
definition: 1. n. people who are old collectively；2. adj. advanced in years; (`aged' is pronounced as two syllables)
example: They sort of teach us why it's so important to respect the elderly.
exampleZh: 这本书告诉了我们,为什么要尊重老人。

meaning: v. 提拔，提升；抬起，提起；提高，增加；使情绪高昂，使兴高采烈
definition: 1. v. give a promotion to or assign to a higher position；2. v. raise from a lower to a higher position
example: Even better would be to help elevate notions of beauty beyond the material standards of a particular industry.
exampleZh: 更好的办法是帮助提升美的概念，超越特定行业的物质标准。

meaning: n. 突发事件，紧急情况；急症病人，急诊病人；（医院的）急诊室；adj. 紧急情况下的；应急的
definition: 1. n. a sudden unforeseen crisis (usually involving danger) that requires immediate action；2. n. a state in which martial law applies
example: What is right in normal situations will not be the same as what is right in states of emergency.
exampleZh: 是非常不同于,紧急状态时的正当。

meaning: n. 重要性，重点强调；重读，强调；（表达的）强有力
definition: 1. n. special importance or significance；2. n. intensity or forcefulness of expression
example: There's a lot of emphasis on this one exam, and... which I just, I don't think that's right.
exampleZh: 对这一个考试很重视……我就，我觉得不对。

meaning: adj. 无止境的，无穷尽的；永久的，无休止的；两端连接的，环状的
definition: 1. adj. tiresomely long; seemingly without end；2. adj. infinitely great in number
example: There's a danger, I think, that endless tolerance leads to intellectual passivity and the kind of uncritical acceptance of all points of view.
exampleZh: 这会是一场危机，无止境的容忍会导致理智的被动,及无批判能力地,接受所有的观点。

meaning: v. （公开）赞同，认可；（在广告中对某种产品）宣传，吹捧；（尤指在支票背面）签名，背书；(在驾驶执照上)记录违章事项
definition: 1. to make a public statement of your approval or support for something or someone；2. to appear in an advertisement, saying that you use and like a particular product
example: Aristotle could never endorse the view stated by a famous American president that the business of America is business.
exampleZh: 亚里士多德从未认可,那种由一位著名美国总统所说的主张,即美国的本分就是交易。

meaning: n. 工程师，设计师；（航班）机械师，（轮船）轮机长；技师，机修工；工兵；机车司机，火车司机；责任人；v. 设计，建造；策划，精心安排；改变……的基因(或遗传)结构
definition: 1. n. a person who uses scientific knowledge to solve practical problems；2. v. design as an engineer
example: He looked at the design with the eye of an engineer.
exampleZh: 他以工程师的眼光审视这个设计。

meaning: v. 使必要，需要；遗赠（财产），限定继承；使人承担；n. 限定继承，限嗣继承的财产
definition: 1. to make something necessary, or to involve something；2. to involve or make something necessary
example: Does it entail sitting down with a pattern cutter and a designer?
exampleZh: 这需要坐下来与裁剪师和设计师讨论吗？

meaning: n. 娱乐，娱乐表演；招待，款待
definition: 1. n. an activity that is diverting and that holds the attention
example: So, you know, I'm in the entertainment industry as well, so I party with a lot of celebrities.
exampleZh: 所以你知道了，我也在娱乐行业工作，所以我参加很多名人的聚会。

meaning: n. 流行病，传染病；（迅速的）盛行，蔓延；adj. 盛行的，泛滥的
definition: 1. the appearance of a particular disease in a large number of people at the same time；2. a particular problem that seriously affects many people at the same time
example: Health officials have successfully confined the epidemic to the Tabatinga area.
exampleZh: 卫生官员们已经成功地将该传染病控制在塔巴廷加地区。

meaning: adj. （在数量、大小、程度、价值方面）相等的，相同的；平等的，同等的；胜任的，合适的；势均力敌的；v. （在大小、数字、数量上）等于；比得上，达到；导致，结果为；n. 同等的人，相等物
definition: 1. n. a person who is of equal standing with another in a group；2. v. be identical or equivalent to
example: So, what we're saying is that we have n equals to 4, and m sub I being equal to negative 2.
exampleZh: 我们说的是ｎ等于４,ｍｌ等于－２

meaning: n. 均等，平等；等式
definition: 1. n. the quality of being the same in quantity or measure or value or status；2. n. a state of being essentially equal or equivalent; equally balanced
example: Zach insists that he is but one among many who are fighting for equality.
exampleZh: 扎克坚持认为他仅仅是许多为平等而战的人们中的一个。

meaning: adv. （程度）相当地，同样地；平均地，相等地；（用于补充观点）同样（重要）地
definition: 1. adv. to the same degree (often followed by `as')；2. adv. in equal amounts or shares; in a balanced or impartial way
example: The first is the radical theology, and the second is this poem's equally radical and equally daring original verse form.
exampleZh: 第一是它激进的神学观点，第二是这首诗,同样激进大胆的原始诗歌形式。

meaning: n. 财产，遗产；大片私有土地，庄园；住宅区，工业区；社会阶层；（生活）状况，条件
definition: 1. n. everything you own; all of your assets (whether real property or personal property) and liabilities；2. n. extensive landed property (especially in the country) retained by the owner for his own use
example: Most of our real estate exposure is institutional -acquisitions of office buildings -largely in major markets-- central business districts.
exampleZh: 我们大多数不动产投资是机构性的,比如主要是在商业中心地区,大量收购写字楼

meaning: v. 表现出；卖弄，炫耀；提出（证据等）；展览，展出；n. 展品；（法庭上出示的）证物；展览，展出
definition: 1. n. an object or statement produced before a court of law and referred to while giving evidence；2. v. show an attribute, property, knowledge, or skill
example: The new exhibit will tour a dozen US cities next year.
exampleZh: 这批新展品明年将在美国十二个城市巡回展出。

meaning: n. 代价，费用；业务费用，报销（expenses）；需要花钱的东西，花销的东西；v. 把……记入费用账户；向……收取费用；被花掉
definition: 1. n. amounts paid for goods and services that may be currently tax deductible (as opposed to capital expenditures)；2. n. a detriment or sacrifice
example: They're already paying for public transport, so it's just kind of a financial expense they could do without.
exampleZh: 他们已经向公共交通付钱了，所以，那只是一笔没有必要的财务支出。

meaning: n. 勘探，勘察；研究，探究
definition: 1. n. to travel for the purpose of discovery；2. n. a careful systematic search
example: This is your opportunity to begin the exploration of one of the greatest novels of our time.
exampleZh: 这是开始探索当代,最伟大的小说之一的一次机遇。

meaning: n. 表达，表示；表情，神情；（表演、歌唱或演奏时的）情感表现；词语，措词；式，表达式；挤压
definition: 1. n. the feelings expressed on a person's face；2. n. expression without words
example: And the terms of the expression change, the parties to the conflict change, the sights change, but the controversy goes on.
exampleZh: 也许人们对这种冲突的表述有所改变，利益双方有所改变，文化景观有所改变，但这种争议永远存在。

meaning: adj. 广阔的；广泛的；巨大的，大量的；（农业）粗放（经营）的
definition: 1. adj. large in spatial extent or range or scope or quantity；2. adj. broad in scope or content
example: We have got an extensive subway system and an extensive bus system that we have had for 60, 70 years.
exampleZh: 我们有大规模的地铁系统和巴士系统，它们已经有差不多六七十年的历史了。

meaning: adj. 外部的，外面的；对外的，与外国有关的；外来的，外聘的；（药品等类似物质）外用的；n. 外表，外部特征
definition: 1. n. outward features；2. adj. happening or arising or located outside or beyond some limits or especially surface
example: College lecturers acted as external assessors of the exam results.
exampleZh: 学院讲师是考试成绩的校外考核人。

meaning: n. 灭绝，消亡；（债务的）偿清；消光
definition: 1. a situation in which something no longer exists
example: The loggers say their jobs are faced with extinction because of declining timber sales.
exampleZh: 樵夫们说他们的工作因不断下降的木材销售而面临消亡。

meaning: n. 部分，方面；（宝石的）琢面，刻面；（构成昆虫或甲壳动物复眼的）小眼面；v. 在……上琢面
definition: 1. one part of a subject, situation, etc. that has many parts；2. one of the small flat surfaces cut on a precious stone
example: To help you reflect, I'd share some questions you can ask yourself for each facet.
exampleZh: 为了帮你思考复盘，我会分享一些你可以针对每个方面自问的问题。

meaning: n. 设施，设备；卫生间；天赋，才能；（机器等的）特别装置，（服务等的）特色；（用作某种用途的）场所
definition: 1. n. a building or place that provides a particular service or is used for a particular industry；2. n. skillful performance or ability without difficulty
example: Actually I mentioned the Term Securities Loan Facility because it's a new innovation but it hasn't started yet.
exampleZh: 事实上，我提到术语,是因为它是一个,新的革新但还没有开始实施。

meaning: adv. 相当地，颇；公平地，公正地；（用以强调）完全，简直；令人愉快地，让人喜欢地；【名】 （Fairly）（英）费尔利（人名）
definition: 1. adv. to a moderately sufficient extent or degree；2. adv. without favoring one party, in a fair evenhanded manner
example: It's a fairly recent understanding of Maybe you can just give us a little time line of what human rights means.
exampleZh: 这是一个新近的理解,也许你可以先给我们一个时间线索,讲讲人权含义的演变。

meaning: adj. 著名的，出名的；极好的，了不起的
definition: 1. adj. widely known and esteemed
example: The passage is also famous because in it Milton does something that he almost never does. Milton has made a mistake.
exampleZh: 这篇文章有名也是因为弥尔顿做了一些,他几乎从未做过的事，弥尔顿犯了一个错误。

meaning: n. 疲乏，厌倦；（金属部件的）疲劳；（士兵穿的）工作服；士兵杂役（尤指作为惩罚,如做打扫、帮厨）；v. 使疲劳，使劳累；adj. 疲劳的
definition: 1. n. temporary loss of strength and energy resulting from hard physical or mental work；2. v. get tired of something or somebody
example: The wing of the plane showed signs of metal fatigue.
exampleZh: 机翼显示出金属疲劳的迹象。

meaning: adj. 联邦（制）的；（与）联邦政府（有关）的；中央集权式的；（美国内战时期）北部联邦政府的；n. 联邦探员，联邦政府官员；（美国南北战争时期）北部联邦政府支持者；【名】 （Federal）（英）费德勒尔（人名）
definition: 1. n. a member of the Union Army during the American Civil War；2. adj. national; especially in reference to the government of the United States as distinct from that of its member units
example: I'm also part of a variety of social service organizations which seek federal funding to carry out their programs.
exampleZh: 我还参与了各类社会服务组织,它们寻求获得联邦资金以施行其计划。

meaning: n. 化肥，肥料（fertilizer 的英式拼写）
definition: n. any substance such as manure or a mixture of nitrates used to make soil more fertile
example: Indeed, on a global scale, fertiliser manufacturing consumes about 3-5% of the world's annual natural gas supply.
exampleZh: 事实上，在全球范围内，化肥生产消耗了全球每年约3-5%的天然气供应。

meaning: v. （使）充满，占满；堵塞，填补；满足；（声音、气味或光）遍及，弥漫；担任，充任；（感情）充盈于；打发，占据（时间）；（帆）迎风（或受风）鼓起（或张开）；使吃饱，填饱……的肚子；(按订单)供货，(按药方)配药；（用吊牌的方法）凑成，做成（一手好牌）；n. 总量，（某人的）需求总量；填充物，填方，填土；（容器的）最大容量；（某种乐器上的）插入短句，插入乐句；【名】 （Fill）（德、俄、匈）菲尔（人名）
definition: 1. n. a quantity sufficient to satisfy；2. v. make full, also in a metaphorical sense
example: There's only enough of them to fill a decent sized dining room, but they call themselves the "town meeting."
exampleZh: 人数刚够坐满一间小饭馆而已，但他们却称之为“镇民大会“

meaning: v. 完成，做好；（使）结束；消耗尽（所剩之物）；（比赛中）获得（名次）；（英式足球用语）进球；对（物件）做最后加工；杀死，歼灭；使精疲力竭；为（少女）进入上流社会做好准备；使精疲力竭；n. 结尾，结局；（赛跑、比赛的）终点；最后精细加工；饰面，饰面材料；（葡萄酒或啤酒的）余味
definition: 1. n. a decorative texture or appearance of a surface (or the substance that gives it that appearance)；2. v. come or bring to a finish or an end
example: Let's pretend that at work, your boss gives you too much work and not enough time to finish it.
exampleZh: 假设你上班的时候，老板给了你太多的工作，你没有足够的时间来完成它。

meaning: n. 公司，商行；（以顾问医师为首的）医务小组；（敌视敌对球队球迷的）球迷俱乐部，球迷联盟；adj. 结实的，坚硬的；牢固的，稳固的；坚定的，坚决的；强有力的；牢牢掌控的；坚挺的；确切的，可靠的；严厉的，强硬的；v. 使强壮，使坚实；坚挺，稳步上涨；敲定；adv. 坚定地，坚决地
definition: 1. n. the members of a business organization that owns or operates one or more establishments；2. v. become taut or tauter
example: So Firm 1 would be producing half its monopoly quantity and Firm 2 would be producing half its monopoly quantity.
exampleZh: 即公司1生产垄断产量一半的商品,公司2也生产垄断产量一半的商品

meaning: v. 修理，维修；确定（时间、地点、价格等）；安排，组织；处理，解决（问题等）；固定，安装；使（目光、注意力或思想）集中于；牢记，铭记；把（枪、相机、雷达）瞄准；操纵，作弊；梳洗，整理；整容，矫正（牙齿）；提供，准备（饮食等）；惩罚，收拾；固着（颜色），定（影）；阉割（动物）；介绍对象；注射毒品；n. 解决方案（或措施）；窘境，困境；（毒品或致瘾物的）一次用量；方位确定，定位；理解，了解；受操纵的事，勾当；【名】 （Fix）（美）菲克斯（人名）
definition: 1. n. informal terms for a difficult situation；2. v. restore by replacing a part or putting together what is torn or broken
example: And we were talking about how he wants to find ways to sort of fix and make better the,
exampleZh: 我们谈论的是，他想用什么样的方式来提高教育，

definition: 1. v. win a victory over；2. v. get on top of; deal with successfully
example: Read everything you can, Milton insists, because only then can you overcome what he thinks of and characterizes as the temptation of reading.
exampleZh: 尽可能地阅读，弥尔顿坚持到，因为只有这样你才能抵抗他认为以及标榜为的,阅读对人产生的诱惑。

meaning: adj. 外国的，海外的；adv. 在国外，在海外
definition: 1. adj. in a foreign country；2. adv. beyond or across the sea
example: They do a lot of business in lucrative overseas markets.
exampleZh: 他们在利润丰厚的海外市场上生意很多。

meaning: n. 所有权，物主身份
definition: 1. n. the relation of an owner to the thing possessed; possession with the right to transfer possession to others；2. n. the act of having and controlling property
example: Ownership is not clear because of expropriations in the Nazi era.
exampleZh: 所有权因纳粹时期的征收而不明。

meaning: v. 参加，参与；分担，分享；具有，带有（特殊的性质）
definition: 1. v. share in something；2. v. become a participant; be involved in
example: The bonds are auctioned off on regular dates and you cannot participate in the auction; I assume you can't.
exampleZh: 这些债券在规定期限内拍卖,你们不能参与这些拍卖,我想你们是不行的

meaning: adv. 部分地，在某种程度上
definition: 1. adv. in part; in some degree; not wholly
example: It's a persistent problem partly because it always raises these issues of fictionality versus truthfulness, of honesty versus embellishment.
exampleZh: 这是个持久的问题,原因是它一直在质疑虚构性和真实性的关系，还有诚实与修饰的关系。

meaning: n. 密码；口令，暗语
definition: 1. n. a secret word or phrase known only to a restricted group
example: You need a password to get access to the computer system.
exampleZh: 使用这个计算机系统需要口令。

meaning: n. 支付款项，支付额；付款，支付；报答，报复
definition: 1. n. a sum of money paid；2. n. the act of paying money
example: But the interesting thing I realized along the way is that payment is another form of communication.
exampleZh: 我渐渐意识到一个很有趣的事实：,付款是另一种交流方式。

meaning: n. 步行者，行人；adj. 平淡无奇的，乏味的；行人的，行人使用的；徒步的
definition: 1. n. a person who travels by foot；2. adj. lacking wit or imagination
example: A pedestrian bridge now connects the parking garage with the mall.
exampleZh: 现在一座人行桥连通车库和购物中心。

meaning: n. （因违反法律、规定或合同而受到的）处罚，刑罚；（行为、环境带来的）不利后果，苦难；（体育运动中对犯规者的）判罚，处罚；（足球、橄榄球及类似运动中的）罚球；（桥牌）（叫牌者未完成定约时的）罚分
definition: 1. n. the act of punishing；2. n. a payment required for not fulfilling a contract
example: So we're going to show how this technique is going to help us shoot penalty shots in soccer.
exampleZh: 我们讲学到博弈理论讲如何,帮助我们在足球比赛罚球

meaning: n. 便士（英国货币单位，100便士等于1英镑）；便士（英国1971年前使用的硬币，12便士等于1先令）；分（美国和加拿大货币单位）；一小笔钱（pennies）；一分一毫（用于强调没钱）（a penny）；迪纳里厄斯（古罗马的金币或银币）
definition: 1. n. a fractional monetary unit of Ireland and the United Kingdom; equal to one hundredth of a pound；2. n. a coin worth one-hundredth of the value of the basic unit
example: The trip was expensive but it was worth every penny.
exampleZh: 这次旅行花费很大，但是花的每一分钱都不冤枉。

meaning: vt. 认为，理解；察觉，注意到；意识到
definition: 1. v. to become aware of through the senses；2. v. become conscious of
example: Voters perceive him as a decisive and resolute international leader.
exampleZh: 选民认识到他是一位果断、坚定的国际领袖。

meaning: adj. 无瑕的，完好的；完全正确的，极其准确的；完美的，理想的；最佳的，绝配的；十足的，完全的；通常的，大体的；（语法）完成时的，完成式的；（数字）完全的；（花）有雌雄蕊的；（昆虫）性成熟的；（真菌）有性孢子形成阶段的，有性的；完成时的，完成式的；v. 完善，使完美；双面印完（一页纸）；使（礼物、头衔等）合法转移；n. （语法）完成时，完成体；【名】 （Perfect）（美、爱、英）珀费克特（人名）
definition: 1. n. a tense of verbs used in describing action that has been completed (sometimes regarded as perfective aspect)；2. v. make perfect or complete
example: Not with this girl, this girl is perfect. But in the past, I've had lots of problems with roommates.
exampleZh: 和这个女孩没吵过，她太完美了。但在过去，我和室友之间存在很多问题。

meaning: adv. 完美地，极佳地；绝对地，完全地
definition: adv. completely and without qualification; used informally as intensifiers；adv. in a perfect or faultless way
example: So what we see is, again perfectly reasonable statistical techniques, but not looking at things in the right way.
exampleZh: 所以我们这里可以看到，还是很完美很有逻辑的统计学工具，但是他们没有用正确的方式去看待数据。

meaning: v. 锲而不舍，坚持不懈；固执己见（在辩论中）
definition: 1. v. be persistent, refuse to stop
example: You have to persevere with difficult students.
exampleZh: 对难教的学生你必须坚持诲人不倦的精神。

meaning: v. 说服，劝服；使相信，使信服；（情形，事件）驱使，敦促
definition: 1. v. win approval or support for；2. v. cause somebody to adopt a certain position, belief, or course of action; twist somebody's arm
example: Why can't you take to the Hustings, persuade your fellow citizens that taxation is unjust and try to get a majority?
exampleZh: 你何不去参加竞选，劝说你的同胞,收税不公正的，并争取到大多数人的支持呢？

meaning: n. 拓荒者；先锋；（前苏联等共产党国家的）少年先锋队队员；（先头部队的）工兵；（天主教禁欲团体）完全禁欲先锋联盟的成员；先锋号（Pioneer）；adj. 先驱的；拓荒的；v. 做先锋，倡导；开辟（道路）
definition: 1. n. someone who helps to open up a new line of research or technology or art；2. v. open up an area or prepare a way
example: What if I am a pioneer or even a genius?
exampleZh: 要是我是个开拓者，甚至是个天才怎么办？

meaning: n. 盘，碟；一盘（食物）；一道主菜；奉献盘，捐款盘；金属护板（片）；金属牌；（车辆的）号码牌；镀金（或镀银）金属；金/银餐具；盾片，鳞甲；（地质）板块；（书中的）插图；印版；感光板；假牙托；牙箍；全口假牙；（棒球）本垒板；（银质或金质）奖杯；杯赛；横木；（生物）培养皿；载物片，玻璃片；极板；阳极；v. 给……镀（金属）；给……加上装甲；用鳞片覆盖；摆盘；（棒球）跑垒得分；（生物）制作显微片；【名】 （Plate）（英、德、俄、西、意、瑞典）普拉特（人名）
definition: 1. n. a sheet of metal or wood or glass or plastic；2. v. coat with a layer of metal
example: A very important element, he would have had a breast plate made of bronze, perhaps as much as 40 pounds.
exampleZh: 还有一个非常重要的元素,那就是士兵还配有铜质的胸甲,大概能有四十磅重

meaning: n. 衣袋，口袋；钱财，财力；（附在某物上的）小口袋，小容器；（用作贸易计量的）（农产品）袋；（与周围不同的）小群体，小区域；（台球）网袋，球袋；岩石或地层中充满矿石或其他物质的空洞；v. 把……放入口袋；把……装进腰包，将……据为己有；赚取，获得（钱财）；击（球）入袋；收敛，抑制（感情）；包，围；adj. 袖珍的，袋装的
definition: 1. n. a small pouch inside a garment for carrying small articles；2. v. put in one's pocket
example: When they left, Julius Caesar, out of his own pocket, gave every soldier in those legions a year's pay.
exampleZh: 他们离开时，恺撒用自己的钱，给那些士兵发了一年的俸禄。

meaning: n. 从政者，政治家；政客，善于玩弄权术者
definition: 1. n. a leader engaged in civil administration；2. n. a person active in party politics
example: The person who best captures the unconstrained view, Benjamin Constant, French philosopher and politician, " "It is for self-perfectioning that destiny calls us."
exampleZh: 最好地阐述了本性受约束观点的人，法国哲学家政治家Benjamin，Constant说，“命运召唤我们进行自我完善“

meaning: n. （某物的）一部分；（尤指餐馆中食物的）一份，一客；（责任、过失、职责等的）一份，一部分；（根据法律赠与或遗留给继承人的）一份财产； 命运，天数；v. 分配； 给（新娘）嫁妆
definition: 1. n. something determined in relation to something that includes it；2. v. give out or allot
example: And this one will be particularly germane to a portion of Problem Set 1, at least in Problem Set 1.
exampleZh: 这个程序跟习题集1中的,一部分比较相似，至少在习题1中。

meaning: v. 造成，引起（威胁、危险、问题等）；提出（问题）；（为照相、画像等）摆好姿势；假扮，冒充（pose as）；（举止或穿戴）装腔作势，招摇过市；把……难住，使为难；n. （为拍照、画像等摆的）姿势；故作姿态，装腔作势
definition: 1. n. affected manners intended to impress others；2. v. introduce
example: I'll then pose some of the questions and the challenges we are facing in the area of access in sustainability.
exampleZh: 随后我将提出,在获取稳定这方面,我们所面临的问题和挑战。

meaning: adv. 可能，或许；（用于强调惊讶或震惊）怎么，究竟；怎么可能，绝不可能（用于否定句，表强调）；能不能，能否（用于礼貌地请求）；尽量，尽可能
definition: 1. adv. by chance；2. adv. with a possibility of becoming actual
example: Now the subject matter that he's chosen for this poem, for this so-called first poem, couldn't possibly be more appropriate.
exampleZh: 现在他选这首诗的主题很重要，这所谓第一首诗可能不太恰当。

meaning: n. 贫穷，贫困；贫乏，低劣；个人财产权的放弃（作为宗教誓约的一部分）
definition: 1. n. the state of having little or no money and few or no material possessions
example: so you pay and they'll donate money to poverty or Habitat for Humanity or some organizations like that.
exampleZh: 你交钱而他们会把钱捐给穷人或者仁人家园或者其他类似的慈善机构。

meaning: n. 出席，存在；（某人的）所在地方；感觉中的存在物（如鬼魂）；驻扎部队，驻扎的警力；风度，气质；（公司在某地的）工人（或产品），势力
definition: 1. n. the state of being present; current existence；2. n. the immediate proximity of someone or something
example: Likewise, the gifts--the other foods and pleasing odors attracted and maintained the continued presence of God in the sanctuary.
exampleZh: 同样的，个人准备的,都吸引并维持了上帝在圣所里的逗留。

meaning: n. 总统，国家主席；（机构、俱乐部、学院等的）负责人，会长，院长，主席；（公司）董事长，（银行）行长，总裁；（基督教）圣餐主持教士
definition: 1. n. an executive officer of a firm or corporation；2. n. the person who holds the office of head of state of the United States government
example: There are these enormous statues. One of the statues is the President Theodore Roosevelt on a horse, on horseback.
exampleZh: 有很多巨大的雕塑。其中一个雕塑是西奥多•罗斯福总统骑在马背上。

meaning: v. 料想，（不肯定地）认为；假设，设想；（法律上或官方）假定，推定；擅自，冒昧；意味着；擅作主张，冒昧
definition: 1. to believe something to be true because it is very likely, although you are not certain；2. to do something although you know that you do not have a right to do it
example: We must presume innocence until we have proof of guilt.
exampleZh: 在证实一个人有罪之前，我们必须假定其无辜。

meaning: adj. （尤指女孩）漂亮的，标致的；（事物）悦目的，悦耳的；（男子）女子气的，俊俏的；巨大的，令人印象深刻的；好看的，令人愉快的； 非常糟糕的；adv. 相当，颇；非常，很；n. 漂亮东西（尤指悦人但不必要的小饰品）；（以高人一等的口吻）漂亮的人，漂亮的孩子；v. 装饰，使漂亮；【名】 （Pretty）（美、印）普雷蒂（人名）
definition: 1. adj. pleasing by delicacy or grace; not imposing；2. adv. used as an intensifier (`jolly' is used informally in Britain)
example: So the sense that one actually is pretty adept in knowing is one that tends to predominate in the university.
exampleZh: 因此在大学中，认为自己了解很多,这种心态颇为流行。

meaning: adj. 盛行的，普遍的
definition: 1. adj. encountered generally especially at the present time
example: Despite the fact that the disease is so prevalent, treatment is still far from satisfactory.
exampleZh: 尽管事实上这种疾病非常普遍，治疗却远不尽如人意。

meaning: n. 自豪（感）；自尊（心）；傲慢，自负；最佳状态，全盛期；狮群；引以为傲的人（或事物）；v. 以……自豪（pride oneself on/upon）；【名】 （Pride）（英）普赖德（人名）
definition: 1. n. a feeling of self-respect and personal worth；2. v. be proud of
example: My friends are gone, but that's a truth Nor grave nor bed denied, -- Learned in bodily lowliness And in the heart's pride.
exampleZh: 美丑唇齿相依,心的高傲和肉的低贱，都证实这条真理,我伙伴们虽死，但否认它。

meaning: adj. 主要的，首要的；小学教育的，初级教育的；初级的，原发性的；最基本的，最根本的；第一手的，直接的；（有机化合物）连上一个碳原子的；（多指胺）（氨基酸顺序）一级的；n. （选举过程中的党内）初选（=primary election）；原色；初级飞羽；主星；初级线圈，原线圈
definition: 1. n. a preliminary election where delegates or nominees are chosen；2. adj. of first rank or importance or value; direct and immediate rather than secondhand
example: In Book One alone there are four primary instances of what we can think of as this primary simile dynamic.
exampleZh: 仅第一本里就有四个主要的例证,我们可以看作最初的明喻来源的动力。

meaning: adj. 先前的，事先的；优先的，更重要的；在前面的（prior to）；n. 犯罪前科；小修道院院长；大修道院副院长；托钵会会长；【名】 （Prior）（美）普廖尔（人名）
definition: 1. n. the head of a religious order; in an abbey the prior is next below the abbot；2. adj. earlier in time
example: I had been living in Japan for two years prior to meeting her. I'd been over there,
exampleZh: 在认识她之前，我在日本住了两年。那段时间我一直呆在日本，

meaning: n. 特权，特殊待遇；荣幸，光荣；（富人或上层阶级的）权势；（律师、医生及其他专业人士的）保密权；言行免责权（尤指议员的权利）；（授予个人，公司，某地的）特许经营权；（生活）优越；v. 给予特权，特别优待；特免，免除（某人）
definition: 1. n. a special advantage or immunity or benefit not enjoyed by all；2. v. bestow a privilege upon
example: In other words, language, according to Derrida, in the Saussurian tradition seems to privilege sound over script, over what is graphic.
exampleZh: 换句话说，德里达认为，在索绪尔的理论中，音响比文字，更具优势。

meaning: adj. 成问题的，有困难的；未确定的；n. 成问题之事
definition: 1. adj. open to doubt or debate；2. adj. making great mental demands; hard to comprehend or solve or believe
example: This would be particularly problematic if the gateway were hosted by an ISP or other third party.
exampleZh: 如果网关是由 ISP 或其它第三方提供的，这个问题就会特别突出。

meaning: adj. 盈利的，有利可图的；有益的，有用的
definition: 1. adj. yielding material gain or profit；2. adj. promoting benefit or gain
example: We made a big bet against Internet stocks in 1999 and 2000 that was very profitable for the University.
exampleZh: 999年和2000年我们大幅做空互联网股票,为学校赚得了很多利润

meaning: adj. 重要的，著名的；显眼的，突出的；突起的，高耸的；n. 舟蛾（=prominent moth）
definition: 1. adj. having a quality that thrusts itself into attention；2. adj. conspicuous in position or importance
example: But they're, I think, the two most prominent positions and definitely the ones most worth taking seriously for our purposes.
exampleZh: 但我想,它们是,两个最突出的观点,并且绝对是,在我们解答问题上值得严肃对待的观点

meaning: n. 提拔，晋升；促销，推销； 促进，提倡；（体育运动队的）晋级，升级；（为获利而举办的）体育赛事（尤指系列拳击赛）；（化学）助催化
definition: 1. n. a message issued in behalf of some product or cause or idea or person or institution；2. n. act of raising in rank or position
example: So, electron promotion does not happen in terms of nitrogen, because it would not increased our number of unpaired electrons.
exampleZh: 这里对于氮原子不会有电子激发，因为这不会增加,未配对电子的数目。

meaning: v. 散播，宣传（观点、信仰等）；传播（运动、光线、声音等）；（动植物等）繁殖，使繁殖
definition: 1. to produce a new plant using a parent plant；2. (of a plant or animal) to produce young plants or animals
example: The easiest way to propagate a vine is to take hardwood cuttings.
exampleZh: 繁殖葡萄藤最容易的办法就是采取硬木扦插。

meaning: n. 出版，发行；出版物，发行物；（信息的） 刊登，公布
definition: 1. n. a copy of a printed work offered for distribution；2. n. the act of issuing printed materials
example: Book publication can be just as interesting and it can tell us just as much about modern poetry as magazines.
exampleZh: 图书出版是很有意思的，而且也能像杂志本身那样,告诉我们很多关于现代诗歌的事情。

meaning: n. 惩罚手段，处罚；粗暴对待，糟蹋
definition: 1. n. the act of punishing
example: Literal punishment: for example, in the Code of Hammurabi, where someone's ox kills a child, then the ox owner's child is killed.
exampleZh: 例如，在汉穆拉比法典里，如果某人的牛,杀死了一个小孩，那么这头牛的主人的小孩也应处死。

meaning: adj. 纯的，不掺杂质的；血统纯的，纯种的；纯真的，贞洁的；干净的，不含有害物质的；无杂色的，清晰而优美的；完全的，纯粹的；（科学或研究）纯理论的，抽象的；（元音）单音的，纯音的；【名】 （Pure）（俄）普雷（人名）
definition: 1. adj. free of extraneous elements of any kind；2. adj. without qualification; used informally as (often pejorative) intensifiers
example: It is autonomous in the sense that it is a pure, uncluttered and uninfluenced declaration of fact or falsehood.
exampleZh: 科学是自主的，因为,科学就是单纯的,不受外界影响的，关于真伪的论断。

meaning: v. 使困惑，使迷惑；（因迷惑而）苦思，冥思苦想；（通过苦苦思索）解决（或弄清楚），理出头绪（puzzle sth. out）；n. 测验智力（或知识）的游戏（或玩具，问题）；拼图游戏，拼图玩具；令人费解的人（或事物），难题
definition: 1. n. a particularly baffling problem that is said to have a correct solution；2. v. be a mystery or bewildering to
example: We invited readers who completed the puzzle to send in their solutions.
exampleZh: 我们邀请解完谜的读者交出谜底。

meaning: n. 轻易放弃的人，半途而废的人；懒人；故意中途退出游戏的玩家（游戏术语）
definition: n. a person who gives up too easily
example: Strenuous goals are too difficult for the quitter to achieve. So, in general, quitters tend to aim for what comes easily to them.
exampleZh: 艰苦的目标对于轻易放弃的人太难达成，因此，轻言放弃的人通常倾向于以那些他们觉得容易的事为目标。

meaning: n. 问答比赛，智力竞赛；小测验；（尤指警方调查或正式调查中的）询问，审问；恶作剧，戏弄；戏弄他人者，恶作剧者；（性格、相貌）古怪的人；v. 询问，审问；测验（学生，班级）；（透过镜片）好奇地（或仔细地）打量；戏弄，取笑
definition: 1. n. an examination consisting of a few short questions；2. v. examine someone's knowledge of something
example: I don't expect you'll all immediately grab it, but you will need to understand it before the quiz comes along.
exampleZh: 我不期望你们马上就能掌握，但是你们需要在,考试前弄懂它。

meaning: adv. 轻而易举地，迅速地；乐意地，欣然地
definition: 1. adv. without much difficulty；2. adv. in a punctual manner
example: I asked her if she would allow me to interview her, and she readily agreed.
exampleZh: 我问她是否允许我采访她，她欣然同意了。

meaning: adj. （某人）准备好（做某事）的；预先备好的，可供使用的；乐意的；方便使用的，现成的；迅速的，敏捷的；即将……的；需要的，想要的；n. 现款（the ready/readies）；预备好的状态；adv. 已做完，已完成；v. 做好……的准备；【名】 （Ready）（英）雷迪（人名）
definition: 1. n. poised for action；2. v. prepare for eating by applying heat
example: Or, if you are at a party and you're ready to leave but you've left your bag with the host,
exampleZh: 又或者，你在一个派对上，你准备要走了，但是你刚才把你的包放在派对主人那里了，

meaning: v. 记起，回想起；使想起，使想到；召回，叫回（某人）；召回（运动员），使归队； 收回（有问题的产品）；检索，调用（计算机储存的数据）； 罢免；使重新集中注意力； 撤销，废止（行动，决定）；n. 记忆力，记性；召回；（因产品有问题的）收回；（将运动员的）召回归队；（请愿后经投票对政府官员的）罢免；回索率，检索率；撤销
definition: 1. n. a request by the manufacturer of a defective product to return the product (as for replacement or repair)；2. v. recall knowledge from memory; have a recollection
example: You'll recall that at the very end of class we pulled up this little demo that looked like this.
exampleZh: 你们可以回忆一下，我们曾,有个这样的演示。

meaning: n. 烹饪法，食谱；诀窍，秘诀；原因；处方
definition: 1. a set of instructions telling you how to prepare and cook food, including a list of what food is needed for this；2. a set of instructions telling you how to prepare and cook a particular food, including a list of what foods are needed for this
example: Notice the difference. The recipe, the sequence of instructions, is actually getting read in, and it's treated just like data.
exampleZh: 注意其中的差别，方法，也就是指令序列，其实是需要读的，被当做数据来对待。

meaning: v. 改革，革新；改邪归正，改造；（石油炼制）重整；n. 改革，改良；adj. 犹太教改革（仅保留犹太教部分的传统信条和习俗）（Reform）
definition: 1. n. a change for the better as a result of correcting abuses；2. v. make changes for improvement in order to remove abuse and injustices
example: So, his letters come out of this western land, New Mexico, and a land of criminality, the reform school.
exampleZh: 他的信从新墨西哥这片西部的土地而来，还是寄宿学校这种犯罪滋生地。

meaning: v. 克制，避免；n. （诗歌的）叠句，（歌曲的）副歌；叠歌部分的音乐伴奏；经常重复的评价（或抱怨）
definition: 1. n. the part of a song where a soloist is joined by a group of singers；2. v. resist doing something
example: When breaking in an engine, you should refrain from high speeds for the first thousand miles.
exampleZh: 磨合发动机时,你应当避免在最初的1千英里高速行驶。

meaning: n. 解决方法，纠正方法；法定补偿（办法）；治疗（法），药品；（硬币的）公差；v. 补救，纠正；治疗
definition: 1. n. act of correcting an error or a fault or an evil；2. v. set straight or right
example: I'm going to present you one of the most dramatic examples we've seen of differences in brain activations in these areas, and how these differences can be remedy.
exampleZh: 下面我就来给大家展示一下,我们所见过的最令人吃惊的,有关这两处区域活动不同的例子，同时也会介绍如何治疗这些不同。

meaning: adv. 重复地，再三地
definition: 1. adv. several time
example: Is that right? In this game, when we analyzed the game repeatedly, it seemed like our analysis converged towards the equilibrium.
exampleZh: 没错吧,当我们反复分析这个博弈,我们的分析最后会趋近均衡

meaning: n. 名誉，名声
definition: 1. n. the state of being held in high esteem and honor；2. n. notoriety for some particular characteristic
example: And the most important thing in the Southern code of honor, I think, safe to say, was reputation.
exampleZh: 南方人所谓的荣誉的核心部分,我以为,可以肯定的说,是声誉

meaning: n. 反对，抵制；抵抗，反抗；抵抗力，免疫力；阻力；电阻；（敌占区的）秘密抵抗组织
definition: 1. n. the action of opposing something that you disapprove or disagree with；2. n. any mechanical force that tends to retard or oppose motion
example: The good scholars of Milton reveal their typical resistance to anything even remotely interesting or alive in the text.
exampleZh: 研究弥尔顿的优秀学者们透露他们反对,研究文本中那些不太有趣和生动的东西。

meaning: v. 逆转，彻底改变（决定、政策、趋势等）；撤销，推翻（法庭判决）；颠倒，反转；交换，互换（位置、功能）；承认错误，放弃（立场）；倒（车）；（发动机）反向运转；打对方付费的电话；使（铅字，图案）印成白或浅色；n. 相对，相反（the reverse）；逆向，逆转；倒车挡；失败，挫折；反面，背面；（翻开的书）左手页，（活页文件的）背面；（硬币或奖牌）反面图案（或刻字）；（美式橄榄球）反向传球，变位传球；adj. 相反的，反向的；背面的，反面的；（半导体结的外加电压）反向的；（地层）逆断的，冲断的；反身的
definition: 1. n. a relation of direct opposition；2. v. change to the contrary
example: So this is trying to reverse them that tradition actually get students in and engaged in the course material.
exampleZh: 因此这也是试图将学生,从这种传统中扭转出来,从而使他们能更专注于课堂内容。

meaning: v. 骑马，骑车；乘坐；航行，漂浮；穿越，翻越；（车辆）行驶；数落，嘲弄；驾驭，被……所支配；取决于（ride on）；得益于；（骑马或车）参赛；运输（货物）；突伸，重叠；顺势退躲以缓冲（击打）；与……性交；n. 乘骑旅行，搭乘旅行；大型游乐设施，乘坐装置；免费搭车；搭载别人者；行车质量，乘坐感觉；机动车辆；骑马道；骑马表演；性交，交媾；节奏钹；【名】 (Ride) （英、美、法）赖德（人名）
definition: 1. n. a journey in a vehicle (usually an automobile)；2. v. sit and travel on the back of animal, usually while controlling its motions
example: so I'm going to begin by showing you a very personal look at my hometown, a bus ride.
exampleZh: 所以我将首先展示一下,关于我家乡的一个个人视角,一次公车旅程。

meaning: adj. （方法、体制等）严格死板的，僵化的；（人）顽固的，不通融的；刚硬的，不易弯曲的；（因强烈的感情而）僵硬的，僵直的；精确的；n. 未铰接的货车
definition: 1. stiff or fixed; not able to be bent or moved；2. not able to be changed or persuaded
example: He was weaned on a diet of rigid discipline and duty.
exampleZh: 他自幼受到严格纪律和职责的约束。

meaning: adv. 粗略地，大约；粗暴地，粗鲁地；粗糙地，不精细地
definition: 1. adv. (of quantities) imprecise but fairly close to correct；2. adv. with roughness or violence (`rough' is an informal variant for `roughly')
example: Well, I'm going to get back, let's just draw a bigger square than usual that's roughly four times the size.
exampleZh: 嗯，返回的是，我画一个更大的方形,大致上是4倍的大小。

meaning: n. 牺牲，献出；献祭，供奉；祭牲，供品；基督的献身（指耶稣被钉在十字架上）；（天主教作为献祭圣体和圣血，或新教表示感恩的）圣餐礼；（棋）（为战略或战术原因所作出的）弃子，弃卒；（棒球中）牺牲打（sacrifice bunt/fly）；（桥牌）（指在对方叫到进局定约之后的）牺牲性叫牌（sacrifice bid）；v. 牺牲，献出；献祭，以……为祭品；（棋）（故意）弃子，弃卒；（棒球）做牺牲打；（棒球）以牺牲打使（跑垒者）进垒；（桥牌）作牺牲性叫牌；亏本出售
definition: 1. n. the act of losing or surrendering something as a penalty for a mistake or fault or failure to perform etc.；2. v. endure the loss of
example: He was willing to sacrifice his happiness on the altar of fame.
exampleZh: 为了名声，他心甘情愿牺牲幸福。

meaning: n. 沙，沙子；沙堆，沙地；沙滩，沙漠（sands）；沙石层，沙层；（尤指大于0.06毫米的沙粒构成的）沉积沙土；沙土色，浅黄灰色；坚定，刚毅；v. （用砂纸或打磨机）磨光；撒沙于，铺沙于；使撒沙似地布满；给……掺沙子；【名】 （Sand）（英、德、意、芬、罗、捷、挪、瑞典）桑德，（法）桑（人名）
definition: 1. n. a loose material consisting of grains of rock or coral；2. v. rub with sandpaper
example: Bishop's sandpiper poet, there in your handout, is obsessed with the mere details of experience, those sand grains, quartz grains.
exampleZh: 毕肖普写鹬的那首诗，你们的讲稿上有，被零星的描写经验的细节所累，描写了那些谷物和石英岩。

meaning: adj. 骇人的，恐怖的；异乎寻常的，令人惊奇的；胆小的，易受惊吓的
definition: 1. adj. so scary as to cause chills and shudders
example: So if what I'm going to do now is scary, come and see us and we'll deal with it.
exampleZh: 如果我接下来的计算对你来说是天书,过来找我吧,我来帮你想办法

meaning: n. 海洋；内海；海（指月球或火星表面的一片广阔平原）；海面情况，海浪状况；大量，茫茫一片；（用于海名）海（Sea）；巨浪（seas）
definition: 1. n. a division of an ocean or a large body of salt water partially enclosed by land；2. adj. relating to or characteristic of or occurring on the sea or ships
example: He conjures the indecorous image of the dead Lycidas under the whelming tide visiting the bottom of the monstrous sea.
exampleZh: 他想象死去的利西达斯,在排山倒海的浪潮覆盖下拜访尽是妖怪的海底。

meaning: n. 秘书；书记员，干事；部长，大臣；（英国大使、大臣的）助理
definition: 1. n. a person who is head of an administrative department of government；2. n. an assistant who handles correspondence and clerical work for a boss or an organization
example: Notably, on Monday, the Treasury Department, under Secretary Henry Paulson, announced a proposal for fundamental change in our financial markets.
exampleZh: 众所周知，在星期一，美国财务部部长，亨利·鲍尔森，宣布美国金融市场,将要改革的计划。

meaning: adj. 稳固的，可靠的；严密把守的，牢固的；安全的，稳妥的；（对自己和自己的能力）有自信的；感到有保障的，没有顾虑的；固定住的，系牢的；秘密的；v. （尤指经过努力而）获得，得到；使安全，保护；缚牢，将（某物）固定；确保，保证；为（债务或贷款）作抵押，作保；（外科）压迫（血管）止血；停止工作；船抛锚
definition: 1. v. get by special effort；2. adj. free from fear or doubt; easy in mind
example: He is appointed or authorized to secure for the people the, in many ways, limited ends of peace and security.
exampleZh: 他是由人民任命并授权,让他行使权力保卫人民的安全，保卫来之不易的和平。

meaning: n. 种子，籽；（苹果或橙子等的）果核，籽； 精液，精子（常为幽默用法）；（古时用语，原用于《圣经》中）子嗣，子孙；（感情、过程的）起源，开端；（网球、羽毛球等体育项目中的）种子选手， 种子队；晶粒，晶种；辐射管，镭管；v. 给（蔬菜，水果）去籽（去核），给......脱籽；选定......为种子选手（或种子队）；在（地里）播种；（植物）结籽，脱籽；（植物）自播；（喻）使萌芽，使发展；用晶粒物质使冷凝（结晶）（尤指促云化雨）；adj. 用作种子的；【名】 （Seed）（英）锡德（人名）
definition: 1. n. a small hard fruit；2. v. go to seed; shed seeds
example: Nothing better shows our heavenly origins, our divine seed, our human intellect, those holy traces of Promethean fire."
exampleZh: 没有什么能更好的讲述我们的起源，我们的子孙，我们人类的智力，生命之火神圣的踪迹“

meaning: adv. 貌似，看似（但可能并非如此）；似乎，好像（是事实）
definition: 1. adv. from appearances alone
example: Well, how do you get this hearts to move up and down and seemingly in these random patterns?
exampleZh: 但是，你怎样才能让这些爱心们看起来,像是在某种随机的模式下上上下下地移动呢？

meaning: n. 选择，挑选；被挑选的人（或物），精选品；可供选择的事物；（比赛中值得赌的）看好的马；所选数据；（英国的）学校入学选拔；（以优越条件）选购土地
definition: 1. n. the act of choosing or selecting；2. n. an assortment of things from which a choice can be made
example: Let's do selection and let's do merge sort here on the right just to see what actually happens.
exampleZh: 中间进行选择排序，右边进行归并排序,看看会发生什么。

meaning: n. 自我控制，自制力，克己
definition: n. the act of denying yourself; controlling your impulses；n. the trait of resolutely controlling your own behavior
example: Mr. Wang thinks the key to use the apps well is to have good self-control.
exampleZh: 王先生认为，利用好这些应用程序的关键在于要有良好的自我控制能力。

meaning: n. 自我价值，自我价值感，自尊
definition: n. the quality of being worthy of esteem or respect
example: Others might do this out of a sense of self-worth around the ability to influence others.
exampleZh: 其他人这样做可能是出于一种凭借影响他人能力所彰显的自我价值感。

meaning: n. 旗语，信号标；臂板信号装置；（计算机）信号量；v. 打旗语，发信号
definition: n. an apparatus for visual signaling with lights or mechanically moving arms；v. send signals by or as if by semaphore
example: Knight installed a similar gas light, semaphore system near London's Westminster Bridge in December of 1868.
exampleZh: 奈特于1868年12月在伦敦威斯敏斯特桥附近安装了类似的煤气灯臂板信号系统。

meaning: v. 解决，结束（争端等）；确定，决定；定居，安家；殖民，移居于；安置，安顿；（使）平静，（使）安定；降落，停留；（使）沉降，下陷；付清，结算；处理，分配（财产）；笼罩，稳定下来；把......放好，安放；（无可奈何地）接受（或答应）；n. 高背扶手木长椅；【名】 （Settle）（英）塞特尔（人名）
definition: 1. n. a long wooden bench with a back；2. v. settle into a position, usually on a surface or ground
example: Well, however we settle that issue, notice there's still one other assumption that all these positions still have in common.
exampleZh: 不管我们如何解决这个问题，我们都会发现有一个假定,是这些观点都共有的。

meaning: aux. 将要，将会（同I和we连用，表示将来）； ……好吗？要不要……？（用于主动提供帮助、建议或询问意见）；必须，一定（表示决心、命令或指示）；可以（与“you”连用，用以告知某人能做某事或拥有想要的东西）；应，必须（用于法律、规则）；应该，就会（表示可能的结果或后果）；（用于 look forward to 和 hope 之类的动词前表示语气的委婉）
definition: 1. used especially with I or we to express the future, obligation, or an offer
definitionSource: 人工校订（依据词典义项）
example: We have not yet found them all, Lords and Commons, nor ever shall do, till her Master's second coming.
exampleZh: 我们还有找到这些碎片，上帝和普通人，我们也不会去找，知道她的主人第二次来。

meaning: n. 短缺，不足
definition: 1. n. the property of being an amount by which something is less than expected or required；2. n. an acute insufficiency
example: There is a shortage of fresh water on the island.
exampleZh: 岛上缺少淡水。

meaning: n. 签名，署名；签字，签署；鲜明特色，明显特征；（印刷）折标；书贴；标记，用法签（处方上说明药的用法的部分）；（音乐的）拍号；（音乐的）调号；adj. 标志性的，惯有的
definition: 1. n. your name written in your own handwriting；2. n. a distinguishing style
example: But, I also read a poem, and this is kind of a signature-- not my signature, but the kind of course it is.
exampleZh: 不过我还读了一首诗,算是一种签名,不是我的签名,是这种课程的

meaning: adv. 稍微，轻微地；（指某人身材）纤弱地，瘦小地
definition: 1. adv. to a small degree or extent；2. adv. in a slim or slender manner
example: Then as you move in, the outer courtyard, the outer enclosure of the sanctuary, bears a slightly higher degree of holiness.
exampleZh: 然后你走进去，它的外部空间，圣所的外围，神圣的程度有所提高。

meaning: v. 滑倒，失足；滑落，脱落；溜走，悄悄地走；偷偷塞进；滑行，打滑；下降，变差；陷入；迅速穿上，迅速脱下；摆脱，挣脱；飞逝，过得飞快；被（某人）忘记；放出（动物，尤指猎狗）；（身体部分）移位，脱臼；（编织）挑过一针不结；略微松动（汽车离合器）；（动物）流产；n. 疏漏，差错；小纸条；滑，滑倒；滑动；衬裙；（击球员后侧的）守场员；（制陶器用的）泥浆，泥釉；（飞机飞行中的）侧滑；牵狗皮带；（两个码头之间）泊位；（编织）挑针；变糟，下跌；接枝，插枝；瘦小的年轻人；【名】 （Slip）（芬）斯利普（人名）
definition: 1. n. a socially awkward or tactless act；2. v. move stealthily
example: This is the place where people typically slip up in debugging. They don't think in advance what they expect the result to be.
exampleZh: 实验就推翻了你的假设了,人们在做调试的时候往往忽略了这一点,他们做实验之前并没有想想。

meaning: adv. 在社会上，从社会层面看；在社交方面，在社交场合中；善于交际地
definition: adv. by or with respect to society；adv. in a social manner
example: Through experiences of positive emotions, people transform themselves, becoming more creative, knowledgeable, resilient, socially integrated, " and healthy individuals."
exampleZh: 通过体验积极情绪，人们实现改变，变得更有创造力，更博学，适应性更强，更易融入社会，获得更健康的人格“

meaning: adv. 特意，专门地；明确地，具体地；具体来说，确切地说；局限性地；专门；（生）种的
definition: 1. adv. in distinction from others
example: Remember, this is pattern that we use when the question relates specifically to the person you are speaking with.
exampleZh: 记住，我们使用这个句型时，所提的问题仅仅针对谈话的对象。

meaning: n. 货摊，贩卖处，咨询台；牲畜棚，马厩，牛棚；（房间内的）小隔间，淋浴室，洗手间；（教堂内）唱诗班和牧师的座位；（剧场的）正厅前排座位（stalls）；（发动机的）熄火，（车辆的）抛锚，（飞机的）失速，（轮船的）停泊；（机动车停车场的）车位；（赛马开始前各马站位的）单间马房；v. （使）熄火，抛锚；故意拖延（以赢得时间）；拖住（某人）；暂缓，搁置，停顿；（飞机）失速；（航海）（由于风力不够而）航行失控；把（牲畜）关在厩内（养肥）；【名】 （Stall）（美）斯塔尔（人名）
definition: 1. a large table or a small shop with an open front from which goods are sold in a public place；2. a small closed area within a farm building in which there is space for one animal to be kept
example: He got up and stepped out of the stall, and just then he heard the sound of children's voices.
exampleZh: 他站起身，走出隔间，就在这时听到了孩子们的声音。

meaning: n. （某国的）主要产品，支柱产品；主食；主要部份，重要内容；（特定商品的）贸易中心；订书钉；U 形钉；（棉花、羊毛的）纤维（就其长度和细度而言）；adj. 主要生产的，大量生产的；主要的，常用的；v. 用订书钉订住；把……分级
definition: 1. a short, thin piece of wire used to fasten sheets of paper together. It has sharp ends that are pushed through the paper and then bent flat by a special device.；2. a U-shaped piece of metal with sharp ends that is fixed into a surface to hold something, such as a wire fence, in a particular position
example: It is well-known that bamboo shoots are a panda's staple diet.
exampleZh: 众所周知，竹笋是熊猫的主要食物。

meaning: v. 偷窃，盗窃；剽窃，窃取（观点）；悄悄地移动；（在棒球比赛中）偷（垒）；（在篮球或冰球比赛中）断（球），截（球）；偷偷做；偷拿，私自拿；抢（镜头、戏等）；（体育运动中）意外赢得；骗走；n. 极廉价的物品，低价；（尤指篮球比赛中的）断球；（棒球比赛中的）偷垒；偷窃，行窃；剽窃
definition: 1. n. an advantageous purchase；2. v. take without the owner's consent
example: Did they steal the land or the factory or the goods that enabled them to make all that money?
exampleZh: 让他们赚到钱的土地，工厂，或者商品,这些生产资料是不是偷来的？

meaning: v. 促进，激发（某事物）；激发，鼓励；使（身体，生物系统）兴奋，刺激；起刺激作用
definition: 1. v. act as a stimulant；2. v. cause to do; cause to act in a specified manner
example: She questioned whether it was feasible to stimulate investment in these regions.
exampleZh: 她质问在这些地区刺激投资是否可行。

meaning: n. 刺激（物）, 促进因素；（使生物产生反应的）刺激，刺激物；刺激性，趣味性
definition: 1. n. any stimulating information or event; acts to arouse action
example: This refers to a tendency for people in making quantitative judgments to subconsciously have their judgments anchored by some arbitrary stimulus.
exampleZh: 指的是,人们在做定量估测时,会受外界影响,将某些特定数值作为起始值,而起始值像锚一样制约着估测值

meaning: n. 主题，话题；学科，科目，课程；主语；（绘画、摄影等的）主题，题材；实验对象；（批评、学习、调查的）对象；国民；起因；（逻）主词，主项，主概念；（乐）主旋律；（哲）主体，主观；中心实体；v. 使臣服，征服，压服；使经受，使遭受；adj. 隶属的，臣服的；可能受……影响的，易遭受……的；受……支配的，服从于……的；取决于，视……而定
definition: 1. n. the subject matter of a conversation or discussion；2. v. cause to experience or suffer or make liable or vulnerable to
example: So the reasons for this really enormous shift in plans, and the enormous shift in subject matter, are worth exploring.
exampleZh: 弥尔顿的计划变化为何如此之大，他对主题的选择为何有这么大的改变，是值得探究的。

meaning: adj. 足够的，充足的；（理由、条件）充足的，充分的
definition: 1. adj. of a quantity that can fulfill a need or requirement but without being abundant
example: Milton elaborates on this claim that we should read and prove anything we want, for we are sufficient to judge aright.
exampleZh: 弥尔顿详尽阐明了这个论点，我们应该多读书,去求证自己想知道的所有事，因此我们才能够做正确的判断。

meaning: adj. 适宜的，合适的
definition: 1. adj. meant or adapted for an occasion or use；2. adj. appropriate for a condition or purpose or occasion or a person's character, needs
example: OK, so now the question is, how do we know the first place that this is a suitable reductant?
exampleZh: 好的，现在的问题是，我们如何能知道第一步中,镁是一个合适的还原剂？

meaning: n. 外科手术；诊所；（议员的）接待时间；应诊时间；手术室
definition: 1. n. the branch of medical science that treats disease or injury by operative procedures；2. n. a room where a doctor or dentist can be consulted
example: But I certainly won't stop them from seeking plastic surgery if that makes them feel better about themselves.
exampleZh: 但是如果整容可以让他们自我感觉更良好，我当然不会阻止他们接受整容手术。

meaning: adj. 易得病的，易受影响的；（人）易受感动的，易动感情的；可能有······的，容许······的；（尤指想法或陈述）能被理解（或证明、解释）的
definition: 1. easily influenced or harmed by something；2. used to describe someone who is easily emotionally influenced
example: You would first get exposed in children-- in childhood and then at a point when you're susceptible to the disease.
exampleZh: 在儿童期这个较容易受病毒感染时期,第一次接触该病毒,就会引起发病

meaning: n. 综合征，征群，综合症状；（特定情形下人的）典型负面特征；【名】 （Syndrome）辛德罗姆（人名）
definition: 1. a combination of medical problems that shows the existence of a particular disease or mental condition；2. used in the names of various illnesses
example: This first slide shows a graph of the impact of having metabolic syndrome on heart disease and its consequences.
exampleZh: 这张图表明了代谢综合征,对心脏病的影响以及造成的结果

meaning: n. 天赋，才能；天才，人才；性感的人；（尤指古罗马人和古希腊人使用的重量和货币单位）塔兰特
definition: 1. n. natural abilities or qualities；2. n. a person who possesses unusual innate ability in some field or activity
example: Is Milton powerful for the very straightforward reason that he's in possession of this tremendous literary strength, this unimaginable talent?
exampleZh: 弥尔顿之所以强大是因为他有,无穷的文学力量，不可想象的天赋这显而易见的原因呢？

meaning: n. 棕褐色，棕黄色；（日晒后变成的）棕褐色皮肤；鞣料树皮；（铺路和园艺中使用的）鞣酸皮渣；v. （使）晒成褐色，晒黑；鞣（革），硝（皮）； 痛打（某人），鞭打（尤指作为惩罚）；adj. 棕黄色的，棕褐色的；晒黑的；abbr. 正切（tangent）；【名】 （Tan）塔恩，坦，丹（人名）
definition: 1. brown skin caused by being in the sun；2. a pale yellowish-brown colour
example: It's safer to fake a tan with make-up rather than subject your complexion to the harsh rays of the sun.
exampleZh: 用化妆来伪造棕褐色的皮肤比让皮肤暴露于强烈的太阳光线更安全。

meaning: n. 茶，茶水；（用其他植物叶子沏的）饮料；茶叶；茶点，下午茶；便餐，晚点；（咖啡、可可等）热饮；（尤指带有热饮、面包的）早点；vi. 喝茶，吃下午茶；【名】 （Tea）（柬）迪（人名）
definition: 1. n. a beverage made by steeping tea leaves in water；2. n. a light midafternoon meal of tea and sandwiches or cakes
example: If you're having breakfast and it's delicious but it would be perfect if you had it with tea.
exampleZh: 假设你在吃早饭，你觉得很美味，如果有杯茶的话，那就完美了。

meaning: adj. （用于名词前）十几岁的，青少年的（指13至19岁）；关于青少年的，面向青少年的
definition: adj. being of the age 13 through 19
example: A little bit more crazy over here, but it's fun. It's teenage life, so. College life.
exampleZh: 这里更疯狂一些，但是很有意思。这是年轻人的生活，就是这样，也就是大学生活。

meaning: n. 青少年，十几岁的孩子（13到19岁之间的孩子）
definition: 1. n. a juvenile between the onset of puberty and maturity
example: So much has changed in the sport since I was a teenager.
exampleZh: 自我十几岁以来，该项运动发生了很大变化。

meaning: adj. 暂时的，临时的；短期的，短暂的；n. 临时雇员，临时工
definition: 1. n. a worker (especially in an office) hired on a temporary basis；2. adj. not permanent; not lasting
example: This temporary alienation from God is ultimately repaired through Moses' intense prayer and intercession.
exampleZh: 暂时对上帝的疏远最终被修复,通过摩西不断的祈祷和求情。

meaning: v. 引诱，诱惑；怂恿，利诱；冒……的风险
definition: 1. to make someone want to have or do something, especially something that is unnecessary or wrong；2. to want something or to want to do something
example: Vivien refuses to put down bait to tempt wildlife to the waterhole.
exampleZh: 维维恩拒绝放饵到水坑引诱野生动物。

meaning: n. 票，入场券；（交通违章）通知单，罚款单；（政党在选举中支持的）候选人名单；（竞选时所支持的）纲领，政见；（商店中标明货物价格、尺码等的）标签；彩票，奖券；途径；（货物）收条；（船员、飞行员等的）执照；工单；退役证书；……人，……家伙；v. 售票；给（违章停车、超速行驶的人）开罚单；（为显示价格、尺寸等）贴标签于；给定目标；注定
definition: 1. n. a commercial document showing that the holder is entitled to something (as to ride on public transportation or to enter a public entertainment)；2. v. issue a ticket or a fine to as a penalty
example: Do not come to your instructor and say, I've got a really good ticket but I'm leaving on the 13th.
exampleZh: 不要去和你们的讲师说，我已经买好票了,但是我要在13号离开。

meaning: n. 潮汐；潮水；潮流，趋势；怒潮，（难以控制的）浪潮；高涨的情绪；潮水般的人流，洪流；v. 顺潮水漂浮
definition: 1. n. the periodic rise and fall of the sea level under the gravitational pull of the moon；2. v. rise or move forward
example: He conjures the indecorous image of the dead Lycidas under the whelming tide visiting the bottom of the monstrous sea.
exampleZh: 他想象死去的利西达斯,在排山倒海的浪潮覆盖下拜访尽是妖怪的海底。

meaning: n. 木材，原木；（用于生产木材的）林木，树林；（造屋或造船用的）大木料，栋木；（砍伐树木时说）倒啦，小心大树倒下；（尤指人适于某角色的）素质，性格，才干；v. 用木料支撑或建造；【名】 （Timber）（瑞典）廷贝尔（人名）
definition: 1. n. the wood of trees cut and prepared for use as building material；2. n. a beam made of wood
example: They have been bartering wheat for cotton and timber.
exampleZh: 他们一直在用小麦交换棉花和木材。

meaning: adj. 及时的，适时的；adv. 及时地；早
definition: 1. adj. before a time limit expires；2. adv. at an opportune time
example: The recent outbreaks of cholera are a timely reminder that this disease is still a serious health hazard.
exampleZh: 最近几次爆发的霍乱是一个适时的提醒，该疾病依然是个严重的健康危害。

meaning: adv. 完全地，整个地；对极了，太对了
definition: adv. to a complete degree or to the full or entire extent (`whole' is often used informally for `wholly')
example: So the integers are totally ordered the reals are totally ordered lots of things are, the rationals are totally ordered.
exampleZh: 对正数来说,这样的序列是排好序的,对实数也是如此,对很多事情都是如此。

meaning: n. 玩具；玩意儿，小摆设；受人控制（或利用）的人，玩物；小型的东西；adj. 玩具的，和玩具有关的；个头很小的，小体型品种的；v. 漫不经心地考虑；调情，调戏；心不在焉地（或紧张地）摆弄；不热情地（或有节制地）吃（或喝）；【名】 （Toy）（美）托伊（人名）
definition: 1. n. an artifact designed to be played with；2. v. behave carelessly or indifferently
example: And I never got the tent, but it is one of my strongest memories ever related to a toy.
exampleZh: 虽然最终我还是没得到帐篷，但是这是让我印象最深刻的关于玩具的回忆。

meaning: n. 事实，真相；真实性；真理，原理；的确，事实上
definition: 1. n. a fact that has been verified；2. n. conformity to reality or actuality
example: That is to say that when we think we're telling the truth we're actually using worn-out figures of speech.
exampleZh: 也就是说我们认为我们在讲述真理的时候,我们实际上却在使用一些陈腐的修辞手法。

meaning: adj. 想不到的，意外的
definition: adj. not expected or anticipated；adj. made necessary by an unexpected situation or emergency
example: So I guess in terms of material, I love things that are unexpected in that
exampleZh: 所以在素材方面，我比较喜欢令人意想不到的东西，

meaning: adj. 不大可能发生的；未必真实的，难以相信的； 非心目中的，不大恰当的；不典型的；（两个人或物）不般配的；adv. 未必
definition: adj. not likely to be true or to occur or to have occurred；adj. has little chance of being the case or coming about
example: The President is unlikely to cave in to demands for a public inquiry.
exampleZh: 总统未必会屈服而同意进行公开调查。

meaning: adj. 升高的，上升的；向上的，朝上的；adv. 向上，向高处；改善，升高；（数量）上升地，上涨地
definition: 1. adj. directed up；2. adv. spatially or metaphorically from a lower to a higher position
example: The chopper shot upward in a manoeuvre matched by the other pilot.
exampleZh: 这架直升飞机向上冲去，另一架飞机也以相同的移动方向冲了上去。

meaning: v. 利用，使用
definition: v. put into service; make work or employ (something) for a particular purpose or for its inherent or natural purpose；v. convert (from an investment trust to a unit trust)
example: Sound engineers utilize a range of techniques to enhance the quality of the recordings.
exampleZh: 音响工程师利用一系列的技术来提高录音质量。

meaning: n. 体积，容积；总数，总量；音量，响度；（控制音量的）旋钮，控制杆；（成套图书中的）卷，册；（期刊）合订本；书籍；（写在羊皮纸或纸草纸上的）书卷；（尤指头发的）厚，多；adj. 大量的；v. 以卷的形式发出；成团卷起
definition: 1. n. the amount of 3-dimensional space occupied by an object；2. n. the property of something that is great in magnitude
example: These two relations involving entropy are also useful because they'll let us see how entropy depends on volume and pressure.
exampleZh: 这两个涉及熵的关系也非常有用,因为他们告诉我们,熵和体积，压强的关系。

meaning: n. 浪费，滥用；废物，废弃物（同 wastes）；荒地，荒原（wastes）；（尤指因租借人的行为或疏忽而导致的）不动产的损坏，产业损伤；粪便，尿液；v. 浪费，滥用；未能充分利用，没有物尽其用；杀害，谋杀（某人）；（使）（人，身体部位）逐渐变虚弱，变消瘦；破坏，毁坏（地方）；（时间）流逝，被花掉；adj. （通常指城市中的某地）荒芜的，荒废的；（材料、物质等）废弃的，无用的
definition: 1. n. any materials unused and rejected as worthless or unwanted；2. v. spend thoughtlessly; throw away
example: According to the Second Brother, it's virtually impossible for a single, helpless maiden to pass uninjured in this wild, surrounding waste.
exampleZh: 弟弟认为，一个孤独无助的女孩想要，毫发无伤的穿过这野外的荒原是根本不可能的。

meaning: v. 挥手；挥手示意；挥舞，挥动；飘扬，摆动，摇晃；使（头发）略呈波形；（威胁地）举起（某物）；n. 海浪；大海（the waves）；（活动、行为的）爆发，浪潮；涌现的人（或物）；挥手；波，波状运动；（头发的）卷曲；波浪形；（地震、爆炸的）冲击波；人浪（the wave）
definition: 1. n. one of a series of ridges that moves across the surface of a liquid (especially across a large body of water)；2. v. signal with the hands or nod
example: Well, if this thing is going to vibrate for any length of time it better be a standing wave.
exampleZh: 好的，如果它在任意时间振动,那它就是驻波。

meaning: n. 穿戴者，佩戴人；常穿戴……的人
definition: n. a person who wears or carries or displays something as a body covering or accessory
example: These suits are designed to protect the wearer from cold shock as they enter the water.
exampleZh: 这些服装旨在避免穿戴者入水时发生冷休克。

meaning: n. 周末；周末旅行，周末度假；adj. 周末的；v. 度周末
definition: 1. n. a time period usually extending from Friday night through Sunday; more loosely defined as any period of successive days including one and only one Sunday；2. v. spend the weekend
example: So when you go home today or some time this weekend, make sure you read this page in detail.
exampleZh: 因此，请大家在今天回家之后或者在周末找个时间，务必仔细读一读这页纸。

meaning: adj. 每周的，一周一次的；持续一周的，按周计算的；周刊的；n. 周报，周刊；adv. 每周，每星期
definition: 1. n. a periodical that is published every week (or 52 issues per year)；2. adj. occurring or payable every week
example: And on the other, a table, which held loaves of bread that were changed on a weekly basis.
exampleZh: 另一边是一张桌子，用来摆放长面包,面包一周替换一次。

meaning: adj. 白色的；白种人的，白肤色的；苍白的；加牛奶（或奶油）的；（葡萄酒）白的，淡黄色的；（面粉）精白的；空白的；树皮淡色的；（玻璃）透明的，无色的；完全公正的，非常诚实的；（魔法）善意的；（血细胞）白的；（政治）反动的；纯洁的；n. 白色，白颜料；白种人，白人；白葡萄酒；眼白；蛋清，蛋白；白色运动服（whites）；要洗涤的白色织物（whites）；白衣服；执白棋者，白方；白色的东西，白球；白粉蝶；v. 把……漆成白色，使变白；【名】 （White）怀特（人名）
definition: 1. n. a member of the Caucasoid race；2. v. turn white
example: She is a woman who looks very white but is categorized as black in that system of the South.
exampleZh: 事实是，她虽比较白,但还是一个南方的黑人。

meaning: pron. 谁（who 的宾格）；（用作关系代词）……的人
definition: 1. abstract: WHOM (94.9 FM, "94.
example: That is the special category that Foucault wants to reserve for those privileged figures whom he calls founders of discursivity.
exampleZh: 这就是福柯想为那些他称之为散漫性创始人的,特权作家们保留的特殊类别。

meaning: adv. 普遍地，广泛地，范围广地；大不相同
definition: adv. to a great degree；adv. to or over a great extent or range; far
example: He is widely acknowledged to be the best player in the world.
exampleZh: 普遍认为他是世界最佳球员。

meaning: n. 窗，窗玻璃；（计算机屏幕的）视窗；（信封上的）透明纸窗；（商店的）陈列窗，橱窗；一丝的机会，短暂的时机；观察（或学习）的渠道；（办理业务的）窗口；（物理）大气窗；（干扰雷达用的）金属箔片
definition: 1. n. a framework of wood or metal that contains a glass windowpane and is built into a wall or roof to admit light or air；2. n. a transparent opening in a vehicle that allow vision out of the sides or back; usually is capable of being opened
example: If you look at page 62, it's in these little stories: Remi woke up and saw me come in the window.
exampleZh: 看第62页，在这些小故事里就有：,雷米醒来看见我在窗前。

meaning: n. 木材，木料，木头；树林，林地；（高尔夫）木头球棒，木棒；木制酒桶；木棒挥击；（滚木球戏中所用重心略偏的）圆球；（保龄球戏的）木瓶；上天保佑（表示希望继续走好运）；adj. 木制的；用来切割或加工木材的；用木材做燃料的；v. 收集木材；植林于；给……添加木柴；【名】 （Wood）（英、法、西、葡、阿拉伯）伍德（人名）
definition: 1. n. the hard fibrous lignified substance under the bark of trees；2. n. the trees and other plants in a large densely wooded area
example: There was never a sound beside the wood but one, And that was my long scythe whispering to the ground.
exampleZh: 树林边静悄悄，只有一点声音，那是我的长镰在对大地低语。

meaning: adj. 值得尊敬的，值得注意的，值得敬仰的；值得的，应得的，相配的；好（但乏味）的；有（某人或事物）的典型特征；n. 知名人士，要人（常为玩笑或贬义）；【名】 （Worthy）（英）沃西（人名）
definition: 1. n. word is often used humorously；2. adj. having worth or merit or value; being honorable or admirable
example: A number of the report's findings are worthy of note.
exampleZh: 这份报告里有些调查结果值得注意。

meaning: n. 美国亚利桑那州
definition: n. a state in southwestern United States; site of the Grand Canyon；n. glossy snake
example: When they reconstructed London Bridge they moved the old London Bridge to Arizona; some guy bought it.
exampleZh: 当建设者们重建伦敦桥的时候,将这座古老的桥搬到亚利桑那州,有人买下了它

meaning: n. 巴塞罗那（西班牙东北部城市，加泰罗尼亚自治区首府；亦译“巴塞罗纳”）；巴塞罗那足球俱乐部（FC Barcelona 的简称，常称“巴萨”）
definition: n. a city in northeastern Spain on the Mediterranean; 2nd largest Spanish city and the largest port and commercial center; has been a center for radical political beliefs
example: Like, if you want to go party and stuff, I would say Barcelona in Spain.
exampleZh: 你要是想去派对什么的，我建议去西班牙巴塞罗那。

meaning: n. 波士顿（美国马萨诸塞州首府和最大城市）
definition: n. state capital and largest city of Massachusetts; a major center for banking and financial services
example: It begins by, in a sense, rehearsing or taking us back to Frost's own initial move north of Boston.
exampleZh: 某种意义上来说，它以，重复或者带我们重返,最初弗罗斯特去波士顿北部的时候。

meaning: n. 英国，不列颠(包括英格兰、苏格兰及威尔士)；英国，不列颠(包括英格兰、苏格兰及威尔士)
definition: n. a monarchy in northwestern Europe occupying most of the British Isles; divided into England and Scotland and Wales and Northern Ireland
example: The Netherlands ceases to be a great power, whereas Britain in 1707 becomes the biggest of the world powers.
exampleZh: 随着荷兰的衰落,一七零七年,英国成为了世界的霸主

meaning: n. 大卫；戴维（男子名）
definition: n. patron saint of Wales (circa 520-600)；n. French neoclassical painter who actively supported the French Revolution (1748-1825)
example: My favorite professor is David Wallace. I just came out of his class right now.
exampleZh: 我最喜欢的教授是大卫·华莱士。我刚刚上完他的课。

meaning: n. 欧洲；欧盟；（除英国以外的）全欧洲
definition: n. the 2nd smallest continent (actually a vast peninsula of Eurasia); the British use `Europe' to refer to all of the continent except the British Isles；n. an international organization of European countries formed after World War II to reduce trade barriers and increase cooperation among its members
example: But we went to 17 destinations in the Middle East and in Europe and in Scandinavia.
exampleZh: 我们去了17个地方,穿行在中东地区，欧洲,和斯堪的纳维亚之间。

meaning: n. 二月
definition: 1. n. the month following January and preceding March
example: He welshed on his agreement with the team that he would play for them in February.
exampleZh: 他逃避履行他与球队合同中在二月为他们踢球的协议。

meaning: adj. 年龄较小的；地位（或级别）低的，资历较浅的；（体育运动）青少年的；（7-11岁的）学童的；（学校或学校的一部分) 为11或13岁以下儿童设立的；（四年制大学或中学）三年级学生的；小（用于与父亲同名者的名字之后）；n. 较年幼者，年少者；地位（或级别）较低者，下属；（高中或大学的）三年级学生；青少年运动员；男孩，（尤指）儿子；（英国的）小学生；【名】 （Junior）（美、巴、葡）尤尼奥尔（人名）
definition: 1. n. term of address for a disrespectful and annoying male；2. adj. younger; lower in rank; shorter in length of tenure or service
example: and then officially, during the spring of my junior year of high school, so my third year of high school.
exampleZh: 但后来正式决定来这里是在高三的那个春天。

meaning: abbr. 视线（Line of Sight）；月球轨道航天器（Lunar Orbiter Spacecraft）；n. （Los）人名；（匈）洛什；（俄、西、瑞典、塞、英）洛斯
definition: abstract: In the mythological writings of William Blake, Los is the fallen (earthly or human) form of Urthona, one of the four Zoas. He is referred to as the "eternal prophet" and creates the visionary city of Golgonooza.
example: As a result, Los Angeles now has its best chance in decades to combat homelessness.
exampleZh: 因此，洛杉矶现在拥有几十年来应对无家可归问题的最佳机会。

meaning: n. （用于男子的姓或姓名前）先生；（称呼要员）先生
definition: n. a form of address for a man
example: Mr Chen opened the car door for his wife.
exampleZh: 陈先生为妻子打开车门。

meaning: n. 十月（公历一年中的第十个月，在九月和十一月之间）
definition: 1. n. the month following September and preceding November
example: I think she did it two years ago, in October I think, because it was a Halloween theme.
exampleZh: 我想她是两年前开的美术馆，我记得是十月份，因为它正好是以万圣节为主题的。

meaning: abbr. 疗养院（sanatorium 的缩写）；n. （San）圣（西班牙语、意大利语等罗曼语中相当于 Saint，用于人名和地名）；suffix. （日语敬称“さん”的罗马字，加在姓名后）先生，女士
definition: abstract: San (Serbian Cyrillic: Сан, trans. Dream) was a former Yugoslav rock band from Belgrade.
example: Piano master Lang Lang performed a surprising, offbeat encore at a concert in San Francisco.
exampleZh: 钢琴大师郎朗在旧金山的一场音乐会上表演了出人意料的、另类的加演。

meaning: adv. 学术上，学业上
definition: adv. in regard to academic matters
example: So, he got the Nobel in chemistry, which made him a hot property academically.
exampleZh: 总之他获得了诺贝尔化学奖，使他在学术声誉很高。

meaning: v. 陪伴，陪同；伴随，与……一起发生；为……伴奏（或伴唱）；附带，补充
definition: 1. v. be associated with；2. v. go or travel along with
example: Ken agreed to accompany me on a trip to Africa.
exampleZh: 肯同意陪我去非洲旅行。

meaning: adv. 精确地，准确地
definition: adv. with few mistakes；adv. strictly correctly
example: What many people mean by the word "power" could be more accurately described as "control."
exampleZh: 许多人对“权力”这个词的理解可以更为准确地用“控制”来形容。

meaning: adj. 真实的，实际的，现实的；（用于对比主次方面）真正的；现存的，当前的
definition: 1. adj. presently existing in fact and not merely potential or possible；2. adj. taking place in reality; not pretended or imitated
example: Sal in this moment becomes so naive, naive of history, of actual lived history of his own country.
exampleZh: 因为萨尔在这一刻变得非常无知，对自己国家的真实历史非常无知。

meaning: adj. 附加的，额外的
definition: 1. adj. further or added
example: I'm not sure there might be additional things that international students have to do like additional tests.
exampleZh: 我不确定留学生录取是不是还有其他要求，比如说还要加试什么的。

meaning: adj. 不利的，有害的；相反的；敌对的
definition: 1. having a negative or harmful effect on something；2. going against something, or causing harm
example: Lack of money will have an adverse effect on our research programme.
exampleZh: 缺少资金将对我们的研究方案有不利影响。

meaning: adv. 审美地，从美学观点上，从美学角度
definition: adv. in a tasteful way
example: It has been famous for its aesthetically pleasing architecture and healing thermal springs ever since.
exampleZh: 从那时起，这座城市就以美观的建筑和有疗养效果的温泉而闻名。

meaning: n. 喜爱，关爱；爱恋，爱慕之情；精神状况，感情；疾患，病；影响
definition: 1. n. a positive feeling of liking
example: So that when he says that citizens are held together by ties of common affection he means something very specific.
exampleZh: 所以当他们说到公民是由,共同感情的关系所团结在一起,他所指的是非常明确的东西。

meaning: n. 待议事项，议事日程；（政治）议题；秘密计划，秘密目标
definition: 1. n. a temporally organized plan for matters to be attended to；2. n. a list of matters to be taken up (as at a meeting)
example: But propaganda intends to disclose who the person is, what their agenda is, what their models are.
exampleZh: 然而，宣传旨在公开人物身份，人物议程，以及人物的典范作用。

meaning: n. 航空公司；输气管（air line）；航线；adj. 航线的
definition: 1. n. a hose that carries air under pressure；2. n. a commercial enterprise that provides scheduled flights for passengers
example: and ended up owning record companies and radio stations and airline companies and those kind of thing.
exampleZh: 最后拥有了自己的唱片公司、广播电台和航空公司，诸如此类的东西。

meaning: n. 机场，航空站 （港）；空旅通俗读物
definition: 1. n. an airfield equipped with control tower and hangers as well as accommodations for passengers and cargo
example: Everybody and his pet dog is trying to get a seat on a plane out of Logan airport.
exampleZh: 每个人和他们的宠物狗,都想获得罗根机场的飞机上的座位。

meaning: n. 改变，变更；（对衣物的）改动
definition: 1. n. an event that occurs when something passes from one state or phase to another；2. n. the act of making something different (as e.g. the size of a garment)
example: Here the Judicature Act made a definite alteration in the law.
exampleZh: 在此，《司法法》对法律进行了明确的修改。

meaning: adv. 交替地；轮流地；none
definition: 1. in a way that involves two things happening or existing one after the other repeatedly；2. in a manner in which two things each replace the other
example: Alternately, you could also seek out hard data that illuminates your real chance of success in whatever endeavor you are contemplating.
exampleZh: 或者，你也可以寻找能够说明你在所考虑的任何事业中获得成功的真实机会的确凿数据。

meaning: n. 追求的目标，抱负；雄心，野心；干劲；v. 追求，有……野心
definition: 1. n. a cherished desire；2. v. have as one's ambition
example: The other way it shares an ambition of modernism is precisely in that effort to communicate experience, consciousness.
exampleZh: 它与现代主义追求的另一个共同点,正体现在经验和意识的交流上。

meaning: v. 分析，细察；分解，化验；对……进行心理分析
definition: v. consider in detail and subject to an analysis in order to discover essential features or meaning；v. break down into components or essential features
example: We haven't had time to analyse those samples yet.
exampleZh: 我们还没有时间化验分析那些样本。

meaning: v. 宣布，公布；声称，郑重地说；（尤指通过广播）通知；播报，讲解（体育赛事）；通报……的到来；显示；告知；宣布竞选公职
definition: 1. v. make known; make an announcement；2. v. announce publicly or officially
example: So, the more enlightened view is, corporations only pay a stock dividend when they have some good news to announce.
exampleZh: 所以更有说服力的观点是,公司发放股票股利的唯一原因是,他们有利好消息要公布了

meaning: adj. 一年一度的；年度的；（植物）一年生的；n. 一年生植物；年刊，年鉴
definition: 1. n. a plant that completes its entire life cycle within the space of a year；2. adj. occurring or payable every year
example: At the annual meeting, the shareholders can come and elect a board and the board then is in charge of the company.
exampleZh: 在年会上,股东会聚集起来,选出董事会来管理公司

meaning: adv. 不管怎样，无论如何；而且，加之；尽管，即使这样；对了，好吧（用于转换话题或回到前一个话题）；（用于表明某事不重要）反正；至少；总之；（表示有意结束谈话）那么；究竟，到底；噢，啊（用于结束谈话或离开）
definition: 1. adv. used to indicate that a statement explains or supports a previous statement；2. adv. in any way whatsoever
example: But let me use the term "event" anyway, employing it with caution and as if in quotation marks.
exampleZh: 但是无论如何我还是使用，“事件“，这个词，小心谨慎地使用它，带引号地使用。

meaning: adv. 据说，显然；似乎，好像
definition: 1. adv. from appearances alone；2. adv. unmistakably (`plain' is often used informally for `plainly')
example: Franny again cleared her throat. Apparently, her self-imposed sentence of unadulterated good listenership had been fully served. "Why?" she asked.
exampleZh: 弗兰尼又清了喉咙，他的自欺式的自白得到了倾听,遇到了好听众，为什么，她问。

meaning: n. 露面，演出；出庭，到场；外表，外观；表面现象，假象；出现；起源，问世；表现；出版，广播
definition: 1. n. outward or visible aspect of a person or thing；2. n. the event of coming into sight
example: Alpheus is also the god of erotic pastoral poetry, it turns out, and this god is literally gone underground during the terrifying appearance of Saint Peter.
exampleZh: 阿尔甫斯也是描写爱欲的诗歌之神，从诗句上来看，这位神灵在圣彼得面前,悄无声息的隐匿了踪影。

meaning: n. 评估，估价；评价；员工工作评估
definition: 1. the act of examining someone or something in order to judge their or its qualities, success, or needs；2. a meeting in which an employee discusses his or her progress, aims, and needs at work with his or her manager or employer
example: It may also be necessary to get a new appraisal of the property.
exampleZh: 可能还需要对该房产做个新的估价。

meaning: n. 考古学
definition: n. the branch of anthropology that studies prehistoric people and their cultures
example: A distinction must be made between archaeology proper and science-based archaeology.
exampleZh: 必须对严格意义上的考古学和以科学为基础的考古学加以区分。

meaning: n. 建筑设计，建筑风格；建筑学；结构；计算机的体系结构，架构
definition: 1. n. an architectural product or work；2. n. the discipline dealing with the principles of design and construction and ornamentation of fine buildings
example: Any advice I could give if anybody wants to do, study architecture is that you’ve got to really want to...
exampleZh: 至于我能给真正想学的人一些什么建议，学习建筑学的首要精义是你得发自内心的喜爱......

meaning: n. 一系列，大量；数组，阵列；盛装；v. 布置，排列；配置（兵力）；穿戴，打扮
definition: 1. a large group of things or people, especially one that is attractive or causes admiration or has been positioned in a particular way；2. to arrange a group of things in a particular way
example: It is 1.7475. Conclusion: if I start to react sodium with chlorine, the result is a crystal, a three-dimensional array.
exampleZh: 这是1。7475，结论就是：,如果我使钠和氯反应，结果将会是一个晶体，一个三维排列。

meaning: 渴望；立志；追求
definition: 1. to want something very much or hope to achieve something or be successful
example: Those two words have stayed with me—not as something to disdain, but as something to which to aspire.
exampleZh: 那两个词一直陪伴着我——我没有把它当作鄙夷的对象，而是当作值得追求的目标。

meaning: n. 有利条件，有价值的人或物；资产，财产；【名】（Asset）（法）阿塞（人名）
definition: 1. n. a useful or valuable quality
example: If you accept my estimates and you accept the capital asset pricing model, that would have to be true.
exampleZh: 如果你同意我的估算,而且认同资本资本资产定价模型，那这种投资组合就会带来最大收益。

meaning: adj. 处于危险中的
definition: abstract: Not to be confused with a 2010 TV movie by the same name, starring Andie MacDowell.
example: As much as they needed, they got and they chose 250 kids from an at-risk population.
exampleZh: 他们的一切要求都得到了满足，他们从受危人群中选了250名孩子。

meaning: n. 拍卖；（桥牌）叫牌阶段；v. 拍卖
definition: 1. a usually public sale of goods or property, where people make higher and higher bids (= offers of money) for each thing, until the thing is sold to the person who will pay most；2. to sell something in a public auction
example: For about six months Wallace Turnage worked in Hector Davis's slave auction house helping organize the auctions every day.
exampleZh: 华莱士·特内奇在赫克托·戴维斯的,奴隶拍卖行工作了六个月,每天帮助组织拍卖

meaning: n. 专家，权威人士；行政管理机构；权力，权限；权威，威信；许可，授权；当局，官方
definition: 1. n. the power or right to give orders or make decisions；2. n. (usually plural) persons who exercise (administrative) control over others
example: He's absorbed the touching authority of Phoebus Apollo, the god of the sun. Milton -- why is that important?
exampleZh: 他已经吸收了阿波罗触动他人的权威，那么，弥尔顿，为什么那么重要呢？

meaning: adv. 自然地，必然地；不假思索地，无意识地；自动地
definition: 1. adv. in a reflex manner；2. adv. in a mechanical manner; by a mechanism
example: So if you just automatically type your essay, your tutor will ring the American word
exampleZh: 所以如果你自动输入你的论文，你的导师会圈出美式的单词，

meaning: adj. 自治的，有自治权的；自主的，有自主权的；自动的
definition: 1. independent and having the power to make your own decisions；2. an autonomous organization, country, or region is independent and has the freedom to govern itself
example: Five of the six provinces are to become autonomous regions in a new federal system of government.
exampleZh: 在新的联邦政府体制下，6个省中的5个将成为自治区。

meaning: n. 后院；后庭
definition: 1. n. the grounds in back of a house
example: He had an assemblage of old junk cars filling the backyard.
exampleZh: 他曾经在后院堆满了废旧汽车。

meaning: n. 禁止，禁令；逐出令；褫夺公民权的判决；诅咒；巴尼（罗马尼亚货币单位，复数bani）；v. 禁止，取缔；（官方）把（某人）逐出某地；【名】 （Ban）（美、罗马、克罗地亚）班恩（人名）
definition: 1. n. a decree that prohibits something；2. v. prohibit especially by legal means or social pressure
example: The most outrageous action in Laud's crackdown was his move to ban -his attempt to ban preaching in churches.
exampleZh: 他所做过的最骇人听闻的暴行,是企图在教堂里禁止布道训诫行为。

meaning: n. 男低音歌手；低音，低音部；低音吉他，低音提琴；鲈鱼；椴树；adj. 低音的，低声调的；【名】 （Bass）（英、法、德、俄、罗、捷、马里、匈）巴斯（人名）
definition: 1. the lowest range of musical notes, or a man with a singing voice in this range；2. the set of low musical sounds on a radio, music system, etc.
example: Please go get the clicker at the Bass Circulation Desk, and they should have enough everybody in the class.
exampleZh: 去巴斯借书处领取表决器吧,应该每人都能领取到一个

meaning: n. （海或湖的）湾；山脉的低凹处，山间平地；（装窗的）房间突出部分；间隔区，限定区域；月桂树；枣红马，栗色马；（尤指教堂中殿墙壁的）柱间距；（船或飞机上的）货舱；v. （犬）连续吠，（狼）连续嚎叫；（尤指要求惩罚某人时）大声叫嚷；adj. 枣红色的，深棕色的；【名】 （Bay）（英、老）贝，（德、意、罗、捷、土、丹）巴伊，（匈）鲍伊，（瑞典）巴伊，（越）七（人名）
definition: 1. n. an indentation of a shoreline larger than a cove but smaller than a gulf；2. v. utter in deep prolonged tones
example: Like, I think the Bay Area is really awesome. There's a lot of like, things to do.

meaning: n. 豆，菜豆，豆科植物；籽实，豆形种子；用于强调丝毫，一点；脑袋；（Bean）描述Java的软件组件模型（Enterprise Java Bean）；v. （用某物）击中（某人）头部；【名】 （Bean）（英）比恩（人名）

meaning: v. （反复地）敲，击，打；狠打，猛抽；搅拌，混合；拍动，扇动（翅膀）；（心脏）跳动，搏动；击败，战胜；抢……之先，赶在……之前；避开，避免；n. 敲，击；（音乐或诗歌的）强音拍；（经常去或经过的）路线，地点；以之字形航线抢风航行；adj. 筋疲力尽，疲惫不堪；垮掉的一代的；【名】 （Beat）贝亚特（人名）
definition: 1. n. a regular route for a sentry or policeman；2. v. come out better in a competition, race, or conflict

meaning: n. 牛肉；肌肉，力量，力气；抱怨，牢骚；要点，关键；犯罪指控，罪名；v. 抱怨，发牢骚

meaning: n. 旁观者；观看者

exampleZh: 像“美在观者的眼中”这样的陈述很少受到质疑。

meaning: prep. （位置）在……下面； （数、量、水平等）在……以下；（职位、官衔等）低于；adv. 在下面；（数字或级别）在……以下；在下文中；在下层甲板；【名】 （Below）（英、德、芬、瑞、丹、加）贝洛（人名）
definition: 1. adv. in or to a place that is lower；2. adv. at a later place
example: He separates the waters above and the waters below and creates this space that will become the inhabited world.
exampleZh: 他将天上的水和地上的水分离开来,开创了这个将被居住的世界。

meaning: adj. 弯曲的，变形的；驼背的；(有权者）不诚实的，不正派的；下定决心的；同性恋的；n. 天赋，爱好；信仰；翦股颖；草茎，草梗；莎草；石南丛生的荒野，荒草牧场；v. 弯腰；使弯曲；屈从（bend 的过去式和过去分词形式）；【名】 （Bent）（美、丹、挪）本特（人名）
definition: n. a relatively permanent inclination to react in a particular way；n. grass for pastures and lawns especially bowling and putting greens
example: And the geometry, which I didn't ask you, is going to be bent for this molecule.
exampleZh: 几何形状，虽然我没有问你们，对于这个分子是折线型。

meaning: n. 浆果，莓；果仁，果核；虾子，鱼子；无核浆果；vi. 采集浆果；【名】 （Berry）（法、英、德、意、葡）贝里，（匈）拜里（人名）
definition: 1. n. any of numerous small and pulpy edible fruits; used as desserts or in making jams and jellies and preserves；2. v. pick or gather berries
example: Mr. Berry said the timing was a coincidence and that his decision was unrelated to Mr. Roman's departure.
exampleZh: 贝里先生说时间的安排是个巧合，而且他的决策与罗曼先生的离去毫无关系。

meaning: v. 出价；投标，竞标；努力争取；（纸牌戏中的）叫牌；命令，吩咐；打招呼，示意；邀请；n. 出价，喊价；投标；努力，尝试；（纸牌戏中的）叫牌；【名】 （Bid）（美）比德（人名）
definition: 1. n. an authoritative direction or instruction to do something；2. v. propose a payment
example: But, it showed additional information that you won't find on Treasury Direct; it showed bid and ask for dealers.
exampleZh: 但是,那里还有,"国库指南"上没有的内容,对于中间商的买入价和卖出价

meaning: n. 自行车，脚踏车，单车；摩托车；v. 骑自行车（单车）； 用自行车（或摩托车）投递（信件，包裹）；用自行车（或摩托车）投递（信件，包裹）；n. （Bike)（土、土库、塞）比克

example: Plus, there's a lot more bike lanes than there used to be, so that helps.
exampleZh: 另外，现在的自行车道也比以前多了很多，这个也很有用。

meaning: adj. 味苦的；痛苦的，辛酸的；激烈的，充满敌意的；愤愤不平的；严寒的，刺骨的；（巧克力）黑色不加糖的；n. 苦啤酒；adv. 严寒刺骨地；v. 使变苦；【名】 （Bitter）（英、法、德、芬、捷、匈）比特（人名）
definition: 1. n. English term for a dry sharp-tasting ale with strong flavor of hops (usually on draft)；2. v. make bitter
example: Bitter constraint and sad occasion are forcing him to write, even though, of course, he's not yet ready.
exampleZh: 亲友的惨遇，痛苦的重压迫使他下笔，尽管如此，他还是没准备好。

meaning: v. 有（值得自豪的东西）；吹嘘，夸耀；n. 夸耀，自吹自擂，感到自豪的事；【名】 (Boast)（英）博斯特（人名）
definition: 1. n. speaking of yourself in superlatives；2. v. show off
example: In its heyday, the studio's boast was that it had more stars than there are in heaven.
exampleZh: 该制片厂吹嘘，它在鼎盛时期拥有的明星比天上的星星还多。

meaning: v. （使）沸腾，煮沸，烧开；用开水煮；怒火中烧；（海，云）翻腾；n. 煮沸，沸腾；疖，皮下脓肿；激昂，兴奋；突然浮上来食鱼饵；【名】 （Boil）（美）博伊尔（人名）
definition: 1. n. a painful sore with a hard core filled with pus；2. v. come to the boiling point and change from a liquid to vapor
example: Now men will go content with what we spoiled, Or, discontent, boil bloody, and be spilled.
exampleZh: 现在人们也许会对我们的破坏得意洋洋或者大发牢骚，也许还会会血液沸腾，飞溅。

meaning: v. 增强，激励；巩固（地位），加强；改善，改进；给（座位）加软垫；n. 长枕，垫枕；承梁（用于支撑或减少摩擦）；托木；（削砖用的）凿刀；【名】 （Bolster）（美、印、荷）博尔斯特（人名）
definition: 1. to support or improve something or make it stronger；2. a long firm cylinder-shaped pillow
example: The country is free to adopt policies to bolster its economy.
exampleZh: 这个国家可自由采取措施来巩固经济。

meaning: v. 借，借入；（向……）借贷；采用，借用；（演算减法时）借（位）；【名】 （Borrow）（英）博罗（人名）

exampleZh: 董事会一直被该借多少钱的问题所困扰着,不同的国家有着不同的文化

meaning: n. 上司，领导，领班；圆形装饰物，浮雕装饰；牛犊，奶牛；v. 发号施令，对……颐指气使；当首领；adj. 很好的，出色的；【名】 （Boss）（英、法、德、西、瑞典）博斯（人名）
definition: 1. n. a person who exercises control over workers；2. v. raise in a relief
example: and your boss comes to you with a very large project when you already have much work to do.
exampleZh: 你的老板找到你，希望你参与一个大型项目，而你自己的工作已经快忙不过来了。

meaning: v. 弹起，反弹；跳动，蹦；（使）上下晃动；（用膝盖）颠动（孩子）；蹦蹦跳跳地去；拒付，退回（支票等）；退回（电子邮件）；驱逐，解雇；（向某人）透露主意（以试探其反应）；反复跳槽，来回往返某地；（光线或声音）反射；撞击，碰撞；n. 弹跳，跳动；弹性，弹力；活力，精力；（头发的）弹性，蓬松；突然的增长
definition: 1. n. the quality of a substance that is able to rebound；2. v. spring back; spring away from an impact
example: and have everyone come up with different ideas, and then you can bounce ideas off each other and
exampleZh: 每个人都能提出不同的想法，你们可以互相讨论各自的观点，

meaning: n. 男孩；儿子；男青年，小伙子；男性朋友们，一群男伙伴（the boys）；一群从事同一职业的男子（boys）；（从事某一职业的）男子；小家伙（用于称呼雄性的狗或马）；伙计（尤用于亲切谈论某人时）；（尤指在战场上作战的）士兵，战友；指称某地等的人；运动队队员（the boys）；小子（对黑人男性的冒犯语）；int. （尤用于表示羡慕或兴奋）好家伙，好样的；【名】 （Boy）（美、印、法、荷）布瓦（人名）
definition: 1. n. a youthful male person；2. n. a friendly informal reference to a grown man
example: The relation between the speech sounds it's like the relation, as I'm saying, between the boy and the birches.
exampleZh: 语言韵律和,就像这种关系，像我说的，像孩子和桦树的关系一样。

meaning: v. 埋，埋葬；埋藏，隐藏；掩藏情感；把头/脸埋进……；嵌入，插入；埋头于，专心于（bury oneself in）；证明……是错的；轻松战胜，击败；【名】 （Bury）（英、西）伯里，（法）比里，（德、意、罗、波、捷、匈）布里，（俄）布雷（人名）
definition: 1. v. cover from sight；2. v. place in a grave or tomb
example: The woman's objection, as the poem unfolds, is summed up by his choice, the father's choice, to bury the child himself.
exampleZh: 这首诗里揭示的这个女人的反对，从这个父亲的选择中就可以总结出，亲自埋葬这个孩子。

meaning: adj. 繁忙的，忙碌的；热闹的；全神贯注的；占线的；繁琐的，杂乱的；v. 使自己忙于；n. 警官，警察；【名】 （Busy）（匈）布希，（法）比西（人名）
definition: 1. v. keep busy with；2. adj. actively or fully engaged or occupied
example: I guess some days at Yale can be very busy. Do you think those busy days happen a lot?
exampleZh: 我想有时候在耶鲁会很忙。你觉得经常很忙吗？

meaning: n. 蝴蝶；见异思迁的人，轻浮易变的人；蝶泳，蝶泳比赛；紧张，心慌；耳环托；v. （将食物）切成蝴蝶展翅状，使成蝶形；adj. 蝴蝶状
definition: 1. n. diurnal insect typically having a slender body with knobbed antennae and broad colorful wings；2. v. flutter like a butterfly
example: It is a very pretty butterfly, with a 2 inch wing span.
exampleZh: 它是一只非常漂亮的蝴蝶，翅膀张开有2英寸宽。

meaning: n. 咖啡馆，小餐馆
definition: 1. n. a small restaurant where drinks and snacks are sold
