meaning: 卡纳维拉尔（角）
example: It will be launched vertically from remodeled Apollo pads at the John f. Kennedy space center at cape canaveral, fla.
exampleZh: 它将在佛罗里达州长纳维拉尔角肯尼迪空间中心从改进过的阿波罗发射架垂直发射。

meaning: n. 癌症；痼疾，社会恶习；巨蟹宫，巨蟹座（Cancer）；出生于巨蟹宫时段（即6月22日至7月22日）的人（Cancer）
definition: 1. n. any malignant growth or tumor caused by abnormal and uncontrolled cell division; it may spread to other parts of the body through the lymphatic system or the blood stream；2. n. (astrology) a person who is born while the sun is in Cancer
example: So 9% less cardiovascular disease, 13% less Parkinson's and Alzheimer's, 6% less cancer, 9% less mortality from all causes.
exampleZh: 心血管类疾病患病率降低9%,帕金森病和老年痴呆症降低13%,癌症降低6%,由各种原因导致的死亡率降低9%

meaning: n. 加农炮，大炮；自动机关炮；v. 猛撞，碰撞；炮轰；【名】 （Cannon）（英、葡）坎农（人名）
definition: 1. a large, powerful gun, usually attached to two or four wheels, that was used in the past to fire heavy stone or metal balls；2. a gun fastened to an aircraft
example: The stillness of the night was broken by the boom of a cannon.
exampleZh: 夜晚的寂静被大炮的轰鸣声打破了。

meaning: adj. 有能力的；有本领的，能干的；可以……的，容许……的
definition: 1. adj. (usually followed by `of') having capacity or ability；2. adj. possibly accepting or permitting
example: They're capable of these extraordinarily delicate feats of dexterity, and that's because the poet has mastered his touch.
exampleZh: 反而能够灵巧地完成精细的动作，这是因为诗人已经完全掌握了自己的触觉。

meaning: adj. 灾难性的；极糟的，失败的；大规模突变的；（与）地质灾变（有关）的
definition: 1. causing sudden and very great harm or destruction；2. very bad
example: The minister gave a warning that if war broke out, it would be catastrophic.
exampleZh: 大臣警告说战争一旦爆发，将会是灾难性的。

meaning: v. 提供餐饮服务，承办酒席；满足，迎合；【名】 （Cater）（英）凯特（人名）
definition: 1. v. provide what is desired or needed, especially support, food or sustenance；2. v. supply food ready to eat; for parties and banquets
example: In the contemporary western world, rapidly changing styles cater to a desire for novelty and individualism.
exampleZh: 在当代西方世界，快速变换着的款式迎合了人们对新奇和独特性的追求。

meaning: n. 牛；家牛（包括牦牛、犎牛及水牛）；【名】 （Cattle）（意）卡特莱（人名）
definition: 1. n. domesticated bovine animals as a group regardless of sex or age
example: And in particular, dairy maids, whose responsibility was to milk cows, and so they had a very intimate relationship with cattle, often didn't get disease.
exampleZh: 特别是挤奶女工,她们的工作就是挤奶,她们与奶牛有紧密的关系,通常不会得天花

meaning: n. 名声，名望；名人，明星
definition: 1. someone who is famous, especially in the entertainment business；2. the state of being famous
example: And a lot of these other places that are very famous for their celebrity clientele also are down there,
exampleZh: 而且这里还有很多以名人顾客光临而闻名的地方，

ipa: ˌsiː iː ˈəʊ / ˌsiː iː ˈoʊ
meaning: abbr. 首席执行官；执行总裁（chief executive officer）
definition: n. the corporate executive responsible for the operations of the firm; reports to a board of directors; may appoint other managers (including a president)
example: The fire chief was asked, CEO well, he wasn't exactly the fire chief. I guess he was the CEO.
exampleZh: 记者问消防队长，准确地说不是消防队长，我估计是。

meaning: n. 确实，确定性；确实的事，必然的事
definition: 1. n. the state of being certain；2. n. something that is certain
example: Such attitudes are valueless unless they reflect inner cognition and certainty.
exampleZh: 这种态度如果不能反映内心的认知和确定性就毫无价值。

meaning: n. 混乱，无秩序状态；混沌；【名】 （Chaos）（西）查奥斯（人名）
definition: 1. n. a state of extreme confusion and disorder；2. n. the formless and disordered state of matter before the creation of the cosmos
example: The storms and torrential rain caused traffic chaos across the country.
exampleZh: 暴风雨和倾盆大雨造成了全国的交通混乱。

meaning: n. 巧克力，朱古力；巧克力糖，夹心巧克力糖；巧克力饮料，一杯巧克力饮料；深褐色，巧克力色；adj. 巧克力的，巧克力味的；【名】 （Chocolate）（葡）绍科拉特（人名）
definition: 1. n. a beverage made from cocoa powder and milk and sugar; usually drunk hot；2. n. a food made from roasted ground cacao beans
example: And I just got a box lunch and there was a strange chocolate bar that I got.
exampleZh: 我得到了一盒午餐，里面有一根很奇特的巧克力棒。

meaning: n. 圆，圆形物；圈子，阶层；弧形楼座；黑眼圈；循环，周期；v. 盘旋，环行；围绕，圈起
definition: 1. n. ellipse in which the two axes are of equal length; a plane curve generated by one point moving at a constant distance from a fixed point；2. v. travel around something
example: Sure. I think that Columbus Circle is probably one of the most fashionable places in the city.
exampleZh: 当然可以。我觉得哥伦布环岛可能是这座城市里最时尚的地方之一。

meaning: n. 条件，情况，环境；境况，经济状况；详情，原委；命运，境遇；v. 处于某种情况
definition: 1. n. a condition that accompanies or influences some event or activity；2. n. the set of facts or circumstances that surround a situation or event
example: The defenses had to do with necessity, their dire circumstance, and, implicitly at least, the idea that numbers matter.
exampleZh: 有人说他们在那样的处境下，不得已而为之，并且暗含了“人数重要“的理念。

meaning: n. 从句，分句；（法律文件的）条款；【名】 （Clause）（法）克洛斯（人名）
definition: 1. n. (grammar) an expression including a subject and predicate but not constituting a complete sentence；2. n. a separate section of a legal document (as a statute or contract or will)
example: He has a clause in his contract which entitles him to a percentage of the profits.
exampleZh: 他在他的合同里有一项条款保证他享有一定比例的利润。

meaning: n. 清洁工人；清洁剂，去污剂；清洁器，清洁设备；干洗店（the cleaner's/cleaners）；adj. 更清洁的，更干净的（clean 的比较级形式）
definition: n. a preparation used in cleaning something；n. the operator of dry-cleaning establishment
example: This new kitchen cleaner is formulated to cut through grease and dirt.
exampleZh: 这种新的厨房清洁剂能去除油渍和污垢。

meaning: n. 夹子，别针；（电影、电视节目等的）片段；弹夹，弹匣；猛击，抽打；修剪；（行动）速度（尤指快速）；一次；（从羊或羊群）剪下的羊毛量；v. 修剪；剪下；减少，缩短；（意外地）斜撞，侧击；诈骗（某人），抢劫（某人）；截取（图像）；截取（信号）的标准振幅，限幅；夹住，固定住
definition: 1. n. a metal frame or container holding cartridges; can be inserted into an automatic gun；2. v. sever or remove by pinching or snipping
example: So, more data to come, so this is a clip some of you might have seen in section already.
exampleZh: 随着更多数据的出现，就会形成一个标签,有些人可能已在相应章节中看到过了。

meaning: n. 云，云朵；云状物，一团；阴影，令人忧虑的事；皱眉，沮丧的表情；v. 把……搞糊涂，使难以理解；破坏，给……蒙上阴影；（使）显得阴沉；模糊不清，（使）起雾；布满云；使（房间、天空等）烟雾缭绕，使尘土飞扬；【名】 （Cloud）克劳德（人名）
definition: 1. n. any collection of particles (e.g., smoke or dust) or gases that is visible；2. v. make overcast or cloudy
example: Here, the cloud becomes the obscuring of this sense of intent to communicate or a sense of meaning's pattern.
exampleZh: 在这里，试图沟通,或者说意图形式的,感觉变得模糊。

meaning: n. 教练；私人教师；长途客车，长途汽车；火车车厢；四轮大马车；（飞机）经济舱，（火车）普通车厢；（体育队的）领队；（棒球运动中的）跑垒指挥员；教练；v. 训练，指导；（尤指私人）辅导；指示，专门传授；乘火车（或汽车、马车）旅行；adv. 乘（飞机、火车的）经济舱地
definition: 1. n. (sports) someone in charge of training an athlete or a team；2. v. teach and supervise (someone); act as a trainer or coach (to), as in sports
example: The reason I got to be a soccer team captain in the first place was because my coach said,
exampleZh: 我最初之所以成为球队队长是因为我的教练说，

meaning: n. 认识，认知；认识（或认知）的结果
definition: 1. the use of conscious mental processes
example: Such attitudes are valueless unless they reflect inner cognition and certainty.
exampleZh: 这种态度如果不能反映内心的认知和确定性就毫无价值。

meaning: adj. 合作的，协作的
definition: 1. adj. accomplished by collaboration
example: We have the active learning, the collaborative learning from other students.
exampleZh: 我们有自主学习，从他人身上学的,互助式学习。

meaning: n. 收藏品，收集物；募捐；一堆（东西），一群（人）；系列时装；专辑，作品集；领取，收取；收集，采集；收账，收债；（尤指牛津大学的）学院期初（或期末）考试
definition: 1. n. several things grouped together or considered as a whole；2. n. a publication containing a variety of works
example: I was able to do letter writing, I was able to do data collection, and do a product there.
exampleZh: 我以前上书信写作的课，要上数据搜集的课，还要上美工课。

meaning: adj. 集体的，共同的；总的，集合的；n. 集体农庄，集体企业；集合名词
definition: 1. n. members of a cooperative enterprise；2. adj. done by or characteristic of individuals acting together
example: This principle of collective bargaining has been a mainstay in labour relations in this country.
exampleZh: 这种集体谈判原则已成为该国劳动关系的一个重要基础。

meaning: v. 犯（罪、错）；调拨，投入；（使）承诺，承担义务；郑重承诺，忠于；把……关进医院（监狱），监禁；传唤（某人）到法院受审；订婚，决定与（某人）保持长期感情；把……托付给
definition: 1. v. perform an act, usually with a negative connotation；2. v. give entirely to a specific person, activity, or cause
example: Ford kept his suspicions to himself, even to the extent of going to jail for a murder he obviously didn't commit.
exampleZh: 福特把自己的怀疑藏在心里，即使到了要为他显然没有犯的谋杀罪而入狱的地步他也不说。

meaning: n. 商品，货物；有用的东西，必需品
definition: 1. n. articles of commerce
example: Money was a commodity she never thought about except in the abstract.
exampleZh: 金钱是她从未具体想过的一种商品。

meaning: n. 同伴，伴侣；（受雇照料老人或病人的）陪护；成对的物品之一；同甘共苦的伙伴；（用于书名）指南，手册；伴星；最低级爵士；v. 陪伴；【名】 （Companion）（英）康帕宁（人名）
definition: 1. n. a person who is frequently in the company of another；2. v. be a companion to somebody
example: It's called Death and Transfiguration, and I hear this as a companion piece, a kind of pendant to the Zarathustra.
exampleZh: 这首曲子名叫死亡与净化,我听说它是查拉图斯特拉的姊妹篇,某种对查拉图斯特拉的补充

meaning: n. 同情，怜悯
definition: 1. a strong feeling of sympathy and sadness for the suffering or bad luck of others and a wish to help them
example: And it speaks to those who are courageous enough to acknowledge that life is rife with pain and conflict, just as it's filled with compassion and joy.
exampleZh: 这是属于坚强的人们的,承认生活充满痛苦与矛盾，而并非总是激情欢乐的。

meaning: adj. 综合性的，全面的；有理解力的；n. 综合中学；专业综合测验
definition: 1. n. an intensive examination testing a student's proficiency in some special field of knowledge；2. adj. including all or everything
example: And what this is going to be is a comprehensive introduction to the study of the human mind.
exampleZh: 本课程旨在让大家,在宏观上对人类心智研究形成基本的认识

meaning: v. （通常指不情愿地）承认；认（输），承认（失败）；授予，让与；让对手得分
definition: 1. to admit, often unwillingly, that something is true；2. to admit that you have lost in a competition
example: After losing this decisive battle, the general was forced to concede.
exampleZh: 输掉了这场决定性的战役后，那位将军不得不承认失败。

meaning: n. 音乐会，演奏会；一致，和谐；（尤指犯罪时的）联合行动；v. 共同议定，协调
definition: 1. n. a performance of music by players or singers not involving theatrical staging；2. v. contrive (a plan) by mutual agreement
example: We went out for sushi and then we went to a small concert. You know, it was actually really great.
exampleZh: 我们去吃了寿司，去听了个小型音乐会，真的很棒。

meaning: n. 谴责，严厉指责；非难的理由
definition: 1. n. an expression of strong disapproval; pronouncing as wrong or morally culpable；2. n. (law) the act of condemning (as land forfeited for public use) or judging to be unfit for use (as a food product or an unsafe building)
example: That's a condemnation of the students as a whole, and doesn't explain all campus unhappiness.
exampleZh: 这是对全体学生的指责，也无法解释校园里所有的不满情绪。

meaning: v. 授予，赋予；商讨，交换意见；【名】 （Confer）（英）康弗 （人名）
definition: 1. to exchange ideas on a particular subject, often in order to reach a decision on what action to take；2. to give an official title, honour, or advantage to someone
example: He wanted to confer with his colleagues before reaching a decision.
exampleZh: 他想与他的同事先商议一下再作出决定。

meaning: n. （大型、正式的）会议，研讨会；（小型正式的）商讨，讨论；体育协会（或联合会）
definition: 1. n. a prearranged meeting for consultation or exchange of information or discussion (especially one with a formal agenda)；2. n. an association of sports teams that organizes matches for its members
example: And he had a press conference, spoke about the increased use of cars, and the decreased amount of carpooling.
exampleZh: 他开了一个新闻发布会，说道汽车使用量的增加，和拼车的减少。

meaning: v. 限制，局限；防止……扩散；关押，监禁；使离不开（或受困于床、轮椅等）；n. 边界，范围；限制，局限
definition: 1. v. restrict or confine,；2. v. place limits on (extent or access)
example: I will confine myself to looking at the period from 1900 to 1916.
exampleZh: 我将把自己考察的范围限定在1900年至1916年这段时间以内。

meaning: n. 困惑，不明确；混淆，混同；慌乱，窘迫；混乱局面，乱成一团
definition: 1. n. disorder resulting from a failure to behave predictably；2. n. a mental state characterized by a lack of clear and orderly thought and behavior
example: Now, I think there's a deliberate confusion here about these lines because their precise historical significance isn't what's most significant.
exampleZh: 这里有一个刻意而为的困惑,是关于这些句子中严谨的历史意义的,而不是关于什么是最重要的。

meaning: adj. 意识到的；神志清醒的，有知觉的；关注的；刻意的，慎重的
definition: 1. adj. intentionally conceived；2. adj. knowing and perceiving; having awareness of surroundings and sensations and thoughts
example: I have made a conscious choice that I can't drive to work, I do have a spot in the parking garage.
exampleZh: 我都会故意,不开车上班，我的车,停在车库里。

meaning: n. 一致看法，共识
definition: 1. n. agreement in the judgment or opinion reached by a group as a whole
example: The consensus among the world's scientists is that the world is likely to warm up over the next few decades.
exampleZh: 全世界科学家的共识是地球可能在未来几十年中变暖。

meaning: n. 许可，允许；同意，赞同；正式批准文件，批文；v. 赞同，准许，同意；【名】 （Consent）（美、法、荷）孔桑（人名）
definition: 1. n. permission to do something；2. v. give an affirmative reply to; respond favorably to
example: At no time did I give my consent to the plan.
exampleZh: 我从未同意过这项计划。

meaning: n. （自然环境、野生动植物等）保护主义者，环保人士
definition: n. someone who works to protect the environment from destruction or pollution
example: Valmik Thapar, a conservationist, says India will have 300 to 400 tigers in four years.
exampleZh: 环保人士Valmik Thapar说，在未来的四年里，印度老虎的数量将会是300到400只。

meaning: v. 保护，保存；节省，节约；使（量，如能量、质量）守恒；将……制成蜜饯；n. 蜜饯，果脯
definition: 1. to keep and protect something from damage, change, or waste；2. a type of jam in which the fruit is whole or in large pieces
example: We should conserve oil and gas by making full use of other energy sources.
exampleZh: 我们应该通过充分利用其他能源节约石油和天然气。

meaning: n. 考虑，斟酌；考虑因素；体贴，关心；报酬，酬金；（合同协议中的）对价，约因；重要（性）
definition: 1. n. the process of giving careful thought to something；2. n. information that should be kept in mind when making a decision
example: Now that's precisely the question that Freud asked himself in Beyond the Pleasure Principle, a text which begins with a consideration of trauma victims.
exampleZh: 这就是弗洛伊德,在他的《超越快乐原则》中提到的核心问题，整篇文章以对创伤患者的考虑开始。

meaning: v. 咨询，请教；商量，商讨；查询，查阅；当顾问
definition: 1. v. get or ask advice from；2. v. seek information from
example: If your skin becomes red, sore or very scaly, consult your doctor.
exampleZh: 如果你的皮肤变红，疼痛或严重脱皮，请咨询医生。

meaning: adj. 当代的，现代的；同时期的，同时代的；n. 同时代的人；同龄人，同辈
definition: 1. n. a person of nearly the same age as another；2. adj. characteristic of the present
example: Galileo is the only contemporary personage, the only seventeenth-century figure, even so much as mentioned in Paradise Lost.
exampleZh: 伽利略是唯一的一个当代人物，唯一的一个17世纪的人物，甚至在里也提到了这点。

meaning: adv. 连续不断地
definition: adv. at every point；adv. with unflagging resolve
example: These are the first machines that can stand the wear and tear of continuously crushing glass.
exampleZh: 这些是第一批能经得住连续碾碎玻璃造成的磨损的机器。

meaning: n. 差异，对比；对照物，明显不同的事物；（摄影或绘画中的）颜色反差，明暗对比；（电视屏幕的）图像明暗对比度，反差；v. 对比，对照；显出明显的差异，形成对比
definition: 1. n. the opposition or dissimilarity of things that are compared；2. v. put in opposition to show or emphasize differences
example: You could contrast the roguish and fanciful, clearly done by hand, title of the magazine, with that machine-type Blast.
exampleZh: 你们可以把这些明显手写的，无赖而稀奇的标题，和机械化的“暴风“相对比。

meaning: adj. 有争议的，引发争论的
definition: 1. adj. marked by or capable of arousing controversy
example: .. What the Norwegian Government is doing wrong is-- it's a little bit controversial, my pointing this out to them.
exampleZh: 挪威政府做的不对的地方就在于-,这引起了一些争议，我把他们的处境告诉了他们。

meaning: adj. 凉的，凉爽的；（衣服布料）使人凉爽的；冷静的，沉着的；时髦的，酷的；没问题，不介意；冷漠的，冷淡的；冷色调的；（钱）大笔的，不折不扣的；v. （使）冷却，（使）变凉；（感情）冷静下来，冷淡下来；adv. 冷静地，镇定地；n. 凉快，凉爽；平静，镇静；时髦，酷；【名】 （Cool）（英）库尔，（法）科尔（人名）
definition: 1. n. the quality of being at a refreshingly low temperature；2. v. make cool or cooler
example: So when I expand this gas adiabatically and it cools down, why do you think it might cool down?
exampleZh: 现在我们知道了气体绝热膨胀时,温度会下载，为什么会降温？

meaning: adj. 装门面的，表面的；化妆用的，美容的；整容的；不重要的，没意义的；n. 化妆品，美容品
definition: 1. substances that you put on your face or body that are intended to improve your appearance；2. Cosmetic changes, etc. are intended to make you believe that something is better when, really, the problem has not been solved
example: She received a cosmetic makeover at a beauty salon as a birthday gift.
exampleZh: 作为生日礼物，她得到了在一家美容院美容的机会。

meaning: adj. 昂贵的，值钱的；造成严重损失的，代价大的；【名】 （Costly）（英）科斯特利（人名）
definition: 1. adj. entailing great loss or sacrifice；2. adj. having a high price
example: The best equipment is costly but is well worth the outlay.
exampleZh: 最好的设备花费大，但这种开支很值得。

meaning: n. 覆盖范围；新闻报道；保险范围；课程内容；防守，盯守
definition: 1. n. the total amount and type of insurance carried；2. n. the extent to which something is covered
example: Now a special TV network gives live coverage of most races.
exampleZh: 现在一个专门的电视网对大多数比赛进行现场报道。

meaning: n. 母牛，奶牛；雌性动物；讨厌的人（或事物、情况）；v. 恐吓，威胁
definition: 1. n. female of domestic cattle:；2. v. subdue, restrain, or overcome by affecting with a feeling of awe; frighten (as with threats)
example: So, it's awkward to have to wait for a cow to get infected before you can vaccinate a population.
exampleZh: 在给人们预防接种之前,你只有干等着,直到有一头奶牛感染了病毒才行

meaning: n. 工艺，手艺；船，艇，飞行器；诡计，骗术；行业，职业；手工艺品；v. 精心制作；【名】 （Craft）（英、德、罗）克拉夫特（人名）
definition: 1. n. the skilled practice of a practical occupation；2. v. make by hand and with much skill
example: He has a genuine and abiding love of the craft.
exampleZh: 他对这门手艺有着一种发自内心和持久不变的热爱。

meaning: v. 渴望；恳求，请求；【名】 （Crave）（法）克拉夫（人名）
definition: 1. to have a very strong feeling of wanting something；2. to desire something strongly
example: It is only natural for youngsters to crave the excitement of driving a fast car.
exampleZh: 年轻人渴望开快车的刺激相当自然。

meaning: n. 渴望，热望，渴求（常与 for 连用）；v. 渴望；恳求（crave 的 ing 形式）
definition: n. an intense desire for some particular thing
example: Escaping our craving for paper will be anything but an easy affair.
exampleZh: 摆脱我们对纸张的渴望绝非易事。

meaning: n. 全体船员，全体机组人员；一组工作人员；一伙人，一帮人；全体划船队员；赛艇运动；（尤指演奏车库音乐的）一群乐师；v. 当船员，当空乘人员；【名】 （Crew）（英、西）克鲁（人名）
definition: 1. n. the men who man a ship or aircraft；2. v. serve as a crew member on
example: Sexy? A little, maybe; those full, slightly parted lips, that windswept hair, the general J. Crew look.
exampleZh: 性感吗？或许有一点;,饱满微开的嘴唇，随风飘散的头发，典型美国派的外表。

meaning: v. 批评，指责；评论
definition: v. find fault with; express criticism of; point out real or perceived flaws；v. act as a critic
example: We were taught how to criticize poems.
exampleZh: 我们学习了怎样评论诗歌。

meaning: adv. 关键地，至关重要地；重要的是，关键的是
definition: adv. to a crucial degree
example: I want to point to a different question that-- I think it's a crucially important question.
exampleZh: 我想提出另一个问题-,非常关键的问题。

meaning: n. 暗示，提示；（戏剧或电影中的）尾白，提示；（台球等的）球杆；线索；选听（或选看）键；v. 提示，暗示；用球杆击球；【名】 （Cue）（西）库埃（人名）
definition: 1. n. an actor's line that immediately precedes and serves as a reminder for some action or speech；2. v. assist (somebody acting or reciting) by suggesting the next words of something forgotten or imperfectly learned
example: She stood in the wings and waited for her cue to go on.
exampleZh: 她站在舞台侧面等待着出场的提示。

meaning: v. 控制，抑制；勒住（马）；n. 控制，抑制；路缘，马路牙子；（马的跗关节后部因扭伤韧带引起的）硬瘤
definition: 1. n. an edge between a sidewalk and a roadway consisting of a line of curbstones (usually forming part of a gutter)；2. v. lessen the intensity of; temper; hold in restraint; hold or keep within limits
example: Jay jumped to his feet and ran outside just as an ambulance skidded to the curb.
exampleZh: 杰跳了起来，跑了出去，这时一辆救护车滑到了路边。

meaning: n. 数据集，资料组
example: "An ultimate face recognition algorithm should perform with billions of people in a dataset," the researchers wrote.
exampleZh: “最终的人脸识别算法应该能在一个数据集里处理数十亿人的数据。”研究人员写道。

meaning: v. 变得明朗，开始清楚；破晓，开始；n. 拂晓，黎明；曙光，开端；【名】 （Dawn）（西）道恩（人名）
definition: 1. n. the first light of day；2. v. become clear or enter one's consciousness or emotions
example: First,they don't meet in the daytime; they meet either early before light,at dawn, or after dark,at night.
exampleZh: 首先，他们不在白天聚会;,要么在天亮前的黎明，要么在天黑后的夜晚。

meaning: v. 认为，相信；【名】 （Deem）（英）迪姆 （人名）
definition: 1. v. keep in mind or convey as a conviction or view
example: Mainstream organizations will go for what they deem are safe bets rather than venture into unknown territories.
exampleZh: 主流组织将选择他们认为安全的事情，而不是冒险进入未知领域。

meaning: n. 防御，保卫；防御物，防御能力；国防机构，国防体系；辩解，辩白；被告，辩护律师；（法庭上的）辩护，答辩； 防守队员，防守；（竞赛中的）卫冕，（选举中的）保住席位；戒备心理，自我防卫；国际象棋的防御（黑棋的某种特定走法）
definition: n. (sports) the team that is trying to prevent the other team from scoring；n. military action or resources protecting a country against potential enemies
example: The DAP will set up a framework to increase defense and strategic cooperation.
exampleZh: 发展援助计划将建立一个框架，加强国防与战略协作。

meaning: v. 延期，推迟；听从，遵从（defer to）；【名】 （Defer）（法）德费（人名）
definition: 1. to delay something until a later time；2. to delay something until a later time; to postpone
example: as Joyce would say--stream of consciousness, I understand difference temporally. I defer difference. I unfold.
exampleZh: 乔伊斯会说，意识流，我只是暂时地理解了差异，推迟了差异，将之打开。

meaning: adv. 肯定地，当然；明确地，确定地
definition: 1. adv. without question and beyond doubt
example: But... there're definitely, it's definitely a campus that gives you a lot of opportunities to do unique things.
exampleZh: 但是……我们校园的确给学生提供了充足的机会来获得特别的体验。

meaning: v. 砍伐（某地）的树林，毁林
definition: v. remove the trees from
example: I intend that humans cease to deforest and reforest those regions that have been deforested.
exampleZh: 我希望人类停止滥砍伐，并对那些已经过度砍伐的森林重新造林。

meaning: adj. 故意的，蓄意的；从容的，小心翼翼的；深思熟虑的；v. 仔细考虑，认真商讨
definition: 1. v. think about carefully; weigh；2. adj. by conscious design or purpose
example: The deliberate cruelty of his words cut her like a knife.
exampleZh: 他故意说的残酷无情的话对她像刀割一样。

meaning: n. 错觉；妄想
definition: 1. belief in something that is not true；2. something a person believes and wants to be true, when it is actually not true
example: Insinuations about her mental state, about her capacity for delusion, were being made.
exampleZh: 当时有对她的精神状态的影射——说她有妄想症的影射。

meaning: n. （组织或机构中的）部，司，系，处，科；（商场里的）部；专长，专责；（法国等国的）省
definition: 1. n. a specialized division of a large organization；2. n. the territorial and administrative division of some countries (such as France)
example: but I'm more in the biology department, so that's about all I can tell you on that front.
exampleZh: 但是我是生物系的，所以我能说的就这么多了，

meaning: adj. 可靠的，可信赖的
definition: 1. adj. worthy of reliance or trust；2. adj. worthy of being depended on
example: He was a good friend, a dependable companion.
exampleZh: 他是个好朋友，一个可以信赖的同伴。

meaning: v. 大量减少，耗尽
definition: 1. to reduce something in size or amount, especially supplies of energy, money, etc.；2. to reduce something in size or amount, esp. supplies, energy, or money
example: Surely it is an economic nonsense to deplete the world of natural resources.
exampleZh: 耗尽世界的自然资源无疑是一件经济上的愚蠢行为。

meaning: v. 部署，调度；利用
definition: 1. to use something or someone, especially in an effective way；2. to move soldiers or equipment to a place where they can be used when they are needed
example: Speech is the way in which we appropriate, deploy and make use of language, and Saussure calls that "parole."
exampleZh: 话语是我们使用语言，分配部署语言的结果，索绪尔叫它，个人语言“

meaning: v. 值得，应受
definition: 1. v. be worthy or deserving
example: And the poor don't deserve, don't deserve the benefits that would flow from taxing Michael Jordan to help them.
exampleZh: 你是说穷人不应得到这些福利,不值得通过向乔丹征税来救济他们。

meaning: v. 把……定名为，把……描述为；任命，指定；标明，标示；adj. 已当选而尚未上任的
definition: 1. to choose someone officially to do a particular job；2. to say officially that a place or thing has a particular quality or purpose
example: There are efforts under way to designate the bridge a historic landmark.
exampleZh: 在努力把这座桥定为历史地标。

meaning: v. 破坏，毁灭；杀死，人道毁灭（受伤、生病或危险的动物）；彻底打败，击溃；毁掉……的生活，使垮掉
definition: 1. v. do away with, cause the destruction or undoing of；2. v. destroy completely; damage irreparably
example: The virus can actually destroy those white blood cells, leaving the body wide open to attack from other infections.
exampleZh: 该病毒实际上能破坏那些白血球，使身体极易受到其他感染。

meaning: v. 毁坏，破坏；使极度震惊，使伤心欲绝
definition: 1. to destroy a place or thing completely or cause great damage；2. to make someone feel very shocked and upset
example: When cyclones devastate a city, when homes collapse in a sudden earthquake, the most urgent need is medical attention.
exampleZh: 当气旋毁灭一座城市时，当房屋在突如其来的地震中倒塌时，人们最迫切需要的是医疗看护。

meaning: n. 开发商，开发公司；开发者，研制者；显影剂，显色剂；（在特定时间或以特定速度）成长（或发育成熟）的人
definition: 1. n. someone who develops real estate (especially someone who prepares a site for residential or commercial use)；2. n. photographic equipment consisting of a chemical solution for developing film
example: A developer bought the land and divided it into stands.
exampleZh: 开发商买下这块土地将其分为多块建筑用地。

meaning: n. 柴油；内燃机，柴油车；【名】 (Diesel）（德）狄塞耳（人名）
definition: 1. a type of heavy oil used as fuel；2. any vehicle, especially a train, that has a diesel engine
example: And so people definitely go down there to pick up some items that they can't get at Tom Ford or Diesel.
exampleZh: 所以人们一定是去那儿采购一些在汤姆•福特和狄塞尔买不到的东西。

meaning: n. 尊严，自尊；庄严，端庄，庄重；尊贵，高贵，高尚；高位，显职
definition: 1. n. the quality of being worthy of esteem or respect；2. n. formality in bearing and appearance
example: The two accounts are extremely different but they both Signal the unique position and dignity of the human being.
exampleZh: 这两种描述是截然不同的，但是它们都,表明了人类特有的地位和尊严。

meaning: v. 进餐，吃饭；宴请；【名】 （Dine）（英）戴恩，（意、葡）迪内，（法）迪纳（人名）
definition: 1. v. have supper; eat dinner；2. v. give dinner to; host for dinner
example: Will you dine à la carte or take the table d'hôte?
exampleZh: 您是要点菜还是选套餐？

meaning: n. 正餐，晚餐；晚宴，宴会；速食饭，方便饭；【名】 （Dinner）（法）迪内（人名）
definition: 1. n. the main meal of the day served in the evening or at midday；2. n. a party of people assembled to have dinner together
example: For example,I said this meal they have, it's called "the boss's dinner." We call it the Lord's Supper.
exampleZh: 比如，我前面说他们聚餐，叫“老板请客“，我们现在称之为圣餐。

meaning: n. 二氧化物
definition: 1. n. an oxide containing two atoms of oxygen in the molecule
example: And so I think we need to take action as soon as possible to start reducing carbon dioxide emissions.
exampleZh: 所以我觉得我们需要尽快开始行动，减少二氧化碳排放。

meaning: n. 外交官，外交家；有手腕的人，善交际的人
definition: 1. n. an official engaged in international negotiations；2. n. a person who deals tactfully with others
example: The two countries have each expelled another diplomat following a round of tit-for-tat expulsions.
exampleZh: 在一轮以牙还牙的驱逐行动之后，这两个国家又分别驱逐了一位外交官。

meaning: n. 分歧，争论；不符，不一致
definition: 1. n. a conflict of people's opinions or actions or characters；2. n. a difference between conflicting facts or claims or opinions
example: If there's a disagreement among students in a team project, what would you guys do to mend it?
exampleZh: 如果你们队友之间出现矛盾，你们会如何处理呢？

meaning: n. 发现，被发现的事物；（法律）强制性透露
definition: 1. n. the act of discovering something；2. n. something that is discovered
example: And the way that we'll do this is starting with talking about the discovery of the electron and the nucleus here.
exampleZh: 在这之后,我们就可以通过,经典力学来描述一个原子。

meaning: n. 歧视，区别对待；区分，辨别；辨别力，鉴赏力
definition: 1. n. unfair treatment of a person or group on the basis of prejudice；2. n. the cognitive process whereby two or more stimuli are distinguished
example: Now one of the main questions going to face your advisory council is the question of discrimination on hiring.
exampleZh: 现在，一个主要问题将会,摆在你们顾问委员会面前，那就是,雇佣歧视的问题。

meaning: v. 开除，解雇；不考虑，不理会；驳回，停止受理；让……离开，解散；（板球）使退场，使出局
definition: 1. v. bar from attention or consideration；2. v. cease to consider; put out of judicial consideration
example: In The Iliad, as you can see, the warrior Glaucus uses the simile of the leaves to dismiss the importance of genealogy.
exampleZh: 在里，你们会发现，武士格劳休斯,用了落叶的比喻来降低家族谱系的重要性。

meaning: v. 分散，散布；疏散，驱散；使（光）色散；adj. 分散的
definition: 1. to spread across or move away over a large area, or to make something do this；2. to scatter or move away over a large area, or to cause this to happen
example: Police used tear gas to disperse the crowds.
exampleZh: 警察使用催泪瓦斯驱散人群。

meaning: adv. 不成比例地
definition: adv. out of proportion；adv. to a disproportionate degree
example: During the 1990-91 recession, African-Americans suffered disproportionately.
exampleZh: 在1990到1991年的经济衰退中，非洲裔美国人遭受了不成比例的损失。

meaning: v. 使分心，使转移注意力；使困惑，使迷惑
definition: 1. v. draw someone's attention away from something；2. v. disturb in mind or make uneasy or cause to be worried or alarmed
example: It was all a ploy to distract attention from his real aims.
exampleZh: 那全是障眼法，借以转移对他真实目的的注意。

meaning: n. 分发；分销，配送；（电影在各院线的）发行，上映；分配，分布
definition: 1. n. (statistics) an arrangement of values of a variable showing their observed or theoretical frequency of occurrence；2. n. the spatial property of being scattered about over an area or volume
example: He tried to even out the distribution of work among his employees.
exampleZh: 他尽量把工作平均分配给雇员。

meaning: n. 多样性，多样化；不同，差异
definition: 1. n. noticeable heterogeneity；2. n. the condition or result of being changed
example: So this course is actually going to run counter to that historical tendency to make unity out of diversity.
exampleZh: 所以这一课程,是与历史趋同的趋势相悖的。

meaning: n. 穹顶，圆屋顶；半球形物，圆顶状物；v. 变圆，膨胀；加穹顶（状物）于；【名】 （Dome）（法）多姆（人名）
definition: 1. a rounded roof on a building or a room, or a building with such a roof；2. a shape like one-half of a ball
example: The use of steel and concrete has allowed the builders to perch a light concrete dome on eight slender columns.
exampleZh: 钢筋混凝土的使用使建筑者们能将一个轻巧的混凝土穹顶架在8根细柱上。

meaning: n. 责任，义务；上班，值班；职责，任务；税，关税；兵役；（牧师的）行礼拜式；（发动机的）功率；【名】 （Duty）（英）迪蒂（人名）
definition: 1. n. work that you are obliged to perform for moral or legal reasons；2. n. the social force that binds you to the courses of action demanded by that force
example: Some others If I might have a right to X, do you have a duty to fulfill that for me?
exampleZh: 其他的像如果我有某项权利，你有没有义务帮我实现？

meaning: adj. 热切的，渴望的，渴求的；【名】 （Eager）（英）伊格（人名）
definition: 1. n. a high wave (often dangerous) caused by tidal flow (as by colliding tidal currents or in a narrow estuary)；2. adj. having or showing keen interest or intense desire or impatient expectancy
example: The company is eager to gain a foothold in Europe.
exampleZh: 这家公司急于在欧洲取得一席之地。

meaning: n. 东，东方（the east）；（世界或某个国家、地区或城市的）东部；东方（指亚洲南部和东部，包括印度、中国和日本）（the East）；（旧时）东欧共产主义国家（the East）；（桥牌）坐在东首位置的人（East）；adj. 近东的，面朝东的；（特定的地区、城市、国家或其居民）东部的；东风的；在教堂设有圣坛的一端的（实际上的东端）；adv. 向东，在东方；【名】 （East）（美、英、加）伊斯特（人名）
definition: 1. n. the cardinal compass point that is at 90 degrees；2. adj. situated in or facing or moving toward the east
example: The epic also explains and mirrors the rise of Babel as one of the great cities in the Ancient Near East.
exampleZh: 史诗也解释并且映射了巴比伦王国的兴起,它是古代近东繁盛的城市之一。

meaning: vt. 使电气化；使激动，使振奋，使震惊；使带电，使充电，使通电；使触电
definition: v. excite suddenly and intensely；v. charge (a conductor) with electricity
example: The company calculates that at full output, each megawatt of installed capacity can electrify 650 homes.
exampleZh: 该公司预计，在全部完工后，每一个兆瓦级装机容量可以向650户家庭供电。

meaning: n. 电子邮件（通信方式）；电子邮件；v. 给（某人）发电子邮件；【名】 （Email）（法）埃马伊（人名）
definition: 1. n. (computer science) a system of world-wide electronic communication in which a computer user can compose a message at one terminal that is generated at the recipient's terminal when he logs in；2. v. communicate electronically on the computer
example: Those email messages have given us lots of important feedbacks regarding how people are going to use the site.
exampleZh: 关于人们怎样使用这一网站的,很好的反馈信息,开放课程软件的影响。

meaning: v. （使）尴尬，窘迫；使难堪，使为难；妨碍（人，移动，行动）；使困难重重，使复杂化
definition: 1. v. cause to be embarrassed; cause to feel self-conscious；2. v. hinder or prevent the progress or accomplishment of
example: I didn't want to embarrass him by kissing him in front of his friends.
exampleZh: 我并没想当着他的朋友吻他而使他感到难堪。

meaning: adv. 在情感上，情绪上，感情上；激动地，动情地，情绪冲动地
definition: adv. in an emotional manner；adv. with regard to emotions
example: When Yeats aestheticizes the political, he makes it moving, moving in the literal sense of, I think, emotionally engaging and cathartic.
exampleZh: 叶芝将政治艺术化时，他使之变得感人，在文字上很感人，我想它使人情绪感染，灵魂净化。

meaning: v. 雇用；使用，利用；忙于，从事（be employed in）；n. 受雇（in the employ of）
definition: 1. n. the state of being employed or having a job；2. v. put into service; make work or employ (something) for a particular purpose or for its inherent or natural purpose
example: We'll have to check him out before we employ him.
exampleZh: 我们得先调查一下再雇用他。

meaning: v. 遭遇；偶遇，邂逅；n. 偶遇，邂逅；经历，体验；冲突；比赛，交锋
definition: 1. n. a minor short-term fight；2. v. come together
example: In high school, I was very unpopular, and I did encounter a little prejudice.
exampleZh: 在中学，我很不受欢迎，确实遇到了一点偏见。

meaning: adj. （动植物）濒危的
definition: adj. (of flora or fauna) in imminent danger of extinction
example: The society was set up to preserve endangered species from extinction.
exampleZh: 成立这个协会是为了保护濒危物种不致灭绝。

meaning: n. 结尾，结局；后缀，词尾；终止，终结；末梢；v. 结束；终止（end 的现在分词形式）
definition: 1. n. the end of a word (a suffix or inflectional ending or final morpheme)；2. n. the act of ending something
example: In Lycidas Milton doesn't let himself, thank God, go quite so far as he does in this amazing ending to "Damon's Epitaph."
exampleZh: 感谢上帝，在《利西达斯》中，弥尔顿做的不像，他在《达蒙的墓志铭》的结尾那样过火“

meaning: v. 实施，执行（法律、规章）；强迫，迫使；竭力使人接受（要求，论点）
definition: 1. v. ensure observance of laws and rules；2. v. compel to behave in a certain way
example: It's the job of the police to enforce the law.
exampleZh: 警察的工作就是执法。

meaning: n. 婚约，订婚；约会，约定；交战，战斗；演出任务；聘用，雇用；参加，从事；(与……的)密切关系，(对……的)了解；啮合；（与……的）密切关系，（对……的）了解
definition: 1. n. a hostile meeting of opposing military forces in the course of a war；2. n. a meeting arranged in advance
example: This is the result, this is the fruit, of the hermeneutic engagement between horizons that results in meaning.
exampleZh: 这是阐释学的结果，它的产物，不同视域会合的阐释学能得到文章的含义。

meaning: n. 工程，工程学；控制，引导，管理；筹划，出谋划策；v. 设计，建造；策划，精心安排（engineer 的现在分词形式）
definition: 1. n. the practical application of science to commerce or industry；2. n. the discipline dealing with the art or science of applying scientific knowledge to practical problems
example: I figured Chemical Engineering would be the best way to get into it because it's a really broad major.
exampleZh: 我发现化学工程应该是接触新能源的最好方式，因为这个专业覆盖面也很广。

meaning: adj. 巨大的，极大的；凶暴的，极恶的
definition: 1. adj. extraordinarily large in size or extent or amount or power or degree
example: So the reasons for this really enormous shift in plans, and the enormous shift in subject matter, are worth exploring.
exampleZh: 弥尔顿的计划变化为何如此之大，他对主题的选择为何有这么大的改变，是值得探究的。

meaning: n. 热衷者，爱好者；热烈支持者，热情赞成者；基督教狂热分子
definition: 1. n. an ardent and enthusiastic supporter of some person or activity；2. n. a person having a strong liking for something
example: The exhibition is interesting to both the enthusiast and the casual visitor.
exampleZh: 热心的爱好者和碰巧来参观的人都认为这个展览有意思。

meaning: adj. 热心的，热情的
definition: 1. adj. having or showing great excitement and interest
example: And as you can see, the children were really encouraged, and they were also enthusiastic to read all of these books.
exampleZh: 你能看出来,学生们都很积极，他们充满了热情,去读所有这些书。

meaning: n. 时代，年代，纪元；【名】 （Era）（意、芬、印）埃拉（人名）
definition: 1. n. a period marked by distinctive character or reckoned from a fixed point or event；2. n. a major division of geological time; an era is usually divided into two or more periods
example: But whenever we've had a reform era there's been a big issue, or two or three or four.
exampleZh: 但每当我们有一个改革的时代,都会存在一个,两个,三个或者四个大问题

meaning: v. （使）变得严重，（使）升级；迅速增加，迅速增长；逐步增强，逐步升高
definition: 1. to become or make something become greater or more serious；2. to involve someone more important or higher in rank in a situation or problem
example: Conditions are still very tense and the fighting could escalate at any time.
exampleZh: 形势依然很紧张，战斗随时可能升级。

meaning: n. 本质，要素；香精，香料；【名】 （Essence）（英）埃森丝（人名）
definition: 1. n. the choicest or most essential or most vital part of some idea or experience；2. n. any substance possessing to a high degree the predominant properties of a plant or drug or other natural product from which it is extracted
example: For many, the essence of French living is to be found in the rural heartlands.
exampleZh: 对许多人来说，法国生活方式的精髓要到心脏地带的乡村去寻找。

meaning: n. 尊重，敬重；v. 尊重，敬重；认为，把……看作
definition: 1. respect for or a good opinion of someone；2. to respect someone or something or have a good opinion of them
example: Right. I just think when he went abroad, he wasn't respected that he lost self-esteem. And so I think that's why.
exampleZh: 对，我想当他在国外的时候，他没有得到十分的尊重因而丧失了自尊,我觉得这也是为什么。

meaning: v. 评价，评估，估值；求（方程式，公式，函数）的数值
definition: 1. v. place a value on; judge the worth of something；2. v. form a critical opinion of
example: I don't know how to evaluate everything Icahn has done but some corporate raiders have been unkind to employees.
exampleZh: 我不清楚如何评估伊坎,做过的所有的事情，但是一些公司蓄意收购者,一直以来对雇员都不友善。

meaning: n. 评价，评估
definition: 1. n. act of ascertaining or fixing the value or worth of；2. n. an appraisal of the value of something
example: This is where evaluation comes in. The success or failure of a poem depends on the realization of meaning.
exampleZh: 这时就需要评估介入了，一首诗好与坏,取决于它含义表达是否清晰。

meaning: pron. 每个人，人人
definition: 1. abstract: "Everybody" is a dance/house single by Russian DJ Leonid Rudenko. The song features vocals from Kelly Barnes -a singer/songwriter in Los Angeles from the band Ragsy.
example: It was a question of constructing an elaborate formal edifice to which everybody could contribute. Students got excited about it.
exampleZh: 现在的精读已形成了一种精确而正式的体系,每个人都可以做出自己的贡献，学生当然会对此感兴趣。

meaning: v. 精通，擅长；超过，胜过
definition: 1. v. distinguish oneself
example: or even to make it through school or to do well or excel at school.
exampleZh: 或者甚至是完成学业或者在学校成绩好。

meaning: n. 例外，除外
definition: 1. n. a deliberate act of omission；2. n. an instance that does not conform to a rule or generalization
example: Nobody had much money at the time and I was no exception.
exampleZh: 那时候谁都没有很多钱，我也不例外。

meaning: n. 令人激动（或兴奋）的事，刺激因素；激动，兴奋；性兴奋
definition: 1. n. the feeling of lively and cheerful joy；2. n. the state of being emotionally aroused and worked up
example: Whatever excitement they may have entailed in the long run, we feel as we wake up that they go on too long.
exampleZh: 因为任何刺激的情节放在这么长的梦里，我们醒来都会觉得持续得太久了。

meaning: vt. （故意）不包括，把……排除在外；认为……不可能，排除……的可能；阻挡；开除（学生）；防止……的发生
definition: 1. v. prevent from being included or considered or accepted；2. v. prevent from entering; shut out
example: I cannot entirely exclude the possibility that some form of pressure was applied to the neck.
exampleZh: 我不能完全排除有些压力作用到了颈部的可能性。

meaning: n. 排斥，排除在外；被排除在外的人（或事物）；认为不可能；（合约中的）除外事项；开除学籍
definition: 1. n. the state of being excluded；2. n. the state of being excommunicated
example: many of these ion channels have this size exclusion pore, it's a very important part of them.
exampleZh: 很多离子通道也都有这样的具有尺寸排斥性的小孔，这是它们非常重要的组成部分。

meaning: adj. 独有的，专用的；高档的，昂贵的；不含……的；排外的；排斥的；全部的；唯一关心的；（新闻或报道）独家的；（条款）除外责任的；高级的，昂贵的；n. 独家新闻，独家报道
definition: 1. n. a news report that is reported first by one news organization；2. adj. not divided or shared with others
example: Our group will have exclusive use of a 60-foot boat.
exampleZh: 我们组将有一条专用的60英尺的船。

meaning: adj. 奇异的，异国风情的；n. 外来植物，外来动物
definition: 1. unusual and exciting because of coming (or seeming to come) from far away, especially a tropical country；2. strange in an attractive way
example: I was beguiled by the romance and exotic atmosphere of the souks in Marrakech.
exampleZh: 我被马拉喀什剧场浪漫的异国情调迷住了。

meaning: n. 扩大，扩张；扩充，展开；扩张物；膨胀
definition: 1. n. the act of increasing (something) in size or volume or quantity or scope；2. n. a discussion that provides additional information
example: Adiabatic meaning there's no heat involved, and we're going to see how that differs from the isothermal expansion and compression.
exampleZh: 绝热意味着没有热量的传递，我们将看到它,与等温过程的区别。

meaning: adj. 清楚明白的，明确的，详述的；直截了当的，坦率的；赤裸裸表现性爱（或暴力）的，露骨的；n. （手稿、早期印刷品或礼拜仪式上唱诗的）结束语
definition: 1. adj. precisely and clearly expressed or readily observable; leaving nothing to implication；2. adj. in accordance with fact or the primary meaning of a term
example: So, inside of code, or inside of a script, there's no print, unless we make it explicit.
exampleZh: 因此，在代码里面，或者在脚本里面，不会有显示结果的功能，除非我们让它这么做。

meaning: n. 暴露，接触；曝光，揭发；报道，宣传；单张胶片；曝光时间，曝光量；受冻；朝向
definition: 1. n. vulnerability to the elements; to the action of heat or cold or wind or rain；2. n. the act of subjecting someone to an influencing experience
example: And,again,to us in the modern world, if you didn't already have some exposure to religious narratives like this,that would sound odd.
exampleZh: 同样的，对现代人来说，如果没接触过这类宗教描述,可能会觉得奇怪。

ipa: ˌfeɪs tə ˈfeɪs / ˌfeɪs tə ˈfeɪs
meaning: adj. 面对面的，当面的；adv. 面对面地，当面地；（face-to-face with）与…当面相见，直面，遭遇
definition: adj. in each other's presence；adv. within each other's presence
example: Do we want to be electronically delivered or do we want to have face-to-face component?
exampleZh: 想借电子技术传达信息,还是想面对面交流？

meaning: v. 逐渐消失；（使）褪色，（使）变暗；枯萎，凋谢；变得虚弱；退步；（车辆的刹车因摩擦发热而）暂时失灵；（使）（电影或电视画面）淡入（或淡出）另一画面；变得默默无闻，变得无关紧要；（高尔夫球）偏离直线；接受（掷骰子者）的打赌；n. 淡入，淡出；褪色，变暗；（高尔夫球运动员故意击出的）向右偏离球；adj. 平淡的，乏味的；【名】 （Fade）（法）法德（人名）
definition: 1. n. a golf shot that curves to the right for a right-handed golfer；2. v. become less clearly visible or distinguishable; disappear gradually or seemingly
example: III Yonder a maid and her wight Come whispering by: War's annals will fade into night Ere their story die.
exampleZh: 那边一个女仆和她的同伴,走进来低语：,在故事结束前战争会没入夜色中。

meaning: n. 幻想，想象；想象产物，幻想作品；虚拟比赛（游戏）；幻想曲，集成曲；期望；v. 想象，幻想
definition: 1. n. imagination unrestricted by reality；2. v. indulge in fantasies
example: I mentioned in the last lecture that the famous flower passage here of course is -- this is pure fantasy.
exampleZh: 我在上次上课时说过，这段非常著名的花之段落,是一种纯粹的幻想。

meaning: n. 农田，耕地
definition: n. a rural area where farming is practiced；n. arable land that is worked by plowing and sowing and raising crops
example: So, the citadel and the farmland surrounding it, make up fundamentally the unit which is the Mycenaean kingdom.
exampleZh: 因此,以城堡和周围的农田为根基,组成了称为迈锡尼帝国的文明

meaning: v. （尤指蛇）以眼神震慑（人，动物），使无法动弹；深深吸引，迷住
definition: 1. v. cause to be interested or curious；2. v. to render motionless, as with a fixed stare or by arousing terror or awe
example: The private lives of movie stars never fail to fascinate.
exampleZh: 电影明星的私生活总为人所津津乐道。

meaning: n. 父亲，爸爸；祖先；发明者，创始人；（Father）天父，上帝；（Father）（尤指天主教和东正教的）神父；父亲般的人；（城邦、市镇等的）元老；（动物的）父代；保护人，庇护人；（Father）（用于拟人化的专有名称）……老人；早期基督教神学家；v. 是……的父亲；创立（新思想），创造，发明（新方法）；如父亲般对待（或抚养、照料）；确定（某人）的生父为……，确定（某事物）的责任应由……来承担
definition: 1. n. a male parent (also used as a term of address to your father)；2. v. make children
example: He goes into the freak show at the fair, and he joins the crowd where his father also is.
exampleZh: 他去市集去看畸形秀，挤入了他父亲也身处其中的人群。

meaning: n. 可行性，可能性
definition: 1. n. the quality of being doable
example: The committee will study the feasibility of setting up a national computer network.
exampleZh: 委员会将研究建立一个国家计算机网络的可行性。

meaning: n. 毛毡；v. （使）毡合；用毡覆盖；v. 感受到，体会到；觉得，相信；使人感觉……（feel 的过去式和过去分词）；【名】 （Felt）（美）费尔特（人名）
definition: n. a fabric made of compressed matted animal fibers；v. mat together and make felt-like
example: I felt like, in my hometown of Huston, it was cool, special, and different that I was an actor.
exampleZh: 在我的老家休斯顿，作为一名演员，我觉得很酷、很特别、很与众不同。

meaning: adv. 终于；总之，最后；决定性地，不可变更地
definition: 1. adv. after a long period of time or an especially long delay；2. adv. the item at the end
example: We then promised to move to an emphasis on psychological matters, and finally social and cultural determinants of literature.
exampleZh: 然后我们把重点转移到了心理学，最后还讨论了社会和文化对文学的决定因素。

meaning: n. 失火，火灾；火焰；炉火，灶火；取暖器；射击，火力；怒火，激情；严厉批评，猛烈批判；v. 射击，开火；射（箭）；扔，抛；点火，启动；连珠炮似的提出（问题）；解雇，开除；激发；烧制（陶器）
definition: 1. n. the event of something burning (often destructive)；2. v. start firing a weapon
example: You can see him, in a sense Yeats, cooling the fire in the head of Aengus at this moment.
exampleZh: 你们可以感受到此时叶芝正从,安古斯的狂热里冷静下来。

meaning: n. 鱼；鱼肉；双鱼座；接合板；鱼雷；（在某方面怪异的）怪人；v. 钓鱼，捕鱼；搜寻；在……中捕鱼；打听消息；用接合板修补；【名】 （Fish）（美、爱）菲施（人名）
definition: 1. n. any of various mostly cold-blooded aquatic vertebrates usually having scales and breathing through gills；2. v. seek indirectly
example: Because it's right near the river, people will catch the fish from the morning and put it into the restaurant.
exampleZh: 因为它就在河的旁边，人们早上捕鱼，然后把它送到饭店。

meaning: n. 缺点，缺陷；裂痕，瑕疵；v. 削弱，使失效
definition: 1. n. an imperfection in a device or machine；2. v. add a flaw or blemish to; make imperfect or defective
example: There is always a flaw in the character of a tragic hero.
exampleZh: 悲剧主角总有性格上的缺点。

meaning: n. 洪水泛滥；（医学）子宫大量出血，尤指产后出血；（心理学）满灌疗法，冲击疗法；（计算机网络）泛洪
definition: n. a technique used in behavior therapy; client is flooded with experiences of a particular kind until becoming either averse to them or numbed to them；adj. overfull with water
example: In the weeks since flooding began, 16 people have died statewide.
exampleZh: 洪水暴发几周以来，全州已有16人遇难。

meaning: v. 飞，飞行；乘飞机，搭乘（某公司航班）；驾驶（飞机）；空运；飞越；疾驰，快速移动；放飞（风筝）；飞舞，飘荡；悬挂，飘扬；（使）逃离，匆忙离开；成功；飞逝；击腾空球；流传，四处传播；（指责，谩骂）往来激烈；被认可，被接受；n. 苍蝇，假蝇；裤门襟；腾空球，高飞球；努力，尝试；（帐篷的）篷顶；（剧院）吊景区，悬吊布景的空间；单马出租马车；adj. 时髦漂亮的；机灵的；【名】 （Fly）（英）弗莱，（法）弗利（人名）
definition: 1. n. two-winged insects characterized by active flight；2. v. travel through the air; be airborne
example: And when he says that, his workers pull off the tarp and sparks fly from the chandelier.
exampleZh: 当他说这些话的时候，助手就把油布掀开了，然后就看到吊灯那里有火星飞出来。

meaning: n. 人们；家人，双亲；民间音乐；诸位，大伙儿；adj. 民俗的，传统的；流传民间的，普通百姓的；【名】 （Folk）（英、匈、捷）福克（人名）
definition: 1. n. people in general (often used in the plural)；2. n. a social division of (usually preliterate) people
example: What was the wonderful movie that had the Coen Brothers and all that great American folk music in it?
exampleZh: 是哪一部经典的电影,由科恩兄弟执导的,那里面有众多美妙的美国乡村乐

meaning: v. 形成，缔造；伪造，假冒；稳步前进；锻造；伪装，假冒；n. 锻铁炉，锻造车间；【名】 （Forge）（美）福格（人名）
definition: 1. n. furnace consisting of a special hearth where metal is heated before shaping；2. v. create by hammering
example: When I come in from the forge of a night, anyone can see me turning to at this.
exampleZh: 我夜里从铁匠铺一进屋，谁都能看见我着手做这件事。

meaning: adj. 旧时的；以前的，前……；（两者中）前者的；n. 模子，模型；形成某事的人（或事）；线圈架，绕线模；（机翼、机身的）翼肋；pron. （两者中的）前者；【名】 （Former）（法）福尔梅，（德、捷）福尔默（人名）
definition: 1. n. the first of two or the first mentioned of two；2. adj. referring to the first of two things or persons mentioned (or the earlier one or ones of several)
example: My home country is Croatia. I was born in and raised in what used to be the former Yugoslavia,
exampleZh: 我是克罗地亚人。我生长在从前的南斯拉夫。

meaning: n. 化石；思想僵化的人；僵化的事物；adj. 化石的，从地下采掘出的；不变的，古老的
definition: 1. n. someone whose style is out of fashion；2. adj. characteristic of a fossil
example: On a global scale, 77% of energy is created from fossil fuels.
exampleZh: 全球77%的能量产生自化石燃料。

meaning: v. 创办，成立；建造，兴建；根据，以……为基础；熔铸，铸造；adj. 偶然（或意外）发现的；（艺术）原汁原味的；装备好的；（用餐、供暖）不另外收费的；v. 找到，找回；发现，发觉；（经过研究）找出，查明（find 的过去式和过去分词形式）
definition: 1. n. food and lodging provided in addition to money；2. v. set up or found
example: stem cell researchers have found a way to get perfectly usable stem cells from fully grown human beings.
exampleZh: 干细胞研究者已经找到了一种方法，可以从成年人身上获取可用的干细胞。

meaning: n. 铸造工，铸造厂业主（或厂长）；创立者，缔造者；（动物）新群体建立者（尤指已受孕的雌性昆虫）；（马等有蹄动物的）蹄叶炎，马跛病；v. （船）沉没；（事业，计划）失败，垮掉；绊倒，摔倒；（尤指马等有蹄动物的）患蹄叶炎；感到寒冷；（牲口）因过食而得病
definition: 1. n. inflammation of the laminated tissue that attaches the hoof to the foot of a horse；2. v. fail utterly; collapse
example: Aristotle is considered the "father of criticism," and yet he is also what Foucault would call a "founder of discursivity."
exampleZh: 亚里士多德被认为是批判学之父“,但他是福柯承认的话语学奠基人“

meaning: adv. 自由地；免费地；大量地，慷慨地；直率地；自愿地
definition: adv. in a free manner
example: Millions of people gave freely in response to the appeal for the victims of the earthquake.
exampleZh: 为响应救济地震灾民的呼吁，几百万人慷慨相助。

meaning: v. 结冰；冻住；冷藏，冷冻；感到很冷，冻僵；突然停止，呆住；使（物价或工资等）固定不动；冻结（钱财）；使定格；（计算机屏幕因系统故障）被暂时锁定；n. 冻结；停止；冰冻期；霜冻
definition: 1. n. the withdrawal of heat to change something from a liquid to a solid；2. v. change to ice
example: It could be me that-- my cabin could burn down and I would freeze to death in the winter.
exampleZh: 因为也许中招的会是我-,我的房子可能被烧毁,冬天我可能会被冻死。

meaning: adj. 新鲜的；新近的，刚经历的；新的，不同的；新颖的，独创的；清新的，清爽的；（水）淡的，无盐的；（风）凉爽的，强劲的；洁净的，亮丽的；精力充沛的；刚来的；（对异性）放肆的，无礼的；年轻可爱但缺乏经验的；气味难闻的；adv. 刚刚，新近地
definition: 1. adj. recently made, produced, or harvested；2. adv. very recently
example: So if you want a real milk to drink, go to the cow and tell, "Give me fresh milk."
exampleZh: 所以，如果你想喝真正的牛奶了，就去跟牛说，“给我点儿新鲜牛奶吧。”

meaning: v. 使惊吓，使惊恐
definition: 1. v. cause fear in；2. v. drive out by frightening
example: All this was just designed to frighten me and keep me in line.
exampleZh: 所有这一切只是设计来吓唬我、让我守规矩。

meaning: n. 前线，火线；第一线，一线，最前沿（常与 the 连用）；锋线（包括大前锋、小前锋、中锋）；adj. 前线的，一线的，指直接在前线执行任务或直接面对服务对象的
definition: abstract: Frontline is the fifth album by the Australian folk-rock group Redgum.Redgum discography Album information
example: The idea is that away from the frontline, soldiers can swop stories and wind down with those who understand their immediate problems.
exampleZh: 这一理念就是远离前线，让战士们能互相分享经历，能在理解他们眼前问题的人面前放松下来。

meaning: vt. 履行（诺言、义务、职责等），执行（任务、命令等）；实现（梦想、愿望、抱负、潜能等）；满足（要求、需要、条件、期望等），达到（标准）；v. fulfill oneself：充分发挥自己的才能，实现自己的抱负
definition: v. put in effect；v. fulfil the requirements or expectations of
example: How gratifying it is to help a young lady fulfill her dreams and lower her financial burden!
exampleZh: 帮助一位年轻的女士实现她的梦想，减轻她的经济负担是多么令人欣慰啊！

meaning: n. 履行，实行，完成（承诺、责任、要求等）；满足（感），成就感；（物流）订单履行
definition: n. a feeling of satisfaction at having achieved your desires；n. the act of consummating something (a desire or promise etc)
example: Accomplishing an objective set by ourselves can give us a sense of fulfillment.
exampleZh: 完成我们自己设定的目标可以给我们带来满足感。

meaning: n. 聚集，聚会；搜集，采集；v. 聚集，召集；收集，采集；认为，推断（gather 的现在分词形式）
definition: 1. n. a group of persons together in one place；2. n. the social act of assembling
example: In the first example, you could be at a social gathering and you really feel the need for some nicotine.
exampleZh: 在第一个例子中，你可能在一个社交聚会上，你特别想找个地方抽根烟。

meaning: n. 谷物，谷粒；颗粒，细粒；少量；纹理；（表面的）质地，触感；格令（旧的重量单位，一格令相当于0.065克）；（照片、底片的）显影颗粒；（用于火箭发动机的）固体推进剂；（皮革或其他类似人工材料的）粗糙面，皱面；（石头和煤等原料的）解理面，劈理面；（人的）性格，天性；胭脂虫，胭脂虫红；v. 使表面（或纹理）粗糙；成粒状；（尤指将家具或内表面）漆成木纹（或大理石纹）；将（生皮）去毛；用谷物喂（马）；【名】 （Grain）（法）格兰（人名）
definition: 1. n. a small hard particle；2. v. thoroughly work in
example: Because the plywood has been sliced into thin pieces that are laminated cross-grain.
exampleZh: 因为胶合板是被分割的,层积的混合谷物的板子。

meaning: v. 授予，给予；承认；n. 补助金，拨款；（政府给予的）土地；给予，授予；合法转让；【名】 （Grant）（美）格朗（人名）
definition: 1. n. any monetary aid；2. v. let have
example: May no fate willfully misunderstand me And half grant what I wish and snatch me away not to return.
exampleZh: 别来个命运之神，故意曲解我,只成全我愿望的一半，把我卷了走。

meaning: v. 吃草；放牧；擦过；擦伤，擦破；经常吃零食而不吃正餐，吃很多零食；随意地尝试（或体验、浏览）；n. 擦伤
definition: 1. to break the surface of the skin by rubbing against something rough；2. If an object grazes something, it touches its surface lightly when it passes it
example: The land is used by local people to graze their animals.
exampleZh: 这块地当地人用来放牧。

meaning: n. 格力（品牌名）；〈古〉优越或胜利；〈古〉善意或恩惠；v. 〈古〉〈方〉（使）达成一致或和谐
definition: abstract: GREE is a Japanese social networking service founded by Yoshikazu Tanaka and operated by GREE, Inc..
example: The number of striations is commonly considered as a measure of mixing de-gree.
exampleZh: 通常用流体通过分流元件后形成的流体条纹数，即分流数来度量混合程度。

meaning: n. 食品杂货店，食品杂货业；食品杂货（groceries）
definition: 1. n. a marketplace where groceries are sold；2. n. (usually plural) consumer goods sold by a grocer
example: The grocery shop is offering customers 5 cents for each shopping bag re-used.
exampleZh: 该杂货店为顾客重复使用每个购物袋给5美分。

meaning: n. 落花生；野豆
definition: n. a North American vine with fragrant blossoms and edible tubers; important food crop of Native Americans；n. nutlike tuber; important food of Native Americans
example: Today she is making leaves from a local vegetable which she will mix with pounded groundnut to make a stew.
exampleZh: 今天，她扯了几片当地的蔬菜叶子，和着舂碎的花生炖了一锅汤。

meaning: v. 带领，引导（某人至某地）；任向导；指导，影响；解释，阐明；n. 指南，手册；导游，向导；准则，指针；女童子军，女童子军成员；【名】 （Guide）（法、葡）吉德（人名）
definition: 1. n. someone employed to conduct others；2. v. direct the course; determine the direction of travelling
example: I used to be a campus tour guide, and what I'd say is, you know, everyone uses a number.
exampleZh: 我以前是校园的导游，我要说的是，每个人都用数字。

meaning: n. 礼堂，大厅；门厅；走廊，过道；（大学的）学生宿舍；府邸，庄园；【名】 （Hall）（英）霍尔，（法）阿尔，（土）哈勒，（德、波、丹、芬、瑞典）哈尔（人名）
definition: 1. n. an interior passage or corridor onto which rooms open；2. n. a large entrance or reception room or area
example: And by his smile, I knew that sullen hall,-- By his dead smile I knew we stood in Hell.
exampleZh: 看着他的笑，我想起了阴沉压抑的礼堂-,看着他的笑，我想起了阴沉压抑的礼堂。

meaning: n. 处理，应对，对待；（货物、物料等的）搬运，装卸，操作；（车辆、机械等的）操纵性能，操控性；v. handle 的现在分词；拿；处理；应付；操纵；操作；负责
definition: n. manual (or mechanical) carrying or moving or delivering or working with something；n. the action of touching with the hands (or the skillful use of the hands) or by the use of mechanical means
example: There is a very significant job that is just handling the schedule.
exampleZh: 这是个非常重要的工作,仅仅是安排日程就非常重要。

meaning: v. 厌恶，不喜欢；仇恨，憎恨；（表示不愿说某事，或客气地请求）不愿，不想；n. 憎恶，憎恨；所憎恶的人（或事物）；【名】 （Hate）（法）阿特（人名）
definition: 1. n. the emotion of hate; a feeling of dislike so strong that it demands action；2. v. dislike intensely; feel antipathy or aversion towards
example: It's a... I'd hate to learn all by, when I was a little kid, when I learned, but...
exampleZh: 我小的时候很讨厌学，我学的时候…

meaning: v. （鬼魂）出没；萦绕在……心头；（长期）困扰；常去（某地）；n. 常去的地方；栖息地
definition: 1. n. a frequently visited place；2. v. follow stealthily or recur constantly and spontaneously to
example: Well, in Tennyson sound is the device, "the murmurous haunt"--oh, I have no memory at all today.
exampleZh: 在坦尼森的的作品中声音扮演同样的角色，那沙沙的萦绕之声，哦不，我记混了。

meaning: adv. 在很大程度上，大量地；慢慢地，沉重地；让人难受地，令人不快地；结实，坚实；装满（或装载）重物的，重载的；缓慢又高声地；缓慢而忧郁地，悲伤地
definition: adv. to a considerable degree；adv. in a heavy-footed manner
example: Grace sighed so heavily that Trish could hear it in the next room.
exampleZh: 格雷丝沉重地叹气，特蕾什在隔壁房间都听到了。

meaning: n. （农药）除草剂，除莠剂
definition: n. a chemical agent that destroys plants or inhibits their growth
example: The herbicide might damage populations of certain rare plant species that the lake contains.
exampleZh: 除草剂可能会破坏湖泊中某些稀有植物的种群。

ipa: ˌeɪtʃ ef ˈsiː / ˌeɪtʃ ef ˈsiː
meaning: abbr. 高频电流（high-frequency current）
definition: n. a fluorocarbon emitted as a by-product of industrial manufacturing
example: Most of the world's factories that produce HFC are in China.
exampleZh: 全球多数产生氢氟烃的工厂都在中国。

ipa: ˌhaɪd ən ˈsiːk / ˌhaɪd ən ˈsiːk
meaning: n. 捉迷藏（一种儿童游戏，一名玩家蒙眼或数数，其他玩家藏好后由前者寻找）；（比喻）回避、遮掩或难以捉摸的行为（常用于 play hide-and-seek with）
definition: n. a game in which a child covers his eyes while the other players hide then tries to find them
example: Where do we play hide-and-seek?
exampleZh: 我们在哪里玩捉迷藏？

meaning: n. 主人；主持人；主办者，东道主；寄主，宿主；接受移植组织（或器官）的受体；主机；（某种特别生物的）生存地；许多人（或物）；军队；（圣餐仪式中的）圣饼，圣体；v. 主办，做……的东道主；做节目主持人；作为主人组织（聚会），做东；（通常收费在与互联网连接的计算机上）存储网站
definition: 1. n. a person who invites guests to a social event (such as a party in his or her own home) and who is responsible for them while they are there；2. v. be the host of or for
example: Host: Flashback 29 years ago, and put yourself in the seat here and pretend you were still in school.
exampleZh: 主持人：回首29年前，假装你还坐在这儿,还在商学院念书。

meaning: n. 家庭，一家人；家务；王室（the Household）；adj. 家用的，家务的；全家人的；家喻户晓的；皇家的（Household）；【名】 （Household）（美、瑞）豪斯霍尔德（人名）
definition: 1. n. a social unit living together
example: The slaves and the freed persons of a Roman household Familia were legally the ones who were the familia.
exampleZh: 一户罗马家庭的奴隶及被释放的自由民,法律上就称为。

meaning: n. 室内植物，盆栽植物
definition: n. any of a variety of plants grown indoors for decorative purposes
example: With these tips, anyone can keep a houseplant alive - even you!
exampleZh: 采用下面的建议，任何人都能让室内植物保持存活——甚至是你。

meaning: v. （狗、狼等）嗥叫，长嚎；（因疼痛、愤怒、开心等）大声叫喊；（风）怒号，呼啸；怒吼，怒声要求；嚎哭；n. （狗、狼等）嗥叫，长嚎；（痛苦、愤怒、快乐的）嚎叫，咆哮；（狂风的）怒号，呼啸；颤噪效应
definition: 1. If a dog or wolf howls, it makes a long, sad sound；2. to make a loud sound, usually to express pain, sadness, or another strong emotion
example: They listened to the howl of the wind through the trees.
exampleZh: 他们听着风在林间呼啸的声音。

meaning: adj. 人造的，人为的
example: In the 21st century, the term has evolved to capture the need to combat human-made climate change.
exampleZh: 在21世纪，该词的含义已发生演变，涵盖了应对人为气候变化的需求。

meaning: adj. 水力发电的；水电治疗的
definition: adj. of or relating to or used in the production of electricity by waterpower
example: Plans are being drawn up to build a hydroelectric station here.
exampleZh: 这里正筹划建设一座水力发电站。

meaning: n. 意识形态，思想体系；观念学；空想
definition: 1. a set of beliefs or principles, especially one on which a political system, party, or organization is based；2. a particular set of ideas and beliefs, especially one on which a political system, party, or organization is based
example: He attributed the party's lack of success to an overemphasis on ideology and ideas.
exampleZh: 他将该党的不成功归咎与过分强调意识形态和观点。

meaning: n. 错觉，幻觉；幻想，错误的观念
definition: 1. n. an erroneous mental representation；2. n. something many people believe that is false
example: Mirrors in a room often give an illusion of space.
exampleZh: 房间里的镜子常给人一种空间增大的错觉。

meaning: n. 插图，图解；说明，例释；实例，示例
definition: 1. n. artwork that helps make something clear or attractive；2. n. showing by example
example: Let me, by way of illustration , quote from one of her poems.
exampleZh: 作为说明，让我援引她的一首诗。

meaning: adj. 富于想象力的，创新的；运用想象（力）的，虚构的
definition: 1. adj. (used of persons or artifacts) marked by independence and creativity in thought or action
example: You need to be more flexible and imaginative in your approach.
exampleZh: 你的方法必须更加灵活，更富有想象力。

meaning: n. 动力，促进；动量，冲力
definition: 1. something that encourages a particular activity or makes that activity more energetic or effective；2. a force that encourages a particular action or makes it more energetic or effective
example: By 1982, she was restless and needed a new impetus for her talent.
exampleZh: 到1982年，她焦躁不安，需要一个新的对其才华的推动力。

meaning: n. 可能的影响（或作用、结果）；含意，暗指；牵连，涉及
definition: 1. n. something that is inferred (deduced or entailed or implied)；2. n. a meaning that is not expressly stated but can be inferred
example: Implication in a murder finally brought him to the gallows.
exampleZh: 与一桩谋杀案的牵连最终把他送上了绞刑架。

meaning: v. 暗示，暗指；意味着；必然包含
definition: 1. v. express or state indirectly；2. v. suggest as a logically necessary consequence; in logic
example: Israel was chosen by Yahweh in an act of spontaneous love it does not imply her perfection an act of spontaneous love for the patriarchs.
exampleZh: 以色列被上帝选择是出于一种无意识的爱,这并不暗示着她是完美的,只是对族长无意识的喜欢。

meaning: v. 使钦佩，使留下深刻印象；使意识到（重要性或严重性等）；使铭记；压，压印；外加（电流，电势）；传送；强征；n. 压印，印记
definition: 1. n. the act of coercing someone into government service；2. v. have an emotional or cognitive impact upon
example: It didn't impress me as a good place to live.
exampleZh: 那地方没有给我留下适合居住的印象。

meaning: n. 冲动；脉冲；推动力；adj. 一时兴起的，随兴的；v. 推动
definition: 1. n. an instinctive motive；2. n. a sudden desire
example: Unable to resist the impulse, he glanced at the sea again.
exampleZh: 他抑制不住冲动，又看了一眼大海。

meaning: adj. 无能力的，不能的（常作表语，后接 of + 名词或动名词，表示“无法……、不会……”）；不能胜任的，无能的（指人，多含贬义）；不能……的，无法……的（用于事物或抽象概念，后接 of，表示不可能被……或不可能发生某种情况）
definition: adj. (followed by `of') lacking capacity or ability；adj. not being susceptible to or admitting of something (usually followed by `of')
example: If people keep telling you you're incapable, you begin to lose confidence in yourself.
exampleZh: 如果人们不断地对你说你无能，你就开始失去自信了。

meaning: n. 发生率；入射
definition: 1. n. the relative frequency of occurrence of something；2. n. the striking of a light beam on a surface
example: Authentic Italian cooking is very healthy—witness the low incidence of heart disease in Italy.
exampleZh: 正宗的意大利烹饪对健康非常有益，在意大利心脏病发病率低就是证据。

meaning: v. （使）倾向于；点头；（使）倾斜；赞同（某人，某事）；n. 斜坡，倾斜
definition: 1. n. an elevated geological formation；2. v. have a tendency or disposition to do or be something; be inclined
example: He stopped just as his truck tilted down the steep incline, put on the handbrake, and stepped out.
exampleZh: 就在他的卡车沿陡峭的斜坡向下滑的时候，他停了下来，拉住了手闸，然后下了车。

meaning: adv. 难以置信地；非常地
definition: 1. adv. not easy to believe
example: And so suddenly, you are thrown into a pool of so many other incredibly intelligent, driven people, and
exampleZh: 所以，突然之间，你发现周围人都是绝顶聪明，都是劲头十足的人，

meaning: n. 标志，迹象；方向灯，转向指示灯；指示器，显示器；指示剂；指示（物）种
definition: 1. n. a number or ratio (a value on a scale of measurement) derived from a series of observed facts; can reveal relative changes as a function of time；2. n. a signal for attracting attention
example: I mean buy could actually be a negative indicator that this is probably not of interest to the user.
exampleZh: 我的意思是购物可能是一个负面暗示,暗示用户对这些不是很有兴趣。

meaning: adj. 个人主义的；利己主义的；我行我素的，具有个人特色的
definition: adj. marked by or expressing individuality；adj. with minimally restricted freedom in commerce
example: An analysis based on such assumptions could be valid for a highly competitive, individualistic society.
exampleZh: 基于这种假设的分析可能对一个高度竞争、个人主义的社会有效。

meaning: n. 个性，个人特征；个体，单个实体；个人的嗜好
definition: n. the quality of being individual；n. the distinct personality of an individual regarded as a persisting entity
example: Self-expression and individuality are the greatest weapons against tyranny.
exampleZh: 自我表达和个性是对抗专制暴政的最强武器。

meaning: adj. 室内的，户内的
definition: 1. adj. located, suited for, or taking place within a building；2. adj. within doors
example: If the weather is wet or cold choose an indoor activity.
exampleZh: 如果下雨或是天气寒冷，就选择室内活动。

meaning: vt. 使（国家、地区或经济）工业化（industrialize 的英式拼写）；vi. （国家、地区或经济）实现工业化（industrialize 的英式拼写）
definition: v. organize the production of into an industry；v. develop industry; become industrial
example: As countries industrialise and diversify, their exports grow, which sometimes results in a trade surplus.
exampleZh: 随着这些国家的工业化和多样化，他们出口额增长，这有时会导致贸易顺差。

meaning: n. 不公平，不公正；不公平的事例，不公正的行为
definition: n. injustice by virtue of not conforming with rules or standards
example: It also means giving them the tools they need to address inequity and bias in their own lives.
exampleZh: 这也意味着，要为他们提供所需的工具，以应对他们自己生活中的不公和偏见。

meaning: adj. 便宜的，廉价的，不贵的
definition: adj. relatively low in price or charging low prices
example: We can easily think of a number of foods and recipes that are both inexpensive and nutritious.
exampleZh: 我们可以很容易地想到许多既便宜又营养的食物和食谱。

meaning: n. 婴儿，幼儿；（英国学校里四至七岁的）学童；未成年人；adj. 供婴幼儿用的；初期的，初创期的；四岁至七岁幼儿的；【名】 （Infant）（英）因方特（人名）
definition: 1. n. a very young child (birth to 1 year) who has not yet begun to walk or talk
example: There was an infant squalling in the back of the church.
exampleZh: 教堂的后面有个婴儿大声啼哭的声音。

meaning: v. 推断，推论；暗示，暗指
definition: 1. v. reason by deduction; establish by deduction；2. v. draw from specific cases for more general cases
example: Right. The unconscious, Freud is saying, is something that we have to infer from the way consciousness operates.
exampleZh: 弗洛伊德说潜意识，是由意识的活动方式中推断出来的。

meaning: n. 通货膨胀，通胀率；充气，膨胀，增大；（宇宙论某些理论）暴涨；夸张，自命不凡
definition: 1. n. a general and progressive increase in prices；2. n. (cosmology) a brief exponential expansion of the universe (faster than the speed of light) postulated to have occurred shortly after the big bang
example: Nationally, home prices in the United States rose 85% between 1997 and 2006 in real terms-- in inflation-corrected terms.
exampleZh: 在通货膨胀已校正的条件下,美国房价,在1997 年到2006年之间,实质上上涨了85%

meaning: v. 通知，告知；告发，检举（inform on）；赋特征于，渗透；了解，熟悉；影响
definition: 1. v. impart knowledge of some fact, state or affairs, or event to；2. v. give character or essence to
example: It was remiss of them not to inform us of these changes sooner.
exampleZh: 他们粗心大意，没有早一些通知我们这些变化。

meaning: n. （对他人权益的）侵犯，侵害；（对法律、规则等的）违反，违背
definition: 1. an action that breaks a rule, law, etc.；2. an action that is against a law, an agreement, etc.
example: There're other women in the same religious community who'll say, "this is no human rights infringement at all.
exampleZh: 也有同一个宗教团体中的其他女性,会说“这根本不是侵犯人权。

meaning: n. 新事物，新方法；革新，创新
definition: 1. n. a creation (a new device or process) resulting from study and experimentation；2. n. the creation of something in the mind
example: That's why many of them are thinking really very hard of how to foster entrepreneurship, how to encourage innovation.
exampleZh: 这就是为什么大家都在思索,如何才能培养企业家精神，如何鼓励创新。

meaning: n. 洞悉，了解；洞察力；【名】 （Insight）（英）因赛特（人名）
definition: 1. n. clear or deep perception of a situation；2. n. a feeling of understanding
example: He was a man of forceful character, with considerable insight and diplomatic skills.
exampleZh: 他是个性格坚强的人，有着非凡的洞察力和交际手腕。

meaning: n. （形势的）不稳定；（行为、情绪等的）不稳定状态，变化无常
definition: n. an unstable order；n. unreliability attributable to being unstable
example: The passion principle's popularity is even stronger among those facing job instability.
exampleZh: 在那些面临就业不稳定的人群中，热情原则理念甚至更为盛行。

meaning: v. 安装，设置；（计算机）安装（新软件）；正式任命，使正式就职；安顿，安置
definition: v. set up for use；v. put into an office or a position
example: as well as install them in the cars and validate the software that was with them.
exampleZh: 还把系统安装在车里并检验配对的软件。

meaning: n. 本能，天性；直觉；天分，天赋；adj. 充满（某种品质，尤指好品质）的
definition: 1. n. inborn pattern of behavior often responsive to specific stimuli；2. adj. (followed by `with')deeply filled or permeated
example: And that's the kind of instinct I'd like you to get into thinking about. So the answer here is no.
exampleZh: 所以答案是否定的,好的，那我们能在线性时间内排序么？

meaning: adj. 不充分的，不够重要的
definition: adj. of a quantity not able to fulfill a need or requirement
example: Stop and go were insufficient for the new volumes of cars zooming through intersections.
exampleZh: 对于越来越多飞速穿越路口的汽车来说，仅有停止和通行已不足以应对。

meaning: adj. 很大的，十分强烈的；严肃紧张的，激烈的；热情的，热切的；专注的，认真的
definition: 1. adj. in an extreme degree；2. adj. extremely sharp or intense
example: so I, you know, I enjoy that sort of intense effort, the sort of adrenaline that goes with the crunch
exampleZh: 我就喜欢那种高强度的努力，那种肾上腺素增长的感觉。

meaning: adj. 人际关系的，人际的
definition: adj. occurring among or involving several people
example: It's also about merging social and cultural and interpersonal horizons and it applies to all of those spheres.
exampleZh: 也与社会，文化,和人际关系相关，并且适用于所有这些领域。

meaning: v. 解释，说明；口译；把……理解为；演绎
definition: 1. v. make sense of; assign a meaning to；2. v. give an interpretation or explanation to
example: She couldn't speak much English so her children had to interpret for her.
exampleZh: 她讲不了几句英语，所以她的孩子们得给她翻译。

meaning: adj. 直觉的；有直觉力的；易懂的，使用简便的
definition: 1. based on feelings rather than facts or proof；2. able to know or understand something because of feelings rather than facts or proof
example: And we'll talk about this more, so if this is not completely intuitive, we'll see why in a second.
exampleZh: 关于这个我们将会讨论更多，所以如果这个不是完全凭直觉获知的，我们一会儿再来看看为什么。

meaning: adj. 不相关的，不相干的
definition: adj. having no bearing on or connection with the subject at issue
example: That sounds funny, but in a sense, that is--we have to define the sense in which it's irrelevant.
exampleZh: 听起来很有意思,但从某种意义上讲,我们必须说清楚不相关性的含义

meaning: n. 恼怒，生气；（尤指一段时间的）恼人事，烦恼；（身体某部位的）疼痛；刺激（作用），兴奋
definition: 1. the feeling of being angry or annoyed, or something that makes you feel like this；2. a painful or sore feeling in a part of the body
example: He tried not to let his irritation show as he blinked in the glare of the television lights.
exampleZh: 在对着耀眼的电视光线眨眼时，他竭力不把自己的恼怒表现出来。

meaning: n. 欢欣，高兴；使人高兴的人（或物），乐趣；成功，满足；v. 感到高兴，感到欣喜
definition: 1. n. the emotion of great happiness；2. v. feel happiness or joy
example: And there is finally, again, an affirmation of this joy and gaiety, here seen as a property of the artwork itself.
exampleZh: 最后在这里又一次，叶芝又一次提到了快乐欢愉，这里应看作是这件艺术品的部分特性。

meaning: adj. 年龄较小的；地位（或级别）低的，资历较浅的；（体育运动）青少年的；（7-11岁的）学童的；（学校或学校的一部分) 为11或13岁以下儿童设立的；（四年制大学或中学）三年级学生的；小（用于与父亲同名者的名字之后）；n. 较年幼者，年少者；地位（或级别）较低者，下属；（高中或大学的）三年级学生；青少年运动员；男孩，（尤指）儿子；（英国的）小学生；【名】 （Junior）（美、巴、葡）尤尼奥尔（人名）
definition: 1. n. term of address for a disrespectful and annoying male；2. adj. younger; lower in rank; shorter in length of tenure or service
example: and then officially, during the spring of my junior year of high school, so my third year of high school.
exampleZh: 但后来正式决定来这里是在高三的那个春天。

meaning: v. 是……的正当理由；对……作出解释，为……辩解；使（文本）对齐；（在上帝的眼中）称义，使有义；证明合法；整理版面
definition: 1. v. show to be reasonable or provide adequate ground for；2. v. show to be right by providing justification or proof
example: He's able to justify the ways of God to men here on the physical - on this intimately bodily earth.
exampleZh: 弥尔顿得以从这具体的物质的人间的角度,证明了上帝待人之法。

meaning: n. 肯尼亚人；adj. 肯尼亚的，肯尼亚人的，肯尼亚文化的
definition: n. a native or inhabitant of Kenya；adj. of or relating to or characteristic of Kenya or its people
example: They also learned about traditional Kenyan music.
