exampleZh: 他渴望与他的邻居和睦相处。

meaning: det. 两者都不；pron. （两者中）无一个；conj. 既不……（也不……）；也不（用于否定句后，表示前句适用于所有提到的人或物）；也不（用于否定句后，强调要引出另一否定句）；adv. （否定的陈述同样适用于其他人或物）也不；（否定的陈述适用于两方面）既不……也不……；adj. 两者都不的
definition: 1. abstract: "neither" is a very short story by Samuel Beckett written in 1976 and originally published in the Journal of Beckett Studies No. 4 (Spring 1979).
example: God and humans lock in an eternal struggle, neither prevailing, yet both forever changed by their encounter with one another.
exampleZh: 上帝与人类陷入一场永恒的战争，谁也不占上峰，但是他们相遇时却一直会引起改变。

meaning: n. 神经科学家，神经系统科学家
definition: n. a neurobiologist who specializes in the study of the brain
example: On the one hand, Freud made his start as a neuroscientist.
exampleZh: 一方面，弗洛伊德在一开始时是一位神经学家。

meaning: n. 绰号，外号；v. 给……起绰号；叫错名字
definition: 1. an informal name for someone or something, especially a name that you are called by your friends or family, usually based on your real name or your character；2. to give someone or something a nickname
example: Well, I think their nickname is Boris Bikes 'cause the mayor Boris Johnson kind of set up the scheme.
exampleZh: 好的，它们的小名是鲍里斯车，因为市长鲍里斯•詹森建立了这项计划。

meaning: adj. 显而易见的，明显的；值得注意的
definition: 1. adj. capable or worthy of being perceived；2. adj. capable of being detected
example: It was noticeable how a few people managed to impose their will on the others.
exampleZh: 显而易见，有少数几个人设法把自己的意志强加于别人。

meaning: v. 培养，促进；养育，培育；抱有，怀有；扶持，帮助；滋养，滋生；n. 养育，培育；教养；（总称）环境因素
definition: 1. to take care of, feed, and protect someone or something, especially young children or plants, and help him, her, or it to develop；2. to help a plan or a person to develop and be successful
example: Parents want to know the best way to nurture and raise their child to adulthood.
exampleZh: 父母们想了解把他们的孩子养育成人的最好方法。

meaning: n. 坚果（仁）；螺母，螺帽；疯子，怪人；入迷的人，狂热分子；头，头脑；营运经费，开销；难事，难题，难对付的人；睾丸；（尤指煤的）块，团；（小提琴或类似乐器琴弓末端的）松紧螺丝；（弦乐器上的）琴马；v. 用头撞；采坚果，采干果；【名】 （Nut）（阿拉伯）努特，（柬）努（人名）
definition: 1. n. usually large hard-shelled seed；2. v. gather nuts
example: It's important to put a lock washer on that last nut, or it can work loose.
exampleZh: 重要的是要在最后一个螺母上安装一个防松垫圈，否则它会逐渐变松。

meaning: n. 过度肥胖，肥胖症
definition: 1. n. more than average fatness
example: The study also demonstrated a direct link between obesity and mortality.
exampleZh: 这项研究也证明了肥胖和死亡率之间的直接关系。

meaning: n. 观察者，目击者；观察家，评论员；（会议等的）观察员
definition: 1. n. a person who becomes aware (of things or events) through the senses；2. n. an expert who observes and comments on something
example: The talks took place in the presence of a diplomatic observer.
exampleZh: 会谈是在一位外交观察家在场的情况下进行的。

meaning: adj. 偶尔的，不经常的；（家具）特定场合才使用的； （文章、演讲或宗教仪式等）在特殊场合所作的，为特殊场合所准备的；非定时的，临时的
definition: 1. adj. occurring from time to time；2. adj. occurring or appearing at usually irregular intervals
example: In the first place, a mask is nearly always occasional.
exampleZh: 首先，这个节目几乎是偶然的。

meaning: adv. 偶然，偶尔
definition: 1. adv. now and then or here and there
example: Most of our work is in higher education, But occasionally, we do do projects that go beyond that scope.
exampleZh: 我们大多数研究是在高等教育范围，偶尔也会有几个项目,是特例。

meaning: pron. 自己，自身；亲自；（不受他人影响的）自己
definition: 1. abstract: Oneself is an American hip hop artist based in Milwaukee, Wisconsin. A former member of the legendary Rusty Ps, began his career in 1995.
example: One has to ask oneself what the purpose of the exercise is.
exampleZh: 大家必须问一问自己，这个锻炼的目的是什么。

meaning: n. （环绕地球、太阳等运行的）轨道；势力范围，影响范围；眼眶，眼窝；v. 沿轨道运行，环绕……运行；使（卫星）进入轨道
definition: 1. n. the (usually elliptical) path described by one celestial body in its revolution about another；2. v. move in an orbit
example: The orbit of this comet intersects the orbit of the Earth.
exampleZh: 这颗彗星的轨道和地球的轨道相交。

meaning: adj. （英国英语拼写，相当于 organizational）组织的，与组织有关的；编制的
definition: adj. of or relating to an organization
example: Employees also feel taxed when they are invited together to meetings that don't inspire participation, says Cliff Scott, professor of organisational science.
exampleZh: 组织科学教授克里夫·斯科特表示，当员工被邀请一起参加那些无法激发参与意愿的会议时，他们也会感到疲惫不堪。

meaning: vt. （英式拼写，美式常作 organize）组织，安排，使系统化；筹备或举办（活动等）；组建或成立（团体等）；vi. 组织起来；成立或加入工会
definition: v. bring order and organization to；v. create (as an entity)
example: To function as entrepreneurs, she and her colleagues will have to organise themselves.
exampleZh: 要想成为企业家，她和她的同事们必须组织起来。

meaning: v. 应该（表义务、责任、必要等）；应该（表期望）；n. 零（=nought）；pron. 任何事物（=aught）
example: We ought to remain a little aloof and take pleasure in this aloofness, the interweave of a given masterpiece.
exampleZh: 并享受着这种冷漠，伴着颤抖来品味名著。

meaning: v. 监管，监督；看到，无意中看到
definition: 1. v. watch and direct
example: I was assigned as depot engineer to oversee the oil and gasoline tanks at the compound.
exampleZh: 我被指派为仓库工程师，监管厂区内的石油和汽油储罐。

meaning: v. 夸大，对……言过其实
definition: 1. to describe or explain something in a way that makes it seem more important or serious than it really is；2. to state something too strongly, or to state that it is greater than it really is
example: Such managers have an enormous stake in succeeding, so they invariably overstate the potential of their new technologies.
exampleZh: 这些管理者与成功有着巨大的利害关系，因此他们总是夸大新技术的潜力。

meaning: v. （感情上）使受不了，使不知所措；使大吃一惊；压垮，使应接不暇；打败，击垮； （水）漫过，淹没；压倒，制服
definition: 1. v. overcome, as with emotions or perceptual stimuli；2. v. charge someone with too many tasks
example: A big or steady serving of sarcasm will overwhelm the emotional flavor of any conversation and can taste very bitter to its recipient.
exampleZh: 大量或持续的讽刺会淹没任何谈话的情感色调，而且会让接受者尝到苦涩的滋味。

meaning: n. 油漆，涂料；绘画颜料（paints）；（已干的）油漆层，涂层；化妆，涂脂抹粉；（计算机）（尤指模拟真画效果的）绘图功能；花马，杂色马；（篮球）三秒区；v. （给……）上油漆，（给……）涂颜料；用油漆（或涂料）覆盖（paint sth. out）；（用颜料）绘画；涂，抹（嘴唇、指甲等）；（以某种方式）描绘，描写；（计算机）用绘图程序作图；（在雷达屏幕上）显示（飞机，车辆）；【名】 （Paint）（美）潘（人名）
definition: 1. n. a substance used as a coating to protect or decorate a surface (especially a mixture of pigment suspended in a liquid); dries to form a hard coating；2. v. make a painting
example: The general structure that we're looking at can be summarized as this, if this helps paint a nice mental picture.
exampleZh: 我们一般看到的这个结构可以这样概括,如果这个帮助我们描绘出一个漂亮的记忆画面。

meaning: n. 公园；自然保护区；（乡间大宅的）庭园，园林；足球场，橄榄球场；运动场，（尤指）棒球场；专用区，园区；停车场；（汽车）制动；v. 停车，泊车；存放，寄存； （在某处）坐，站立（park yourself）；把……搁置，推迟；【名】 （Park）（英、芬、瑞典）帕克（人名）
definition: 1. n. a large area of land preserved in its natural state as public property；2. v. place temporarily
example: And it's a really great experience. So that's pretty much what I associate Golden Gate Park with, for me.
exampleZh: 节日办得很不错。特别是对我这种常在金门公园附近溜达的人，是一种很好的体验。

meaning: n. 合伙（关系），合股；合伙企业；合伙人；（两个人、组织或国家之间的）合作关系，伙伴关系；合伙契约；（板球）（回合结束前或其中一人被迫退场前）一对击球手的跑动得分数
definition: 1. n. the members of a business venture created by contract；2. n. a cooperative relationship between people or groups who agree to share responsibility for achieving some specific goal
example: The administration of justice,which means deciding what is just, is the regulation of the partnership which is the polis.
exampleZh: 司法机构,即决定是否公正的地方,是调整人与人关系的机构,即城邦

meaning: n. 巅峰，顶点；山顶；有尖峰的山；尖端，尖顶；帽檐，帽舌；极值，峰值；（艏或艉的）尖舱；斜桁外端，（帆的）后上角；v. 达到高峰，达到最大值；消瘦，衰弱，精神萎靡；adj. 巅峰状态的，最高的；高峰时期的；【名】 （Peak）（英）皮克（人名）
definition: 1. n. the most extreme possible amount or value；2. v. to reach the highest point; attain maximum intensity, activity
example: That percent grew to the peak of the market in 1999; after the peak in 2000 it began to fall.
exampleZh: 在1999年这一赞同的比例接近最高点,在2000年达到顶点后开始下降

meaning: n. 百分比，百分率；部分，比例；利润分成，提成；利益，好处
definition: 1. n. a proportion multiplied by 100；2. n. assets belonging to or due to or contributed by an individual person or group
example: On the other hand, there's a higher percentage of companies that don't sort of let me say make it.
exampleZh: 另一方面，没有能够很好利用新想法,来发展自身获得成功的公司的确不在少数。

meaning: n. 完美主义者，追求完美的人；（哲学/伦理学）至善论者；adj. （常作定语）完美主义的，追求完美的
definition: n. a person who is displeased by anything that does not meet very high standards
example: He was such a perfectionist that he published only those results that satisfied him completely.
exampleZh: 他是个完美主义者，只发表那些令他完全满意的成果。

meaning: n. 近地点（月球或人造卫星等绕地球运行的轨道上距地球最近的点）
definition: n. periapsis in Earth orbit; the point in its orbit where a satellite is nearest to the Earth
example: When a full moon happens close to perigee, it's going to look a bit bigger.
exampleZh: 当满月发生在接近近地点时，它看起来会大一点。

meaning: n. 同意，许可；许可证，书面许可
definition: 1. n. approval to do something；2. n. the act of giving a formal (usually written) authorization
example: Like I said, basically it's just asking permission to do something or asking for somebody else to do something.
exampleZh: 就像我说的，这个句型的基本意思是征求做某事的允许或请求他人做某事。

meaning: n. 继续存在，维持；坚持不懈，执意
definition: 1. n. the property of a continuous and connected period of time；2. n. persistent determination
example: None can match your sheer will-power and persistence in wearing down the opposition.
exampleZh: 在消磨反对派的意志方面，没有人能比得上你那惊人的毅力和恒心。

meaning: n. （发展或变化的）阶段，时期；做出某种行为的短时期；（动物生活周期或年周期的）阶段，期；（月亮的）位相，盈亏；同步，协调；（化）相；（动）（由遗传或季节引起的）动物颜色变化（期）；（物理）相位，相角；（线圈的）匝，（多相电机或电路的）连接；（语言学）（系统语法用语）相（指链接动词与后续动词的关系）；相结构（含有链接动词和后续动词的结构）；v. 分阶段进行；（物理）使相位同步，使定相
definition: 1. n. (physical chemistry) a distinct state of matter in a system; matter that is identical in chemical composition and physical state and separated from other material by the phase boundary；2. v. arrange in phases or stages
example: And that's where like, in Phase One, you can only sign up for 10 units worth of classes.
exampleZh: 比如说，在第一阶段，你只能报10个学分的课程。

meaning: n. 照片，相片；v. 拍照，照相；在照片上显出某种样子
definition: n. a picture of a person or scene in the form of a print or transparent slide; recorded by a camera on light-sensitive material；v. record on photographic film
example: We all grouped around the tree for a photograph.
exampleZh: 我们全体围着这棵树照了张相。

meaning: v. 采，摘（花、果）；（用手指）弄掉；找茬；捡，抱起；选择；弹，拨（弦）；撬开（锁），扒窃……中的东西；小心走路（~ one's way）；（反复地）拔，拉，撕，扯；没胃口地吃；（高尔夫）拾球（尤指认输的拾球）（~ up）；采，摘（花、果等）；n. 精华（the pick of）；选择，选择权；被选中的人（或事物）；鹤嘴锄；（吉他的）拨子；（尖状的）挖撬工具；（篮球）掩护；【名】 （Pick）（英、法、德、捷、匈、瑞典）皮克（人名）
definition: 1. n. the person or thing chosen or selected；2. v. select carefully from a group
example: I was a first year student and happily minding my own business, getting ready to try to pick a summer job.
exampleZh: 我当时是一年级，只关心自己的小生活，想好好准备暑假打个工。

meaning: n. 比萨饼，披萨（一种意大利烤饼，用扁平的面饼铺上番茄酱、奶酪及其他配料烤制而成）；（Pizza）皮扎（意大利人名）
definition: 1. n. Italian open pie made of thin bread dough spread with a spiced mixture of e.g. tomato sauce and cheese
example: Or in another example, let's pretend that you wake up after you had a pizza the next day.
exampleZh: 又或者，假设你吃完披萨，第二天醒来。

meaning: n. 瘟疫，传染病；鼠疫（尤指腺鼠疫）；（老鼠或昆虫等肆虐造成的）灾害，祸患； 普遍的祸害；烦恼事；愿上天降灾难于……（a plague on）；v. 困扰，折磨；烦扰，纠缠；使得灾祸
definition: 1. n. a serious (sometimes fatal) infection of rodents caused by Yersinia pestis and accidentally transmitted to humans by the bite of a flea that has bitten an infected animal；2. v. cause to suffer a blight
example: Now the second plague in each set of three is introduced with the divine instruction, "Go to Pharaoh."
exampleZh: 每三组的第二个瘟疫开始于圣谕,“到法老面前去“

meaning: n. 行星；地球（the planet）；命运星辰；【名】 （Planet）普拉内特（人名）
definition: 1. n. (astronomy) any of the nine large celestial bodies in the solar system that revolve around the sun and shine by reflected light; Mercury, Venus, Earth, Mars, Jupiter, Saturn, Uranus, Neptune, and Pluto in order of their proximity to the sun; viewed from the constellation Hercules, all the planets rotate around the sun in a counterclockwise direction；2. n. a person who follows or serves another
example: The new planet is about ten times the size of the earth.
exampleZh: 这个新发现的行星大约是地球大小的10倍。

meaning: n. （尤指热带的）种植地，农园；人工林场，苗木场；殖民地，新开垦地；普兰泰申市（美国佛罗里达州城市名）
definition: 1. n. an estate where cash crops are grown on a large scale (especially in tropical areas)；2. n. a newly established colony (especially in the colonization of North America)
example: One is the plantation owner who may have hundreds of thousands of acres.
exampleZh: 一类是拥有成千上万英亩土地的种植园主。

meaning: adj. 令人愉快的，惬意的；礼貌而友善的，和蔼可亲的；【名】 （Pleasant）（英）普莱曾特（人名）
definition: 1. adj. affording pleasure; being in harmony with your taste or likings；2. adj. pleasant in manner or behavior
example: Kind of pleasant, I guess, right? " The desire to return to the quiescence of the organic world."
exampleZh: 听起来还不错，不是吗？,“希望回到静态的无机世界的愿望“

meaning: n. 阴谋，密谋；情节；（专用的）小块地；（表现两个变量关系的）图表；图表，地图；底层平面图；v. 密谋，暗中策划；（在地图上）画出，标出；构思（情节）；绘制（曲线）；绘制（图表）；在图表上标记，布置；用图表说明；计划，制订；【名】 （Plot）（捷、法）普洛特，普洛（人名）
definition: 1. n. a secret scheme to do something (especially something underhand or illegal)；2. v. plan secretly, usually something illegal
example: That's not good enough, and so the repetition in the plot reinforces the repetition of the sound in question.
exampleZh: 由于她总是不能正确地发音,这样一来情节的重复，就加强了声音的重复。

meaning: n. 警察部门；警察；v. 巡查，维护治安；监督，管制；执行（法律，协议，条约）
definition: 1. n. the force of policemen and officers；2. v. maintain the security of by carrying out a control
example: On 231, just to add to this catalog--we have murdered, abandoned, neglected children--we also have police brutality.
exampleZh: 在231页，就是为了加些内容到这个目录中，我们看到了谋杀，抛弃，忽视儿童，我们还读到了警察的残忍，让我看一下231页。

meaning: v. 污染，弄脏；玷污，败坏
definition: 1. v. make impure
example: Mining would pollute the lake and denude the forest.
exampleZh: 采矿将会污染湖水并伐光森林。

meaning: v. 拥有，持有；具有（品质或能力）；（尤指邪恶的鬼魅或精灵）缠住，迷住；受（感情）支配，受（感情）影响；了解，懂得;
definition: 1. v. have as an attribute, knowledge, or skill；2. v. have ownership or possession of
example: Under state law, it is a misdemeanour to possess a firearm on school premises.
exampleZh: 根据该州法律，在校园里拥有枪械是一种轻罪。

meaning: n. 拥有，持有；个人财产，所有物；持有违禁物，私藏毒品（或武器）；（对球的）控制，球权；进攻；领地，殖民地；鬼魂附体，着魔；（观点或情感的）支配，控制
definition: 1. n. the act of having and controlling property；2. n. anything owned or possessed
example: Is Milton powerful for the very straightforward reason that he's in possession of this tremendous literary strength, this unimaginable talent?
exampleZh: 弥尔顿之所以强大是因为他有,无穷的文学力量，不可想象的天赋这显而易见的原因呢？

meaning: adv. 可能地，潜在地
definition: adv. with a possibility of becoming actual
example: You will be surprised at how good it makes you feel and the potentially positive change in your health.
exampleZh: 你会惊讶地发现，它能让你感觉良好，并给你的健康带来潜在的积极变化。

meaning: v. 练习，实践；（尤指）形成……的习惯（或风俗、传统）；作（恶），施（虐）；从事（尤指医疗和法律）工作；阴谋策划（同 practice）
definition: v. engage in a rehearsal (of)；v. carry out or practice; as of jobs and professions
example: You could read some rules on pronunciation, you can try to practise those on your own.
exampleZh: 你可以先学习一些发音规则，然后尝试着自己进行练习。

meaning: v. 预言，预计，预卜
definition: 1. v. make a prediction about; tell in advance；2. v. indicate by signs
example: It is impossible to predict what the eventual outcome will be.
exampleZh: 无法预测最终结果。

meaning: n. 新闻工作者，新闻界，报刊（the press）；新闻报道；新闻舆论，媒体评论；印刷机；出版社，印刷厂；印刷；按，压，熨；压平器，熨烫机；人群，拥挤；大壁橱，衣柜，书柜；（篮球）紧逼；（举重）推举；（尤指海军的）强行征兵；商业压力；v. 压，挤，推，贴；按，揿；困扰，严重影响；挤着走；敦促，逼迫；坚持，竭力要求；压平，熨平；压榨，榨汁；CD 制作，压制（唱片）；（深情地）紧握（某人的手或臂）；前进，推进；（敌人，对手）进逼，进攻；（高尔夫）过猛击球；征用，临时使用；（举重）推举；【名】 (Press) （美、英、加、俄、印、澳）普雷斯（人名）
definition: 1. n. newspaper writers and photographers；2. v. exert pressure or force to or upon
example: And he had a press conference, spoke about the increased use of cars, and the decreased amount of carpooling.
exampleZh: 他开了一个新闻发布会，说道汽车使用量的增加，和拼车的减少。

meaning: n. 猎物，捕获物；受害者，受骗者；掠夺品；v. 捕食；欺凌，坑害（尤指弱者）；不断困扰，折磨；【名】 （Prey）（美、德、爱）普赖（人名）
definition: 1. an animal that is hunted and killed for food by another animal；2. a creature that is hunted and killed for food by another animal
example: It suggests that ecstasy is like wine, ; and wine is like an eagle clasping you; it's prey in its claws.
exampleZh: 这里暗示着令人着迷的狂喜如同美酒一般，而酒又像是紧紧抓着你的鹰;,用它的利爪疯狂地掠夺着你所有的。

meaning: vt. 给予……优先权，优先考虑（常与 over 连用）；按优先顺序处理；vi. 把事情按优先顺序排好（等于 prioritize）

example: Logging in tropical forests is selective but the timber cutters usually prioritise the biggest and oldest trees.
exampleZh: 砍伐热带森林是有选择性的，但伐木工人通常优先砍伐最大最古老的树木。

meaning: n. 奖品，奖项；非常珍贵的人（或物），十分重要的人（或物）；（海战中）缴获的敌船；adj. 可获奖的，优等的；作为奖品的；获奖的；有奖的；完全的；非常重要的，珍贵的；v. 珍视，高度重视；撬开；竭力打探（消息等）
definition: 1. n. something given for victory or superiority in a contest or competition or for winning a lottery；2. v. hold dear
example: Well, Mario Molina, who was a faculty member here at MIT, won a Nobel prize for describing this process.
exampleZh: 马里奥，莫丽娜，一个麻州理工学院的教员，凭借描述这一过程获得了诺贝尔物理学奖。

meaning: adv. 迅速地；立即，马上；准时地
definition: adv. with little or no delay；adv. in a punctual manner
example: The girl's life was saved because the doctors acted so promptly.
exampleZh: 多亏医生行动迅速，女孩的生命得救了。

meaning: n. 可能性，希望；预期，展望；（尤指事业的）成功机会，前景；有望成功的人，有前途的人；可能的顾客，潜在的主顾；（尤指从高处看到的）景象，景色；潜在矿藏或矿床；v. 勘探，勘察；寻找（商业机会）
definition: 1. n. the possibility of future success；2. v. search for something desirable
example: Different former colleague of mine once talked about the prospect of having a kind of heavenly vision of the divine.
exampleZh: 一位前任同事曾和我谈及,一种天堂似的,上帝的生活。

meaning: n. 保护，防护；保护物，护身符；保险；避孕（措施）；保护费；贸易保护，关税保护制；保护条例，保护措施；（登山）安全保护器材数量与质量
definition: 1. n. the activity of protecting someone or something；2. n. a covering that is intend to protect from damage or injury
example: One of my favorite stories is, William Ruckelshaus, William Ruckelshaus who was head of the Environmental Protection Agency in the early 1970s.
exampleZh: 我最喜欢的一个故事，是讲,他是20世纪70年代时候的,环境保护机构的会长。

meaning: n. 贸易保护主义者；adj. 贸易保护主义的，保护贸易论的
definition: n. an advocate of protectionism
example: The administration may be moving away from free trade and toward more protectionist policies.
exampleZh: 该政府可能正在放弃自由贸易而走向贸易保护主义的政策。

meaning: adj. 自豪的，得意的；令人自豪的；傲慢的，自负的；自尊的，自重的；秀丽的，壮观的；凸出的，隆起的；（肌肉）愈合伤口四周赘生的；（动物）有力量的，精力充沛的；【名】 （Proud）（英）普劳德（人名）
definition: 1. adj. feeling self-respect or pleasure in something by which you measure your self-worth; or being a reason for pride；2. adj. having or displaying great dignity or nobility
example: Because I am very, very proud to be a Texan. As I think you'll find with most people from Texas.
exampleZh: 因为我为自己是德克萨斯人而感到无比骄傲。我想你会发现许多德克萨斯人有同样的感受。

meaning: n. 四分之一；一刻钟，十五分钟；季度，三个月；学季，四分之一学年；（城镇中的）区；个人，群体；（士兵、服务人员等的）营房；上弦（或下弦）月；（美式足球的）一节；（美国和加拿大的）二十五分硬币；四分之一磅；（对败者的）宽恕，仁慈；四分之一畜体（或鸟身）；（马的）腰腿，臀部及后腿（quarters）；（罗盘上四个点之一所指的）方向；船侧后部；盾的四分之一；v. 将……四等分；把……降至原先的四分之一；提供食宿；在（某处）来回走动；移动，斜向行进；展示，炫耀（盾的四分之一部位上的不同纹章）；adj. 四分之一的
definition: 1. n. one of four equal parts；2. v. provide housing for (military personnel)
example: It's (a) quarter to four now—I'll meet you at (a) quarter past.
exampleZh: 现在是差一刻四点，我会在四点一刻和你碰面。

meaning: adj. 轻声的，安静的；不出声的；沉默寡言的，文静的；寂静的，平静的；不受打扰的，悠然的；（感情）不外露的，不张扬的；秘密的，私下的；（颜色、服饰）素净的，朴素大方的；清淡的；n. 安静，静谧；v. （使）平静，安静；消除，减轻（恐惧），平息（抱怨）
definition: 1. n. a period of calm weather；2. v. become quiet or quieter
example: In "Mowing," the scythe makes a sound as it cuts, and that sound is delicate, it's quiet, it whispers.
exampleZh: 在“割草“中镰刀割草时发出声响，这个声音很微弱，安静，像低声细语。

meaning: n. 光辉，光芒，发光；容光焕发；（物理）辐射亮度
definition: n. the amount of electromagnetic radiation leaving or arriving at a point on a surface；n. the quality of being bright and sending out rays of light
example: The dim bulb of the bedside lamp cast a soft radiance over his face.
exampleZh: 床头灯微弱的灯光给他的脸上涂上了一层柔和的光辉。

meaning: n. 铁路，铁轨；铁路公司，铁路部门；v. 迫使……仓促行事，强迫……做；迫使……草率通过；轻率判处
definition: n. line that is the commercial organization responsible for operating a system of transportation for trains that pull passengers or freight；n. a line of track providing a runway for wheels
example: The signal system on the railroad served as the basis for the first traffic light.
exampleZh: 铁路上的信号系统成为第一个交通信号灯的基础。

meaning: vt. （英国英语拼写，同 realize）认识到，明白，意识到；实现，达成；（财务）将（资产）变现，变卖；获得（利润）
definition: v. earn on some commercial or business transaction; earn as salary or wages；v. convert into cash; of goods and property
example: As a university student, I've come to realise just how little I know about money.
exampleZh: 作为一名大学生，我逐渐意识到自己对金钱知识的了解是多么匮乏。

meaning: n. 接受者，领受者；接收器，容器；adj. 接受的，容纳的
definition: 1. n. a person who gets something；2. n. the semantic role of the animate entity that is passively involved in the happening denoted by the verb in the clause
example: A big or steady serving of sarcasm will overwhelm the emotional flavor of any conversation and can taste very bitter to its recipient.
exampleZh: 大量或持续的讽刺会淹没任何谈话的情感色调，而且会让接受者尝到苦涩的滋味。

meaning: v. 使（光、声波等）折射；发生折射；测定（透镜的）折射力
definition: v. subject to refraction；v. determine the refracting power of (a lens)
example: As we age, the lenses of the eyes thicken, and thus refract light differently.
exampleZh: 随着我们年龄的增长，眼睛的晶状体变厚，因此对光线的折射也会发生变化。

meaning: n. 庇护，避难；（行为和想法的）逃避，躲避；避难所，庇护处；（街道中央的）避车岛，安全岛；v. 给予庇护，接纳避难；避难，逃避
definition: 1. (a place that gives) protection or shelter from danger, trouble, unhappiness, etc.；2. protection or shelter from danger, trouble, etc., or a place that provides this
example: Four people who sought refuge in the Italian embassy have left voluntarily.
exampleZh: 到意大利大使馆寻求避难的四个人已经自愿离开了。

meaning: v. 重新获得，恢复；重回，回到（某处）；n. 取回
definition: v. get or find back; recover the use of；v. come upon after searching; find the location of something that was missed or lost
example: Student: How did you regain confidence in your ? investors and people who gave money to you?
exampleZh: 学生；，你是如何赢回,投资者或者投给你资金的人的信心的呢？

meaning: v. 懊悔，惋惜；（用于正式书面语）对......感到抱歉，对......感到遗憾；对（损失或缺乏）感到痛惜；n. 遗憾，惋惜；（因无法出席会议、聚会等的）致歉语
definition: 1. n. sadness associated with some wrong done or some disappointment；2. v. feel remorse for; feel sorry for; be contrite about
example: Because you will come to regret it if you don't do it. But we're not going to grade it.
exampleZh: 但是我们不会对此计分,因为不计分所以让你们。

meaning: v. （用规则条例）控制，管理；调节，调整；监控，监管；校准，对准（时钟或其他仪器）
definition: 1. v. fix or adjust the time, amount, degree, or rate of；2. v. bring into conformity with rules or principles or usage; impose regulations
example: Under such a plan, the government would regulate competition among insurance companies so that everyone gets care at lower cost.
exampleZh: 根据这样一个计划，政府会控制保险公司之间的竞争，这样每个人都能以较低价格获得保险。

meaning: n. （人或物间的）联系；（国家、公司、组织等之间的）（正式）关系； 性关系；亲戚，亲属；讲述，叙述
definition: 1. n. an abstraction belonging to or characteristic of two entities or parts together；2. n. the act of sexual procreation between a man and a woman; the man's penis is inserted into the woman's vagina and excited until orgasm and ejaculation occur
example: Both Guillory and Angus Fletcher are examining the troubled relation of Milton to one of his favorite poets.
exampleZh: 无论是古伊洛还是安格斯弗莱彻,他们都在研究弥尔顿最爱的一首诗中和他相关的问题。

meaning: n. 亲戚，亲属；同类事物，亲缘动物（或植物）；（语法）关系代词，关系限定词，关系副词；（哲学）关系项；相关物；adj. 相比较而言的，比较的；相对的，相关联的；（语法）（代词、限定词或副词）关系的，（从句）由关系词引导的；（乐）（大小调）调号相同的；（与不同军种的军阶）相应（或对应）的； 关于（或涉及到）......的；相比之下存在（或有）的
definition: 1. n. a person related by blood or marriage；2. adj. not absolute or complete
example: Fitness is relative; one must always ask "Fit for what?"
exampleZh: 适宜是相对的；始终必须问问：“适宜什么？”

meaning: v. 释放，放走；放开，松开；公布，发布；发行，上映；发泄，宣泄；排放（物质）；免除，解雇；放弃，让予；放松，使松弛；n. 释放，获释；排放，泄漏；释放装置；表达，宣泄；解脱，轻松感；新发行的东西；发表，发布；（责任等的）免除； 放弃，让予； 传球；（设备的）松开
definition: 1. n. merchandise issued for sale or public showing (especially a record or film)；2. v. release, as from one's grip
example: And it's nice way to, you know, not be stressed out and just release some energy.
exampleZh: 这是很好的方式，你知道，让自己不要压力过大，释放一些活力。

meaning: adj. 依赖的，依靠的
definition: adj. relying on another for support
example: They are reliant on a very limited number of exportable products.
exampleZh: 他们依赖于数量非常有限的可出口产品。

meaning: adj. 引人注目的，非凡的
definition: 1. adj. unusual or striking；2. adj. worthy of notice
example: That's something that we see again and again and it's remarkable how little common sense is often applied.
exampleZh: 这些技能是我们司空见惯的,当时很奇怪人们一般却没有注意到它们。

meaning: adj. 边远的，偏僻的；（距离或空间上）遥远的；（时间上）久远的；（机会或可能性）渺茫的；差别很大的，很不相同的；不友好的，冷漠的；远亲关系的；（电子设备）遥控的；（计算机）远程的，远程连接的；n. 遥控装置，遥控器
definition: 1. n. a device that can be used to control a machine or apparatus from a distance；2. adj. apart in space
example: Its difficulty lies in Milton's tendency in this poem to seek out what Dr. Johnson wonderfully calls remote allusions.
exampleZh: 诗的难点在于弥尔顿想要在诗中极力追求,被约翰逊绝妙地称为不切实际的幻想的倾向。

meaning: n. 租费，租金；出租，租赁；租用物（尤指房屋或车辆）；adj. （与）租借（有关）的，可供租用的
definition: 1. n. property that is leased or rented out or let；2. adj. available to rent or lease
example: He has a rental car and is zooming to the airport.
exampleZh: 他出租给别人的一辆车正在向机场高速驶去。

meaning: v. 回答，答复；（以行动）作出回应，回击；（在体育比赛中）以得分回应，回敬；n. （口头或书面）回答，答复；回应，作出反应；（比赛）一方得分（进球）但对方未得分（进球）；（原告对被告抗辩的）驳复，答辩
definition: 1. n. a statement (either spoken or written) that is made in reply to a question or request or criticism or accusation；2. v. reply or respond to
example: When we finished last time, we were looking at John Stuart Mill's attempt to reply to the critics of Bentham's Utilitarianism.
exampleZh: 上节课结束时，我们讲到约翰·斯图尔特·穆勒试图回应,对边沁功利主义的批判。

meaning: v. 像，与……相似
definition: 1. v. appear like; be similar or bear a likeness to
example: In this respect it would resemble Spenser's Faerie Queene, or perhaps more importantly, Virgil's Aeneid -- other nationalist epics.
exampleZh: 这样的话它就会与斯宾塞的《仙后》，更重要的，维吉尔的《埃涅阿斯记》等一些民族主义史诗相类似。

meaning: v. 重新考虑，再想；n. （常作单数）重新考虑，反思；新想法
definition: n. thinking again about a choice previously made；v. change one's mind
example: There must be a rethink of government policy toward this vulnerable group.
exampleZh: 对这一弱势群体的政府政策一定要进行重新思考。

meaning: v. 找回，收回；检索（储存于计算机的信息）；（狗等）衔回（物品、猎物）；挽救，挽回；回忆，追忆；收绕钓鱼线；n. （尤指中枪猎物的）找回；收绕钓鱼线； 恢复的可能性；检索
definition: 1. to find and bring back something；2. in tennis and similar sports, to successfully return a ball that is difficult to reach
example: There was absolutely no way that we were going to be able to retrieve it.
exampleZh: 我们绝对不可能把它找回来。

meaning: n. 审查，检查；评论，评论文章；（时事、艺术等的）评论期刊；述评，回顾；复习，温习；（一门课程的）材料，练习；阅兵，阅兵式；中止快速倒带（或卷带）重放装置；v. 仔细研究，审视；给（书、戏剧、电影等）写评论；回顾，反思；（为考试而）复习，温习；校阅，审核；复查（病人）；检阅（军队）；将（判决、案件等）提交上级法院（或权力机构）复审
definition: 1. n. a new appraisal or evaluation；2. v. look at again; examine again
example: It's also that knowledge that an educated, sort of belletristic reader of The Saturday Review of Literature would be very, very familiar with.
exampleZh: 这也是受过教育，某种研究文学且是,《周六文学评论》的读者所十分熟悉的知识。

meaning: 右脑：指人类大脑的右半球，尤其是在创造力和直觉思维等方面的主导思维过程。
definition: n. the cerebral hemisphere to the right of the corpus callosum that controls the left half of the body
example: To get these companies back on track, they need to invite in and listen to a few right-brain marketers. Sooner rather than later.
exampleZh: 要想让这些企业回到正轨，他们需要邀请一些右脑思考的行销者们参与决策，并听取他们的意见，越早越好。

meaning: adj. （表面）粗糙的，不平的；（网球或软式墙网球拍）粗面的；粗暴的，猛烈的；（地方）多暴力的，犯罪盛行的；汹涌的，风浪很大的；粗制的，不完善的；粗俗的，不讲究的；粗略的，大致的； 艰难的，不愉快的； 身体不适的；（声音）粗哑的，不悦耳的；（酒）涩味的；未经加工的；（文具）用以打草稿的；n. （高尔夫球场的）深草区（the rough）；草稿，草图； 粗野的人，暴徒；未加工的宝石；高低不平的地面；粗糙的部分；艰苦，不愉快；v. 粗制，对……粗加工；草拟，画……的轮廓；使不平，把……弄毛糙； 因陋就简地生活；粗暴地对待；（在美式橄榄球、冰球等比赛中对对手）动粗；adv. 粗糙地，粗暴地； 风餐露宿；【名】 （Rough）（英）拉夫（人名）
definition: 1. n. the part of a golf course bordering the fairway where the grass is not cut short；2. v. prepare in preliminary or sketchy form
example: In fact, a rough grasp on traditional English meter to Stevens, say, or to Crane, or to Auden or Bishop.
exampleZh: 事实上，粗略的了解英国节律,比如史蒂文斯，克瑞恩，奥登和主教。

meaning: n. 常规，惯例；生活乏味，无聊；（演出中的）一套动作，一系列笑话（等）；（为达到特定目的的）老一套，俗套；（计算机）例行程序；adj. 常规的，例行的；平常的，毫不特别的；平淡乏味的；v. 按惯例安排
definition: 1. n. an unvarying or habitual method or procedure；2. adj. occurring at fixed times or predictable intervals
example: And your workout routine is getting in the way of your job. You have to make a decision.
exampleZh: 但是你的健身计划开始影响到工作。你不得不做一个选择。

meaning: n. 毁坏，毁灭；破产，身败名裂；祸根； 残垣断壁，废墟；残存部分（ruins）；v. 毁坏，破坏；使（建筑物，地方）破败，使成为废墟；使倾家荡产，使破产； 头朝下跌落，哗啦一声掉下；【名】 （Ruin）（法、俄、意、瑞典）吕安（人名）
definition: 1. n. an irrecoverable state of devastation and destruction；2. v. destroy completely; damage irreparably
example: My shoes cost over 6,000 yuan; they have sheepskin soles and can't get wet—once they do, they're ruined.
exampleZh: 我这个鞋子啊，六千多块，都是羊皮底，不能沾水的，沾水就废掉了。

meaning: n. 反刍动物；沉思默想的人；adj. 反刍动物的，反刍亚目的；沉思默想的
definition: n. any of various cud-chewing hoofed mammals having a stomach divided into four (occasionally three) compartments；adj. related to or characteristic of animals of the suborder Ruminantia or any other animal that chews a cud
example: Cows, sheep and other ruminant animals can break cellulose down and release the solar energy contained in this vast resource.
exampleZh: 牛、羊等反刍动物却能分解纤维素，释放这一庞大资源中储存的太阳能。

meaning: adv. 安全地，平安地；稳定地，可靠地
definition: adv. with safety; in a safe manner
example: OK, I think we can safely go back to notes.
exampleZh: 好的，我想我们可以放心地继续讲下面的内容了。

meaning: v. （人）航行；（船）航行；启航；驾驶（船只）；飘过，（轻快地）移动；n. 帆；乘船航行；（用作交通工具的）帆船的使用；（潜艇的）瞭望塔；油布，篷帆布；帆状物，功能似帆的物体；（风车的）翼板；（旗鱼或一些史前爬行动物的）脊鳍；（僧帽水母等的）帆器
definition: 1. n. a large piece of fabric (usually canvas fabric) by means of which wind is used to propel a sailing vessel；2. v. traverse or travel by ship on (a body of water)
example: He'd learned to sail when he was young, but on the river.
exampleZh: 他年轻时就学会了航海,但是在河上

meaning: n. 利益，好处；目的；为了便于讨论（for the sake of argument）；（强调重要或表示恼火）看在上帝分上，天哪（for God's/goodness'/Christ's/heaven's/Pete's etc. sake）；日本米酒，日本清酒；【名】 （Sake）（罗）萨克，（日）酒（姓）（人名）
definition: 1. n. a reason for wanting something done；2. n. Japanese alcoholic beverage made from fermented rice; usually served hot
example: The structural moment of concentration on the code for its own sake cannot be avoided, and literature necessarily breeds its own formalism.
exampleZh: 集中在代码上的结构瞬间,因为它本身的原因不可避免，文学必要地导致了它自身的形式主义。

meaning: n. 样本，样品；试用产品，试样；（供科学或医学检测用的）抽样样本；（抽查的）样本，抽选人员；（用于新乐曲中的）选录的歌曲片段；v. 品尝，尝试（食品、饮料）；体验（活动）；对……作抽样调查；节录，选录（歌曲等，用于其他录音）；确定（模拟信号）瞬时值；adj. 样品的，实例的；【名】 （Sample）（美、英、爱尔兰）桑普尔（人名）
definition: 1. n. a small part of something intended as representative of the whole；2. v. take a sample of
example: 'I'd like to see a sample of your work,' said the manager.
exampleZh: “拿一件你做的货样给我看看。”经理说。

meaning: n. 卫星；人造卫星；卫星国，附属国；卫星城镇，卫星郊区；卫星电视；随体DNA；adj. 卫星传送的，使用卫星技术的
definition: 1. n. man-made equipment that orbits around the earth or the moon；2. v. broadcast or disseminate via satellite
example: The news programme came to us via satellite.
exampleZh: 新闻节目是通过卫星传送到我们这里来的。

meaning: v. 撒，播撒；（使）散开，（使）散布在各处；（物理）散射（电磁辐射或粒子）；（棒球）（被击中但没有得分的）有效投（球）；n. 零星散布的东西；（统计）（对某一变量作反复测量或观察所得数值的）离差；（物理）（光、其他电磁波或粒子的）散射
definition: 1. n. a haphazard distribution in all directions；2. v. to cause to separate and go in different directions
example: The concept of regression goes back to the mathematician Gauss, who talked about fitting a line through a scatter of points.
exampleZh: 回归这个概念要追溯到数学家高斯,讨论的是从若干散点中切合出一条直线

meaning: n. 香味，芳香；（动物或人的）气味，臭迹；香水；察觉，预示；线索，踪迹；嗅觉；v. 使……带有某种香味；（动物）嗅出，闻到；预感，觉察；【名】 （Scent）（英）森特（人名）
definition: 1. n. a distinctive odor that is pleasant；2. v. cause to smell or be smelly
example: The scent of climbing roses wafts through the window.
exampleZh: 蔷薇的香味随风从窗户飘进来。

meaning: n. 座位；（椅子等的）座部；（机器的）基座；（议会、委员会、法庭等的）席位，职位； 议会议员选区；（组织或重大活动的）所在地；（大户人家在乡间的）别墅，宅邸；（裙子或裤子的）臀部，后裆；屁股；（骑马的）骑姿；v. 使坐下，使就座；容纳，坐得下；使就职；固定，安装
definition: 1. n. a space reserved for sitting (as in a theater or on a train or airplane)；2. v. show to a seat; assign a seat for
example: She's stuck between competing ideals of bodily purity just as surely and as firmly as she is stuck to her seat.
exampleZh: 她陷入贞洁理念的矛盾迷潭之中,与陷入陷入椅子一样确定而坚定。

meaning: adj. （教育）中等的，中学的；次要的， 第二位的；（疾病、感染）继发性的，第二期的；间接的；（化学反应）副的；（有机化合物）二代的；（主要指胺）仲的；（电）次级的；（地质）中生代的（Secondary）；n. 副手，下属；第二防线；中学（secondary school 的简称）；（鸟）次级飞羽（secondary feather 的简称）；（变压器中的）次级线圈；（地质）中生代（the Secondary）
definition: 1. n. the defensive football players who line up behind the linemen；2. adj. being of second rank or importance or value; not direct or immediate
example: Examinations are taken after about five years of secondary education.
exampleZh: 经过约五年的中等教育后参加考试。

meaning: adj. 秘密的，保密的；（感情、担心、行动）不公开的，暗自的；（某人的行为）诡秘的，神秘的；善于掩饰自己的，严守秘密的；n. 秘密，内情；神秘，奥秘；秘诀，诀窍；（罗马天主教弥撒捐献仪式后牧师的）默祷；【名】 （Secret）（法）塞克雷（人名）
definition: 1. n. something that should remain hidden from others (especially information that is not to be passed on)；2. adj. not open or public; kept private or not revealed
example: I guess, like, there're certain things like in the meetings that are secret, like the ritual or whatever,
exampleZh: 我想有一些事情是秘密的，例如会议程序什么的，

meaning: adv. 不常，很少
definition: 1. adv. not often
example: She was a severe woman who seldom smiled.
exampleZh: 她是个严肃的女人，脸上很少出现笑容。

meaning: n. （探测光、热、压力等的）传感器，敏感元件，探测设备
definition: 1. n. any device that receives a signal or stimulus (as heat or pressure or light or motion etc.) and responds to it in a distinctive manner
example: The electronic sensor has been adapted to fit on a newborn baby.
exampleZh: 电子传感器已被改装以适应新生儿。

meaning: adv. 严重地，恶劣地；严肃地，认真地；说正经的，说实在的；真的，当真；非常，极其
definition: adv. in a serious manner；adv. to a severe or serious degree
example: He was amused to see how seriously she took the game.
exampleZh: 他看见她玩这个游戏十分认真的样子，觉得好笑。

meaning: n. （食物或饮料的）一人份；adj. 上菜用的，分菜肴用的；目前任职的，（尤指）现役的；v. 为……服务；供应，上（饮料、食物）；服役，供职于（serve 的现在分词形式）；【名】 （Serving）（美、瑞）塞尔温（人名）
definition: 1. n. an individual quantity of food or drink taken as part of a meal；2. n. the act of delivering a writ or summons upon someone
example: You also read an article by Milgrom where Milgrom talks about Priestly cultic imagery serving as a kind of theodicy.
exampleZh: 在米尔格罗姆的一篇文章中,这篇文章讲到祭司的宗教仪式,被形象化为一种神义论。

meaning: adj. 十分严重的，极为恶劣的；艰巨的，严峻的；（惩罚、批评）严厉的，重的；严厉的，苛刻的；不加装饰的，朴素的
definition: 1. adj. intensely or extremely bad or unpleasant in degree or quality；2. adj. very strong or vigorous
example: I think it's much severe than what you have experienced in the past year or two for the general economic situation.
exampleZh: 甚至比过去两年的经济形势,还要严峻。

meaning: adj. 短期的，近期的
definition: adj. relating to or extending over a limited period
example: Investors weren't concerned about short-term profits over the next few years.
exampleZh: 投资者不关心今后几年里的短期收益。

meaning: n. 肩，肩膀；双肩，上背部（shoulders）；（衣服的）肩部；（动物的）前腿连肩肉，肘子；山肩，瓶肩； （公路旁的）路肩，紧急停车道；（担负责任或艰难困苦或提供力量的）肩膀；（四足动物的）肩背；（鸟、昆虫的）肩背；v. 承担，担负；挤，闯；（用肩膀）推开，顶开；肩扛，肩挑
definition: 1. n. the part of the body between the neck and the upper arm；2. v. lift onto one's shoulders
example: Writing the book was as if I had eyes over my shoulder or voices speaking to my ear.
exampleZh: 写这本书就好比自我反省,听自己在辩论一样。

meaning: adj. （人）精明的，机敏的；（决定和判断）精明的，准确的；（打击）沉重的，尖锐的；邪恶的，恶意的；（尤指天气）寒冷刺骨的，凛冽的
definition: 1. having or based on a clear understanding and good judgment of a situation, resulting in an advantage；2. able to judge a situation accurately and turn it to your own advantage
example: He was a shrewd lawyer with a talent for uncovering paper trails of fraud.
exampleZh: 他是个精明强干的律师，能从一连串文件中找出诈骗的蛛丝马迹。

meaning: v. （使）缩小，减少；（通常指布料、衣服等洗后）缩水，皱缩；退缩，畏缩；畏避，回避（工作、责任等）；n. 精神病学家，心理学家；收缩；畏缩
definition: 1. n. a physician who specializes in psychiatry；2. v. wither, as with a loss of moisture
example: If you give up exercise, your muscles shrink and fat increases. By the same token, if you expend more energy you will lose fat.
exampleZh: 如果你放弃锻炼，肌肉就会萎缩，脂肪会增多。同样地，如果你消耗较多的体能，你就会减掉脂肪。

meaning: n. 灌木；（尤指掺朗姆酒或白兰地的）果汁甜酒；果汁露酒；v. 因肯尼亚英语的影响而发错音
definition: 1. a large plant with a rounded shape formed from many small branches growing either directly from the ground or from a hard stem, grown in gardens；2. a drink made from fruit juice mixed with sugar and rum or brandy
example: Once the fire is out, the grass and shrub ecosystems should return quickly.
exampleZh: 火一旦被熄灭，草和灌木的生态系统就会很快恢复。

meaning: n. 银；银器（尤指餐具）；银币；银（白）色；银牌（silver medal 的简写）；adj. 银（白）色的；银制的，含银的，（有关）银的；二十五周年纪念的，银婚纪念的；口才流利的；v. 镀（或包）银于；使具有银色光泽，使变成银色；使（头发）变成银灰色（或银白色）；【名】 （Silver）（法）西尔韦，（英、德、芬、瑞典）西尔弗（人名）
definition: 1. n. a soft white precious univalent metallic element having the highest electrical and thermal conductivity of any metal; occurs in argentite and in free form; used in coins and jewelry and tableware and photography；2. v. coat with a layer of silver or a silver amalgam
example: In an aqueous solution, he passes electric current and causes silver ions to deposit and form metallic silver.
exampleZh: 在水溶液中，他接通电流，这得银离子,沉淀，并形成金属银。

meaning: n. 简单（性)，容易（性）；简朴，朴素；简单（或质朴、朴素）之处；愚蠢，无知
definition: 1. n. the quality of being simple or uncompounded；2. n. a lack of penetration or subtlety
example: Using plastic to pay for an order is simplicity itself.
exampleZh: 使用信用卡支付订单本身就很简单。

meaning: adj. （常含贬义）过分简单化的，过分单纯化的
example: He has a simplistic view of the treatment of eczema.
exampleZh: 他对湿疹治疗所持观点过于简单化。

meaning: v. 假装，冒充；模拟，模仿；看上去像；计算机模拟；adj. 虚假的，假装的
definition: 1. to do or make something that looks real but is not real；2. to create conditions or processes similar to something that exists
example: The scientist developed one model to simulate a full year of the globe's climate.
exampleZh: 这位科学家研制出一个模型，能模拟全年地球的气候。

meaning: n. 歌手，歌唱家；Singer（英语姓氏或人名，译名有“桑热”，常见“辛格”）
definition: 1. n. a person who sings；2. n. United States inventor of an improved chain-stitch sewing machine (1811-1875)
example: The Heart responds.] The Heart. What, be a singer born and lack a theme?
exampleZh: 心回应道],心：什么，一个天生的歌唱家怎能缺少一个旋律？

meaning: v. 下沉，沉没；使失败，受挫；下降，下陷；倒下，坐下；衰退，恶化；渗透，渐渐陷入；减少，降低；（声音）变低，变小；堕落，沉沦；挖掘；插入，打入；投进，滚进；投资；喝（酒）；adj. 贫困的，贫民窟的；n. 水槽，水池；洼地，渗坑；位于社会贫困地区的学校或房产；藏垢的场所；汇，壑；【名】 （Sink）（美、英、罗）辛克（人名）
definition: 1. n. plumbing fixture consisting of a water basin fixed to a wall or floor and having a drainpipe；2. v. fall or drop to a lower place or level
example: So realize if it doesn't quite sink in today, not a problems in terms of these low level details.
exampleZh: 如果你们没有完全吸收我今天讲的内容，没关系,这些小细节都会在习题集中找得到。

meaning: n. 坐着（做某事）的一段时间；（一次）供人画像（照相）的时间；一批，一次（就餐时间）；（法庭的）开庭，（议会的）开会；孵卵；adj. 坐的，坐着做的；（母鸡，鸟）孵蛋的，伏窝的；现任的，在任期内的；易击中的；（动物）蹲着的，（鸟）停落的；v. 坐，坐下；使就座；坐落在，位于（sit 的现在分词形式）；【名】 (Sitting) （美、加）西特（人名）
definition: 1. n. (photography) the act of assuming a certain position (as for a photograph or portrait)；2. adj. (of persons) having the torso erect and legs bent with the body supported on the buttocks
example: you get more of...you already have things that you want to talk about, going in, sitting down to dinner.
exampleZh: 你会得到更多……走进去，坐下来吃顿饭的同时，你已经想好要聊哪些话题了，

meaning: adj. 轻微的，少量的；（人）瘦小的，纤弱的；（尤指创作）不深奥的，不重要的；v. 怠慢，轻视；破坏，摧毁（防御工事）；n. 冒犯，冷落
definition: 1. n. a deliberate discourteous act (usually as an expression of anger or disapproval)；2. v. pay no attention to, disrespect
example: So in return to, we have a slight variance here, -- where I'm defining apparently -- declaring a function called cube.
exampleZh: 作为应答，这里我们有一点变化，这里我显然定义了-,声明了一个叫做cube的函数。

meaning: v. （价格、价值、数量等）骤降，猛跌；惨败，猛跌；（因无力站立而）倒下，倚，靠；（肩或脑袋）耷拉着；n. （价格、销售额、利润等的）突然下跌；（经济的）不景气，萧条；（运动员或运动队的）低迷期
definition: 1. (of prices, values, or sales) to fall suddenly；2. to sit or fall heavily and suddenly
example: The slump on Wall Street set up a chain reaction in stock markets around the world.
exampleZh: 华尔街股价暴跌在全球股票市场上引起了连锁反应。

meaning: adj. 小规模的；小比例尺的（指地图、图纸、模型等按小比例绘制或制作）
definition: adj. created or drawn on a small scale；adj. limited in size or scope
example: A number of small-scale studies have already indicated that there is a relationship between diet and cancer.
exampleZh: 一些小规模的研究已经表明，饮食和癌症之间有一种联系。

meaning: v. 微笑；微笑着说，以微笑表示；现出（笑容）；觉得好笑，觉得高兴；惠及，赞许；n. 微笑，笑容；一脸笑意，喜滋滋的（all smiles）；【名】 （Smile）（俄、印、美）斯米莱（人名）
definition: 1. n. a facial expression characterized by turning up the corners of the mouth; usually shows pleasure or amusement；2. v. change one's facial expression by spreading the lips, often to signal pleasure
example: And by his smile, I knew that sullen hall,-- By his dead smile I knew we stood in Hell.
exampleZh: 看着他的笑，我想起了阴沉压抑的礼堂-,看着他的笑，我想起了阴沉压抑的礼堂。

meaning: adj. （表示不认同）所谓的；叫做……的，号称……的
definition: 1. adj. doubtful or suspect
example: Despite the vogue for so-called health teas, there is no evidence that they are any healthier.
exampleZh: 尽管所谓的保健茶成了时尚，但并没有证据表明这种茶更有益于健康。

ipa: ˌsəʊsiəʊ ˌiːkəˈnɒmɪk; ˌsəʊsiəʊ ˌekəˈnɒmɪk / ˌsoʊsioʊ ˌiːkəˈnɑːmɪk; ˌsoʊsioʊ ˌekəˈnɑːmɪk
meaning: adj. 社会经济的，涉及社会与经济因素的（亦作 socioeconomic）
definition: adj. involving social as well as economic factors
example: Infant mortality is a reliable barometer of socio-economic conditions.
exampleZh: 婴儿死亡率是社会经济状况的可靠指标。

meaning: adj. 固体的，坚硬的；结实的，牢固的；实心的，无空隙的；纯质的；纯色的，单色的；可靠的，可信赖的；一致的，坚定的；不中断的，连续的；相当不错（但谈不上出色或独特）的；立体的，立方的；关系融洽的；严厉的，不公平的；很难的；n. 立体（图形）；固体；固体食物；（液体中的）固形物；【名】 （Solid）（瑞典）索利德（人名）
definition: 1. n. a substance that is solid at room temperature and pressure；2. adj. of definite shape and volume; firm; neither liquid nor gaseous
example: So,composition alone can't give you the answer to the question why is the plywood superior to the solid pine board?
exampleZh: 只用组成成分无法解答,这个问题,为什么胶合板要优于松木板呢？

meaning: n. 儿子；孩子（长者对男孩或年轻男子的称呼）；（某国或地区出生并能作其代表的）男性，子；圣子（耶稣基督）（the Son）；（动物的）雄性后代；男性后裔；（某个人、某种影响或某种环境）熏陶出的人；（司铎对男子或男孩的称呼）孩子（my son）；【名】 （Son）（土、老、柬）松，（法、罗）索恩，（日）存（人名）

meaning: n. （书、杂志等中区别于图片的）正文，文字材料；（演说等的）原文；（学习某课程必读的）课本，教科书；（供讨论或回答问题的）文本，文章；（讨论等的）题目，主题；（尤指科学或学术方面的）文献；（计算机、手机等）文档；短信；（尤指引作布道主题的）圣经经文；（尤指用于手稿的）粗体正楷；v. （用手机）给……发短信
definition: 1. n. the words of something written；2. n. a passage from the Bible that is used as the subject of a sermon
example: It shouldn't be difficult to see a kind of problem that is beginning to arise in Milton's text here.
exampleZh: 这是一个很容易看出的问题,在弥尔顿的作品中也被提了出来。

meaning: adv. 因此，所以
definition: 1. adv. (used to introduce a logical conclusion) from that fact or reason or as a result；2. adv. as a consequence
example: They had seen him trawling and therefore knew that there were fish.
exampleZh: 他们看见他正用拖网捕鱼，因此他们知道那里有鱼。

meaning: adj. 厚的，粗的；有……厚的；（衣服）厚重的，暖和的 ；（字体）粗体的；茂密的，繁茂的；（毛发）浓密的；（烟、云、雾等）浑浊的，能见度低的；（液体）稠的，浓的； 愚钝的，笨的；（尤指由于疾病、酗酒而使头脑）隐痛的，思路不清的；充满的，弥漫的；（因为难过等而嗓音）沙哑的，低沉的；（口音）重的，难听懂的；亲密无间的，交情厚的；n. 在……最激烈时，在……最紧张的时刻（the thick）；adv. 厚地，浓密地；大量地；【名】 （Thick）（美、英、加）西克（人名）
definition: 1. n. the location of something surrounded by other things；2. adj. not thin; of a specific thickness or of relatively great extent from one surface to the opposite usually in the smallest of the three solid dimensions
example: It used to be this big, thick thing and you would go there everyday to look up and everything was in there.
exampleZh: 它过去是一份很大很厚的报纸,你每天都会查阅资讯,上面有所有需要的资讯

meaning: n. 兴奋，激动；使人兴奋的事物，令人激动的事；一阵强烈的感觉；（医）震颤；追求的快感；性快感；v. 使（某人）非常兴奋，非常激动；（情感，感觉）颤抖，振动；颤动，跳动
definition: 1. a feeling of extreme excitement, usually caused by something pleasant；2. to make someone feel very excited and pleased
example: I can remember the thrill of not knowing what I would get on Christmas morning.
exampleZh: 我记得，在不知道圣诞节早上会收到何种礼物时自己的激动心情。

meaning: v. 投，掷，抛，扔；掷（色子），掷出（色子的点数）；随手扔下（某物）；猛推，使劲撞；急伸，猛动（身体部位）；使迅猛地摔倒在地；使突然陷入；使困惑，使惊奇；把……拉成坯；投射（光或影子）；使嗓音听起来像来自他人（或别处）；故意输掉（比赛）；扳动（开关、操作杆等）；将……关进（监狱等）；大发脾气；（挥拳）猛击；举办（聚会）；投入，投身（于）；将……投向（某人）；（车辆）突然换挡；成功完成；迅速放置（或立起）；（马）脱落（蹄铁）；（动物）下仔；（在车床上）车（木料等）；捻（丝等）成线；n. 投，掷；投射距离；套，罩；摔倒对手；每一份（花费）；（地质）落差，位移；速转装置，旋转工具；摆动；（指针的）行程；冒险
definition: 1. n. the act of throwing (propelling something through the air with a rapid movement of the arm and wrist)；2. v. project through the air
example: and to kind of throw away my ideas that are perhaps a bit too creative, a bit too off the wall.
exampleZh: 放弃我那些过于新奇、太异类的想法。

meaning: n. （计量）公吨（1,000 公斤，等于 metric ton）
definition: n. a unit of weight equivalent to 1000 kilograms
example: The facility recently recorded finding 1,890 grammes of gold per tonne of ash from incinerated sludge.
exampleZh: 这个机构最近记录了从每吨焚化污泥后的灰烬中提取了1890克黄金。

meaning: adj. （物质，物体）坚韧的，坚固的；（政策或行动）强硬的，严厉的；吃苦耐劳的，坚韧不拔的；顽固的，固执的；困难的，棘手的；艰难的，困苦的，难熬的；（食物）老的，不易切开的，嚼不动的；（人）粗暴的，粗鲁的；（地区）充满暴力与犯罪的；不幸的，倒霉的，活该（表示不同情）；n. 恶棍；v. 坚持，忍受，忍耐；adv. 坚强地，坚定地；【名】 （Tough）（英）图赫（人名）
definition: 1. n. someone who learned to fight in the streets rather than being formally trained in the sport of boxing；2. adj. not given to gentleness or sentimentality
example: Although this kind of talk about "armed prophets always win" is characteristic of Machiavelli, he likes this kind of tough talk.
exampleZh: 虽然这种关于,“武装先知总是赢“的言论“,是马奇亚维利的特色，但他真的喜欢这种顽固的论调。

meaning: n. 交易，买卖，业务；（学术团体会议的）议事录，公报；（人与人之间的）交流，相互影响；事务（元），事项
definition: 1. n. the act of transacting within or between groups (as carrying on commercial activities)
example: The new device can also cancel the cheque after the transaction is complete.
exampleZh: 这种新设备还能在交易结束后将支票注销。

meaning: n. 旅行者，旅客（英式拼写；美式拼写为 traveler）
definition: n. a person who changes location
example: The tired traveller fell back on the bed and at once fell asleep.
exampleZh: 那个疲劳的旅客往床上一倒就睡着了。

meaning: adj. 部落的，部族的；；有组成集团倾向的，集团意识强的； 部落的，部族的；n. （尤指印度次大陆的）部落成员（tribals）；【名】 （Tribal）（法）特里巴尔（人名）
definition: 1. relating to a tribe；2. of or relating to a tribe
example: As an Arab sociologist puts it, in a tribal society you do not buy loyalty, you only rent it.
exampleZh: 正如一位阿拉伯社会学家所说，在一个部落社会中，你不是收买忠诚，只是在租赁。

meaning: n. 部落，宗族；一大群人，一大伙人；大家庭；许多人；（动物或植物的）群，族；（古罗马）行政部门；组织严密的社会（或政治）群体；【名】 （Tribe）（英）特赖布（人名）
definition: 1. a group of people, often of related families, who live together, sharing the same language, culture, and history, especially those who do not live in towns or cities；2. a large family or other group that someone belongs to
example: There were five guys, from this village in where this sort of tribe in Egypt,
exampleZh: 有五个人，他们来自这么一个埃及部落的一个村子，

meaning: n. 家庭教师，私人教师；导师，指导教师；大学助教；（负责成人教育或在大中学中有特别任务的）教师；（尤指音乐）课本；v. 指导，辅导，担任私人教师；当家庭教师，当大学助教，当大学导师
definition: 1. n. a person who gives private instruction (as in singing or acting)；2. v. be a tutor to someone; give individual instruction
example: You seem to be on very familiar terms with your tutor.
exampleZh: 你似乎和你的导师之间很随便。

meaning: adv. 两次；两倍，强（或好、难）的多
definition: 1. adv. two times；2. adv. to double the degree
example: and I also really like the, you know, going to the theatre as well obviously because I went twice.
exampleZh: 我还真的很喜欢去剧院。这很明显，因为我去过两次了。

meaning: adj. 不知道的，未察觉到的，未意识到的；adv. 意外地，不知不觉地
definition: adj. (often followed by `of') not aware；adj. not aware or knowing
example: Due to the fact that they did not read English, the prisoners were unaware of what they were signing.
exampleZh: 这些囚犯由于看不懂英语，不知道自己在签什么。

meaning: adv. 独特地，与众不同地，珍奇地；唯一地，仅，仅仅；（数学/技术）单义地，唯一确定地，一一对应地；（强调）极其，特别，非常
definition: adv. so as to be unique
example: The formalists are uniquely concerned, however, with the way in which literature is put together.
exampleZh: 形式主义者特别关注，文本是怎么被组合的。

meaning: n. 宇宙，天地万物（the universe）；领域，体系；（已知宇宙以外的）宇宙
definition: 1. n. everything that exists anywhere；2. n. (statistics) the entire aggregation of items from which samples can be drawn
example: The idea of a parallel universe is hard to grasp.
exampleZh: 认为另有一个平行宇宙的概念是很难理解的。

meaning: adj. 未经请求的，主动提供的，不请自来的
definition: adj. not asked for
example: The unsolicited ads appear prominently on the screen and are a pet peeve for many users.
exampleZh: 不请自来的广告显眼地出现在屏幕上，对于许多使用者来说是个恼人的事。

meaning: adj. 上面的，上层的，较高的；顶部的，上部的；（在机构、体系等中）较高级的，上级的；上游的，北部的；（地质，考古）晚期的，较近期的；n. 鞋面，鞋帮；兴奋剂（尤指安非他明）；【名】 （Upper）（英）厄珀（人名）
definition: 1. n. the higher of two berths；2. adj. higher in place or position
example: And I am going to superscript it molecular orbital, and this upper one, to indicate that it's antibonding, has the asterisk.
exampleZh: 我将给分子轨道加上标，这个上标，表示反键轨道，有一个星号。

meaning: v. （使）城市化；（使）农村人口迁徙到城市（等于 urbanize）
definition: v. impart urban habits, ways of life, or responsibilities upon；v. make more industrial or city-like
example: As the world continues to urbanise, the voices calling for rural preservation may well grow louder.
exampleZh: 随着世界继续城市化，呼吁保护农村的声音可能会越来越大。

meaning: adj. 紧急的，急迫的；急切的，催促的；（尤指某人的行动）执着的，坚定的
definition: 1. adj. compelling immediate action
example: There is an urgent need for food and water.
exampleZh: 有着对食品和水的迫切需要。

ipa: ˌjuː es ˈeɪ / ˌjuː es ˈeɪ
meaning: abbr. 美国，美利坚合众国（the United States of America）；（军事）美国陆军（United States Army）；n. 宇佐（日本地名、人名 Usa 的罗马字）；尤萨（人名 Usa 的译名）
definition: n. North American republic containing 50 states - 48 conterminous states in North America plus Alaska in northwest North America and the Hawaiian Islands in the Pacific Ocean; achieved independence in 1776；n. the army of the United States of America; the agency that organizes and trains soldiers for land warfare
example: and this I think only in the USA, New Orleans is the only other city that has cable cars.
exampleZh: 并且在美国的其它城市中，除了新奥尔良市，没有第三个城市还有有线缆车了。

meaning: adj. 有用的，有益的；好的，熟练的
definition: 1. adj. being of use or service；2. adj. having a useful function
example: These two relations involving entropy are also useful because they'll let us see how entropy depends on volume and pressure.
exampleZh: 这两个涉及熵的关系也非常有用,因为他们告诉我们,熵和体积，压强的关系。

meaning: adj. 通常的，惯常的；n. 常事（the usual）；常喝的饮料（尤指酒）（the usual）
definition: 1. adj. occurring or encountered or experienced or observed frequently or in accordance with regular practice or procedure；2. adj. commonly encountered
example: But I mean, yeah, I don't know. They are like teenagers after all really, the same as usual.
exampleZh: 但我的意思是，我不知道。他们毕竟都是青少年，跟普通人一样。

meaning: n. 真空，真空容器；真空吸尘器；空白，空虚；（用真空吸尘器所做的）清洁，清扫；v. 用真空吸尘器打扫；adj. 利用真空的；真空的；产生真空的
definition: 1. n. the absence of matter；2. v. clean with a vacuum cleaner
example: And, in between, there is void, which is very similar to how we would describe vacuum.
exampleZh: 而存在其中的，就是虚无了，那是与我们描述的真空很接近。

meaning: v. 批准，确认……有效；证实，确认；使生效，使具有法律效力；证明有……价值，认可
definition: 1. v. declare or make legally valid；2. v. prove valid; show or confirm the validity of something
example: as well as install them in the cars and validate the software that was with them.
exampleZh: 还把系统安装在车里并检验配对的软件。

meaning: adj. 巨大的，广大的；n. 广阔空间；【名】 （Vast）（法）瓦斯特（人名）
definition: 1. adj. unusually great in size or amount or degree or especially extent or scope
example: All of this monistic philosophy, I think, is implicit in the image of divinity's impregnation of the vast abyss.
exampleZh: 这所有的一元论观点，我认为，都可从神灵孕育洪荒这一意象中看出来。

meaning: n. 风险项目，冒险事业；冒险旅行，冒险行动；v. 敢于去（未知或危险等地方）；冒险；小心地说，谨慎地做；敢说，大胆表示；【名】 （Venture) （法）旺蒂尔（人名）
definition: 1. n. any venturesome undertaking especially one with an uncertain outcome；2. v. proceed somewhere despite the risk of possible dangers
example: I was still uncommitted to the venture when we reached Kanpur.
exampleZh: 直到我们到达坎普尔时，我还是不太支持这次冒险。

meaning: prep. （比赛或诉讼中）以……为对手，与……竞争；与……相对，与……相比
definition: 1. abstract: Versus is the diffusion line of noted Italian fashion house Versace. It began in 1989 as the first of many diffusion lines by the house, a gift by the founder Gianni Versace to his sister, Donatella Versace.
example: Only 18.8% of the class of 1982 had some kind of diploma four years after high school, versus 45% of the class of 1972.
exampleZh: 相对于1972届学生中有45%在中学毕业4年后获得了某种文凭来说，1982届学生的这一比例只有18.8%。

meaning: prep. 经由，经过（某一地方）；通过，借助于（某种手段或人）
definition: 1. abstract: Via is a genus of moths of the Noctuidae family.
example: I could actually swipe a card and generate electronic receipt via email and then send it out to a person.
exampleZh: 这下，我真的能刷刷卡，发一封邮件，把电子回执,发给对方。

meaning: adj. 可望成功的，切实可行的；能存活的，能生长发育的
definition: 1. able to work as intended or able to succeed；2. able to continue to exist as or develop into a living being
example: Now, recruiting is tremendously important because you need to have a certain number of settlers to make the settlement viable.
exampleZh: 招募是极其重要的,因为你需要有一定数量的移民,来维持居住地的运转

meaning: n. 电视观众，观众；观看者，观赏者，观察者；（计算机）查看器，查看程序；（光学）观片器
definition: n. a close observer; someone who looks at something (such as an exhibition of some kind)；n. an optical device for viewing photographic transparencies
example: My films try to describe a journey of discovery, both for myself and the viewer.
exampleZh: 我的影片力图为我自己和观众描述一段自我发现的心路历程。

meaning: n. 观点，看法；视角，观察点
definition: 1. n. a mental position from which things are viewed；2. n. a place from which something can be viewed
example: You have to know where to stand for a good viewpoint.
exampleZh: 你得知道站在哪儿才会有好的视角。

meaning: n. 访问者，参观者；（网站的）浏览者；客队队员（visitors）；候鸟；（大学或其他学术机构的）督察员
definition: 1. n. someone who visits
example: Reception just rang through to say my visitor has arrived.
exampleZh: 服务台刚刚打电话来说我的客人到了。

meaning: v. 投票选举，投票表决；投票评选；（通过投票）决定给予（资助），同意提供（款项）；表明，公认（某事好或坏）；投票同意；建议，主张；n. 选票，票；投票，表决；（选举中的）选票总数（the vote）；选举权，表决权；投票结果，表决结果；投票者，选民（the vote）；特定投票群体，特定选民；【名】 （Vote）（英、法）沃特（人名）
definition: 1. n. a choice that is made by counting the number of people in favor of each alternative；2. v. express one's preference for a candidate or for a measure or resolution; cast a vote
example: Now here's a question for you guys, which we're going to vote on, so you better start thinking about it.
exampleZh: 现在我希望，大家来，判断一下。

meaning: v. 等候；盼望，期待；推迟，延缓；（已备好）可处理，可取用；（用于鼓励或威胁）等着；（用于打断讲话）等一下，慢着；服侍，招待；n. 等待，等候的时间；（城镇）官方乐队（waits）；【名】 （Wait）（英）韦特，（捷）魏特（人名）
definition: 1. n. time during which some action is awaited；2. v. stay in one place and anticipate or expect something
example: And your dad is like, "Oh, give me a big hug, I can't wait to see you."
exampleZh: 你的爸爸说，“哦，来赶紧给爸爸抱一下，我等不及要见你了。”

meaning: n. 城墙，围墙；墙，壁，墙壁；屏障，壁垒；（感情或行为的）障碍，隔阂；人墙，隔离墙；（身体器官或动植物细胞等的）外壁；（盒子或管道等空心物的）内壁；堆得像墙一样的大量东西；柏林墙（the Wall）；防波堤，防洪堤；（尤指宏大的）峭立面；围住矿脉（或矿层）的岩石；梅戈拉毛眼蝶（同 wall brown）；v. 用墙围住（一区域）；砌墙封闭，砌墙堵住（wall sth. up）；把……关起来，禁闭（wall sb./sth. in/up）；adj. 墙壁的；【名】 （Wall）（英）沃尔，（德、芬、捷、瑞典）瓦尔（人名）
definition: 1. n. an architectural partition with a height and length greater than its thickness; used to divide or enclose an area or to support another structure；2. v. surround with a wall in order to fortify
example: A shudder in the loins engenders there The broken wall, the burning roof and tower And Agamemnon dead.
exampleZh: 腰肢的猛一颤动,残破的墙垣，燃烧的屋顶和塔巅,阿伽门农死去。

meaning: v. 漫游，游荡，漫步，流浪；走神，开小差；偏离，走偏（道路、航线等）；（目光）游移，往别处看；（河流、道路等）蜿蜒曲折；离题；（因年老而）神志恍惚，精神错乱；在人的身上摸来摸去（尤指他人不情愿时）；（对固定的性伴侣）不忠；n. 游荡，漫步；【名】 （Wander）万德（人名）
definition: 1. v. move about aimlessly or without any destination, often in search of food or employment；2. v. be sexually unfaithful to one's partner in marriage
example: You can't wander around any Greek city, or Roman city of the Ancient World, without seeing the latrine.
exampleZh: 古代希腊城市，及罗马城市，都有公共厕所。

meaning: n. 警示，提醒，告诫；（对不良行为的）警告；预告，预兆；adj. 表示警告的，告诫的；v. 提醒注意（可能发生的事），使警惕；劝告（使有所防备），告诫；警告（warn 的现在分词）；【名】 （Warning）（德）瓦宁（人名）
definition: 1. n. a message informing of danger；2. adj. serving to warn
example: Again, we'll arrange for this, but you need to give us enough warning so that we can deal with that.
exampleZh: 重申，我们会对此进行安排，不过你需要给我们足够的提醒,以便我们能及时处理。

meaning: contr. 我们将，我们会（we shall，we will）
example: To finish with, we'll listen to a few songs.
exampleZh: 最后我们将听几首歌。

meaning: v. 欢迎，迎接；迎新；乐意接纳，欣然接受；乐于接受（已发生的事）；庆祝；adj. （某人）受欢迎的；令人愉快的；（表示乐于让某人做某事）可随意；尽管……好了（指非常乐意让别人拥有自己不想要的东西）；n. 欢迎，迎接；（对观念的）接受；int. 欢迎；【名】 （Welcome） （美、印）韦尔科姆（人名）
definition: 1. n. the state of being welcome；2. v. accept gladly
example: So, if you want to go at 1:00, you're welcome to do so, but please arrange it with my assistants.
exampleZh: 如果你想去上1点的课，也可以，但是一定要和我的助教安排一下。

meaning: n. 幸福，安康；福利救济，社会福利；（给失业者和穷人的）福利救济金；adj. 福利的；接受社会救济的
definition: 1. n. governmental provision of economic assistance to persons in need；2. n. something that aids or promotes well-being
example: We don't care at all about corporations-- we should make that clear-- except as they contribute to individual welfare.
exampleZh: 我们完全不关心企业-,我们应该明确这一点-,除非它们对个人福利有贡献。

meaning: conj. 当……的时候；与…同时；然而，但是；虽然，尽管；直到…为止；与……同时；直到……为止
example: So whilst the Queen is in charge and is Head of the Church,
exampleZh: 所以，女王统治国家的同时，也是教堂的头领，

meaning: abbr. 无线保真技术（wireless fidelity）；无线上网技术
definition: n. a local area network that uses high frequency radio signals to transmit and receive data over distances of a few hundred feet; uses ethernet protocol
example: Yesterday’s introduction of a $139 wi-fi Kindle has sparked speculation about further price drops.
exampleZh: 而昨天，139美元的WiFi版Kindle面世，引来人们对进一步降价的猜测。

meaning: v. （使）变宽，加宽；（使）扩展，程度加深，范围扩大；（尤因惊讶或恐惧而眼睛）睁大；【名】 （Widen）（德）维登（人名）
definition: 1. v. become broader or wider or more extensive；2. v. make (clothes) larger
example: They may have to widen the road to cope with the increase in traffic.
exampleZh: 他们可能得拓宽这条道路以适应车辆的增多。

meaning: adj. 普遍的，广泛的
definition: 1. adj. widely circulated or diffused；2. adj. distributed over a considerable extent
example: Well, the conception of the universe that was widespread among ancient peoples is one that you're probably familiar with.
exampleZh: 那就是，对宇宙的理解,一个古人很崇尚,大家也很熟悉的说法。

meaning: adj. 愿意的，乐意的；乐于相助的，积极肯干的；出于自愿的，志愿的；v. 希望，想要（某事发生）；凭意志促使……做某事；立遗嘱遗赠（will 的现在分词形式）；【名】 （Willing）（德、芬、瑞典）维林，（英）威林（人名）
definition: 1. n. the act of making a choice；2. adj. disposed or inclined toward
example: At each cross-section, people are either willing to use a certain sign in a certain way or they're not.
exampleZh: 在每一个横街面上，人们可以自由的,以自己的方式使用符号。

meaning: adj. （行为或决定）明智的，高明的；有学问的，精通的；说话粗鲁的；v. 了解，知道；【名】 （Wise）（英）怀斯（人名）
definition: 1. n. a way of doing or being；2. adj. having or prompted by wisdom or discernment
example: She wrote a very compelling argument about O'Connor's fiction not about Wise Blood in particular, but about her stories.
exampleZh: 她针对奥克纳小说写过一篇极有说服力的文章,并不只是针对《慧血》，而是针对奥克纳的所有故事。

meaning: n. 收回，撤回，停止；（对所说人的话的）收回，撤回；撤军，撤退；不再参加，退出（组织）；提款，取钱；戒毒过程，脱瘾期；脱瘾症状；沉默寡言，孤僻
definition: 1. n. a retraction of a previously held position；2. n. the act of taking out money or other capital
example: He replied that the UN had passed two major resolutions calling for a complete withdrawal.
exampleZh: 他回复说联合国已经通过要求完全撤军的两项重大决议。

meaning: n. 车间，工场，作坊；研讨会，讲习班；v. （在正式上演前）研讨性演出（戏剧）
definition: 1. n. small workplace where handcrafts or manufacturing are done；2. n. a brief intensive course for a small group; emphasizes problem solving
example: She got a bank loan to rent and equip a small workshop.
exampleZh: 她取得一笔银行贷款来租用和装备一个小车间。

meaning: n. （职业的）作家，作者；执笔者，撰写人；写字……的人；（计算机）记录器；〈英，史〉文书，抄写员
definition: 1. n. writes (books or stories or articles or the like) professionally (for pay)；2. n. a person who is able to write and has written something
example: Moore is quoting here in that phrase "business documents and school-books," as she tells us, from Tolstoy, a prose writer.
exampleZh: 穆尔在那个短语里引用了这句,“商业文书和教科书“，正如她告诉我们的，引用来自托尔斯泰，俄国小说家。

meaning: adv. 是，是的，对；是吗？（升调，表示疑问或请对方继续说）；n. 是（表示肯定），肯定答复；赞成票
definition: 1. n. an affirmative
example: It's usually best to respond in a complete sentence rather than saying yes or no which can be ambiguous.
exampleZh: 一般来说，回答最好是完整的句子，而不是简单的模棱两可的“是”或“不是”。
